author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Whoever makes a mistake in a Surah, let
him recite ‘Surah Al Ikhlas’ and then bow."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: «مَنْ غَلِطَ
فِي سُورَةٍ فَلْيَقْرَأُ «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» ثُمَّ ليَرْكَعِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.295 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.697 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.110
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

From him, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Hammad ibn Uthman who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “Sometimes standing in prayer becomes
difficult for me.”
Imam {a.s} said: "If you want to attain the reward of the one who stands in prayer, then
recite while you are sitting, and when only two verses remain from the Surah, then
stand up, complete what remains, bow, and prostrate, that will be counted as the
prayer of one who stood."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَدْ
بَشتَدْ عَلَيَّ الْقِيَامُ فِي الصَّلاةِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تُذْرِكَ صَلاَةَ ٱلْقَائِمِ فَاقْرَأْ وَ أَنْتَ جَالِسُ فَإِذَا بَقِيَ مِنَ السُّورَةِ
آيَتَانِ فَقُمْ فَأْتِمَّ مَا بَقِيَ وَ اِرْكَعْ وَ اُسْجُدْ فَذَلِكَ صَلاَةُ ٱَلْقَائِمِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.364 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.295 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.113 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.498
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Sayf ibn Umayrah from Amir ibn Abdullah who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say: "Whoever recites something from
the Hawamim (the Surahs beginning with 'Ha Mim') in the Fajr prayer, for he will miss
the time (of the prayer due to length of the Surahs)."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ يَقُولُ: «مَنْ قَرَأْ شَيْئاً مِنَ الْحَوَامِيمِ فِي صَلَاَةِ الْفَجْرِ فَاتَهُ الْوَقْتُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.295
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Isma'il ibn Abd Al-Khaliq, from Muhammad ibn Abi Talhah, from Abd Al-Khaliq:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, used to recite in the two rak'ahs after the night
prayer (Al-Atamah) ‘Surah Al-Waqi'ah’ and ‘Surah Al Ikhlas’.
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْخَالِقِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْخَالِقِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ : أَنَّهُ
كَانَ يَقْرَأْ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ ٱلْعَتَمَةِ بِالْوَاقِعَةِ وَ «قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.295 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.667 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.112
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Al-Barqi, from Sa'd ibn Sa'd Al-Ash'ari, from Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him,
who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who recited Al-Hamd and half of a Surah in one rak'ah,
would it suffice in the second rak'ah not to recite Al-Hamd and only recite what
remains of the Surah?
Imam {a.s} said: "He should recite Al-Hamd, then recite what remains of the Surah."

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This narration is to be understood as referring to the
supererogatory (nafl) prayers, because we have already explained that in the
obligatory (fard) prayer, it is not permissible to recite less than a complete Surah along
with Al-Hamd.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْبَرْقِيِّ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ سَعْدِ الْأَشعَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ قَرَأَ فِي
رَكْعَةٍ الْحَمْدَ وَ نِصْفَ سُورَةِ هَلْ يُجْزِيهِ فِي الثَانِيَةِ أَنْ لاَ يَقْرَأ الْحَمْدَ وَ يَقْرَأْ مَا بَقِيَ مِنَ السُورَةِ فَقَالَ «يَقْرَأَ ٱلْحَمْدَ
ثُمَّ يَقْرَأْ مَا بَقِيَ مِنَ السُّورَةِ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : هذا الخبر محمول على صلاة النوافل لانا قد بينا ان الفريضة لا يقرأ فيها بأقل من سورة مع الحمد.
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This narration is to be understood as referring to the
supererogatory (nafl) prayers, because we have already explained that in the
obligatory (fard) prayer, it is not permissible to recite less than a complete Surah along
with Al-Hamd.”
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.295 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.316 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.676 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.45
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin, from his brother Al-Husayn ibn Ali, from their father Ali ibn Yaqtin
who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, about combining two Surahs in the
obligatory and the supererogatory prayers.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
And (Imam {a.s} was asked) about reciting part of a Surah.
Imam {a.s} said: "I dislike that, but there is no harm in it for the supererogatory prayers."
And (Imam {a.s} was asked) about the two rak'ahs in which the Imam (of prayer) remains
silent, should ‘Surah Al-Hamd’ be recited in them when one is following an Imam (of
prayer)?
Imam {a.s} said: "If you recite, there is no harm; and if you remain silent, there is no
harm."

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “His {a.s} statement, peace be upon him; "There is no
harm in combining two Surahs in the obligatory prayer," is to be understood as
meaning when one of the two Surahs is Al-Hamd.
And there is nothing apparent in the wording to suggest that it is permissible to recite
two Surahs after the recitation of Al-Hamd. And if it were not apparent in its wording,
we would interpret it according to what we have said, so as not to contradict the
previous narrations we have mentioned.
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنِ الْقِرَانِ بَيْنَ السُّورَتَيْنِ فِي الْمَكْتُوبَةِ وَ النَّافِلَةِ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ» وَ عَنْ تَبْعِيضِ السُّورَةِ قَالَ «أَكْرَهُ
ذَلِكَ وَ لا بَأْسَ بِهِ فِي النَّافِلَةِ» وَ عَنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اللَّتَيْنِ يَصْمُتُ فِيهِمَا الْإِمَامُ أَيُقْرَأُ فِيهِمَا بِالْحَمْدِ وَ هُوَ إِمَامٌ يُقْتَدَى
بِهِ قَالَ «إِنْ قَرَأْتَ فَلاَ بَأْسَ وَ إِنْ سَكَتَّ فَلاَ بَأْسَ».
قال محمد بن الحسن: قوله عليه السلام لا بأس بالقران بين السورتين في المكتوبة محمول على انه إذا كان احدى
السورتين الحمد وليس في الظاهر انه لا بأس بقرائتهما بعد قراءة الحمد، وإذا لم يكن ذلك في ظاهره حملناه على ما قلناه
لئلا ينافي ما قدمناه من الاخبار.
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “His {a.s} statement, peace be upon him; "There is no
harm in combining two Surahs in the obligatory prayer," is to be understood as
meaning when one of the two Surahs is Al-Hamd.
And there is nothing apparent in the wording to suggest that it is permissible to recite
two Surahs after the recitation of Al-Hamd. And if it were not apparent in its wording,
we would interpret it according to what we have said, so as not to contradict the
previous narrations we have mentioned.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.296
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
text_chunk:
From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin, from his brother Al-Husayn ibn Ali, from their father Ali ibn Yaqtin
who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, about combining two Surahs in the
obligatory and the supererogatory prayers.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
And (Imam {a.s} was asked) about reciting part of a Surah.
Imam {a.s} said: "I dislike that, but there is no harm in it for the supererogatory prayers."
And (Imam {a.s} was asked) about the two rak'ahs in which the Imam (of prayer) remains
silent, should ‘Surah Al-Hamd’ be recited in them when one is following an Imam (of
prayer)?
Imam {a.s} said: "If you recite, there is no harm; and if you remain silent, there is no
harm." Scholar's Note:

harm in combining two Surahs in the obligatory prayer," is to be understood as

previous narrations we have mentioned.

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Al-‘Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa {a.s}, peace
be upon him, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man who recites in an obligatory prayer the ‘Opening of the
Book’ (Surah Al-Fatiha) and another Surah in one breath.
Imam {a.s} said: "If he wishes, he may recite them in one breath, and if he wishes, he
may recite them in separate breaths."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيّى عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى ع قَالَ: سَأَلْثُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَقْرَأْ فِي
الْفَرِيضَةِ - بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ وَ سُورَةِ أُخْرَى فِي النَّفَسِ الْوَاجِدِ قَالَ «إِنْ شَاءَ قَرَأَ فِي نَفَسِ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ فِي غَيْرِهِ».
cross_references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.236 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.296 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.699 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.113

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Abu Ishaq, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Muhammad ibn Udhafir, from Abu Abdillah {a.s},
peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about joining the prayer behind someone while I am reciting behind
him in the second rak'ah, and he bows just as I finish reciting the ‘Opening of the Book’
(Surah Al-Fatiha).
Imam {a.s} said: "Recite in the last two rak'ahs so that you will have recited in two
rak'ahs."
text_ar:
وَ عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُذَافِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ
دُخُولِي مَعَ مَنْ أَقْرَأْ خَلْفَهُ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ فَيَرْكَعُ عِنْدَ فَرَاغِي مِنْ قِرَاءَةِ أُمِّ الْكِتَابِ فَقَالَ « تَقْرَأُ فِي ٱلْأَخْرَاوَيْنِ
كَي تَكُونَ قَدْ قَرَأْتَ فِي رَكْعَتَيْنِ».
cross_references: ‘Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.340 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.296 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1211 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.363 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.369 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 5 p.87

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Al-Husayn, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar ibn
Musa:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said regarding a man who forgets a letter from
the Qur'an and remembers it while he is bowing, is it permissible for him to recite it?
Imam {a.s} said: "No, but when he prostrates, let him recite it."
And Imam {a.s} said: "When a man recites ‘By the sun and its brightness’ (Surah Al-
Shams), upon completing it, he should say: 'Allah {SWT} and His Messenger {saws} have
spoken the truth.'
And when a man recites ‘Is Allah {SWT} better, or what they associate with Him?’ (Surah
An-Naml 27:59), he should say: 'Allah {SWT} is better, Allah {SWT} is better, Allah {SWT} is
greater.'
And when he recites ‘Then those who disbelieve set equals with their Lord’ (Surah Al-
An‘am 6:1), he should say: 'Those who set equals with Allah {SWT} have lied.'
And when he recites ‘Praise be to Allah {SWT}, who has not taken a son, and who has no
partner in His dominion, nor any protector out of weakness, and glorify Him with great
glorification’ (Surah Al-Isra’ 17:111), he should say: 'Allah {SWT} is the Greatest, Allah {SWT}
is the Greatest, Allah {SWT} is the Greatest.'"
I asked: “What if a man does not say anything of this when he recites?”
Imam {a.s} said: "There is nothing upon him."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةً عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ : فِي الرَّجْلِ يَنْسَى حَرْفاً مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ فَذَكَرَ وَ هُوَ رَاكِعْ هَلْ يَجُوزُ لَهُ أَنْ يَقْرَأَهُ قَالَ «لا وَ لَكِنْ إِذَا سَجَدَ
فَلْيَقْرَأْهُ» - وَ قَالَ «اَلرَّجُلُ إِذَا قَرَأَ «وَ الشَّمْسِ وَ ضُحاها» فَيَخْتِمُهَا أَنْ يَقُولَ صَدَقَ اللَهُ وَ صَدَقَ رَسُولُهُ وَ الرَّجُلُ
إِذَا قَرَأَ «آللهُ خَيْرٌ أَمَا يُشرِكُونَ» أَنْ يَقُولَ اللّهُ خَيْرٌ اللّهُ خَيْرٌ اللّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَ إِذَا قَرَأَ «ثُمَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا بِرَبِّهمْ يَعْدِلُونَ»
أَنْ يَقُولَ كَذَبَ الْعَادِلُونَ بِاللَّه وَ الرَّجُلُ إذَا قَرَأَ «الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ الَّذِي لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَداً وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ شَرِيْكٌ فِي اَلْمُلْكِ وَلَمْ
يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلِي مِنَ الذُّلِّ وَ كَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيراً» أَنْ يَقُولَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ» قُلْتُ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَقُلِ الرَّجُلُ شَيْئاً مِنْ هَذَا
إِذَا قَرَأْ قَالَ «لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.297 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.674
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Musa Al-Khashshab, from Ghiyath ibn Kallub, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from
(Imam) Ja'far {a.s}, from his father {a.s}, peace be upon them both:
(Imam {a.s} said) "Two men from among the companions of the Messenger of Allah {SWT},
may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, differed regarding the prayer of the Messenger
of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family.
So they wrote to Ubayy ibn Ka'b asking: “How many pauses did the Messenger of Allah
{SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, have in his prayer?”
He said: “He had two pauses, one when he finished reciting the ‘Opening of the Book’
(Surah Al-Fatiha) and another when he finished the Surah."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُوسَى الْخَشَابِ عَنْ غِيَاتِ بْنِ كَلُوبِ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيِهِ عَلَيْهِمَا السِّلَاَمُ
: «أَنّ رَجُلَيْنٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابٍ رَسُولِ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ اِخْتَلَفًا فِي صَلاَةِ رَسُولِ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
فَكَتَبَا إِلَى أَبَيَّ بْنِ كَعْبِ كَمْ كَانَتْ - لِرَسُولِ اللّهِ صَلّى اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ مِنْ سَكْتَةٍ قَالَ كَانَتْ لَهُ سَكْتَتَانِ إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنْ
أَمِّ الْقُرْآنِ وَ إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنَ السُّورَةِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.297 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.700 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.114 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.1 p.25 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.1 p.83

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah who said:
Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "When you intend to bow and to prostrate,
raise your hands and then bow and prostrate."
text_ar:
عَلِي بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السّلاَمُ : «إِذَا أَرَدْتَ
أَنْ تَرْكَعَ وَ تَسْجُدَ فَارْفَع يَدَيْكَ ثُمَّ اِرْكَغْ وَ أُسْجُدْ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.320 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.297 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.702 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.296
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Musa ibn Yasar Al-Minqari from Ali ibn
Ja'far Al-Sakuni from Isma'il ibn Muslim Al-Sha'iri from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, from his father {a.s}, from his
forefathers {a.s}, peace be upon them:
The Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, said:
"Place the two hands where you place the face, for indeed they both prostrate just as
the face prostrates."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ يَسَارِ ٱلْمِنْقَرِيَّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرِ السَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ
إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ الشَّعِيرِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ آللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلاَمُ أَنّ اَلنَّبِيَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
قَالَ: «ضَعُوا اَلْيَدَيْنِ حَيْثُ تَضَعُونَ ٱلْوَجْهَ فَإِنَّهُمَا يَسْجُدَانٍ كَمَا يَسْجُدُ الْوَجْهُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.297 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.719 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.357
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Musa ibn Umar, from Al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Ibn Bukayr and Tha'labah, from Burayd:
Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "The forehead to the nose, whichever of them
you place upon the ground in prostration, it suffices you, and prostrating with all of it
(the entire forehead and nose) is better."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ وَ تَعْلَبَةَ عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ:
«الْجَبْهَةُ إِلَى الْأَنْفِ أَيّ ذَلِكَ أَصَبْتَ بِهِ الْأَرْضَ فِي السُجُودِ أَجْزَأَكَ وَ السُجُودُ عَلَيْهِ كُلَّهِ أَفْضَلُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.298 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.326 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.716 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.356
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
text_chunk:
From him, from Musa ibn Umar, from Al-Hasan ibn Faddal, from Ibn Bukayr and Tha'labah, from Burayd:
Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "The forehead to the nose, whichever of them
you place upon the ground in prostration, it suffices you, and prostrating with all of it
(the entire forehead and nose) is better."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Abu Abdillah Al-Barqi from Muhammad ibn Musadif, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s} say: "Indeed, the prostration is upon the forehead, and there
is no prostration upon the nose."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَرْقِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ مُصَادِفٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ
يَقُولُ: «إِنَّمَا السُّجُودُ عَلَى الْجَبْهَةِ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَى الْأَنْفِ سُجُودٌ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.298 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.326 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.717 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.343
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Abu Abdillah Al-Barqi from Muhammad ibn Musadif, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s} say: "Indeed, the prostration is upon the forehead, and there
is no prostration upon the nose."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Marwan ibn Muslim and Ammar Al-Sabati:
(Imam {a.s}) said: "The area between the hairline and the tip of the nose is a place of
prostration; whichever part of that you place on the ground suffices you."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ وَ عَمَّارٍ السَّابَاطِيَّ قَالَ: «مَا بَيْنَ قُصَاصِ الشَّعْرِ إِلَى طَرَفٍ
الْأَثْفٍ مَسْجِدٌ أَيُّ ذَلِكَ أَصَبْتَ بِهِ الْأَرْضَ أَجْزَأَكَ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.271 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.298 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.327 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.716 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.356

From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Marwan ibn Muslim and Ammar Al-Sabati:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ammar from (Imam)
Ja'far {a.s} from his father {a.s}, peace be upon them both:
(Imam {a.s}) said: “(Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: ‘The prayer is not sufficient
if the nose does not touch what the forehead touches’."

Scholar's Note:
Thus, this narration is to be understood as indicating a kind of disliked (action) and not
an obligation, because the obligation is the prostration upon the forehead, and
pressing the nose is a recommended act, as we have explained. What also indicates
its being disliked is what was narrated:
text_ar:
فَأَمّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ قَالَ قَالَ عَلِيْ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ : «لا تُجْزِي صَلاَةُ لا يُصِيبُ الْأَنْفُ مَا يُصِيبُ الْجَبِينُ».
فهذه الرواية محمولة على ضرب من الكراهية دون الفرض لان الفرض هو السجود على الجبهة والارغام بالانف سنة على
ما بيناه، والذي يدل على كراهيته أيضا ما رواه :
commentary:
Thus, this narration is to be understood as indicating a kind of disliked (action) and not
an obligation, because the obligation is the prostration upon the forehead, and
pressing the nose is a recommended act, as we have explained. What also indicates
its being disliked is what was narrated:
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.298
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah ibn Zayd from (Imam)
Ja'far {a.s} from his father {a.s}, peace be upon them both:
(Imam {a.s}) said: "Indeed, (Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, disliked arranging the
pebbles during the prayer, and He {a.s} used to dislike that one should pray upon the
hairline until he lets it fall naturally."

Scholar's Note:
And we have explained in the narration of Muhammad ibn Musadif and others that
there is no prostration upon the nose, and what also indicates this is what was
narrated:
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدِ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «إِنّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَامُ كَرِهَ تَنْظِيمَ الْحَصَى فِي الصَّلَاةِ وَ كَانَ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ عَلَى قُصَاص شَعْرِهِ حَتَّى يُرْسِلَهُ إِرْسَالاً».
وقد بينا في رواية محمد بن مصادف وغيره انه ليس على الانف سجود، ويدل على ذلك أيضا ما رواه :
commentary:
And we have explained in the narration of Muhammad ibn Musadif and others that
there is no prostration upon the nose, and what also indicates this is what was
narrated:

source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Najran from Hammad ibn Isa from
Hariz from Zurarah, who said:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless
him and his family, said: ‘Prostration is upon seven bones: the forehead, the two
hands, the two knees, and the two big toes, and you press your nose firmly in humility.
As for the obligation, it is these seven, and as for pressing the nose, it is a Sunnah from
the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ
قَالَ أَبْو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «السُجُودُ عَلَى سَبْعَةٍ أَعْظُمِ ٱلْجَبْهَةِ وَ الْيَدَيْنِ وَ
الرُكْبَتَيْنِ وَ الْإنْهَامَيْنِ وَتُرْغِمُ بِأَنْفِكَ إِرْغَاما فَأَمَّا ٱلْفَرْضُ فَهَذِهِ السَّبْعَةُ وَ أَمَّا ٱلْإرْغَامُ بِالْأَنْفِ فَسُنّةٌ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى
اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.299 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.329 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.718 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.343
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Umar Al-Halabi from Aban ibn Taghlib, who said:
I entered upon Abu Abdillah {a.s}, while He {a.s} was praying, and I counted for Him {a.s} in
the bowing and the prostration sixty tasbihat.
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عُمَرَ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ تَغْلِبَ قَالَ: دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي .
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ وَ هُوَ
يُصَلِّي فَعَدَدْتُ لَهُ فِي الرُّكُوعِ وَ السُّجُودِ سِتَّينَ تَسْبِيحَةً.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.329 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.299 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.93 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.708 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.304 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.4 7 p.50 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.2 0 p.138
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Umar Al-Halabi from Aban ibn Taghlib, who said:
I entered upon Abu Abdillah {a.s}, while He {a.s} was praying, and I counted for Him {a.s} in

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about a man who remembers the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT}
bless him and his family, while he is in the obligatory prayer, whether bowing or
prostrating, and he sends blessings upon Him {saws} while in that state.
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, indeed, sending blessings upon the Prophet of Allah {SWT}, may
Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, is like the takbir and the tasbih, and it is ten good
deeds, and eighteen angels hasten to deliver it to him, each vying as to who will convey
it to him."
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الرّجُلِ
يَذْكُرُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ هُوَ فِي الصَّلاةِ ٱلْمَكْثُوبَةِ إِمَّا رَاكِعاً وَ إمَّا سَاجِداً فَيُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ وَ هُوَ عَلَى تِلْكَ
الْحَالٍ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ إِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ عَلَى نَبِيَّ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَهَيْئَةِ التَّكْبِيرِ وَ التَّسْبِيحِ وَ هِيَ عَشَرُ حَسَنَاتٍ
يَنْتَدِرُهَا ثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ مَلَكاً أَيُّهُمْ يُبَلِّغُهَا إِيَّاهُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.322 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.299 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.885 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.326
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Fadalah from Aban from Abdurrahman ibn Sayabah, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “Shall I supplicate to Allah {SWT} while I am in prostration?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, so supplicate for the world and the Hereafter, for indeed He {AZJ} is
the Lord {AZJ} of the world and the Hereafter."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَيَابَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَدْعُو اَللَّهَ وَ أَنَا سَاجِدْ
فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ فَادْعُ لِلدُّنْيَا وَ اَلْآخِرَةِ فَإِنَّهُ رَبُّ اَلدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.323 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.299 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.2 p.44 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.881 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.371
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
Abu Basir led us in prayer on the way to Mecca, and while he was in prostration, and
their camel had been lost, he said: “O Allah {SWT}, return so-and-so’s camel to him.”
Muhammad (ibn Muslim) said: “Then I entered upon Abu Abdillah {a.s}, and informed
him, and Imam {a.s} said: "And he did that?"
I said: “Yes”.
Imam {a.s} then remained silent.
I asked: “Should I repeat the prayer?”
Imam {a.s} said: "No."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: صَلَّى بِنَا أَبُو بَصِيرٍ فِي طَرِيقٍ
مَكَّةَ فَقَالَ وَ هُوَ سَاجِدٌ وَ قَدْ كَانَتْ ضَاعَتْ نَاقَةٌ لَهُمْ اللَّهُمَّ رُدَّ عَلَى فُلاَنِ نَاقَتَهُ قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى أُبِي عَبْدِ
اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فَأْخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ «وَ فَعَلَ » فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ قَالَ فَسَكَتَ قُلْتُ أَفَأْعِيدُ الصَّلاةَ قَالَ «لا».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.300
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Ibn Mahbub from Abu Jarir Al-Rawasi, who said:
I heard Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, while He {a.s} was saying:
"O Allah {SWT}, I ask You {AZJ} for comfort at the time of death and pardon at the time of
the reckoning," and He {a.s} kept repeating it.
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَرِيرِ الرَّوَّاسِيَّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَ هُوَ يَقُولُ : « اَللَّهُمَ إِنَّي أَسْأَلُكَ
اَلرَّاحَةَ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ وَ الْعَفْوَ عِنْدَ الْحِسَابِ » يُرَدِّدُهَا.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.300 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1670 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 3 p.216
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
text_chunk:
From him, from Ibn Mahbub from Abu Jarir Al-Rawasi, who said:
I heard Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, while He {a.s} was saying:
"O Allah {SWT}, I ask You {AZJ} for comfort at the time of death and pardon at the time of
the reckoning," and He {a.s} kept repeating it.

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Faddal from Ibn Bukayr from Hamzah ibn Humran and Al-Hasan ibn Ziyad,
who said:
We entered upon Abu Abdillah {a.s}, and with Him {a.s} were a group of people.
He {a.s} led them in the Asr prayer, and we had already prayed, so we counted for Him
{a.s} in his bowing "Glory be to my Lord {AZJ}, the Great" either four or thirty-three times,
and one of them mentioned in his narration "and with His {AZJ} praise" in the bowing and
the prostration.

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “The basis in the congregational prayer is lightness,
and this narration can be understood in that the group with whom he prayed were
capable of enduring lengthiness and strong in bearing it, and for that reason, He {a.s},
peace be upon him, did so.”
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ حُمْرَانَ وَ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ قَالاَ: دَخَلْنَا عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ وَ عِنْدَهُ قَوْمٌ فَصَلَّى بِهِمُ الْعَصْرَ وَ قَدْ كُنَّا صَلَّيْنَا فَعَدَدْنَا لَهُ فِي رُكُوعِهِ « سُبْحَانَ رَبِّيَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ» أَرْبَعاً
أَوْ ثَلاثاً وَ ثَلاَثِينَ مَرَّةً وَ قَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا فِي حَدِيثِهِ «وَ بِحَمْدِهِ» فِي الرُّكُوعِ وَ السُّجُودِ.
قال محمد بن الحسن : الاصل في صلاة الجماعة التخفيف وهذه الرواية يمكن أن يكون الوجه فيها ان القوم الذين صلى
بهم كانوا مطيقين للاطالة واقوياء عليه فلاجل ذلك فعل عليه السلام ذلك.
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “The basis in the congregational prayer is lightness,
and this narration can be understood in that the group with whom he prayed were
capable of enduring lengthiness and strong in bearing it, and for that reason, He {a.s},
peace be upon him, did so.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Aban ibn Uthman from Abdurrahman ibn Abi Abdillah from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man, when he bows and then raises his head, should he first
place his hands on the ground or his knees?
Imam {a.s} said: "It does not harm him whichever of them he begins with; it is accepted
from him."

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “His {a.s}, peace be upon him, saying; "It does not harm
him whichever of them he begins with," means that his prayer is not invalidated,
although the preferable way is what we have previously mentioned, that he should
receive the ground with his hands, except in a case of necessity.”
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ ٱلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ آَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱَلسِّلاَمُ
قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ إِذَا رَكَعَ ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ أَيَبْدَأُ فَيَضَعُ يَدَيْهِ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ رُكْبَتَيْهِ قَالَ «لا يَضُرُهُ بِأَيِّ ذَلِكَ
بَدَأْ هُوَ مَقْبُولٌ مِنْهُ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : قوله عليه السلام لا يضره ذلك بايهما بدأ معناه انه لا يبطل صلاته وان كان الافضل ما قدمناه من
انه ينبغي ان يتلقى الارض بيديه الا عند الضرورة.
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “His {a.s}, peace be upon him, saying; "It does not harm
him whichever of them he begins with," means that his prayer is not invalidated,
although the preferable way is what we have previously mentioned, that he should
receive the ground with his hands, except in a case of necessity.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from Ubaydullah
Al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said: "There is no harm in sitting in the Iq'a' position during the
prayer between the two prostrations." (sitting back on the heels with the bottom of the
toes, and the knees, upon the ground)

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This narration is a concession, and the preferable way
is what we have previously mentioned, that he should not sit in the Iq'a' position
between the two prostrations”.
And what confirms this is what was narrated:
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «لَا بَأْسَ بِالْإِقْعَاءِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فِيمَا بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : هذه الرواية رخصة والافضل ما قدمناه من انه لا يقعي بين السجدتين ، ويؤكد ذلك ما رواه:
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This narration is a concession, and the preferable way
is what we have previously mentioned, that he should not sit in the Iq'a' position
between the two prostrations”.
And what confirms this is what was narrated:

اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا تُقْع بَيْنَ السِّجْدَتَيْنِ إِقْعَاءَ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi' from Abu Isma'il Al-Sarraj from Harun ibn
Kharijah, who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah {a.s} while He {a.s} was in prostration, and He {a.s} had lifted his feet from
the ground, with one of his feet placed upon the other.

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “It is possible that He, peace be upon him, only did
that out of necessity, because the preferable way is what we have previously
mentioned, which is placing the two big toes upon the ground.”
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِبعِ عَنْ أَبِي إسْمَاعِيلَ السِّرَّاجِ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ خَارِجَةَ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا
عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَ هُوَ سَاجِدٌ وَ قَدْ رَفَعَ قَدَمَيْهِ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ وَ إِحْدَى قَدَمَيْهِ عَلَى اَلْأُخْرَى.
قال محمد بن الحسن: يجوز أن يكون إنما فعل ذلك لضرورة لان الافضل ما قدمناه من وضع الابهامين على الارض.
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “It is possible that He, peace be upon him, only did
that out of necessity, because the preferable way is what we have previously
mentioned, which is placing the two big toes upon the ground.”

Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah {a.s} leveling the pebbles at the place of his prostration between the
two prostrations.
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يُسَوِّي
اَلْحَصَى فِي مَوْضِعٍ سُجُودِهِ بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ.

I asked Imam {a.s}: “Should a man wipe his forehead during the prayer if dust sticks to
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, indeed Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, used to wipe his forehead

عَنَهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْثُهُ أ

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn Al-Hakam from Abu Abdillah
{a.s}, who said:
I said to Imam {a.s}: “Is it sufficient that I say instead of the tasbih in bowing and
prostration, ‘There is no god but Allah {SWT}, and praise be to Allah {SWT}, and Allah {SWT} is
the Greatest?’
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, all of this is remembrance of Allah {SWT}."
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ يُجْزِي أَنْ
أَقُولَ مَكَانَ ٱلتَّسْبِيحِ فِي الرُّكُوعِ وَ السُّجُودِ - لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللَّهُ وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلّهِ وَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ كُلُّ هَذَا ذِكْرُ اللَّهِ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Mu'awiyah ibn Hakim from Abu Malik Al-Hadrami from Al-Husayn ibn
Hammad, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “I prostrate and my forehead falls upon a raised surface.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Raise your head and then place it (properly)."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ حُكَيْمِ عَنْ أَبِي مَالِكِ الْحَضْرَمِيَّ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَسْجُدُ فَتَقَعُ جَبْهَتِي عَلَى الْمَوْضِعِ الْمُرْتَفِعِ قَالَ «اِرْفَعْ رَأْسَكَ ثُمَّ ضَعْهُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.302 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.720 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.354 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.129
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Mu'awiyah ibn Hakim from Abu Malik Al-Hadrami from Al-Husayn ibn

I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “I prostrate and my forehead falls upon a raised surface.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Raise your head and then place it (properly)."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Safwan from Ishaq ibn Ammar from a man from Banu Ijl, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about a place that has dust in it, so I blow on it when I want to
prostrate.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ إسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي عِجْلٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ
عَنِ الْمَكَانِ يَكُونُ فِيهِ الْغُبَارُ فَأْتْفُخُهُ إِذَا أَرَدْتُ السُّجُودَ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.302 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.329 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.907 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.350

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Isma'il from Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan ibn Yahya from Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar, who
said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "When you place your forehead upon a clod of earth, do not lift
it, but rather drag it along the ground."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ: «إِذَا وَضَعْتَ جَبْهَتَكَ عَلَى نَبَكَةٍ فَلاَ تَرْفَعْهَا وَ لَكِنْ جُرَّهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.333 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.302 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.720 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.353 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.129

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad from Al-Fadl from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Abdillah
{a.s}, who said:
I said to Him {a.s}: “A man blows during the prayer upon the place of his forehead.”
Imam {a.s} said: "No."

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This report is to be understood as indicating dislike,
based on the evidence of the reports we have previously presented.”
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدٌ عَنِ الْفَضْلِ عَنْ حَمَادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ
الرَّجُلُ يَنْفُخُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ مَوْضِعَ جَبْهَتِهِ فَقَالَ «لا».
قال محمد بن الحسن : هذا الخبر محمول على الكراهية بدلالة ما قدمناه من الاخبار.
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This report is to be understood as indicating dislike,
based on the evidence of the reports we have previously presented.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ali from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "When a man prostrates and then wants to rise, he should not
knead the ground with his hands, but rather he should spread his palms without
placing his buttocks on the ground."
text_ar:
عَلِيْ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا سَجَدَ الرَّجُلُ ثُمَّ
أَرَادَ أَنْ يَنْهَضَ فَلاَ يَعْجِنُ بِيَدَيْهِ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَ لَكِنْ يَبْسُطُ كَفِّيْهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يَضَعَ مَقْعَدَتَهُ فِي الْأَرْضِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.336 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.303 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.726 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.374
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Ali from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "When a man prostrates and then wants to rise, he should not
knead the ground with his hands, but rather he should spread his palms without
placing his buttocks on the ground."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
As for what was narrated by Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Nadr from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah from
Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar, who said:
Al-Mu'alla ibn Khunays asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, while I was with Imam {a.s}, about
prostrating upon a barren land and upon tar.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in it."

Scholar's Note:
For it is to be understood as referring to a situation of necessity or dissimulation
(taqiyyah), and it is not permissible in the case of choice, and what indicates this is
what was narrated:
text_ar:
فَأَمًا مَا رَوَاهُ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: سَأَلَ ٱلْمُعَلِّى بْنُ
خُنَيْسِ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَ أَنَا عِنْدَهُ عَنِ السُّجُودِ عَلَى الْقُفْرِ وَ عَلَى الْقِيرِ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِهِ».
فانه محمول على حال الضرورة أو التقية ولا يجوز ذلك مع الاختيار، والذي يدل على ذلك ما رواه :
commentary:
For it is to be understood as referring to a situation of necessity or dissimulation
(taqiyyah), and it is not permissible in the case of choice, and what indicates this is
what was narrated:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Khalid from Al-Qasim ibn Urwah from Abu Al-Abbas Al-Fadl
ibn Abd Al-Malik, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "Do not prostrate except upon the earth or what the earth grows,
except for cotton and linen."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بَنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْعَبَّاسِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ
اللّه عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : «لَا تَسْجُدْ إِلَّ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ أَوْ مَا أَنْبَتَتِ الْأَرْضُ إِلَّ الْقُطْنَ وَ الْكَثَّانَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.330 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.303 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.331 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.729 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.344 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.344 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.149
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Khalid from Al-Qasim ibn Urwah from Abu Al-Abbas Al-Fadl
ibn Abd Al-Malik, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "Do not prostrate except upon the earth or what the earth grows,
except for cotton and linen."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ali from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah from Abu Ja'far {a.s}, peace be upon him,
who said:
I said to Him {a.s}: “Shall I prostrate upon zift, meaning tar?”
Imam {a.s} said: "No, and not upon a garment of cotton, nor upon wool, nor upon
anything from an animal, nor upon food, nor upon anything from the fruits of the earth,
nor upon anything from feathers."
text_ar:
عَلِيّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أَسْجُدُ عَلَى الزِّفْتِ
بَعنِي الْقِيرَ فَقَالَ «لا وَ لاَ عَلَى الثَّوْبِ الْكُرْسُفِ وَ لاَ عَلَى الصُّوفِ وَ لاَ عَلَى شَيْءٍ مِنَ ٱلْحَيَوَانِ وَ لاَ عَلَى طَعَامٍ وَ لا
عَلَى شَيْءٍ مِنْ ثِمَارِ الْأَرْضِ وَ لاَ عَلَى شَيْءٍ مِنَ الرِّيَاشِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.330 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.303 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.331 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.730 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.346 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.86
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}

Ali from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah from Abu Ja'far {a.s}, peace be upon him,

Imam {a.s} said: "No, and not upon a garment of cotton, nor upon wool, nor upon

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, about plaster (Gypsum) that had been burned with dung and
the bones of the dead, and with which the mosque was plastered, is it permissible to
prostrate upon it?
So Imam {a.s} wrote to me in his own handwriting: "Indeed, the water and the fire have
purified it."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ عَنِ الْجِصِّ يُوقَدُ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَذِرَةِ وَ
عِظَامِ ٱلْمَوْتَى وَ يُجَصْصُ بِهِ ٱلْمَسْجِدُ أَيُسْجَدُ عَلَيْهِ فَكَتَبَ إلَيْ بِخَطَّهِ «إِنّ ٱلْمَاءَ وَ ٱلنَّارَ قَدْ طَهْرَاهُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.330 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.304 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.306 • Al- Wafi, Vol.6 p.234 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.738 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.527 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.358

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Ali ibn Isma'il from Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Sa'id:
Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha, peace be upon him, said: "Do not prostrate upon barren land,
nor upon tar, nor upon plaster."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «لا تَسْجُدْ عَلَى
اَلْقُفْرِ وَلا عَلَى الْقِيرِ وَ لا عَلَى الصَّارُوجِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.304 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.334 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.353

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn Al-Walid from Yunus ibn Ya'qub:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "Do not prostrate upon gold nor upon silver."
text_ar:
سَهَلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا تَسْجُدْ عَلَى
الذَّهَب وَلاً عَلَى الْفِضَّةِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.332 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.304 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.736 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.361
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Sahl ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn Al-Walid from Yunus ibn Ya'qub:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "Do not prostrate upon gold nor upon silver."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Yahya from Al-Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja'far {a.s} said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man praying upon fresh grass that has grown.
Imam {a.s} said: "If he presses his forehead to the ground, then there is no harm."
And about praying upon thick grown grass (thayyil) that covers solid ground.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيَّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلرَّجُلِ
يُصَلِّي عَلَى الرَّطْبَةِ النَّابِتَةِ قَالَ فَقَالَ «إِذَا أَلْصَقَ جَبْهَتَهُ بِالْأَرْضِ فَلا بَأْسَ» وَ عَلَى الْحَشِيشِ النَّابِتِ اَلثَّيِّلِ وَ هُوَ
يُصِيبُ أَرْضاً جَدَداً قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.332 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.304 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.734 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.361
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}

Imam {a.s} said: "If he presses his forehead to the ground, then there is no harm."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn:
Some of our companions wrote to Abu Al-Hasan Al-Madi, peace be upon him, asking
him about praying upon glass.
He said: “When my letter reached Imam {a.s}, I reflected and said to myself: ‘it is from
what the earth has produced, and I should not have asked about it.’”
So Imam {a.s} wrote back to him: "Do not pray upon glass, even if your soul suggests to
you that it is from what the earth has produced, for it is from salt and sand, and both
are transformed (altered)."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيّى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ : أَنَّ بَعْضَ أَصْحَابِنَا كَتَبَ إِلَى أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الْمَاضِي عَ يَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ الصَّلاةِ
عَلَى الزَّجَاجِ قَالَ فَلَمَا نَفَدَ كِتَابِي إِلَيْهِ تَفَكَّرْتُ وَ قُلْتُ هُوَ مِمَّا أَنْبَتَتِ الْأَرْضُ وَ مَا كَانَ لِي أَنْ أَسْأَلَ عَنْهُ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ
«لا تُصَلَّ عَلَى ٱلزُّجَاجِ وَ إِنْ حَدَّثَثْكَ نَفْسُكَ أَنَّهُ مِمَّا أَنْبَتَتِ الْأَرْضُ وَ لَكِنَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمِلْحِ وَ الرَّمْلِ وَ هُمَا مَمْسُوخَانِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.332 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.304 • Al-Manaqib, Vol.4 p.304 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.737 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.360 • Madinat Ma’ajiz Al-A’immah, Vol.6 p.345 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.4 8 p.37 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.2 1 p.78
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}

text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Jamil ibn Darraj about Abu Abdillah {a.s}:
"Imam {a.s} disliked prostrating upon paper that has writing on it."
text_ar: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ بْنِ دَرَّاجٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: «أَنَّهُ كَرِهَ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ عَلَى قِرْطَاسِ عَلَيْهِ كِتَابَةٌ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.332 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.304 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.334 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.737 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.356

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim from (Imam) Ja'far {a.s},
from his father {a.s}, from (Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam {a.s} said: "A man should not prostrate upon something that the rest of his body
is not upon."

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This report agrees with the view of some of the general
public and is not acted upon, because it is permissible for a person to stand on what
he does not prostrate upon” And what indicates that is:
text_ar:
عَلِي بْنُ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ غِيَاتِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ
أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «لا يَسْجُدُ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى شَيْءٍ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ سَائِرُ جَسَدِهِ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : هذا الخبر موافق لبعض العامة وليس عليه العمل لانه يجوز أن يقف الانسان على ما لم يسجد عليه
، والذي يدل على ذلك :

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
What was narrated by Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Jamil ibn Darraj from Aban from Abdurrahman
ibn Abi Uqbah from Humran from one of the two (Imams {a.s}), peace be upon them both:
(Imam {a.s}) said: "My father {a.s} used to pray upon the khumrah (a small mat) placing it
upon the carpet and would prostrate upon it, and if there was no khumrah, He {a.s}
would place pebbles on the carpet where He {a.s} would prostrate."
text_ar:
مَا رَوَاهُ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجِ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عُقْبَةَ عَنْ حُمْرَانَ عَنْ
أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ قَالَ: «كَانَ أَبِي يُصَلِّي عَلَى الْخُمْرَةِ يَجْعَلُهَا عَلَى الطِّنْفِسَةِ وَ يَسْجُدُ عَلَيْهَا فَإِذَا لَمْ تَكُنْ
خُمْرَةٌ جَعَلَ حَصَّى عَلَى الطَّنْفِسَةِ حَيْثُ يَسْجُدُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.332 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.305 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.335 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.732 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.347
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Muhammad Imam Ali ibn Husayn Zayn al-Abidin {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan from Al-Halabi, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "My father {a.s} requested a khumrah (small prayer mat), but I
delayed in bringing it to Him {a.s}, so He {a.s} took a handful of pebbles and placed them
on the carpet, then prostrated upon them."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ : «دَعَا أَبِي
بِخُمْرَةٍ فَأَبْطَأْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَأَخَذَ كَفّا مِنْ حَصَّى فَجَعَلَهُ عَلَى الْبِسَاطِ ثُمَّ سَجَدَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.331 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.305 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.731 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.347
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al- Baqir {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar and
Burayd ibn Mu'awiyah from one of them (Imams {a.s}), peace be upon them both:
(Imam {a.s}) said: "There is no harm in standing upon a prayer mat made of hair or wool
if one prostrates upon the earth; but if it is from the plants of the earth, then there is
no harm in standing upon it and prostrating upon it."
text_ar:
عَلِي بْنُ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُدَيْنَةَ عَنِ ٱلْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ وَ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا
عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ بِالْقِيَامِ عَلَى ٱلْمُصَلَّى مِنَ الشَّعْرِ وَ الصُّوفِ إِذَا كَانَ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ فَإِنْ كَانَ مِنْ
نَبَاتِ اَلْأَرْضِ فَلاَ بَأْسَ بِالْقِيَامِ عَلَيْهِ وَ السُجُودِ عَلَيْهِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.331 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.305 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.335 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.731 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.344
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al- Baqir {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, about plaster (Gypsum) that had been burned with dung and
the bones of the dead, and with which the mosque was plastered, is it permissible to
prostrate upon it?
So He {a.s} wrote to me in his own handwriting: "Indeed, the water and the fire have
purified it."
text_ar:
احمد بن محمد عن الحسن بن محبوب قال سألت أبا الحسن عليه السلام : عن الجص يوقد عليه بالعذرة وعظام
الموتى ويجصص به المسجد يسجد عليه؟ فكتب إلي بخطه : إن الماء والنار قد طهراه.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ali ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Al-Rayan, who said:
Some of our companions wrote with the hand of Ibrahim ibn Uqbah to Imam {a.s},
meaning Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, asking Him {a.s} about prayer upon the
khumrah of Madinah.
So He {a.s} wrote: "Pray upon it as long as it is made with threadwork, and do not pray
upon that which is made with leather straps."
He said: Then our companions hesitated, so I recited to them a line of poetry by
Ta'abbata Sharran Al-Fihmi: "As if it were the threadwork of a Mari, twisted and spun,"
and Mari is a man who makes ropes and twists threads.
text_ar:
عَلِيْ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الرَّيَّانِ قَالَ: كَتَبَ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا بِيَدِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ إِلَيْهِ يَعْنِي أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ
يَسْأْلُهُ عَنِ الصَّلاةِ عَلَى الْخُمْرَةِ الْمَدَنِيَّةِ فَكَتَبَ «صَلِّ فِيهَا مَا كَانَ مَعْمُولاً بِخُيُوطَةٍ وَ لاَ تُصَلِّ عَلَى مَا كَانَ بِسُيُورَةِ»
قَالَ فَتَوَقَّفَ أَصْحَابُنَا فَأَنْشَدْتُهُمْ بَيْتَ شِعْرٍ لِتَأَبَّطَ شَرَا الْفَهْمِيِّ -) كَأَنَّهَا خُيُوطَةُ مَارِيٍّ ثُغَارُ وَ تُفْتَلُ) وَ مَارِيٌّ رَجُلْ
حَبَّالٌ يَفْتِلُ الخُيُوطَ.
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.331 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.306 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.733 • Awalim Al- Uloom, Vol.2 3 p.394
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Jawad {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Al-Muthanna Al-Hannat from
Uyaynah, the seller of reeds, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “I enter the mosque on a day of extreme heat and dislike to
pray upon the pebbles, so I spread my garment and prostrate upon it.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, there is no harm in it."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنِ الْمُثَنَّى الْحَنَّاطِ عَنْ عُيَيْنَةَ بَيَّاعِ الْقَصَبِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ
اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ أَدْخُلُ الْمَسْجِدَ فِي الْيَوْمِ الشَّدِيدِ الْحَرِّ فَأَكْرَهُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ عَلَى الْحَصَّى فَأَبْسُطُ ثَوْبِي فَأَسْجُدُ عَلَيْهِ
فَقَالَ « نَعَمْ لَيْسَ بِهِ بَأْسِّ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.306 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.332 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.739 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.350

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir from Abu Ja'far,
peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam {a.s}: “I am on a journey and the time for prayer arrives, and I fear the
scorching ground for my face. What should I do?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Prostrate upon part of your garment."
I asked: “I do not have a garment with me whose edge or hem I can prostrate upon.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Prostrate on back of your hand, for it is one of places of prostration."
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ قَالَ:
قُلْتُ لَهُ أَكُونُ فِي السَّفَرِ فَتَحْضُرُ الصَّلاَةُ وَ أَخَافُ الرَمْضَاءَ عَلَى وَجْهِي كَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ قَالَ «تَسْجُدُ عَلَى بَعْضِ ثَوْبِكَ»
قُلْتُ لَيْسَ عَلَيَّ ثَوْبٌ يُمْكِنُنِي أَنْ أَسْجُدَ عَلَى طَرَفِهِ وَ لا ذَيْلِهِ قَالَ «أسْجُدْ عَلَى ظَهِرٍ كَفَّكَ فَإِنَّهَا إِحْدَى ٱلْمَسَاجِدِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.306 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.333 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.740 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.351
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}

I said to Imam {a.s}: “I am on a journey and the time for prayer arrives, and I fear the

Imam {a.s} said: "Prostrate upon part of your garment."
I asked: “I do not have a garment with me whose edge or hem I can prostrate upon.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Prostrate on back of your hand, for it is one of places of prostration."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi

text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Abu Talib ibn Al-Salt from Al-Qasim ibn Al-Fudayl, who said:
I said to (Imam) Al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him: “May I be your ransom, a man
prostrates upon his sleeve due to the harm of heat or cold.”
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in it."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي طَالِبِ بْنِ الصَّلْتِ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ الْفُضَّيْلِ قَالَ: قَلْتُ لِلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ
الرَّجُلُ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى كُمِّهِ مِنْ أَذَى الْحَرِّ وَ الْبَرْدِ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِهِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.306 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.333 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.740 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.350

From him, from Abbad ibn Sulayman from Sa'd ibn Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Qasim ibn Al-Fudayl ibn

A man wrote to Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, asking: “Should a man prostrate upon a cloth to
protect his face from heat and cold, or from something he dislikes to prostrate upon?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, there is no harm in it."
text_ar:
عَنَهُ عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ سَعْدِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ الْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارِ قَالَ: كَتَبَ رَجُلُ إِلَى أَبِي
اَلْحَسَنٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ هَلْ يَسْجُدُ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى التَّوْبِ يَتَّقِي بِهِ وَجْهَهُ مِنَ الْحَرِّ وَ الْبَرْدِ وَ مِنَ الشَّيْءِ يَكْرَهُ السُّجُودَ
عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ « نَعَمْ لاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ».

text_en:
Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab from Wuhaib ibn Hafs from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about a man who prostrates upon a mat.
Imam {a.s} said: "If it is out of dissimulation (taqiyyah), then there is no harm in it."
text_ar:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْخَطَّابِ عَنْ وُهَيْبِ بْنِ حَفْص عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى الْمِسْحِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ فِي تَقِيَّةٍ فَلا بَأْسَ بِهِ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother Al-Husayn ibn Ali from their father
Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Madi, peace be upon him, about a man who prostrates upon
a mat or a carpet.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm if it is in a state of dissimulation (taqiyyah)."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْن مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ
أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الْمَاضِيَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى الْمِسْحِ وَ الْبِسَاطِ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ إِذَا كَانَ فِي حَالِ تَقِيَّةِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.307 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.332 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.741 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.349
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}

Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother Al-Husayn ibn Ali from their father
Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Madi, peace be upon him, about a man who prostrates upon
a mat or a carpet.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm if it is in a state of dissimulation (taqiyyah)."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
As for what was narrated by Sa'd ibn Abdullah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Dawud Al-Sarmi, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Thalith, peace be upon him, and said: “Is it permissible to
prostrate upon linen and cotton without dissimulation (taqiyyah)?”
Imam {a.s} said: "It is permissible."

Scholar's Note:
Thus, the interpretation of this report is that it is permissible to prostrate upon these
two materials even if there is no dissimulation (taqiyyah), provided there is another
necessity such as heat or cold or what is similar to them, and what clarifies this is what
was narrated:
text_ar:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ دَاوُدَ الصَرْمِيَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الثَّالِثَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
فَقُلْتُ هَلْ يَجُوزُ السُّجُودُ عَلَى الْكَتَّانِ وَ الْقُطْنِ مِنْ غَيْرِ تَقِيَّةٍ فَقَالَ «جَائِزٌ».
فالوجه في هذا الخبر انه يجوز السجود على هذين الشيئين وان لم يكن هناك تقية إذا كان هناك ضرورة اخرى من حر أو
برد وما يجري مجراهما، والذي يبين ذلك ما رواه:
commentary:
Thus, the interpretation of this report is that it is permissible to prostrate upon these
two materials even if there is no dissimulation (taqiyyah), provided there is another
necessity such as heat or cold or what is similar to them, and what clarifies this is what
was narrated:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Abd Al-Hamid from Sayf ibn Umayrah from Mansur
ibn Hazim from more than one of our companions, who said:
I said to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him: “We are in a cold land where there is snow;
should we prostrate upon it?”
Imam {a.s} said: "No, but place something between you and it, such as cotton or linen."

Scholar's Note:
And this interpretation is not contradicted by what was narrated:
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمِ عَنْ غَيْرٍ وَاجِدٍ
مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ إِنَّا نَكُونُ بِأَرْضِ بَارِدَةِ يَكُونُ فِيهَا الثَّلْجُ أَفَنَسْجُدُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ « لا
وَ لَكِنِ اِجْعَلْ بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنَهُ شَيْئاً قُطْناً أَوْ كَثَاناً».
ولا ينافي هذا التأويل ما رواه:
commentary: And this interpretation is not contradicted by what was narrated:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Sa'd from Abdullah ibn Ja'far from Al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Kaysan Al-San'ani, who said:
I wrote to Abu Al-Hasan Al-Thalith, peace be upon him, asking Him {a.s} about
prostrating upon cotton and linen without dissimulation (taqiyyah) and without
necessity.
So Imam {a.s} wrote back to me: "That is permissible."

Scholar's Note:
Because it is possible that he only permitted it with the absence of a necessity that
would reach the level of danger to life, while there may still be a lesser necessity such
as heat or cold and what resembles that, as we have explained. As for what was
narrated:
text_ar:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ الصَّنْعَانِيِّ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إلَى أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الثَالِثِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَامُ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ السّجُودِ عَلَى الْقُطْنِ وَ الْكَتَّانِ مِنْ غَيْرِ تَقِيَّةِ وَ لا ضَرُورَةٍ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيَّ «ذَلِكَ جَائِزٌ».
الانه يجوز أن يكون إنما اجاز مع نفي ضرورة تبلغ هلاك النفس ، وان كان هناك ضرورة دون ذلك من حر أو برد وما اشبه
ذلك على ما بيناه، فاما ما رواه :
commentary:
Because it is possible that he only permitted it with the absence of a necessity that
would reach the level of danger to life, while there may still be a lesser necessity such
as heat or cold and what resembles that, as we have explained. As for what was
narrated:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Ishaq from Yasir the servant, who said:
Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, passed by me while I was praying on the Tabari mat, and I had placed
something upon it to prostrate on, so Imam {a.s} said to me:
“Why do you not prostrate upon it? Is it not from what the earth has produced?”

Scholar's Note:
This report is to be understood as referring to a situation of dissimulation (taqiyyah).
text_ar:
أحمد بن محمد عن أحمد بن اسحاق عن ياسر الخادم قال مربي أبو الحسن عليه السلام وانا اصلي على الطبري
وقد القيت عليه شيئا اسجد عليه فقال لي مالك لا تسجد عليه؟ أليس هو من نبات الارض؟
فهذا الخبر محمول على حال التقية.
commentary: This report is to be understood as referring to a situation of dissimulation (taqiyyah).
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s}

Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, passed by me while I was praying on the Tabari mat, and I had placed

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Mahziyar, who said:
Dawud ibn Yazid asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, about papers and parchment that have
writing on them, is it permissible to prostrate upon them or not?
So Imam {a.s} wrote: "It is permissible."

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “There is no contradiction between this report and the
report of Jamil ibn Darraj from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, because that report is to be
understood as indicating dislike, and it is explicit in that, and it does not contain any
wording of prohibition.”
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ قَالَ: سَأَلَ دَاوُدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنِ الْقَرَاطِيسِ وَ الْكَوَاعِذِ
الْمَكْتُوبَةِ عَلَيْهَا هَلْ يَجُوزُ السُّجُودُ عَلَيْهَا أَمْ لا فَكَتَبَ «يَجُوزُ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : لا تنافي بين هذا الخبر وبين خبر جميل بن دراج عن أبي عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام لان ذلك الخبر محمول
على الكراهية وهو صريح فيها وليس فيه شئ من الفاظ الحظر
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “There is no contradiction between this report and the
report of Jamil ibn Darraj from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, because that report is to be
understood as indicating dislike, and it is explicit in that, and it does not contain any
wording of prohibition.”
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.309 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.334 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.737
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Abdurrahman ibn Abi Najran from Safwan Al-Jammal, who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah {a.s}, in the howdah prostrating upon paper, and most of the time
Imam {a.s} would gesture with a slight indication.
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بَنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ صَفَوَانَ الْجَمَّالِ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ فِي
الْمَحْمِلٍ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى قِرْطَاسِ وَ أَكْثَرَ ذَلِكَ يُومِئُ إِيمَاءَ.
cross_references: Al-Muhasin, Vol.2 p.373 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.309 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.334 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.738 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.332 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.355 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.91 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.154

text_chunk:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Abdurrahman ibn Abi Najran from Safwan Al-Jammal, who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah {a.s}, in the howdah prostrating upon paper, and most of the time
Imam {a.s} would gesture with a slight indication.

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Husayn ibn
Uthman from Ibn Muskan from Muhammad ibn Mudarib from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a mound of wheat covered with clay, may I pray upon it?
Imam {a.s} said: "Do not pray upon it."
I asked: “But it is like a leveled surface.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Do not pray upon it."

Scholar's Note:
And this report is not contradicted by what was narrated:
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةً عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ
مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُضَارِبٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ كُدْسِ جِنْطَةٍ مُطَيَّنِ أصَلِّي فَوْقَهُ فَقَالَ «لا تُصَلَّ
فَوْقَهُ» قُلْتُ فَإِنَّهُ مِثلُ السَّطْحِ مُسْتَوِ فَقَالَ «لا تُصَلَ عَلَيْهِ».
ولا ينافي هذا الخبر ما رواه:
commentary: And this report is not contradicted by what was narrated:
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.309 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.400 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.453 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.182
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

Imam {a.s} said: "Do not pray upon it."
I asked: “But it is like a leveled surface.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Do not pray upon it." Scholar's Note:
And this report is not contradicted by what was narrated:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Washsha from Ahmad ibn A'id from Umar ibn Hanzalah,
who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “There is a mound of food covered with clay, levelled like a
surface, may I pray upon it?”
He said: "Pray upon it."

Scholar's Note:
Because the first report is to be understood as indicating dislike, not prohibition.
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ الْوَشَّاءِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عَائِذٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ حَنْظَلَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ يَكُونُ الْكُدْسُ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ مُطَيَّنا مِثلَ السَّطْحِ قَالَ «صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ».
لان الخبر الاول محمول على الكراهية دون الحظر.
commentary: Because the first report is to be understood as indicating dislike, not prohibition.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.309 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.400 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.453 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.182

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abu Khalid from Abu Hamzah, who said:
Abu Ja'far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "There is no harm in prostrating while there is
your garment between your palms and the ground."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «لاَ بَأْسَ أَنْ
تَسْجُدَ وَ بَيْنَ كَفِّيْكَ وَ بَيْنَ الْأَرْضِ ثَوْبُكَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.309 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.719 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.353
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
text_chunk:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abu Khalid from Abu Hamzah, who said:
Abu Ja'far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "There is no harm in prostrating while there is
your garment between your palms and the ground."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah ibn Zayd from (Imam {a.s}) Ja'far {a.s}, from his father {a.s},
about (Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him:
"That He (Imam Ali {a.s}) would not prostrate upon the sleeves nor upon the turban."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ : «أَنَّهُ كَانَ لا يَسْجُدُ عَلَى
الْكُمِّيْنٍ وَلا عَلَى الْعِمَامَةِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.310 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.743 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.363
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
text_chunk:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah ibn Zayd from (Imam {a.s}) Ja'far {a.s}, from his father {a.s},
about (Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him:
"That He (Imam Ali {a.s}) would not prostrate upon the sleeves nor upon the turban."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Dawud Al-Sarmi, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, and said to Him {a.s}: “I go out on this journey, and sometimes
there is no place to pray except upon snow, what should I do?”
Imam {a.s} said: "If it is possible for you not to prostrate upon the snow, then do not
prostrate upon it, but if it is not possible, then level it and prostrate upon it."

Scholar's Note:
And this report is not contradicted by what was narrated:
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنْ دَاوُدَ الصَّرْمِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ قُلْتُ لَهُ إِنَّي أَخْرُجُ فِي هَذَا الْوَجْهِ وَ رُبَّمَا
لَمْ يَكُنُ مَوْضِعْ أَصَلِّي فِيهِ مِنَ الثَّلْجِ فَكَيْفَ أَصْنَعُ فَقَالَ «إِنْ أَمْكَنَكَ أَنْ لا تَسْجُدَ عَلَى الثَّلْجِ فَلا تَسْجُدْ عَلَيْهِ وَ إِنْ
لَمْ يُمْكِنْكَ فَسَوِّهِ وَ أُسْجُدْ عَلَيْهِ».
ولا ينافي هذا الخبر ما رواه:
commentary: And this report is not contradicted by what was narrated:
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.390 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.261 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.310 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.336 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.452 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1051 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.164
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s}

And this report is not contradicted by what was narrated:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Mu'ammar ibn Khallad, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, about prostrating upon snow.
Imam {a.s} said: "Do not prostrate in the salt marsh nor upon snow."

Scholar's Note:
Because this report is to be understood as referring to the situation of choice, or when
there is something available to cover the snow and prostrate upon it, as we have
explained in the report of Mansur ibn Hazim.
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَمَّرِ بْنِ خَلاَّدٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ عَنِ السُّجُودِ عَلَى الثَّلْجِ فَقَالَ «لا تَسْجُدْ
فِي السَّبَخَةِ وَ لاَ عَلَى التَّلْجِ».
لان هذا الخبر محمول على حال الاختيار أو مع وجود شئ يستر به الثلج ويسجد عليه على ما بيناه في خبر منصور بن
حازم.
commentary:
Because this report is to be understood as referring to the situation of choice, or when
there is something available to cover the snow and prostrate upon it, as we have
explained in the report of Mansur ibn Hazim.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.310 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.335 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.743 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.164 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.358
