author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Ashyam from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim Al-Hudayni, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who prays upon a bed while he is able to pray on the
ground.
So Imam {a.s} wrote: "There is no harm; pray upon it."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بَن مُحَمّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَشيَمَ عَنْ مُحَمّدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحُضَيْنِي قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي عَلَى
السَّرِيرٍ وَ هُوَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَكَتَبَ «لاَ بَأْسَ صَلَ فِيهِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.310 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.453 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.179
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Jawad {a.s}
text_chunk:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Ashyam from Muhammad ibn Ibrahim Al-Hudayni, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who prays upon a bed while he is able to pray on the
ground.
So Imam {a.s} wrote: "There is no harm; pray upon it."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Mahmood, who said:
I said to (Imam) Al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him: “A man prays upon a bed made of
teakwood and prostrates upon the teakwood, is that permissible?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ أَبِي مَحْمُودِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ الرَّجُلُ يُصَلِّي عَلَى سَرِيرٍ مِنْ سَاجٍ وَ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى
اَلسَّاجٍ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.261 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.310 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.744 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.178 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.364
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
text_chunk:
From him, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Mahmood, who said:
I said to (Imam) Al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him: “A man prays upon a bed made of
teakwood and prostrates upon the teakwood, is that permissible?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Al-Mufaddal ibn Salih from Al-Husayn ibn Hammad, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about a man who prostrates upon pebbles.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should raise his head until he becomes firmly settled."
text_ar:
الْمُفَضَّلُ بْنُ صَالِحِ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى الْحَصَى قَالَ
«يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ حَتَّى يَسْتَمْكِنَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.310 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.720 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.354
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Al-Mufaddal ibn Salih from Al-Husayn ibn Hammad, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about a man who prostrates upon pebbles.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should raise his head until he becomes firmly settled."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-'Ala from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who
said:
It was mentioned that a man came to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, and asked Imam
{a.s} about prostrating upon woven mats, palm-leaf mats, and plants.
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَلَاءِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: ذَكَرَ أَنَّ رَجْلاً
أَتَى أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ وَ سَأْلَهُ عَنِ السُّجُودِ عَلَى الْبُورِيَاءِ وَ الْخَصَفَةِ وَ النَّبَاتِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.311 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.744 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.346
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
text_chunk:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-'Ala from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who
said:
It was mentioned that a man came to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, and asked Imam
{a.s} about prostrating upon woven mats, palm-leaf mats, and plants.
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Ibrahim Al-Khazzaz from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "There is no harm in praying upon woven mats,
palm-leaf mats, and every plant except the fruit."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْخَزَّازِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ بِالصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الْبُورِيَاءِ وَ
اَلْخَصَفَةٍ وَ كُلِّ نَبَاتٍ إِلَّ الثَّمَرَةِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.261 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.311 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.744 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.345
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
text_chunk:
From him, from Ibrahim Al-Khazzaz from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "There is no harm in praying upon woven mats,
palm-leaf mats, and every plant except the fruit."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Ishaq ibn Al-Fadl, who said:
He asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about prostrating upon mats and woven reed mats.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm, but that one prostrates upon the earth is more
beloved to me, for the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family,
used to love that, to firmly place his forehead upon the earth, so I love for you what the
Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, used to love."
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَدَيْنَةَ عَنْ إسْحَاقَ بْنِ الْفَضْلِ : أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ
عَنِ السَّجُودِ عَلَى الْحُصُرِ وَ الْبَوَارِي فَقَالَ « لا بَأْسَ وَ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ
عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَانَ يُجِبُّ ذَلِكَ أَنْ يُمَكِّنَ جَبْهَتَهُ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ فَأَنَا أَجِبُّ لَكَ مَا كَانَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
يُحِبُّهُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.311 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.744 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.368
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
text_chunk:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Ishaq ibn Al-Fadl, who said:
He asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about prostrating upon mats and woven reed mats.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm, but that one prostrates upon the earth is more
beloved to me, for the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family,
used to love that, to firmly place his forehead upon the earth, so I love for you what the
Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, used to love."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Zurarah from Abu Ja'far,
peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the sick person.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should prostrate upon the earth or on a hand fan (mirwaha) or upon
a tooth-stick that he raises, this is better than gesturing.
The one who disliked prostrating on a hand fan only did so because of the idols that
were once worshipped besides Allah {SWT}, but we have never worshipped other than
Allah {SWT} at all. So prostrate on a hand fan, or on a stick, or on a tooth-stick (miswak)."
text_ar:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُدَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنِ الْمَرِيضِ فَقَالَ «يَسْجُدُ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ أَوْ عَلَى الْمِرْوَحَةِ أَوْ عَلَى سِوَاكٍ يَرْفَعُهُ هُوَ أَفْضَلُ مِنَ ٱلْإِيمَاءِ إِنَّمَا كَرِهَ مَنْ
كَرِهَ السُّجُودَ عَلَى ٱلْمِرْوَحَةِ مِنْ أَجْلِ الْأَوْثَانِ الَّتِي كَانَتْ تُعْبَدُ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ وَ إِنَّا لَمْ نَعْبُدْ غَيْرَ اللَّهِ قَطٌ فَاسْجُدْ
عَلَى الْمِرْوَحَةِ أَوْ عَلَى عُودٍ أَوْ عَلَى سِوَاكٍ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.311 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.177 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.745
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar Al-Sabati,
who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about a man who gestures during the obligatory and
supererogatory prayers when he does not find anything to prostrate upon and has no
place to prostrate.
Imam {a.s} said: "If it is like that, then let him gesture throughout the entire prayer."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقٍ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَابَاطِيَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُومِن فِي الْمَكْتُوبَةِ وَ النَّوَافِلِ إِذَا لَمْ يَجِدْ مَا يَسْجُدُ عَلَيْهِ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ مَوْضِعٌ يَسْجُدُ فِيهِ
قَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ هَكَذَا فَلْيُومِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ كُلَّهَا».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.311 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1052 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.375
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar Al-Sabati,

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
And from him with this same chain of transmission, he said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about a man who prays upon snow.
Imam {a.s} said: "No, but if he is unable to find earth, he should spread his garment and
pray upon it."
And (Imam {a.s} was asked) about a man who is caught by rain and is in a place where
he cannot prostrate due to the mud and cannot find a dry place.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should begin the prayer, and when he bows, let him bow as usual
in prayer, and when he raises his head from bowing, he should gesture for the
prostration while standing. He should do that until he completes the prayer, and he
should recite the testimony (tashahhud) while standing, then he should conclude with
the taslim."
text_ar:
وَ عَنْهُ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي عَلَى الثَّلْجِ قَالَ «لَا فَإِنْ لَمْ يَقْدِرْ عَلَى
اَلْأَرْضِ بَسَطَ ثَوْبَهُ وَ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ» وَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصِيبُهُ مَطَرٌ وَ هُوَ فِي مَوْضِعٍ لا يَقْدِرُ أَنْ يَسْجُدَ فِيهِ مِنَ الطِّينِ وَ
لا يَجِدُ مَوْضِعاً جَافاً قَالَ «يَفْتَتِحُ الصَّلاةَ فَإِذَا رَكَعَ فَلْيَرْكَعْ كَمَا رَكَعَ إِذَا صَلَّى فَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ فَلْيُومِ
بِالسُّجُودِ إِيمَاءً وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ وَ يَتَشَهَدُ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ ثُمَّ يُسَلَّمُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.312 • Al-Sarair, Vol.3 p.603 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.101
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
And with this same chain of transmission from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the extent of mud upon which it is not permissible to prostrate,
what is it?
Imam {a.s} said: "When forehead sinks into it and does not remain stable on the ground."
text_ar:
وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ حَدَّ ٱلطّينِ ٱَلَّذِي لا يُسْجَدُ عَلَيْهِ مَا هَوَ قَالَ «إِذَا
غَرِقَتِ الْجَبْهَةُ فِيهِ وَ لَمْ تَثُبُثْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.447 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.312 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.376 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.143 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.306

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub by Al-Abbas by Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira by Alaa by Muhammad ibn Muslim:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "There is no harm in praying upon a patterned
cloth if you place it beneath you."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عَلاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ
السّلامُ قَالَ: «لَا بَأْسَ بِأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى الْمِثَالِ إِذَا جَعَلْتَهُ تَحْتَكَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.312 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.464 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.439
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
text_chunk:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Ahmad from his father from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Ibn Muskan from Husayn ibn
Hammad from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I said to Imam {a.s}: “I lower my face for prostration, and my face falls upon a stone or
something elevated, should I move my face to a level place?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, drag your face upon the ground without lifting it."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلَاَمُ
قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أَضَعُ وَجْهِي لِلسُجُودِ فَيَقَعُ وَجْهِي عَلَى حَجَرٍ أَوْ عَلَى شَيْءٍ مُرْتَفِعِ أُحَوِّلُ وَجْهِي إِلَى مَكَانٍ مُسْتَوٍ
قَالَ «نَعَمْ جُرَّ وَجْهَكَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ تَرْفَعَهُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.312 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.722 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.353
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Ahmad from Musa ibn Al-Qasim and Abu Qatadah together from Ali ibn Ja'far from his
brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja'far {a.s}, peace be upon them both, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who prostrates upon pebbles but does not firmly place
his forehead upon the ground.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should move his forehead until he becomes firmly settled, pushing
the pebbles away from under his forehead without lifting his head."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ وَ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ جَمِيعاً عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلرَّجُلِ يَسْجُدُ عَلَى الْحَصَى وَ لا يُمَكِّنُ جَبْهَتَهُ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ قَالَ «يُحَرِّكُ جَبْهَتَهُ حَتَّى يَتَمَكِّنَ
فَيُنَحِّي الْحَصَى عَنْ جَبْهَتِهِ وَ لاَ يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ».
cross_references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.239 • Qurb Al-Isnad, Vol.1 p.202 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.312 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.331 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.722 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.353 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.129

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Al-Nahdi from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about prostrating upon elevated ground.
Imam {a.s} said: "If the place of your forehead is elevated above the place of your body
by the height of a brick, then there is no harm."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ النَّهْدِيِّ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ السُّجُودِ
عَلَى الْأَرْضِ الْمُرْتَفِعَةِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ مَوْضِعُ جَبْهَتِكَ مُرْتَفِعاً عَنْ مَوْضِعِ بَدَنِكَ قَدْرَ لَبِنَةٍ فَلاَ بَأْسَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.313
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Al-Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja'far
{a.s}, peace be upon them both, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man, is it permissible for him to raise his voice in the
tashahhud, and in what is said during bowing, prostration, and qunoot?
Imam {a.s} said: "If he wishes, he may raise his voice, and if he wishes, he may not raise
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحيّى عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَجِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنِ الرَّجُلِ لَهُ أَنْ يَجْهَرَ بِالتَّشَهُدِ وَ الْقَوْلِ فِي الرُّكُوعِ وَ السُّجُودِ وَ الْقُنُوتِ قَالَ «إِنْ شَاءَ جَهَرَ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ لَمْ يَجْهَزْ».

text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Al-Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja'far
{a.s}, peace be upon them both, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man, is it permissible for him to raise his voice in the

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Yusuf ibn Al-Harith from Abdullah ibn Yazid Al-Minqari from Musa ibn Ayyub Al-Ghafiqi from
his uncle Iyas ibn Amir Al-Ghafiqi from Uqbah ibn Amir Al-Juhani, who said:
When the verse "So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most Great" (Surah Waqi'ah
56:96) was revealed, the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, said to us (companions): "Place it in your bowing."
Then when the verse "Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High" (Surah A'la 87:1)
was revealed, the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, said
to us (companions): "Place it in your prostration."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ ٱلْمِنْقَرِيِّ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ أَيُوبَ الْغَافِقِيِّ عَنْ عَمِّهِ إِيَاسِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ
الْغَافِقِيِّ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرِ الْجُهَنِيَّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ «فَسَبِّحْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الْعَظِيمِ» قَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ
عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ «اِجْعَلُوهَا فِي رُكُوعِكُمْ» فَلَمَّا نَزَلَتْ «سَبِّحِ اِسْمَ رَبِّكَ الْأَعْلَى» قَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
«اجْعَلُوها فِي سُجُودِكُمْ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED

From him, from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Sayrafi from Hammad ibn Uthman from
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I heard Imam {a.s} say: "Prostration is upon what the earth has produced, except for
what is eaten or worn."
text_ar:
عنه عن العباس بن معروف عن محمد بن يحيى الصير في عن حماد بن عثمان عن أبي عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام قال
: سمعته يقول : السجود على ما انبتت الارض إلا ما أكل أو لبس.

source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Hassan from Abu Muhammad Al-Razi from Al-Nawfali from Al-Sakuni from
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said:
(Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, said to me: "Indeed, I dislike that I see a man whose
forehead is bare and has no trace of prostration upon it."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ عَنْ أَبِي مُحَمَّدِ ٱلرَّازِيِّ عَنِ النَّوْفَلِيّ عَنِ السَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ
لِي عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «إِنِّي لَأَكْرَهُ لِلرَّجُلِ أَنْ أَرَى جَبْهَتَهُ جَلْحَاءَ لَيْسَ فِيهَا أَثَرُ السُّجُوبِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.313 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.376 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.160
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Al-Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja'far {a.s}, peace be upon them
both, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a woman whose forelock grows long, so when she prostrates,
part of her forehead touches the ground while part of it is covered by her hair, is that
permissible?
Imam {a.s} said: "No, until she places her forehead fully upon the ground."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيَّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلْمَرْأَةِ تَطُولُ قُصَّتُهَا
فَإِذَا سَجَدَتْ وَقَعَ بَعْضُ جَبْهَتِهَا عَلَى الْأَرْضِ وَ بَعْضٌ يُغَطّيهِ الشَّعْرُ هَلْ يَجُوزُ ذَلِكَ قَالَ «لا حَتَّى تَضَعَ جَبْهَتَهَا
عَلَى اَلْأَرْضِ».
cross_references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.239 • Qurb Al-Isnad, Vol.1 p.224 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.313 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.717 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.363 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.130 • Mustadrak Al- Wasa’il, Vol.4 p.12

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ziyad from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah
from Ali ibn Al-Hazawwar from Al-Asbagh ibn Nubatah, who said:
When the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, would raise his head from
prostration, He {a.s} would sit until He {a.s} became calm, then He {a.s} would stand.
So it was said to Imam {a.s}: “O Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, Abu Bakr and Umar
before you, when they raised their heads from prostration, they would rise on the balls
of their feet as camels rise.
Commander of the Faithful (Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib {a.s}), peace be upon him, said:
"Indeed, only the coarse people (Ahl al-Jafa) do that; rather, this calmness is part of
showing reverence for the prayer."
(‘coarse people - Ahl al-Jafa)’; harsh, rough, or lacking refinement in behavior and
indifferent to the deeper etiquettes of worship)
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَزَوَّرِ عَنِ ٱلْأَصْبَغِ
بْنِ نُبَاتَةَ قَالَ: كَانَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُوْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ السُّجُودِ قَعَدَ حَتَّى يَظْمَيِنَ ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَقِيلَ لَهُ يَا
أَمِيرَ الْمُوْمِنِينَ كَانَ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَ عُمَرُ إِذَا رَفَعُوا رُءُوسَهُمْ عَنِ السُّجُودِ نَهَضُوا عَلَى صُدُورِ أَقْدَامِهِمْ كَمَا
تَنْهَضُ الْإِبِلُ فَقَالَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ «إِنَّمَا يَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ أَهْلُ الْجَفَاءِ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ إِنَّ هَذَا مِنْ تَوْقِيرِ الصَّلاةِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.314 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.725 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.347

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Safwan from Ibn Bukayr from Ubayd
ibn Zurarah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about mentioning a chapter from the Book (the Qur'an) and
supplicating with it in prayer, like ‘Surah Al-Ikhlas’.
Imam {a.s} said: "If you are supplicating with it, then there is no harm."
text_ar:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا
عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنْ ذِكْرِ السُّورَةِ مِنَ الْكِتَابِ يَدْعُو بِهَا فِي الصَّلاةِ مِثْلِ «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» فَقَالَ «إِذَا كُنْتَ
تَدْعُو بِهَا فَلاَ بَأْسَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.302 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.314 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.882 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.53 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.703 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.1 4 p.502

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Nadr from Yahya Al-Halabi from Ishaq ibn Ammar from Abu Basir, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “I send blessings upon the Prophet, may Allah {SWT} bless him
and his family, while I am in prostration, is that permissible?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, it is like saying SubhanAllah and Allahu Akbar."
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بَنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ يَحْيَى الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ إِسحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ أُصَلِّي عَلَى النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَنَا سَاجِدٌ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ هُوَ مِثلُ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.314 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.326
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Al-Rayan from Al-Husayn ibn Rashid from some of his
companions from Misma' from Abu Abdillah {a.s}:
The Commander of the Faithful (Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib {a.s}), peace be upon him:
"The Prophet, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, forbade a man from closing his
eyes during the prayer."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الرَّيَّانِ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ رَاشِدِ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ عَنْ مِسْمَعِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ
اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنْ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلهِ نَهَى أَنْ يُغَمّضَ الرَّجُلُ عَيْنَيْهِ
فِي الصَّلاَةِ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Aban from Isma'il ibn Al-Fadl, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about the qunoot and what should be said in it.
Imam {a.s} said: "Whatever Allah {SWT} causes to flow from your tongue, and I do not know
of anything specifically fixed for it."
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةً عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ الْفَضْلِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الْقُنُوتِ
وَ مَا يُقَالُ فِيهِ فَقَالَ »مَا قَضَى اللَّهُ عَلَى لِسَانِكَ وَ لاَ أُعلَمُ فِيهِ شَيْئاً مُوَقَّتاً».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.340 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.314 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.755 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.277 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.98
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about the minimum of the qunoot.
Imam {a.s} said: "Five tasbihat (saying SubhanAllah five times)."
text_ar:
عَنَهُ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ أَدْنَى
الْقُنُوتِ فَقَالَ «خَمْسُ تَسْبِيحَاتٍ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.340 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.315 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.756 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.273

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Isma'il from Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Zurarah, who said:
I said to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him: “A man forgets the qunoot while on his way
(after the prayer).”
Imam {a.s} said: "He should face the qiblah and then say it."
Then Imam {a.s} said: "Indeed, I dislike for a man to turn away from the Sunnah of the
Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, or to abandon it
(Qunoot)."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ رَجُلٌ نَسِيَ الْقُنُوتَ وَ هُوَ فِي بَعْضِ الطَّرِيقِ فَقَالَ «يَسْتَقْبِلُ الْقِبْلَةَ ثُمَّ ليَقُلْهُ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «إِنِّي لَأَكْرَهُ لِلرَّجُلِ أَنْ
يَرْغَبَ عَنْ سُنَّةٍ رَسُولِ اللهِ صَلَّى اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أَوْ يَدَعَهَا».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.340 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.315 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.935 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.286
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}

Imam {a.s} said: "He should face the qiblah and then say it."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Al-Husayn ibn Ali Al-Kufi from Abu Dawud Sulayman ibn Sufyan from
Amr ibn Hurayth, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, said to me: "Say in the first two rak‘ahs, after the tashahhud and
before you rise, Subhan Allah {SWT}, Subhan Allah {SWT} seven times."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ الْكُوفِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي دَاوُدَ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثِ
قَالَ قَالَ لِي أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «قُلْ فِي الرَكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ التّشَهُمِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَنْهَضَ - سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.315 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.409
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar Al-Sabati:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "If a man forgets the qunoot in any part of the prayer until he
bows, his prayer is still valid and there is nothing upon him, but it is not permissible for
him to deliberately abandon it."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ
قَالَ: «إِنْ نَسِيَ الرَّجْلُ الْقُنُوتَ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ حَتَّى يَرْكَعَ فَقَدْ جَازَتْ صَلاَتُهُ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ وَ لَيْسَ لَهُ
أَنْ يَدَعَهُ مُتَعَمِّداً».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.315 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.936 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.286
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Sulayman, who said:
I wrote to the Al Faqih (Jurist), peace be upon him, asking Imam {a.s} about the qunoot.
He {a.s} wrote back to me: "If there is a severe necessity, then do not raise your hands,
and say three times: ‘Bismillah Hir Rahman Nir Rahim.’"
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مُحَمَدِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى الْفَقِيهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ ٱلْقُنُوتِ
فكَتَبَ إليَّ «إِذَا كَانَتْ ضَرُورَةْ شَدِيدَةْ فَلاَ تَرْفَعِ الْيَدَيْنِ وَ قُلْ ثَلاَثَ مَرّاتِ «بِسْمِ اللهِ الرّحْمْنِ الرّحِيمِ» ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.315 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.753 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.274 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.282
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s}

Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Sulayman, who said:
I wrote to the Al Faqih (Jurist), peace be upon him, asking Imam {a.s} about the qunoot.

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Walid Al-Khazzaz from Aban ibn Uthman from Abdurrahman ibn Abi Abdillah:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} (was asked) regarding a man who joins the last rak'ah of the Fajr prayer
with the imam (of prayer), and the imam performs qunoot, should he perform qunoot
with him?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, and it suffices him for the qunoot for himself."
text_ar:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْوَليدِ الْخَزَّازِ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ: فِي الرَّجُلِ يَدْخُلُ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الْأَخِيرَةِ مِنَ الْغَدَاةِ مَعَ ٱلْإِمَامِ فَيَقْنُتُ ٱلْإِمَامُ أَيَقْنُتْ مَعَهُ قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ يُجْزِيهِ
مِنَ الْقُنُوتِ لِنَفْسِهِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.315 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.753 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.287
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Walid Al-Khazzaz from Aban ibn Uthman from Abdurrahman ibn Abi Abdillah:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Ali ibn Asbat from Al-Hakam ibn Miskin from Ammar Al-
Sabati, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “I fear to perform qunoot while there are opponents (non-
followers) behind me”.
Imam {a.s} said: "Raising your hands suffices," meaning raising them as if you are
bowing.
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَسْبَاطِ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ مِسْكِينٍ عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَّابَاطِيّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي
عَبْدِ
اَللَّه عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ أَخَافُ أَنْ أَقْنُتَ وَ خَلْفِي مُخَالِفُونَ فَقَالَ «رَفْعُكَ يَدَيْكَ يُجْزِي» يَعْنِي رَفْعَهُمَا كَأَنَّكَ تَرْكَعُ.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.316 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.753 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.282
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

Imam {a.s} said: "Raising your hands suffices," meaning raising them as if you are

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from his father from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Abdullah ibn Bukayr:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "The tashahhud in the supererogatory prayer is part of the
tashahhud of the obligatory prayer."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «اَلتَّشَهْدُ
فِي النّافِلَةٍ بَعْضُ تَشَهُدِ الْفَرِيضَةِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.316 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.772 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.394
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

Ahmad ibn Muhammad from his father from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Abdullah ibn Bukayr:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "The tashahhud in the supererogatory prayer is part of the
tashahhud of the obligatory prayer."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Ibn Abi Nasr from Tha'labah ibn Maymun from Muyassar:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "Two things by which people corrupt their prayer
are: a man saying ‘Tabarakasmuka wa ta'ala jadduka wa la ilaha ghayruka’ (Blessed is
Your {AZJ} Name, exalted is Your {AZJ} Majesty, and there is no god besides You {AZJ}),
And this is something the jinn said out of ignorance, and Allah {SWT}, Mighty and
Majestic, related it from them, and a man saying ‘As-salamu 'alayna wa 'ala 'ibadillah
as-salihin’ (Peace be upon us and upon the righteous servants of Allah {SWT})."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ تَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ مَيْمُونِ عَنْ مُيَسِّرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «شَيْئَانِ يُفْسِدُ ٱَلنَّاسُ بِهِمَا
صَلاتَهُمْ قَوْلُ الرَّجُلِ تَبَارَكَ اِسْمُكَ وَ تَعَالَى جَدُّكَ وَ لاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ وَ إِنَّمَا هَوَ شَيْءُ قَالَتهُ الْجِنُ بِجَهَالَةٍ فَحَكَى اللَّهُ عَزَّ
وَ جَلَّ عَنْهُمْ وَ قَوْلُ الرَّجْلِ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَ عَلَى عِبَادِ اللّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ ».
cross_references: Al-Khisal, Vol.1 p.50 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.316 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.772 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.409 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.286 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.506 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.320 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.304 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.435

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub by Al-Abbas by Abu Shu'ayb by Abu Jamilah by Abdurrahman ibn Abdullah:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “What is the meaning of a man's saying At-tahiyyatu lillah
(greetings are for Allah {SWT})?”
Imam {a.s} said: "It means sovereignty belongs to Allah {SWT}."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ أَبِي شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَمِيلَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ
لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ مَا مَعْنَى قَوْلِ الرَّجُلِ التَّحِيَّاتُ لِلَّهِ قَالَ «الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.316 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.772 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.394
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub by Al-Abbas by Abu Shu'ayb by Abu Jamilah by Abdurrahman ibn Abdullah:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: “What is the meaning of a man's saying At-tahiyyatu lillah
(greetings are for Allah {SWT})?”
Imam {a.s} said: "It means sovereignty belongs to Allah {SWT}."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Ali ibn Ya'qub Al-Hashimi from Marwan ibn
Muslim from Abu Kahmas from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the first two rak'ahs, when I sit for the tashahhud and while
sitting I say, ‘Peace be upon you, O Prophet {saws}, and the mercy of Allah {SWT} and His
blessings’, is that considered the dismissal (end of prayer)?”
Imam {a.s} said: "No, but when you say, ‘Peace be upon us and upon the righteous
servants of Allah {SWT}’, that is the dismissal (end of prayer)."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ الْهَاشِمِيَّ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي كَهْمَسِ
عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ الْأَوّلَتَيْنِ إِذَا جَلَسْتُ فِيهِمَا لِلتَشَهُدِ فَقُلْتُ وَ أَنَا جَالِسْ
السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللّهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ اِنْصِرَافاً هُوَ قَالَ «لا وَ لَكِنْ إِذَا قُلْتَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَ عَلَى عِبَادِ اللَّهِ
الصَّالِحِينَ فَهُوَ الإِنْصِرَافُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.348 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.316 • Al-Sarair, Vol.3 p.604 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.2 p.41 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.773 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.426 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.309
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Al-Husayn ibn Uthman from Al-Halabi, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "Everything by which you mention Allah {SWT}, Mighty and
Majestic, and the Prophet {saws}, is part of the prayer, and if you say ‘Peace be upon us
and upon the righteous servants of Allah {SWT}’, then you have concluded (the prayer)."
text_ar:
ٱلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُوبَ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنِ ٱلْحَلَبِيّ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلَامُ:
«كُلْ مَا ذَكَرْتَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ بِهِ وَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَهُوَ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ وَ إِنْ قُلْتَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْنَا وَ عَلَى عِبَادِ
اللّهِ الصَّالِحِينَ فَقَدِ اِنْصَرَفْتَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.337 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.316 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.2 p.42 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.766 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.426
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from Al-Husayn ibn Uthman from Al-Halabi, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "Everything by which you mention Allah {SWT}, Mighty and
Majestic, and the Prophet {saws}, is part of the prayer, and if you say ‘Peace be upon us
and upon the righteous servants of Allah {SWT}’, then you have concluded (the prayer)."

text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "When you conclude the prayer, then turn to your right side."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثُمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةً عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا اِنْصَرَفْتَ عَنِ الصَلاةِ
فَانْصَرِفَ عَنْ يَمِينِكَ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Muhammad from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Sulayman ibn
Dawud from Al-Nu'man ibn Abd Al-Salam from Abu Hanifah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about crying during prayer, does it invalidate the prayer?
Imam {a.s} said: "If he cries due to the remembrance of Paradise or Hellfire, then that is
the best of deeds in prayer, but if he cries because of remembering a deceased person
of his, then his prayer is invalid."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ عَنِ النَّعْمَانِ بْنِ عَبْدِ
السّلاَمٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَنِيفَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ عَنِ اَلْبُكَاءِ فِي الصَّلاةِ أَيَقْطَعُ الصَّلاةَ قَالَ «إِنْ بَكَى
لِذِكْرٍ جَنَّةٍ أَوْ نَارٍ فَذَلِكَ هُوَ أَفْضَلُ ٱلْأَعْمَالِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ ذَكَرَ مَيّتاً لَهُ فَصَلاَتُهُ فَاسِدَةٌ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.317 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.408 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.880 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.247 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.313

text_en:
Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar ibn Musa Al-Sabati, who
said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, about the taslim, what is it?
Imam {a.s} said: "It is permission (to end the prayer)."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدِ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى السَّابَاطِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ
اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ التَّسْلِيمِ مَا هُوَ فَقَالَ «هُوَ إِذْنٌ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Al-Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far, peace be
upon him, who said:
I saw my brothers (Imam) Musa {a.s}, Ishaq, and Muhammad, the sons of Ja'far, peace
be upon him, giving taslim (salutation) in prayer to the right and to the left, saying:
"Peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah {SWT}, peace be upon you and the mercy of
Allah {SWT}."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ إِخْوَتِي
مُوسَى وَ إسْحَاقَ وَ مُحَمَّداً بَنِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ يُسَلَّمُونَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَ ٱلشَمَالِ - « ٱلسَّلَاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ
وَ رَحْمَةُ اللّهِ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللهِ ».
cross_references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.309 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.317 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.779 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.419
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Al-Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far, peace be
upon him, who said:
I saw my brothers (Imam) Musa {a.s}, Ishaq, and Muhammad, the sons of Ja'far, peace
be upon him, giving taslim (salutation) in prayer to the right and to the left, saying:
"Peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah {SWT}, peace be upon you and the mercy of

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him, from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from Ibn Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Al-Fudayl, Zurarah, and
Muhammad ibn Muslim:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "When a man completes the two testimonies
(shahadatayn), his prayer is complete. So if he is in a hurry for something he fears may
be missed, and he says the taslim and departs, it suffices him."
text_ar:
عَنَهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ اِبْنِ أُذَيْئَةَ عَنِ ٱلْفُضَيْلِ وَ زُرَارَةَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي
جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا فَرَغَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الشَّهَادَتَيْنِ فَقَدْ مَضَتْ صَلاَثُهُ فَإِنْ كَانَ مُسْتَعْجِلاً فِي أَمْرِ يَخَافُ أَنْ
يَفُوتَهُ فَسَلَّمَ وَ اِنْصَرَفَ أَجْزَأَهُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.317 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.774 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.397 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.416 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.301
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} (was asked) regarding a man who is behind the imam (of prayer) and
the imam (of prayer) prolongs the tashahhud.
Imam {a.s} said: "Those behind him may say the taslim and proceed to their needs if they
wish."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ : فِي الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ خَلْفَ
الْإِمَامِ فَيْطِيلُ الْإِمَامُ النَّشَهُدَ قَالَ «يُسَلَّمُ مَنْ خَلْفَهُ وَ يَمْضِي فِي حَاجَتِهِ إِنْ أَحَبّ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.393 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.317 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.349 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1273 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.416 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.413

Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} (was asked) regarding a man who is behind the imam (of prayer) and

Imam {a.s} said: "Those behind him may say the taslim and proceed to their needs if they

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Safwan from Abdullah ibn Bukayr from
Zurarah who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “A man experiences a hadath (minor
ritual impurity) after he raises his head from the final prostration.”
Imam {a.s} said: "His prayer is complete, and indeed the tashahhud is a sunnah within
the prayer, so he should perform ablution and sit in his place or in a clean place and
then recite the tashahhud."

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “It is possible that the question was regarding one who
experiences a hadath after the two testimonies, even if he did not complete the rest of
his tashahhud, and for that reason he said: His prayer is complete. And if it had been
before that, it would have been obligatory upon him to repeat the prayer, as we have
explained. As for his statement: "And indeed the tashahhud is a sunnah," its meaning
is what is beyond the two testimonies, as we have explained previously, and what he
commanded him to do, to repeat it after performing ablution, is to be understood as
recommended.” As for what he narrated:
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ الرَّجُلُ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ مَا يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ السُّجُودِ الْأَخِيرِ فَقَالَ «تَمَّتْ صَلاَتُهُ وَ إِنَّمَا التَّشَهْدُ
سُنَّةٌ فِي الصَّلاةٍ فَيَتَوَضَّأْ وَ يَجْلِسُ مَكَانَهُ أَوْ مَكَاناً نَظِيفاً فَيَتَشَهَّدُ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : يحتمل أن يكون إنما سأل عمن أحدث بعد الشهادتين وإن لم يستوف باقي تشهده فلاجل ذلك قال:
تمت صلاته ، ولو كان قبل ذلك لكان يجب عليه اعادة الصلاة على ما بيناه، وأما قوله : وإنما التشهد سنة معناه ما زاد على
الشهادتين على ما بيناه فيما مضى ويكون ما أمره به من اعادته بعد أن يتوضأ محمولا على الاستحباب، فأما ما رواه:
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “It is possible that the question was regarding one who
experiences a hadath after the two testimonies, even if he did not complete the rest of
his tashahhud, and for that reason he said: His prayer is complete. And if it had been
before that, it would have been obligatory upon him to repeat the prayer, as we have
explained. As for his statement: "And indeed the tashahhud is a sunnah," its meaning
is what is beyond the two testimonies, as we have explained previously, and what he
commanded him to do, to repeat it after performing ablution, is to be understood as
recommended.” As for what he narrated:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Sa'd from Abu Ja'far from his father from Muhammad ibn Isa and Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id and Muhammad ibn
Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Zurarah:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who experiences a hadath
after he raises his head from the final prostration and before he recites the tashahhud.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should leave, perform ablution, and if he wishes, he may return to
the mosque, and if he wishes, then in his house, and if he wishes, wherever he wishes,
he may sit and recite the tashahhud and then offer the taslim. And if the hadath occurs
after the two testimonies, then his prayer has been completed."

Scholar's Note:
The interpretation of this narration is that we carry it upon the one who entered his
prayer with tayammum and then experienced a hadath forgetfully before the two
testimonies; in that case, he should perform ablution if he has found water and
complete the prayer with the two testimonies, and it is not obligatory upon him to
repeat it, just as it is obligatory upon him to complete it if he experiences a hadath
before that, as we have explained in the Book of Purity.
text_ar:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى وَ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ
عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : فِي الرَّجُلِ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ أَنْ يَرْفَعَ رَأْسَهُ فِي السَّجْدَةِ الْأَخِيرَةِ وَ قَبْلَ أَنْ
يَتَشَهْدَ قَالَ «يَنْصَرِفُ فَيَتَوَضَّأُ فَإِنْ شَاءَ رَجَعَ إِلَى ٱلْمَسْجِدِ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ فَفِي بَيْتِهِ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ حَيْثُ شَاءَ قَعَدَ فَتَشَهَدَ
ثُمَّ يُسَلَّمُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ الْحَدَثُ بَعْدَ الشَّهَادَتَيْنِ فَقَدْ مَضَّتْ صَلَاَتُهُ».
فالوجه في هذا الخبر ان نحمله على من دخل في صلاته بتيمم ثم أحدث ناسيا قبل الشهادتين فانه يتوضأ إذا كان قد
وجد الماء ويتمم الصلاة بالشهادتين وليس عليه اعادتها كما أن عليه اتمامها لو أحدث قبل ذلك على ما بيناه في كتاب
الطهارة.
commentary:
The interpretation of this narration is that we carry it upon the one who entered his
prayer with tayammum and then experienced a hadath forgetfully before the two
testimonies; in that case, he should perform ablution if he has found water and
complete the prayer with the two testimonies, and it is not obligatory upon him to
repeat it, just as it is obligatory upon him to complete it if he experiences a hadath
before that, as we have explained in the Book of Purity.

source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
text_chunk:
Sa'd from Abu Ja'far from his father from Muhammad ibn Isa and Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id and Muhammad ibn
Abi Umayr from Umar ibn Udhaynah from Zurarah:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who experiences a hadath
after he raises his head from the final prostration and before he recites the tashahhud.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should leave, perform ablution, and if he wishes, he may return to
the mosque, and if he wishes, then in his house, and if he wishes, wherever he wishes,
he may sit and recite the tashahhud and then offer the taslim. And if the hadath occurs
after the two testimonies, then his prayer has been completed." Scholar's Note:
The interpretation of this narration is that we carry it upon the one who entered his
prayer with tayammum and then experienced a hadath forgetfully before the two
testimonies; in that case, he should perform ablution if he has found water and
complete the prayer with the two testimonies, and it is not obligatory upon him to
repeat it, just as it is obligatory upon him to complete it if he experiences a hadath
before that, as we have explained in the Book of Purity.

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Sa'd ibn Abdullah from Musa ibn Al-Hasan from Al-Sindi ibn Muhammad from Al-Ala' ibn Razin from
Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who is overtaken by nosebleed or vomiting during the
prayer; what should he do?
Imam {a.s} said: "He should leave, wash his nose, and return to the prayer, and if he
speaks, then he must repeat the prayer."
text_ar:
سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنِ السِّنْدِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي
جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْثُهُ عَنِ الرَّجْلِ يَأْخَذُهُ الرُّعَافُ أَوِ الْقَيِءُ فِي الصَّلاةِ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ «يَنْقَتِلُ فَيَغْسِلُ
أَنْفَهُ وَ يَعُودُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَإِنْ تَكَلَّمَ فَلْيُعِدِ الصَّلاَةَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.318 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.403 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.240
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Khalid from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Amr ibn
Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar ibn Musa Al-Sabati:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "If a man forgets the tashahhud in the
prayer and remembers that he only said 'In the name of Allah {SWT},' then his prayer is
valid. But if he does not remember anything from the tashahhud, he must repeat the
prayer."

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “The interpretation of this narration is that if he
remembers that he said: " Bismillah," then his prayer is complete, and he should
complete the two testimonies in the manner of fulfillment and does not repeat the
prayer. And if he does not remember anything from the tashahhud, he must repeat the
prayer if he left it intentionally. And there is nothing in the narration indicating whether
he left it forgetfully or intentionally. But if he left it forgetfully and then remembered, it
would be obligatory upon him to fulfill the tashahhud as we have explained.”
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ
مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى السَّابَاطِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِنْ نَسِيَ الرَّجُلُ التَّشَهُدَ فِي
الصَّلاَةِ فَذَكَرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ فَقَطْ فَقَدْ جَازَتْ صَلاَتُهُ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ شَيْئاً مِنَ التَّشَهْدِ أَعَادَ الصَّلاَةَ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : الوجه في هذا الخبر انه إذا ذكر انه قال : بسم اللّٰه فقد تمت صلاته ويتمم الشهادتين على جهة
القضاء ولا يعيد الصلاة، وإذا لم يذكر شيئا من التشهد اعاد الصلاة إذا كان تركه له متعمدا ، وليس في الخبر أنه إذا لم
يذكره ناسيا أو متعمدا ، ولو تركه ناسيا ثم ذكر كان يجب عليه قضاء التشهد على ما بيناه.
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “The interpretation of this narration is that if he
remembers that he said: " Bismillah," then his prayer is complete, and he should
complete the two testimonies in the manner of fulfillment and does not repeat the
prayer. And if he does not remember anything from the tashahhud, he must repeat the
prayer if he left it intentionally. And there is nothing in the narration indicating whether
he left it forgetfully or intentionally. But if he left it forgetfully and then remembered, it
would be obligatory upon him to fulfill the tashahhud as we have explained.”
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.319 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.343 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.943 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.403 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 5 p.155

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Kufi from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Ghalib
ibn Uthman from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who performs the obligatory prayer, and his prayer
concludes and he recites the tashahhud, then he falls asleep before offering the
taslim.
Imam {a.s} said: "His prayer is complete, and if it was a nosebleed, he should wash it
and then return and offer the taslim."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ الْكُوفِيّ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ غَالِبِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْثُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي الْمَكْثُوبَةَ فَتَنْقَضِي صَلاَتُهُ وَ يَتَشَهَّدُ ثُمَّ يَنَامُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسَلَّمَ
قَالَ «قَدْ تَمَّتْ صَلاَتُهُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ رُعَافاً غَسَلَهُ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَسَلَمَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.319 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.868 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.425
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Sa'd ibn Bakr from Habib Al-Khath'ami from Abu Ja'far,
peace be upon him, who said:
I heard Imam {a.s} say: “When a man sits for the tashahhud and praises Allah {SWT}, it
suffices him.”

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “The interpretation of this narration is that it is due to
taqiyyah, because it is the doctrine of the general public, and we have already
explained the obligation of the two testimonies and the sending of blessings upon
Muhammad {saws} and his family {a.s}.”
text_ar:
أحمد بن محمد عن ابن أبي عمير عن سعد بن بكر عن حبيب الخثعمي عن أبي جعفر عليه السلام قال سمعته
يقول : إذا جلس الرجل للتشهد فحمد اللّه أجزأه.
قال محمد بن الحسن : الوجه في هذا الخبر التقية لانه مذهب العامة ونحن قد بينا وجوب الشهادتين والصلاة على محمد
واله،
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “The interpretation of this narration is that it is due to
taqiyyah, because it is the doctrine of the general public, and we have already
explained the obligation of the two testimonies and the sending of blessings upon
Muhammad {saws} and his family {a.s}.”
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Aban ibn Uthman from Zurarah from Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him,
who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who is praying, then sits and experiences a hadath
before offering the taslim.
Imam {a.s} said: "His prayer is complete, and if he is praying with an imam (of prayer)
and he feels discomfort in his stomach and offers the taslim to himself and stands up,
then his prayer is complete."

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This narration indicates that the taslim is not an
obligation, because if it were an obligation, it would be necessary for him to repeat the
prayer.” As for what he narrated:
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثمَانَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ
يُصَلِّي ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ فَيُحْدِثُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُسَلَّمَ قَالَ «قَدْ تَمَّثْ صَلاَتُهُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مَعَ إِمَامٍ فَوَجَدَ فِي بَطْنِهِ أَذَّى فَسَلَّمَ فِي
نَفْسِهِ وَ قَامَ فَقَدْ تَمَّتْ صَلاَتُهُ».
قال محمد بن الحسن: هذا الخبر يدل على ان التسليم ليس بفرض لانه لو كان فرضا لكان يجب عليه اعادة الصلاة، فأما
مارواه :
مممسطن صمعلونوسلسلممسالمانممطل سلململواسهلهمممنسمميا

obligation, because if it were an obligation, it would be necessary for him to repeat the
prayer.” As for what he narrated:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah from Abu Basir who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say regarding a man who prayed the
morning prayer, and when he sat in the two units before reciting the tashahhud, he
experienced a nosebleed.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should leave, wash his nose, then return and complete his prayer,
for the end of the prayer is the taslim."

Scholar's Note:
His statement, peace be upon him, "the end of the prayer is the taslim," is to be
understood as referring to what is preferable. As for the completion of the prayer, it is
necessary, because part of completing it is the recitation of the two testimonies, as
we have explained.
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةً عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:
فِي رَجُلٍ صَلَّى الصُّبْحَ فَلَمَّا جَلَسَ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَشَهَدَ رَعَفَ قَالَ «فَلْيَخْرُجْ فَلْيَغْسِلْ أَنْفَهُ ثُمَّ ليَرْجِع
فَلْيُتِمَّ صَلاَتَهُ فَإِنَّ آخِرَ الصَّلاَةِ التَّسْلِيمُ».
قوله عليه السلام : آخر الصلاة التسليم محمول على الافضل ، واما اتمام الصلاة فلا بد منه لان من اتمامها الاتيان
بالشهادتين على ما بيناه :
commentary:
His statement, peace be upon him, "the end of the prayer is the taslim," is to be
understood as referring to what is preferable. As for the completion of the prayer, it is
necessary, because part of completing it is the recitation of the two testimonies, as
we have explained.

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Abbas from Ali ibn Mahziyar from Abu Dawud Al-Mustariq from Hisham who
said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “I go out for a need, and I like to be among
those who perform ta'qib (post-prayer supplication).”
Imam {a.s} said: "If you are in a state of ablution, then you are among those who perform
ta'qib."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ أَبِي دَاوُدَ الْمُسْتَرِقٌ عَنْ هِشَامٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ إِنّي أُخْرُجُ فِي الْحَاجَةِ وَ أُحِبْ أنْ أكُونَ مُعَقَّباً فَقَالَ «إنْ كُنْتَ عَلَى وُضُوءِ فَأَنْتَ مُعَقِّبٌ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.320 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.786 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.457 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 2 p.316
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Musa ibn Umar from Mu'ammar ibn Khallad who said:
Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha, peace be upon him, sent for me regarding a need, so I entered
upon Imam {a.s}.
Imam {a.s} said: "Leave, and when tomorrow comes, then come, but do not come
except after the sun has risen, for I sleep after I have prayed the Fajr prayer."

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This narration has been reported as a concession,
and it is preferable that a person does not sleep after the Fajr prayer until the rising of
the sun, and it is permissible that Imam {a.s}, peace be upon him, only slept due to an
excuse that He {a.s} had.
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ مُعَمَّرِ بْنِ خَلاَّدٍ قَالَ: أَرْسَلَ إِلَيَ أَبُو الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
فِي حَاجَةٍ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ «اِنْصَرِف فَإِذَا كَانَ غَداً فَتَعَالَ وَ لا تَجِى إِلاَّ بَعْدَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ فَإِنَّي أَنَامُ إِذَا صَلَّيْتُ
الفَجْرَ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : هذه الرواية وردت رخصة والافضل ان لا ينام الانسان بعد الفجر الى طلوع الشمس ، ويجوز أن
يكون عليه السلام إنما نام لعذر كان به.
commentary:

and it is preferable that a person does not sleep after the Fajr prayer until the rising of
the sun, and it is permissible that Imam {a.s}, peace be upon him, only slept due to an
excuse that He {a.s} had.

text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad from his father from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Al-Sakuni

prayer place until the rising of the sun, there will be for him a covering from the Fire."

مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنِ ٱلسّكُونِيّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلَاَمُ
عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «مَنْ صَلَّى فَجَلَسَ فِي مُصَلاَّهُ إِلَى طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ كَانَ لَهُ سِثْراً
مِنَ النَّارِ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Abdur-Rahman ibn Abi Hashim from Salim ibn Abi Khadijah
from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
A man asked Imam {a.s} while I was listening, and said: “I pray the Fajr prayer, then I
engage in the remembrance of Allah {SWT} with all that I wish to remember of what is
obligatory upon me, then I desire to lay down my side and sleep before the rising of the
sun, but I dislike that.”
Imam {a.s} said: "And why?"
(the man) said: “I dislike that the sun should rise from other than its usual place.”
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no ambiguity in that. Look from where the Fajr rises, for from
there the sun rises, and there is no harm upon you to sleep if you have already engaged
in the remembrance of Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي هَاشِمِ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي خَدِيجَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ
قَالَ: سَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ وَ أَنَا أَسْمَعُ فَقَالَ إِنَّي أَصَلِّي الْفَجْرَ ثُمَّ أَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ بِكُلَّ مَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَذكُرَهُ مِمَّا يَجِبُ عَلَيّ فَأْرِيدُ أَنْ
أضَعَ جَنْبِي فَأَنَامَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ فَأَكْرَهُ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ «وَ لِمَ» قَالَ أَكْرَهُ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ مِنْ غَيْرِ مَطْلَعِهَا قَالَ
«لَيْسَ بِذَلِكَ خَفَاءَ أُنْظُرْ مِنْ حَيْثُ يَطْلُعُ الْفَجْرُ فَمِنْ ثَمَّ تَطْلُعُ الشَّمْسُ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ حَرَجِ أَنْ تَنَامَ إِذَا كُنْتَ قَدْ
ذَكَرْتَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Ammar
ibn Marwan from Al-Munakhkhal ibn Jamil from Jabir:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: “When you turn away from an obligatory prayer,
do not turn away except with a supplication for the curse upon the sons of Umayyah.”
text_ar:
محمد بن علي بن محبوب عن محمد بن الحسين عن محمد ابن سنان عن عمار بن مروان عن المنخل بن جميل
عن جابر عن أبي جعفر عليه السلام قال : إذا انحرفت عن صلاة مكتوبة فلا تنحرف إلا بانصراف لعن بني امية.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi' from Al-
Husayn ibn Thuwair and Abu Salamah Al-Sarraj who said:
We heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, while Imam {a.s} was cursing after every
obligatory prayer four men and four women; the Taymi, the Adawi, so-and-so, and
Mu'awiyah. And Imam {a.s} would name them, and so-and-so and so-and-so and Hind
and Umm Al-Hakam, the sister of Mu'awiyah.”
(The Four Men: al-Taymi; Abu Bakr ibn Abi Quhafa from Banu Taym of Quraysh, al-
Adawi; Umar ibn al-Khattab from the Banu ‘Adi clan, ‘so-and-so’; Uthman ibn ‘Affan &
Mu‘awiyah ibn Abi Sufyan of Banu Umayyah.
The Four Women: ‘so-and-so and so-and-so’; Aisha bint Abi Bakr and Hafsa bint Umar,
Hind bint ‘Utbah; mother of Mu’awiyah and wife of Abu Sufyan, Umm al-Hakam bint
Abi Sufyan; the sister of Mu’awiyah)
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَخْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعِ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ ثُوَيْرٍ وَ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ
السَّرَّاجٍ قَالاَ: سَمِعْنَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ وَ هُوَ يَلْعَنُ فِي دُبُرِ كُلِّ مَكْتُوبَةِ أَرْبَعَةً مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَ أَرْبَعاً مِنَ النَّسَاءِ
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.321 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.803 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.3 0 p.397 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 3 p.58

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Hisham ibn Salim from
Sulayman ibn Khalid who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "When the imam (of prayer) finishes the
prayer, he should not perform two units of prayer in his place until he moves away from
his position."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْن مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو
عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «إِذَا اِنْصَرَفَ الْإِمَامُ فَلاَ يُصَلِّي فِي مَقَامِهِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ حَتَّى يَنْحَرِفَ عَنْ مَقَامِهِ ذَلِكَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.321 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.382 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.284 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1267 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1267 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.186

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah from Al-Qasim ibn Yahya from his grandfather Al-Hasan ibn Rashid from Abu Basir
from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, from his forefathers {a.s}, peace be upon them:
The Commander of the Faithful (Imam Ali Ibn Abi Talib {a.s}), peace be upon him, said:
"When one of you finishes the prayer, let him raise his hands toward the sky and devote
himself to supplication."
Ibn Saba said: “O Commander of the Faithful, is not Allah {SWT} in every place?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
He asked: “Then why does he raise his hands toward the sky?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Do you not read in the Qur'an: 'And in the heaven is your sustenance
and that which you are promised'? (Surah Dhariyat 51:22)
So from where is sustenance sought except from its place? And the place of
sustenance and what Allah {SWT} has promised is the heaven."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ جَدِّهِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ رَاشِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلامُ أَنَّ أَمِيرَ الْمُؤمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «إِذَا فَرَغَ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ فَلْيَرْفَعْ يَدَيْهِ إِلَى
السّمَاءٍ وَلْيَنصَب فِي الدُّعَاءِ» فَقَالَ اِبْنُ سَبَا يَا أَمِيرَ ٱلْمُوْمِنِينَ أَلَيْسَ اللّهُ فِي كُلَّ مَكَانٍ فَقَالَ «بَلَى» قَالَ فَلِمَ يَرْفَعُ
يَدَيْهِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ قَالَ «أَمَا تَقْرَأُ فِي الْقُرْآنِ «وَ فِي السِّمَاءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَ مَا تُوعَدُونَ» فَمِنْ أَيْنَ يُطْلَبُ الرِّزْقُ إلا مِنْ
مَوْضِعِهِ وَ مَوْضِعُ الرِّزْقِ وَ مَا وَعَدَ اللَّهُ السَّمَاءُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.325 • ‘Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.344 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.322 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.785 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.487 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.161 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol.9 0 p.308 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.124 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.1 2 p.417 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.5 p.184

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Sinan from Ibn Muskan from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "The length of the saddle of the Messenger
of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, was one cubit, and when He {saws}
prayed, He {saws} would place it in front of Him and shield himself with it from those who
would pass in front of Him {saws}."

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “These narrations are to be understood as
recommending the act, not that whoever does not do it, his prayer is invalid.” What
indicates this is what has been narrated:
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ: «كَانَ طُولُ رَحْلِ رَسُولِ
اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ ذِرَاعاً وَ كَانَ إِذَا صَلَّى وَضَعَهُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ يَسْتَتِرُ بِهِ مِمَّنْ يَمُرُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ».
قال محمد بن الحسن: هذه الاخبار محمولة على الاستحباب لا ان من لم يفعله فسدت صلاته ، والذي يدل على ذلك رواه:

recommending the act, not that whoever does not do it, his prayer is invalid.” What
indicates this is what has been narrated:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Ibn Muskan from Ibn Abi Ya'fur who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man, does anything that passes
in front of him break his prayer?
Imam {a.s} said: "Nothing breaks the prayer of a Muslim, but repel as much as you are
able."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْن مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثُمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ
عَنِ الرَّجُلِ هَلْ يَقْطَعُ صَلاَتَهُ شَيْءُ مِمَا يَمُرْ بِهِ فَقَالَ «لا يَقْطَعُ صَلاَةَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِ شَيْءٌ وَ لَكِنِ اِدْرَءُوا مَا اِسْتَطَعْتُمْ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.322 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.406 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.483
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

text_en:
And Ibn Muskan narrated from Abu Basir:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Nothing breaks the prayer, neither a dog,
nor a donkey, nor a woman, but seek to shield yourselves with something. If there is in

yourself."
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى اِبْنُ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «لا يَقْطَعُ ٱلصَّلاةَ شَيْءَ كَلْبٌ وَ لاَ جِمَارٌ وَ لاَ
اِمْرَأَةً وَ لَكِنِ اِسْتَتِرُوا بِشَيْء فَإِنْ كَانَ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ قَدْرَ ذِرَاعِ رَافِعٌ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ فَقَدِ اِسْتَتَرْتَ».

text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from his father from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Ghiyath:

أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمْدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ غِيَاتٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللّهُ

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Amr ibn Khalid from Sufyan ibn Khalid
from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam {a.s} was praying one day when a man passed in front of him while his son (Imam)
Musa {a.s}, peace be upon him, was sitting.
When (Imam al-Sadiq {a.s}) finished, his son (Imam al-Kadhim {a.s}) said:
"O my father, did you not see the man who passed in front of you?"
Imam {a.s} said: "O my son, the One {AZJ} for whom I was praying is closer to me than the
one who passed in front of me."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ : أَنَّهُ كَانَ يُصَلِّي ذَاتَ يَوْمِ إِذْ مَرَ رَجُلَ قُدَامَهُ وَ اِبْنُهُ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ جَالِسْ فَلَمَّا اِنْصَرَفَ قَالَ لَهُ اِبْنَهُ
«يَا أَبَتٍ مَا رَأَيْتَ الرِّجُلَ مَرّ قُدَّامَكَ» فَقَالَ «يَا بُنَيَ إنَّ ٱلَّذِي أُصَلِّي لَهُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِي مَرَّ قُدَامِي».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah {a.s},
peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man, does anything that passes in front of him cut off his
prayer?
Imam {a.s} said: "Nothing cuts the prayer of a Muslim, but repel as much as you are
able." He (al Halabi) said: “And I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who experiences a
nosebleed and the bleeding does not stop until the time of prayer enters.”
Imam {a.s} said: "He should stuff his nose with something and then pray, and he should
not prolong the prayer if he fears that the blood will precede him."
He (al Halabi) said: “And Imam {a.s} said: ‘If you turn away during an obligatory prayer
without completing it, then repeat the prayer if the turning was excessive; but if you
have already recited the tashahhud, then do not repeat.’"
text_ar:
عَلِيْ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ
الرَّجُلِ أَيَقْطَعُ صَلاَتَهُ شَيْءٌ مِمَّا يَمُرُّ بِهِ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فَقَالَ «لا يَقْطَعُ صَلاَةَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِ شَيْءُ وَ لَكِنِ إِدْرَأْ مَا اِسْتَطَعْتَ)
قَالَ وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ رَعَفَ وَ لَمْ يَرْقَ رُعَافُهُ حَتَّى دَخَلَ وَقْتُ الصّلاَةِ قَالَ «يَحْشُو أَنْفَهُ بِشَيْءٍ ثُمّ يُصَلِّي وَ لا
يُطيلُ إنْ خَشِيَ أَنْ يَسْبِقَهُ الدَّمُ» قَالَ وَ قَالَ «إِذَا الْتَفَتَّ فِي صَلاةٍ مَكْتُوبَةِ مِنْ غَيْرِ فَرَاغٍ فَأَعِدِ الصَّلاَةَ إِذَا كَانَ
اَلالْتِفَاتُ فَاحِشا وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ قَدْ تَشَهَدْتَ فَلاَ تُعِدْ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.365 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.323
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Abdullah ibn Amir from Ali ibn Mahziyar from Fadalah from Al-Ala' from
Muhammad ibn Muslim who said:
I asked Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, about a man who experiences nosebleed and
vomiting during the prayer, what should he do?
Imam {a.s} said: "He should turn away, wash his nose, and return to his prayer. But if he
speaks, then he must repeat his prayer, and he is not required to perform ablution."
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْن مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ الْعَلاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ:
سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنِ الرّجُلِ يَأْخُذُهُ الرُعَافُ وَ الْقَيْءُ فِي الصَّلاةِ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ «يَنْقَتِلُ فَيَغْسِلُ أَنْفَهُ
وَ يَعُودُ فِي صَلاَتِهِ وَ إِنْ تَكَلَّمَ فَلْيُعِدْ صَلاَتَهُ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ وُضُوء».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.365 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.323 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.870 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.1 p.264 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.238
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from Zurarah:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Loud laughter does not invalidate the
ablution, but it does invalidate the prayer."
text_ar:
عَلِي بْنُ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ بْنِ دَرَّاجِ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلَاَمُ قَالَ:
«اَلْقَهْقَهَةُ لا تَنْقُضُ الْوُضُوءَ وَ لَكِنْ تَنقُضُ الصَّلاَةَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.364 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.324 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.891 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.1 p.261 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.250

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Al-Hasan from his brother from Zur'ah from Sama'ah who said:
I asked Him about laughter, does it break the prayer?
He said: "As for smiling, it does not break the prayer, but as for loud laughter, it does
break the prayer."
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَجِيهِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةً قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الضَّحِكِ هَلْ يَقْطَعُ الصَّلاةَ قَالَ
«أمّا التَّبَسُمُ فَلا يَقْطَعُ الصَّلاةَ وَ أَمّا الْقَهْقَهَةُ فَهيَ تَقْطَعُ الصَّلاةَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.364 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.324 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.891 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.250
