author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Safwan from Abdullah ibn Al-Hajjaj who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, about a man who experiences cramping in his stomach and
is able to endure it, should he pray in that condition or not?
Imam {a.s} said: "If he can bear the endurance and does not fear being rushed in his
prayer, then he should pray and be patient."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفُوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ٱلْحَجَاجِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصِيبُهُ الْغَمْزُ فِي بَطْنِهِ وَ هُوَ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَصْبِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَيُصَلِّي عَلَى تِلْكَ اَلْحَالِ أَوْ لا يُصَلِّي قَالَ فَقَالَ
«إِنِ اِحْتَمَلَ الصِّبْرَ وَ لَمْ يَخَفْ إِعْجَالاً عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ فَلْيُصَلِّ وَ لَيَصْبِرْ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.364 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.324 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.863 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.251
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from Muhammad ibn Isa from Yunus from Al-Ala' from Muhammad ibn Muslim from one of
them (Imams {a.s}), peace be upon them:
Imam {a.s} (was asked) regarding a man who touches his nose during the prayer and
sees blood, what should he do, should he leave?
Imam {a.s} said: "If it is dry, then he should throw it away and there is no harm."
text_ar:
عَلِيْ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنِ الْعَلاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلاَمُ : فِي
الرَّجُلٍ يَمَسُّ أَنْفَهُ فِي الصَّلاةِ فَيَرَى دَما كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ أَ يَنْصَرِفُ فَقَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ يَابِساً فَلْيَرْمِ بِهِ وَ لا بَأْسَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.364 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.324 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.871 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.437 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.239

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ali from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah {a.s}:
Imam {a.s} was asked about a man who needs something while he is in prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should gesture with his head and signal with his hand. And a
woman, if she needs something while she is praying, should clap with her hands."
He (al Halabi) said: “And I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who yawns and stretches
during the prayer”.
Imam {a.s} said: "It is from Shaytan, and he will not be able to control it."
text_ar:
عَلِيْ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : أَنَّهُ سُيْلَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُرِيدُ
الْحَاجَةً وَ هُوَ فِي الصَّلاةِ فَقَالَ «يُومِئ بِرَأْسِهِ وَ يُشِيرُ بِيَدِهِ وَ ٱلْمَرْأَةُ إِذَا أَرَادَتِ ٱلْحَاجَةَ وَ هِيَ تُصَلِّي تُصَفَّقُ
بِيَدِهَا» قَالَ وَ سَأَلْثُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يَتَتَأَبُ فِي الصَّلاةِ وَ يَتَمَطَّى قَالَ «هُوَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ وَ لَنْ يَمْلِكَهُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.324
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Nasr from Abu Al-Walid who said:
I was sitting with Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, when Najiyah Abu Habib asked
Imam {a.s} and said: “May I be your ransom, I have a mill in which I grind, and sometimes
I rise during a part of the night and know from the sound of the mill that the servant has
fallen asleep, so I strike the wall to wake him up.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, you are in obedience to Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic, seeking
His sustenance."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْوَلِيدِ قَالَ: كُنْتُ جَالِساً عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ فَسَأَلَهُ نَاجِيَةُ
أَبُو حَبِيبٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ جَعَلَنِيَ اللَّهُ فِدَاكَ إِنّ لِي رَحَى أَطَحَنْ فِيهَا فَرُبَّمَا قُمْتُ فِي سَاعَةٍ مِنَ اللِّيْلِ فَأَعْرِفُ مِنَ الرَّحَى
أَنَّ الْغُلامَ قَدْ نَامَ فَأَضْرِبُ الْحَائِطَ لِأُوقِظَهُ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ أَنْتَ فِي طَاعَةِ اللّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ تَطْلُبُ رِزْقَهُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.301 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.325 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.896 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.256

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ali from his father from Hammad ibn Isa from some of his companions:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Everything with which you speak to Allah
{SWT} during the obligatory prayer, there is no harm in it, and it is not considered speech
(that invalidates the prayer)."
text_ar:
عَلِيٌّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «كُلُّ مَا كَلَّمْتَ اللَّهَ
بِهِ فِي صَلاَةِ الْفَرِيضَةِ فَلاَ بَأْسَ وَ لَيْسَ بِكَلامِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.325
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ali ibn Mahziyar from Fadalah from Aban from Salamah from Abu Hafs:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said that (Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, used
to say: "Nosebleed, blood, and vomiting do not cut off the prayer. So whoever
experiences discomfort should take the hand of a man from the people in the row and
bring him forward, meaning if he is the imam (of prayer)."
text_ar:
عَلِي بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي حَفْص عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ أَنَّ عَلِيَاً عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ
كَانَ يَقُولُ: «لا يَقْطَعُ الصَّلاةَ الرُعَافُ وَ لاَ اَلدَّمْ وَ لاَ الْقَيْءُ فَمَنْ وَجَدَ أَذَى فَلْيَأْخُذْ بِيَدِ رَجْلٍ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ مِنَ الصَّفِّ
فَلْيُقَدَّمْهُ يَعْنِي إِذَا كَانَ إِمَاما».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.366 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.325 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.404 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.870 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1238 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.240

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Dawud Al-Khandaqi from Abu Basir who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "When you stand for prayer, know that you
are before Allah {SWT}; if you do not see Him {AZJ}, then know that He {AZJ} sees you. So turn
fully toward your prayer and do not blow your nose, nor spit, nor crack your fingers, nor
sit in a sprawling manner, for a people were punished for cracking their fingers and
sprawling during the prayer.
When you raise your head from bowing (ruku'), straighten your back until your joints
return to their places. And when you prostrate, do the same. And when you are in the
first and second rak'ahs and raise your head from prostration, sit properly until your
joints return to their places.
When you stand up, say: 'By the power and strength of Allah {SWT} I stand and sit,' for
indeed (Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, used to do so."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ دَاوُدَ الْخَنْدَقِيِّ [الْخَنْدَقِيِّ خ ل] عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ : «إِذَا قُمْتَ فِي الصَّلاةِ فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّكَ بَيْنَ يَدَي اللَّهِ فَإِنْ كُنْتَ لا تَرَاهُ فَاعْلَمْ أَنَّهُ يَرَاكَ فَأَقْبِلْ قِبَلَ صَلاَتِكَ وَ لاَ
نَمْتَخِط وَ لا تَبْزُقُ وَ لا تَنْقُضْ أَصَابِعَكَ وَ لاَ تَوَرَّك فَإِنَّ قَوْما قَدْ عُذَّبُوا بِنَقْضِ الْأَصَابِعِ وَ التَّوَرْكِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَإِذَا
رَفَعْتَ رَأْسَكَ مِنَ الرُكُوعِ فَأَقِمْ صُلْبَكَ حَتَّى تَرْجِعَ مَفَاصِلُكَ وَ إِذَا سَجَدْتَ فَافْعَلْ مِثلَ ذَلِكَ وَ إِذَا كُنْتَ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ
الْأُولَى وَ الثَّانِيَةِ فَرَفَعْتَ رَأْسَكَ مِنَ السُّجُودِ فَاسْتَتِمَ جَالِساً حَتَّى تَرْجِعَ مَفَاصِلُكَ فَإِذَا نَهَضْتَ فَقُلْ بِحَوْلِ اللّهِ وَ
قُوْتِهِ أَقُومُ وَ أَقْعُدُ فَإِنَّ عَلِياً عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ هَكَذَا كَانَ يَفْعَلُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.325 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.850 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.465
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Sayf ibn Umayrah from Abu Bakr Al-Hadrami from his father from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, said:
"Do not pray while you feel anything from the two impurities."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ الْحَضْرَمِيَّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ
إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللّهِ صَلِّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَالَ: «لا تُصَلِّ وَ أَنْتَ تَجِدُ شَيْئاً مِنَ الْأَخْبَثَيْنِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.326 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.864 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.252
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
text_chunk:
From him from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Sayf ibn Umayrah from Abu Bakr Al-Hadrami from his father from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, said:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim from (Imam) Ja'far {a.s} from his father {a.s}:
(Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Do not let your gaze go beyond the place of
your prostration during the prayer."
And Imam {a.s} said: "A man should not pray with his buttons undone if he is not wearing
an izar (waist wrap)."

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This narration is to be understood as recommending
the act”, and what indicates that is what has been narrated:
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ غِيَاتِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ - عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا تُجَاوِزْ بِطَرَفِكَ
فِي الصَّلاةٍ مَوْضِعَ سُجُودِكَ» وَ قَالَ «لا يُصَلِّي الرَجُلُ مَحْلُولَ الْأَزْرَارِ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْهِ إِذَارٌ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : هذا الخبر محمول على الاستحباب ، والذي يدل على ذلك ما رواه :

Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This narration is to be understood as recommending
the act”, and what indicates that is what has been narrated:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from a man who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “The people say that if a man prays while
his buttons are undone and his hands are inside his shirt, it is as if he is praying naked.”
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ إِنَّ النَّاسَ يَقُولُونَ
إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ إِذَا صَلَّى وَ أَزْرَارُهُ مَحْلُولَةٌ وَ يَدَاهُ دَاخِلَةٌ فِي ٱلْقَمِيصِ إِنَّمَا يُصَلِّي عُرْيَاناً قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.326 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.392 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.374 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.394 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.432
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him from Ibn Abi Umayr who said: I heard Abdur-Rahman ibn Al-Hajjaj say:
I saw Abu Abdul Malik Al-Qummi asking Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about
placing one's hand inside the garment during prayer in prostration.
Imam {a.s} said: "If you wish, you may do so; it is not from this that I fear for you."
text_ar:
عَنَهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ الْحَجَّاجِ يَقُولُ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ الْقُمِّيَّ يَسْأَلُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنْ إِذْخَالٍ يَدِهِ فِي التَّوْبِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فِي السُّجُودِ قَالَ «إِنْ شِئْتَ فَعَلْتَ لَيْسَ مِنْ هَذَا أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.326
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
From him from Ibn Abi Umayr who said: I heard Abdur-Rahman ibn Al-Hajjaj say:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Mahziyar who said:
I asked Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, about a man who speaks during the obligatory
prayer with anything by which he converses with his Lord {AZJ}.
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَتَكَلِّمُ فِي صَلاَةِ الْفَرِيضَةِ بِكُلِّ
شَيْءٍ يُنَاجِي رَبَّهُ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.326 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.879 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.289 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.263 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.2 3 p.398
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Jawad {a.s}
text_chunk:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Mahziyar who said:
I asked Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, about a man who speaks during the obligatory
prayer with anything by which he converses with his Lord {AZJ}.
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him from Bakr ibn Muhammad Al-Azdi from Aban ibn Uthman from Al-Halabi who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “Should I name the Imams, peace be
upon them, individually in the prayer?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Mention them collectively."
text_ar:
عنه عن بكر بن محمد الازدي عن أبان بن عثمان عن الحلبي قال قلت : لابي عبد الله عليه السلام أسمي الائمة
عليهم السلام في الصلاة؟ قال : اجملهم.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Musa ibn Al-Qasim from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja'far
{a.s}, peace be upon them both, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man, is it permissible for him to lean against the wall of the
mosque while praying, or to place his hand on the wall while standing without illness
or weakness?
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
And I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who is in the obligatory prayer and stands during
the first two rak'ahs, is it permissible for him to reach toward the side of the mosque
and use it to help himself rise without weakness or illness?
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in it."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنِ الرَّجُلِ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يَسْتَنِدَ إِلَى حَائِطِ الْمَسْجِدِ وَ هُوَ يُصَلِّي أَوْ يَضَعَ يَدَهُ عَلَى الْحَائِطِ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ مِنْ غَيْرٍ
مَرَضٍ وَ لا عِلَّةٍ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ» وَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي صَلاَةٍ فَرِيضَةٍ فَيَقُومُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ ٱلْأُولَيَيْنِ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ
أَنْ يَتَنَاوَلَ جَانِبَ الْمَسْجِدِ فَيَنْهَضَ يَسْتَعِينُ بِهِ عَلَى الْقِيَامِ مِنْ غَيْرِ ضَعْفٍ وَ لا عِلَّةٍ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِهِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.364 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.326 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.899 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.499

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Sa'd from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ali from his father from Al-Husayn ibn Al-Hasan ibn Al-Jahm from Al-
Husayn ibn Musa from Sa'id ibn Yasar who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about leaning during the prayer against
the wall, whether to the right or the left.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
text_ar:
سَغدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ الْجَهِمِ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ سَعِيدِ
بْنِ يَسَارٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ التُكَأَةِ فِي الصَّلاةِ عَلَى ٱلْحَائِطِ يَمِيناً وَ شِمَالاً فَقَالَ «لاَ بَأْسَ».

source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Abdullah ibn Bukayr from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who prays leaning on a staff or on a wall.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm in leaning on a staff or resting against a wall."
text_ar:
عَنَهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ قَالَ:
سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي مُتَوَكِّئا عَلَى عَصًا أَوْ عَلَى حَائِطِ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِالتَّوَكَي عَلَى عَصًا وَ الإِتَّكَاءِ عَلَى
اَلْحَائِطِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.327 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.900 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.500

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him from Ahmad from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Al-Hasan ibn Ribbat from Muhammad ibn
Bajil, the brother of Ali ibn Bajil, who said:
I saw Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, praying, and a man passed in front of Him
{a.s} while He {a.s} was between the two prostrations, so Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon
him, threw a pebble at him, and the man turned toward him.
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ رِبَاطِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ بَجِيلٍ أَخِي عَلِيَّ بْنِ بَجِيلٍ
قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يُصَلِّي فَمَرَّ بِهِ رَجُلٌ وَ هُوَ بَيْنَ السِّجْدَتَيْنِ فَرَمَاهُ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلاَمُ
بِحَصَاةٍ فَأَقْبَلَ إِلَيْهِ الرَّجُلُ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.371 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.327 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.897 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.258
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abu Khalid from Abu Hamzah who said:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "If you insert your hand into your nose while you
are praying and you find flowing blood that is not a nosebleed, then break your prayer
with your hand."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «إِنْ أَدْخَلْتَ يَدَكَ فِي أَثْفِكَ
وَأَنْتَ تُصَلِّي فَوَجَدْتَ دَماً سَائِلا لَيْسَ بِرُعَافٍ فَفُتَّهُ بِيَدِكَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.327 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.872 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.242
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him from Ibn Abi Najran from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb Al-Bajali who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about nosebleed, does it invalidate the
ablution?
Imam {a.s} said: "If a man experiences a nosebleed during his prayer, and he has water
with him or someone nearby who can signal to him and hand him water, and he
gestures with his head and washes it, then let him continue his prayer and not cut it
off."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبِ الْبَجَلِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الرُعَافِ أَيَنْقُضُ
الْوُضُوءَ قَالَ «لَوْ أَنَّ رَجُلاً رَعَفَ فِي صَلاَتِهِ وَ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ مَاءً أَوْ مَنْ يُشِيرُ إِلَيْهِ بِمَاءٍ فَيُنَاوِلُهُ فَقَالَ بِرَأْسِهِ فَغَسَلَهُ
فَلْيَبْنِ عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ وَ لاَ يَقْطَعْهَا».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.327 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.870 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.241
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Isma'il ibn Abd Al-Khaliq who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who is among a group of people leading them in the
obligatory prayer, and he experiences a nosebleed, what should he do?
Imam {a.s} said: "He should leave, and if he finds water before speaking, he should wash
the blood from the nosebleed, then return and continue with his prayer."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْخَالِقِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ يُصَلِّي
بِهِمُ الْمَكْتُوبَةَ فَيَعْرِضُ لَهُ رُعَافٌ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ «يَخْرُجُ فَإِنْ وَجَدَ مَاءً قَبْلَ أَنْ يَتَكَلَّمَ فَلْيَغْسِلِ الرُّعَافَ ثُمَّ ليَعْذُ
فَلْيَبْنِ عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.328 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.403 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.870 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.241
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother Al-
Husayn ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, about nosebleed, cupping, and vomiting.
Imam {a.s} said: "None of these invalidate the ablution, but they do invalidate the
prayer."
text_ar:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيَ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ
أَبَا الْحَسَنٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الرُّعَافِ وَ الْحِجَامَةِ وَ الْقَيءِ قَالَ «لَا يَنْقُضُ هَذَا شَيْئاً مِنَ الْوُضُوءِ وَ لَكِنْ يَنْقُضُ
الصَّلاَةَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.328 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.403 • Al-Wafi, Vol.6 p.253 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.872 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.1 p.262
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
text_chunk:
As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother Al-
Husayn ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, about nosebleed, cupping, and vomiting.
Imam {a.s} said: "None of these invalidate the ablution, but they do invalidate the

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
And what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abu Khalid from Abu
Hamzah:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "Nothing interrupts the prayer except a nosebleed
and severe discomfort in the stomach, so hasten to address them as much as you are
able."

Scholar's Note:
The interpretation of these two narrations is that we carry them upon the case where
the nosebleed requires its person to turn away from the qiblah or to speak. As for when
neither of these occurs, then it does not interrupt the prayer, as we have explained
previously in the earlier narrations.
text_ar:
وَ مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا
يَقْطَعُ الصَّلاَةَ إِلاَّ رُعَافٌ وَ أَزْ فِي الْبَطْنِ فَبَادِرُوا بِهِنَّ مَا اِسْتَطَعْتُمْ».
فالوجه في هذين الخبرين ان نحملهما على رعاف يحتاج صاحبهما الى الانصراف عن القبلة أو الى الكلام ، فأما مع عدم
ذلك فلا يقطع الصلاة على ما قدمناه في الاخبار المتقدمة.
commentary:
The interpretation of these two narrations is that we carry them upon the case where
the nosebleed requires its person to turn away from the qiblah or to speak. As for when
neither of these occurs, then it does not interrupt the prayer, as we have explained
previously in the earlier narrations.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.328 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.872

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who is greeted with salam while he is in prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should respond by saying, 'Salamun alaykum,' and he should not
say, 'Alaykumu as-salam,' for the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and
his family, was once standing in prayer when Ammar ibn Yasir passed by Him {saws} and
greeted Him {saws} with salam, so the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, responded to him in this manner."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثُمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْثُهُ عَنِ الرّجُلِ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَيْهِ وَ هُوَ فِي
الصَّلاةٍ قَالَ «يَرُدّ يَقُولُ «سَلامٌ عَلَيْكُمْ» وَ لاَ يَقُولُ عَلَيْكُمُ السَّلاَمُ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَانَ قَائِماً
يُصَلِّي قَمَرَّ بِهِ عَمَّارُ بْنُ يَاسِرٍ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ فَرَدَّ عَلَيْهِ - أَلنَّبِيْ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ هَكَذَا».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.366 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.328 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.887 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.267 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.2 p.143
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
text_chunk:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who is greeted with salam while he is in prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should respond by saying, 'Salamun alaykum,' and he should not
say, 'Alaykumu as-salam,' for the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and
his family, was once standing in prayer when Ammar ibn Yasir passed by Him {saws} and
greeted Him {saws} with salam, so the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, responded to him in this manner."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim from Muhammad ibn Muslim who said:
I entered upon Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, while He {a.s} was in prayer.
I said: "Peace be upon you,"
And Imam {a.s} replied: "Peace be upon you."
I asked: "How did you wake up?"
But Imam {a.s} remained silent, and when He {a.s} finished, I said to Imam {a.s}:
"Does one return the salam while in prayer?"
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, in the manner it was said to him."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ وَ
هُوَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَقُلْتُ ٱلسَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ فَقَالَ «السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ» قُلْتُ كَيْفَ أَصْبَحْتَ فَسَكَتَ فَلَمَا اِنْصَرَفَ قُلْتُ لَهُ أَ يَرُدْ
السَّلاَمَ وَ هُوَ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ مِثْلَ مَا قِيلَ لَهُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.329 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.887 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.267 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.2 p.143

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Misma’ who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}: “I might be praying and a slave-girl passes by me, and I might
draw her toward me.”
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مِسْمَعٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ فَقُلْتُ أَكُونُ أُصَلِّي فَتَمُرُ بِي
جَارِيَةٌ فَرُبَّمَا ضَمَمْتُهَا إِلَيَ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.329 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.892 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.278
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him from Abu Muhammad Al-Hajjal from Abu Ishaq from Abu Bakr Al-Hadrami:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "There is no harm in blowing during the
prayer at the place of prostration as long as it does not harm anyone."
text_ar:
عَنَهُ عَنْ أَبِي مُحَمَّدِ الْحَجَالِ عَنْ أَبِي إسْحَاقَ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ الْحَصْرَمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ
بالنَّفَخٍ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فِي مَوْضِعِ السُّجُودِ مَا لَمْ يُوْذِ أَحَداً».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.329 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.908 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.350
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abu Khalid from Abu Hamzah who said:
"If you find a louse while you are in prayer, then bury it in the pebbles."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ قَالَ: «إِنْ وَجَدْتَ قَمْلَةً وَ أَنْتَ فِي
الصَّلاَةٍ فَادفِتْها فِي
الْحَصَى».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.329 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.275
source_scholar: Implicit (Muzmar)

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Ala who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who stands in prayer and
sees a louse.
Imam {a.s} said: "Let him bury it in the gravel, for (Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, used
to say: 'If you see it, then bury it in the pebbles.'"
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ ٱلْحَكَمِ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَلاءِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يَقُومُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ
فَيَرَى الْقَمْلَةَ قَالَ «فَلْيَذْفِئْهَا فِي الْحَصَى فَإِنَّ عَلِيَاً عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ كَانَ يَقُولُ «إِذَا رَأَيْتَهَا فَاذْفِئهَا فِي الْبَطْحَاءِ» ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.329 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.906 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.276
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Haytham ibn Abi Masruq Al-Nahdi from Muhammad ibn Haytham Al-Tamimi
from Sa'id Al-A'raj who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “I spend the night intending to fast, and
while I am in the witr prayer I become thirsty, but I dislike cutting off the supplication
to drink, and I also dislike reaching morning while I am thirsty. In front of me there is a
water container, two or three steps away.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Go to it, drink what you need from it, and then return to your
supplication."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْهَيْتَمِ بْنِ أَبِي مَسْرُوقِ النِّهْدِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ هَيْتَمِ التَّمِيمِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدِ الْأَعْرَجِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ إِنَّي أَبِيتُ وَ أُرِيدُ الصَّوْمَ فَأَكُونُ فِي الْوَثْرِ فَأَعْطَشُ فَأَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَقْطَعَ الدُعَاءَ فَأَشرَبَ وَ أَكْرَهُ
أَنْ أُصْبِحَ وَ أَنَا عَطْشَانُ وَ أَمَامِي قُلَّةٌ بَيْنِي وَ بَيْنَهَا خُطْوَتَانِ أَوْ ثَلاَثَةٌ قَالَ «تَسْعَى إِلَيْهَا وَ تَشرَبُ مِنْهَا حَاجَتَكَ وَ
تَعودُ فِي الدُّعَاءِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.329 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.95 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.902 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.279 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.312
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him from Al-Hasan ibn Ali from Amr ibn Sa'id Al-Mada'ini from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah Al-Mada'ini from
Ammar Al-Sabati:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: "There is no harm if a woman carries her child while she is
praying, or if she breastfeeds him while she is reciting the tashahhud."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدِ الْمَدَائِنِيِّ عَنْ مُصَدِّقٍ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ الْمَدَائِنِيِّ عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ أَنْ تَحْمِلَ الْمَرْأَةُ صَبِيَّهَا وَ هِيَ تُصَلِّي أَوْ تُرْضِعَهُ وَ هِيَ تَتَشَهَّدُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.902 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.280
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Talhah ibn Zayd from Ja'far from his father:
(Imam) Ali {a.s} said: "Whoever groans during his prayer has indeed spoken."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدِ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «مَنْ
أنَّ فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَقَدْ تَكَلَّمَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.876 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.281
source_scholar: Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}

text_en:
From him from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Ala who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who sees a snake or a
scorpion while he is praying the obligatory prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should kill them."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَلاءِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَرَى الْحَيَّةَ وَ
الْعَقْرَبَ وَ هُوَ يُصَلِّي الْمَكْتُوبَةَ قَالَ «يَقْتُلُهُمَا».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.905 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.273
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him from Hammad from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who is in prayer and sees a
snake or a scorpion, should he kill them if they harm him?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي
الصَّلاَةِ
فَيَرَى الْحَيَّةَ أَوِ الْعَقْرَبَ يَقْتُلُهُمَا إِنْ آذَيَاهُ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.367 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.905
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from Al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who kills a bug, a
flea, a louse, or a fly during prayer, does it invalidate his prayer or his ablution?
Imam {a.s} said: "No."
text_ar:
عَلِي بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ : فِي الرَّجُلِ يَقْثَلُ
اَلْبَقَّةً وَ الْبُرْغُوثَ وَ الْقَمْلَةَ وَ الذُّبَابَ فِي الصَّلَاَةِ أَيَنْقُضُ صَلَاَتَهُ وَ وُضُوءَهُ قَالَ «لا)).
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.367 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.368 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.905 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.1 p.293
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who is standing in obligatory prayer and remembers his
pouch or some of his belongings, fearing their loss or ruin.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should cut off his prayer, secure his belongings, and then start his
prayer anew."
I asked: “If he is in obligatory prayer and his animal breaks loose and he fears it might
be lost or cause harm”
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm if he cuts off his prayer."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ قَائِماً فِي الصَّلاةِ الْفَرِيضَةِ فَيَنْسَى
كِيسَهُ أَوْ مَتَاعاً لَهُ يَتَخَوَّفُ ضَيْعَتَهُ أَوْ هَلاكَهُ قَالَ «يَقْطَعُ صَلاَتَهُ وَ يُحْرِزُ مَتَاعَهُ ثُمَ يَسْتَقْبِلُ الصَّلاَةَ» قُلْتُ فَيَكُونُ
فِي الصَّلاَةِ الْفَرِيضَةِ فَتَفَلّتْ دَابَّثُهُ فَيَخَافُ أَنْ تَذْهَبَ أَوْ يُصِيبَ مِنْهَا عَنَتاً فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِأَنْ يَقْطَعَ صَلاَتَهُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.367 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.903 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.277 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.289
source_scholar: Implicit (Muzmar)
text_chunk:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who is standing in obligatory prayer and remembers his
pouch or some of his belongings, fearing their loss or ruin.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should cut off his prayer, secure his belongings, and then start his
prayer anew."
I asked: “If he is in obligatory prayer and his animal breaks loose and he fears it might
be lost or cause harm”
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm if he cuts off his prayer."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Isma'il by Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan by Hammad by Hariz by someone from Abu Abdillah {a.s}:
(Imam {a.s}) said: "If you are in obligatory prayer and you see your servant running away,
or a debtor upon whom you have a debt, or a snake that you fear for yourself, then cut
off the prayer and pursue your servant or your debtor and kill the snake."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَمَّنْ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:
«إِذَا كُنْتَ فِي صَلاَةِ الْفَرِيضَةِ فَرَأَيْتَ غُلاَماً لَكَ قَدْ أَبَقَ أَوْ غَرِيما لَكَ عَلَيْهِ مَالٌ أَوْ حَيَّةً تَخَافُهَا عَلَى نَفْسِكَ فَاقْطَعٍ
الصَّلاَةَ وَ اِتْبَعِ اَلْغُلاَمَ أَوْ غَرِيماً لَكَ وَ أُقْتُلِ الْحَيَّةَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.367 • Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.369 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.331 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.903 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.276 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.289
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Isma'il by Al-Fadl ibn Shadhan by Hammad by Hariz by someone from Abu Abdillah {a.s}:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Isma'il from Mansur ibn Yunus from Abu Bakr Al-Hadrami from
Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdullah, peace be upon them both:
The Imam {a.s} said: "Nothing invalidates the prayer except four things: relieving oneself,
urination, passing wind, and speaking."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ يُونُسَ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ وَ أَبِي عَبْدِ
اللّهِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ أَنَّهُمَا قَالا: «لا يَقْطَعُ الصَّلَاةَ إِلاَّ أَرْبَع الْخَلَاءُ وَ الْبَوْلُ وَ الرِّيحُ وَ الصَّوْتُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.331 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.400
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Isma'il from Mansur ibn Yunus from Abu Bakr Al-Hadrami from
Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdullah, peace be upon them both:
The Imam {a.s} said: "Nothing invalidates the prayer except four things: relieving oneself,
urination, passing wind, and speaking."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him from Musa ibn Al-Qasim from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa {a.s}, peace be upon him,
who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who is in his prayer and someone seeks permission at
the door, so he glorifies (says tasbih) and raises his voice and lets his servant girl hear,
and she comes to him, and he gestures with his hand to show her that there is
someone at the door, does that action invalidate his prayer and what is required of
him?
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm; that does not invalidate his prayer."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَجِيهِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرِّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي
صَلاَتِهِ فَيَسْتَأْذِنُ إِنْسَانٌ عَلَى الْبَابِ فَيُسَبَّحُ وَ يَرْفَعُ صَوْتَهُ وَ يُسْمِعُ جَارِيَتَهُ فَتَأْتِيهِ فَيُرِيهَا بِيَدِهِ أَنّ عَلَى الْبَابِ
نُسَاناً هَلْ يَقْطَعُ ذَلِكَ صَلاَتَهُ وَ مَا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ لاَ يَقْطَعُ ذَلِكَ صَلاَتَهُ».
cross_references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.182 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.331 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.896 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.256
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}

From him from Musa ibn Al-Qasim from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa {a.s}, peace be upon him,

I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who is in his prayer and someone seeks permission at

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Sa'd from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar Al-Sabati who
said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who is in prayer and sees a
snake nearby, is it permissible for him to reach out and kill it?
Imam {a.s} said: "If there is only one step between him and it, then he should step and
kill it; otherwise, he should not."
text_ar:
سَغدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدِ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَفَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَّابَاطِيَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَيَرَى حَيَّةً بِحِيَالِهِ يَجُوزُ لَهُ أَنْ يَتَنَاوَلَهَا فَيَقْتُلَهَا فَقَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ بَيْنَهُ وَ
بَيْنَهَا خُطْوَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَلْيَخْطُ وَ لْيَقْتُلْهَا وَ إِلاَّ فَلَا».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.331 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.904 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.273
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Sa'd from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar Al-Sabati who
said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who is in prayer and sees a
snake nearby, is it permissible for him to reach out and kill it?
Imam {a.s} said: "If there is only one step between him and it, then he should step and
kill it; otherwise, he should not."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
And with this same chain of narration, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a person who is praying.
Imam {a.s} said: "If a man from among the Muslims greets you with salam while you are
in prayer, then return the greeting to him within yourself without raising your voice."
text_ar:
وَ بِهَذَا الْإِسْنَادِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْمُصَلِّي فَقَالَ «إِذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ وَ
أَنْتَ فِي الصَّلاةِ فَرُدَّ عَلَيْهِ فِيمَا بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنَ نَفْسِكَ وَ لا تَرْفَع صَوْتَكَ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.368 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.331 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.888 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.268 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.2 p.143
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
And with this same chain of narration, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a person who is praying.
Imam {a.s} said: "If a man from among the Muslims greets you with salam while you are
in prayer, then return the greeting to him within yourself without raising your voice."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Abd Al-Hamid from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi' from Ali ibn Al-Nu'man from
Mansur ibn Hazim:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “If a man greets you with salam while you
are praying, he said: ‘You should return the greeting quietly, just as he said it.’"
text_ar:
سَعدُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعِ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ النّعْمَانِ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ عَنْ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: إِذَا سَلَّمَ عَلَيْكَ الرَّجُلُ وَ أَنْتَ تُصَلِّي قَالَ «تَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ خَفِيّاً كَمَا قَالَ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.368 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.332 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.888 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.268 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.2 p.143
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Abd Al-Hamid from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi' from Ali ibn Al-Nu'man from

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Al-Husayn ibn Uthman from Abdullah ibn Muskan from Al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "If a man sneezes during the prayer, he
should say, 'All praise is due to Allah {SWT}’ (Alhamdulillah)."
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا عَطَسَ ٱلرَّجُلُ فِي الصَّلاَةِ فَلْيَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.332 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.890 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.271
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Al-Husayn ibn Uthman from Abdullah ibn Muskan from Al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "If a man sneezes during the prayer, he
should say, 'All praise is due to Allah {SWT}’ (Alhamdulillah)."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Sa'd from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Al-Hakam ibn Miskin from Al-Mu'alla Abu Uthman from Abu Basir
who said:
I said to Imam {a.s}: “I hear someone sneeze, so I praise Allah {SWT} and send blessings
upon the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, while I am in prayer.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, even if there is an ocean between you and your companion."
text_ar:
سَعَدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ مِسْكِينٍ عَنِ الْمُعَلِّى أَبِي عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أَسْمَعُ
الْعَطْسَةَ فَأَحْمَدُ اللّهَ وَ أَصَلِّي عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلهِ وَ أَنَا فِي الصَّلاةِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ إِنْ كَانَ بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنَ
صَاحِبِكَ اليَمّ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.367 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.332 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.272
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Al-Hasan Al-Ribati from Zakariyya Al-A'war
who said:
I saw Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, praying while standing, and next to Him {a.s} was an elderly man
who wanted to stand up and had a staff with him.
He wanted to reach for it, so Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, bent down while he was still standing
in his prayer and handed the man the staff, then returned to His {a.s} prayer.
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ الرِّبَاطِيّ عَنْ زَكَرِيًّا الْأَعْوَرِ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ يُصَلِّي قَائِمَاً وَ إِلَى جَانِبِهِ رَجُلْ كَبِيرٌ يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَقُومَ وَ مَعَهُ عَصّا لَهُ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَتَنَاوَلَهَا فَانْحَطَّ أَبُو
اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَنَاوَلَ اَلرَّجْلَ اَلْعَصَا ثُمَّ عَادَ إِلَى صَلاَتِهِ.
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.371 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.332 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.901 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.503 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.304
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
text_chunk:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Al-Hasan Al-Ribati from Zakariyya Al-A'war
who said:
I saw Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, praying while standing, and next to Him {a.s} was an elderly man
who wanted to stand up and had a staff with him.
He wanted to reach for it, so Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, bent down while he was still standing
in his prayer and handed the man the staff, then returned to His {a.s} prayer.

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ali ibn Mahziyar from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar who said:
I said to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him: “I might be in prayer and experience cramping
in my stomach, or discomfort, or throbbing.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Leave, then perform ablution, and continue from where you left off in
your prayer, as long as you have not invalidated the prayer by speaking deliberately.
But if you spoke forgetfully, there is no harm upon you, for it is like one who speaks in
prayer forgetfully."
I asked: “Even if he turns his face away from the qiblah?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, even if he turns his face away from the qiblah."
text_ar:
عَلِي بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنِ ٱلْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ أَكُونُ فِي
الصَّلاَةٍ فَأَجِدُ غَمْزاً فِي بَطْنِي أَوْ أَذَّى أَوْ ضَرَبَاناً فَقَالَ «اِنْصَرِفُ ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأْ وَ اِبْنِ عَلَى مَا مَضَى مِنْ صَلاَتِكَ مَا لَمْ
تَنْقُضِ الصَّلاَةَ بِالْكَلاَمِ مُتَعَمَّدا فَإِنْ تَكَلَّمْتَ نَاسِياً فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْكَ فَهُوَ بِمَنْزِلَةِ مَنْ تَكَلَّمَ فِي الصَّلاةِ نَاسِياً» قُلْتُ وَ
إنْ قَلَبَ وَجْهَهُ عَنِ ٱلْقِبْلَةِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ إنْ قَلَبَ وَجْهَهُ عَنِ الْقِبْلَةِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.367 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.332 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.401 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.865 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.235
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
text_chunk:
Ali ibn Mahziyar from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar who said:
I said to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him: “I might be in prayer and experience cramping
in my stomach, or discomfort, or throbbing.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Leave, then perform ablution, and continue from where you left off in
your prayer, as long as you have not invalidated the prayer by speaking deliberately.
But if you spoke forgetfully, there is no harm upon you, for it is like one who speaks in
prayer forgetfully."
I asked: “Even if he turns his face away from the qiblah?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, even if he turns his face away from the qiblah."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Uthman ibn Isa from Sama'ah who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who experiences a
nosebleed and it continues until the time of another prayer enters.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should stuff his nose and then pray, and he should not prolong the
prayer if he fears that the blood will precede him."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُثِمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةً قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ رَعَفَ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ
يَرْعُفُ حَتَّى دَخَلَ وَقْتُ صَلاَةٍ أُخْرَى قَالَ «يَحْشُو أَنْفَهُ ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي وَ لاَ يُطَوِّلُ إنْ خَشِيَ أَنْ يَسْبِقَهُ اَلدَّمُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.333
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him from Al-Barqi from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn Al-Hakam:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "There is no prayer for one who is holding
in urine or one who is holding in feces, and he is in the position of someone who is
relieving himself in his garment."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْبَرْقِيِّ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «لاَ صَلاَةَ لِحَاقِنٍ وَ لا
لِحَاقِنَةٍ وَ هُوَ بِمَنْزِلَةٍ مَنْ هُوَ فِي ثَوْبِهِ».
cross_references: Al-Muhasin, Vol.1 p.83 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.333 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.864 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.251 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 1 p.323

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira who said: Abu Al-
Qasim Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar narrated to me from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam {a.s}: “A man plays with his private part during the obligatory prayer.”
Imam {a.s} said: "And what action is that?"
I said: “He played with it until he touched it with his hand.”
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أُبُو الْقَاسِمِ مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ
عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ الرَّجُلُ يَعْبَثُ بِذَكَرِهِ فِي الصَّلاَةِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ قَالَ «وَ مَا لَهُ فِعلٌ»
قُلْتُ عَبِثَ بِهِ حَتَّى مَسَّهُ بِيَدِهِ فَقَالَ «لاَ بَأْسَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.333 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.892 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.283
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad by Musa ibn Al-Qasim and Abu Qatadah by Ali ibn Ja'far by (Imam) Musa {a.s} said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who is in his prayer and thinks that his garment might
have been torn or that something has soiled it, is it permissible for him to look at it or
touch it?
Imam {a.s} said: "If it is at the front of his garment or on its sides, there is no harm; but if
it is at the back, he should not turn around, for that is not appropriate."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ وَ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَجِيهِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنِ الرَّجْلِ يَكُونُ فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَيَظُنُ أَنَّ ثَوْبَهُ قَدِ اِنْخَرَقَ أَوْ أَصَابَهُ شَيْءَ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يَنظُرَ فِيهِ أَوْ يَمَسَّهُ قَالَ
«إِنْ كَانَ فِي مُقَدَّمِ ثَوْبِهِ أَوْ جَانِبَيْهِ فَلا بَأْسَ وَ إِنْ كَانَ فِي مُؤَخَّرِهِ فَلاَ يَلْتَفِتُ فَإِنَّهُ لا يَصْلُحُ».
cross_references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.186 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.333 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.901 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.245
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Al-Husayn ibn Yazid from Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad
from Ja'far from his father:
(Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, said regarding a man who is praying and sees a
child crawling toward a fire or a sheep entering the house to cause damage.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should leave, secure what he fears for, and continue with his prayer
as long as he has not spoken."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ
عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: فِي رَجُلٍ يُصَلِّي وَ يَرَى الصَّبِيَّ يَحْبُو إِلَى النَّارِ أَوِ الشَّاةَ تَدْخُلُ اَلْبَيْتَ
لِتُفْسِدَ الشَّيْءَ قَالَ «فَلْيَنْصَرِفْ وَ لَيُحْرِزْ مَا يَتَخَوَّفُ وَ يَبْنِي عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ مَا لَمْ يَتَكَلَّمْ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.333 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.904 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.278
source_scholar: Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Al-Amraki from Ali ibn Ja'far from his brother (Imam) Musa {a.s}:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who is in an obligatory prayer and rises during the first
two rak'ahs, is it permissible for him to reach toward the side of the mosque and use
it to help himself stand, without weakness or illness?
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no harm."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيَّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلرَجُلِ
يَكُونُ فِي صَلاةٍ فَرِيضَةٍ فَيَقُومُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ ٱلْأَوَّلَتَيْنِ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يَتَنَاوَلَ جَانِبَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ فَيَنْهَضَ يَسْتَعِينُ
بِهِ عَلَى اَلْقِيَامِ مِنْ غَيْرٍ ضَعْفٍ وَ لاَ عِلَّةٍ قَالَ «لاَ بَأْسَ».
cross_references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.164 • Qurb Al-Isnad, Vl.1 p.206 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.333
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Mu'awiyah ibn
Wahb who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say, and He {a.s} mentioned the prayer of
the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family.
Imam {a.s} said: " A vessel of water for purification would be brought and placed covered
near His {saws} head, and His {saws} siwak (tooth-stick) would be placed under His {saws}
bed. Then He {saws} would sleep as long as Allah {SWT} willed.
When He {saws} awoke, He {saws} would sit and turn his gaze toward the sky, then recite
the verses from (Surah Ale Imran) 'Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth
and the alternation of night and day' (Surah Al ‘Imran 3:190).
Then He {saws} would use the siwak and perform purification, then stand and go to the
mosque and pray four rak'ahs, with his bowing and prostration proportionate to his
recitation. He {saws} would bow so long that it would be said, 'When will He {saws} raise his
head?'
And He {saws} would prostrate so long that it would be said, 'When will he raise his head?'
Then He {saws} would return to his bed and sleep as long as Allah {SWT} willed. Then He
{saws} would awaken, sit, recite the verses from (Surah Ale Imran), turn His {saws} gaze
toward the sky, use the siwak, purify himself, and stand and go to the mosque and pray
four rak'ahs as He {saws} had prayed before.
Then He {saws} would return to His {saws} bed and sleep as long as Allah {SWT} willed. Then
He {saws} would awaken, sit, recite the verses from (Surah Ale Imran), turn His {saws} gaze
toward the sky, use the siwak, purify himself, and stand and go to the mosque to pray
the witr and the two rak'ahs, then go out to the (obligatory) prayer."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبِ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ يَقُولُ: وَذَكَرَ صَلاةَ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ قَالَ: «كَانَ يُوتَى بِطَهُورٍ فَيُخَمَّرُ عِنْدَ رَأْسِهِ وَ
يُوضَعُ سِوَاكُهُ تَحْتَ فِرَاشِهِ ثُمَّ يَنَامُ مَا شَاءَ اللّهُ فَإِذَا اِسْتَيْقَظَ جَلَسَ ثُمَّ قَلْبَ بَصَرَهُ فِي السَّمَاءِ ثُمَّ تَلاَ آَلْآيَاتِ مِنْ
آلِ عِمْرَانَ « «إِنَّ فِي خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ وَ اِخْتِلافِ اللَّيْلِ وَ النَّهارِ» » ٱلْآَيَةَ ثُمَّ يَسْتَنْ وَ يَتَطَهَرُ ثُمَّ يَقُومُ إِلَى
الْمَسْجِدٍ فَيَرْكَعُ أُرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ عَلَى قَدْرِ قِرَاءَتِهِ رُكُوعُهُ وَ سُجُودُهُ عَلَى قَدْرٍ رُكُوعِهِ يَرْكَعُ حَتَى يُقَالَ مَتَى يَرْفَعُ
رَأْسَهُ وَ يَسْجُدُ حَتَّى يُقَالَ مَتَّى يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ ثُمَّ يَعُودُ إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ فَيَنَامُ مَا شَاءَ اللّهُ ثُمَّ يَسْتَيْقِظُ فَيَجْلِسُ فَيَثلُو
آَلايَاتِ مِنْ آلِ عِمْرَانَ وَ يُقَلّبُ بَصَرَهُ فِي السِّمَاءِ ثُمَّ يَسْتَنّ وَ يَتَطَهَرُ وَ يَقُومُ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ فَيُصَلِّي أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ كَمَا
رَكَعَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ يَعُودُ إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ فَيَنَامُ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ يَسْتَيْقِظُ فَيَجْلِسُ فَيَثلُو الْآيَاتِ مِنْ آلِ عِمْرَانَ وَ يُقَلِّبُ
بَصَرَهُ فِي السَّمَاءِ ثُمَّ يَسْتَنُ وَ يَتَطَهَرُ وَ يَقُومُ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ فَيُوتِرُ وَ يُصَلِّي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ يَخْرُجُ إلَى الصَّلاَةِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.334 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.342 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.269 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.1 6 p.276 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.228 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.1 p.422 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.3 p.290

Imam {a.s} said: " A vessel of water for purification would be brought and placed covered
near His {saws} head, and His {saws} siwak (tooth-stick) would be placed under His {saws}
bed. Then He {saws} would sleep as long as Allah {SWT} willed.
When He {saws} awoke, He {saws} would sit and turn his gaze toward the sky, then recite
the verses from (Surah Ale Imran) 'Indeed, in the creation of the heavens and the earth
and the alternation of night and day' (Surah Al ‘Imran 3:190).
Then He {saws} would use the siwak and perform purification, then stand and go to the
mosque and pray four rak'ahs, with his bowing and prostration proportionate to his
recitation. He {saws} would bow so long that it would be said, 'When will He {saws} raise his
head?'
And He {saws} would prostrate so long that it would be said, 'When will he raise his head?'
Then He {saws} would return to his bed and sleep as long as Allah {SWT} willed. Then He
{saws} would awaken, sit, recite the verses from (Surah Ale Imran), turn His {saws} gaze
toward the sky, use the siwak, purify himself, and stand and go to the mosque and pray
four rak'ahs as He {saws} had prayed before.
Then He {saws} would return to His {saws} bed and sleep as long as Allah {SWT} willed. Then
He {saws} would awaken, sit, recite the verses from (Surah Ale Imran), turn His {saws} gaze
toward the sky, use the siwak, purify himself, and stand and go to the mosque to pray
the witr and the two rak'ahs, then go out to the (obligatory) prayer."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Safwan ibn Yahya from Al-Ala' from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "There is no servant except that he is
awakened every night once, or twice, or several times. If he gets up, then that is good;
otherwise, Shaytan snorts and urinates in his ear. Do you not see that if one of you gets
up without responding to this call, he gets up sluggish, heavy, and lazy?"
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنِ الْعَلاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسّلاَمُ
أَنّهُ قَالَ: «لَيْسَ مِنْ عَبْدِ إِلَّ يُوقَظُ فِي كُلِّ لَيْلَةٍ مَرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ مِرَاراً فَإِنْ قَامَ كَانَ ذَلِكَ وَ إِلاَّ فَحِّجَ الشَّيْطَانُ فَبَالَ
فِي أَذْنِهِ أَوَ لا يَرَى أَحَدُكُمْ أَنَّهُ إِذَا قَامَ وَ لَمْ يَكُنُ ذَلِكَ مِنْهُ قَامَ وَ هُوَ مُتَخَثَرٌ تَقِيلٌ كَسْلاَنُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.334 • Miftah Al-Falah, Vol.1 p.290 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.159 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.6 0 p.262

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him by Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn by Safwan from Ibn Bukayr from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Kamil:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said: "When you begin the night prayer and finish the
opening supplication, then recite Ayat al-Kursi and the two surahs of seeking refuge
(Al-Falaq and Al-Nas), then recite the Opening of the Book (Al-Fatiha) and a surah."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفَوَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ كَامِلٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسّلاَمُ
قَالَ: «إِذَا اِسْتَفْتَحْتَ صَلاةَ آللَّيْلِ وَ فَرَغْتَ مِنْ الإِسْتِفْتَاحِ فَاقْرَأْ آيَةَ ٱلْكُرْسِيَ وَ ٱلْمُعَوِّدَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ اِقْرَأ فَاتِحَةَ ٱلْكِتَابِ
وَ سُورَةً».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.334 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.668 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.32
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Isma'il from Mansur from Umar ibn Udhaynah from
Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the saying of Allah {SWT}, the Exalted: "Stand (in prayer) at night
except a little." (Surah Muzzammil 73:2)
Imam {a.s} said: "Allah {SWT} commanded Him {saws} to pray every night except that there
might come upon him a night among the nights in which he does not pray anything."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ مَنصُورٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَذَيْنَةَ عَنْ مُحَمّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللّهِ تَعَالَى «قُمِ اللَّيْلَ إلا قَلِيلاً» قَالَ «أَمَرَهُ اللَهُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ كُلَ لَيْلَةٍ إِلا أَنْ يَأْتِيَ عَلَيْهِ
لَيْلَةٌ مِنَ اَللَّيَالِي لا يُصَلِّي فِيهَا شَيْئًا».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.335 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.99 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.147 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.516 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.126 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.127 • Tafsir Nur Al- Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.446 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.1 3 p.496

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him from Al-Hakam ibn Miskin from Abdullah ibn Ali Al-Zarrad who said:
Abu Kahmas asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, saying: “Should a man
perform his nawafil prayers (supererogatory prayers) in one place or should he
distribute them in different places?”
Imam {a.s} said: "No, rather here and there, for indeed they will bear witness for him on
the Day of Resurrection."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ مِسْكِينٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ ٱلزَّرَّادِ قَالَ: سَأَلَ أَبُو كَهْمَسِ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ فَقَالَ يُصَلِّي
الرَّجُلُ نَوَافِلَهُ فِي مَوْضِعٍ أَوْ يُفَرَّقُهَا قَالَ «لا بَلْ هَاهُنَا وَ هَاهُنَا فَإِنَّهَا تَشَهَدُ لَهُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.455 • ‘Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.343 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.335 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.627 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.7 p.318 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.35

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Al-Hakam from Harun from Murazim from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be
upon him, who said:
I said to Him {a.s}: “When should I pray the night prayer?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Pray it at the end of the night."
I said: “But I do not wake up.”
Imam {a.s} said: "You will wake up once, so pray it, then if you sleep, you can make it up.
When you become concerned with making it up during the day, you will wake up (at
night)."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ هَارُونَ عَنْ مُرَازِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلامُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ مَتَّى أُصَلَّي
صَلاةً اللّيْلٍ فَقَالَ «صَلَّهَا آخِرَ اللّيْلِ» قَالَ فَقُلْتُ فَإِنِّي لاَ أَسْتَنْبِهُ فَقَالَ «تَسْتَئْبِهُ مَرّةً فَتُصَلَّيهَا وَ تَنَامُ فَتَقْضِيهَا فَإِذَا
اِهْتَمَمْتَ بِقَضَائِهَا بِالنَّهَارِ اِسْتَنْبَهْتَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.335 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.314 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.256
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Isa Al-Ubaydi from Ali and Ishaq, the two sons of
Sulayman ibn Dawud, that Ibrahim ibn Muhammad informed them, saying:
I wrote to the Faqih (jurist): "O my master, I made a vow that whenever I miss the night
prayer, I would fast the following morning. If he misses it, what should he do? Is there
a way out for him, and how much expiation is due upon him for each day he misses if
he chooses to offer expiation?"
So He wrote: "For each day, he should give a mudd of food as expiation."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى الْعُبَيْدِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ وَ إِسْحَاقَ اِبْنَيْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ دَاوُدَ أَنَّ إبْرَاهِيمَ
بْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ أَخْبَرَهُمَا قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى الْفَقِيهِ يَا مَوْلايَ نَدَّرْتُ أَنْ يَكُونَ مَتَى فَاتَثنِي صَلاَةُ اللِّيْلِ صُمْتُ فِي صَبِيحَتِهَا
فَفَاتَهُ ذَلِكَ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ فَهَلْ لَهُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ مَخْرَجْ وَ كَمْ يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْكَفَّارَةِ فِي صَوْمِ كُلِّ يَوْمِ تَرَكَهُ إِنْ كَفَّرَ إِنْ
أَرَادَ ذَلِكَ فَكَتَبَ «يُفَرِّقُ عَنْ كُلِّ يَوْمِ بِمُدَّ مِنْ طَعَامٍ كَفَّارَةً».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.335 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.2 2 p.394

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
From him from Al-Hasan ibn Ali from Al-Abbas ibn Amir from Jabir from Abu Basir:
Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, said regarding the verse: "They used to sleep but little
of the night" (Surah Adh-Dhariyat 51:17)
Imam {a.s} said: "The people used to sleep, but whenever one of them turned over, he
would say, 'Praise be to Allah {SWT}, there is no god but Allah {SWT}, and Allah {SWT} is the
Greatest.'"
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ قَالَ: « «كَانُوا
قَلِيلاً مِنَ اللِّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ» » قَالَ «كَانَ ٱلْقَوْمُ يَنَامُونَ وَ لَكِنْ كُلِّمَا اِنْقَلَبَ أَحَدُهُمْ قَالَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَهِ وَ لا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ
وَ اللهُ أَكْبَرُ » .
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.335 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1594 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.449 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.159 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.125 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.123 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.1 2 p.413

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said regarding the saying of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty
and Majestic: "Indeed, the rising by night is the firmest way to tread and the best in
speech," (Surah Muzzammil 73:6).
Imam {a.s} said: "By His {AZJ} saying 'and the best in speech', He {AZJ} means the rising of a
man from his bed intending by it Allah {SWT}, the Mighty and Majestic, and intending no
one other than Him {AZJ}."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ : فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ «إِنَّ
تاشِئَةَ اللّيْلِ هِيَ أَشَدُ وَطْئاً وَ أَقْوَمُ قِيلاً» قَالَ «يَعْنِي بِقَوْلِهِ «وَ أَقْوَمُ قِيلاً» قِيَامَ ٱلرَّجُلِ عَنْ فِرَاشِهِ يُرِيدُ بِهِ اللَّهَ
عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لا يُرِيدُ بِهِ غَيْرَهُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.446 • ‘Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.363 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.336 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.98 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.146 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.5 p.517 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.132 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.8 4 p.148 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.448 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.5 p.448

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abu Ayyub Al-Khazzaz from Muhammad ibn Muslim
who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the saying of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty
and Majestic: "They used to sleep but little of the night" (Surah Adh-Dhariyat 51:17)
Imam {a.s} said: "The nights in which they missed getting up were very few; they would
stand in prayer in most of the nights."
text_ar:
عَلِي بْنُ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُوبَ الْخَزَّازِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ «كانُوا قَلِيلاً مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ» قَالَ «كَانُوا أَقَلَ اللَّيَالِي تَفُوتُهُمْ لا يَقُومُونَ
فِيهَا».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.336
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Abu Ayyub Al-Khazzaz from Muhammad ibn Muslim
who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the saying of Allah {SWT}, the Mighty
and Majestic: "They used to sleep but little of the night" (Surah Adh-Dhariyat 51:17)
Imam {a.s} said: "The nights in which they missed getting up were very few; they would
stand in prayer in most of the nights."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughira from Ibn Muskan from Al-Hasan Al-Sayqal from
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Him {a.s}: “A man prays the two rak'ahs of witr, then he stands and forgets the
tashahhud until he bows, and remembers while bowing.”
Imam {a.s} said: "He should sit from his bowing, perform the tashahhud, then stand and
complete (his prayer)."
I asked: “Did you not say regarding the obligatory prayer that if he remembers after
bowing, he should continue, then perform the two prostrations of forgetfulness after
he finishes and recite the tashahhud in them?”
Imam {a.s} said: "The supererogatory prayer (nafila) is not like the obligatory prayer
(faridah)."
text_ar:
علي بن ابراهيم عن أبيه عن عبد اللّه بن المغيرة عن ابن مسكان عن الحسن الصيقل عن أبي عبد الله
عليه السلام قال قلت له: الرجل يصلي الركعتين من الوتر ثم يقوم فينسى التشهد حتى يركع فيذكر وهو راكع
قال: يجلس من ركوعه ويتشهد ثم يقوم فيتم ، قال قلت : أليس قلت في الفريضة إذا ذكره بعدما ركع مضى
ثم سجد سجدتي السهو بعدما ينصرف يتشهد فيهما؟ قال : ليس النافلة مثل الفريضة.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ali ibn Mahziyar from Fadalah and Hammad ibn Isa from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the best time for the witr prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: "The beginning of dawn is the best for that."
text_ar:
عَلِي بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ وَ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلامُ عَنْ أَفْضَلِ
سَاعَاتِ الْوَثْرِ فَقَالَ »الْفَجْرُ أَوَّلُ ذَلِكَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.448 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.336 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.314 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.271
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Ali from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Ibn Udhaynah from Zurarah who said:
I said to Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him: “The two rak'ahs before the morning prayer
(Fajr), when is their time?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Before the rising of the dawn; and when the dawn rises, then the time
for the morning prayer has entered."
text_ar:
علي عن أبيه عن ابن أبي عمير عن ابن اذينة عن زرارة قال قلت : لابي جعفر عليه السلام الركعتان اللتان قبل
الغداة أين موضعهما؟ فقال : قبل طلوع الفجر فإذا طلع الفجر فقد دخل وقت الغداة.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Al-Husayn from Al-Nadr from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Al-Jarud from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace
be upon him, who said:
I heard Him {a.s} say: "(Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, used to perform the witr prayer
with nine surahs."
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي الْجَارُودِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ:
«كَانَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يُوتِرُ بِتِسْعِ سُوَرٍ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.337 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.670 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.52
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}

Al-Husayn from Al-Nadr from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Al-Jarud from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace

I heard Him {a.s} say: "(Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, used to perform the witr prayer

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say: "Is it not enough for one of you to
stand before dawn, perform the witr prayer, and pray the two rak'ahs of Fajr, and have
it written for him as the prayer of the night?"
text_ar:
اَلْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ يَقُولُ: «أَ مَا يَرْضَى أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ
يَقُومَ قَبْلَ الصُبْحِ فَيُوتِرَ وَ يُصَلِّيَ رَكْعَتَيِ ٱلْفَجْرِ وَ يُكْتَبَ لَهُ بِصَلاَةِ ٱللَّيْلِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.337 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.341 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.337 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.258
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Mu'awiyah ibn Wahb who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, say: "Is it not enough for one of you to

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE MANNER OF PRAYER, ITS DESCRIPTION AND WHAT IS OBLIGATORY AND RECOMMENDED
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar from Al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Bilal who said:
I wrote to Him {a.s} regarding the time of the night prayer.
He {a.s}, peace be upon him, wrote back: "At the decline of the night, which is its middle,
is best; but if that is missed, then its beginning and its end are both permissible."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ بِلاَلِ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَيْهِ فِي وَقْتٍ صَلاَةٍ
اللَّيل فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «عِنْدَ زَوَالِ اللَّيْلِ وَ هُوَ نِصْفُهُ أَفْضَلُ فَإِنْ فَاتَ فَأَوِّلَهُ وَ آخِرَهُ جَائِزْ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.337 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.333 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.253 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.123
source_scholar: Implicit (Muzmar)
