author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Al-‘Amraki Al-Bufaki, from Ali ibn Ja‘far, from his brother (Imam) Musa
{a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man whose belongings were either taken from him or
drowned, so he remained naked, and the time of prayer arrived, how should he pray?
Imam {a.s} said: "If he finds grass with which he can cover his private parts, then he
should complete his prayer with bowing and prostration; but if he does not find
anything to cover his private parts, then he should gesture while standing."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيّ الْبُوفَكِيّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنِ الرَّجْلِ قُطِعَ عَلَيْهِ أَوْ غَرِقَ مَتَاعُهُ فَبَقِيَ عُزْيَاناً وَ حَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ كَيْفَ يُصَلِّي قَالَ «إِنْ أَصَابَ حَشِيشاً يَسْتُرُ
بِهِ عَوْرَتَهُ أَتَمَ صَلاَتَهُ بِالرُكُوعِ وَ السُّجُودِ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يُصِبْ شَيْئاً يَسْتُرُ بِهِ عَوْرَتَهُ أَوْمَاً وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ».
cross_references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.172 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.365 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.438 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.448 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.212

text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Al-‘Amraki Al-Bufaki, from Ali ibn Ja‘far, from his brother (Imam) Musa
{a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man whose belongings were either taken from him or
drowned, so he remained naked, and the time of prayer arrived, how should he pray?
Imam {a.s} said: "If he finds grass with which he can cover his private parts, then he
should complete his prayer with bowing and prostration; but if he does not find
anything to cover his private parts, then he should gesture while standing."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
From him, from Ya‘qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibn Muskan, from some of his companions:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who goes out naked
and the time of prayer comes upon him.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should pray naked while standing if no one sees him; but if
someone sees him, then he should pray sitting."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ :
فِي الرَّجُلِ يَخْرُجُ عُرْيَاناً فَتُدْرِكُهُ الصَّلاةُ قَالَ «يُصَلِّي عُزْيَاناً قَائِما إنْ لَمْ يَرَهُ أَحَدٌ فَإِنْ رَآهُ أَحَدٌ صَلَّى جَالِساً».

From him, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from some of his companions:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "The naked person who does not have a
garment, if he finds a pit, he should enter it and perform prostration and bowing within

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Hadid, from Jamil, said:
Murazim asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, while I was present with Imam
{a.s}, about a man who is present (not traveling) and prays wearing only an izar (lower
garment), wrapping it around his waist.
Imam {a.s} said: "He can place cloth or turban over his neck and drape it over himself."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ حَدِيدٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ قَالَ: سَأَلَ مُرَازِمْ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ وَ أَنَا مَعَهُ حَاضِرٌ عَنِ
الرَّجْلِ الْحَاضِرِ يُصَلِّي فِي إِذَارِهِ مُوْتَزِراً بِهِ قَالَ «يَجْعَلُ عَلَى رَقَبَتِهِ مِنْدِيلاً أَوْ عِمَامَةً يَتَرَدَّى بِهَا».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.395 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.366 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.381 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.390 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.453 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.192

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, was asked about a man who has nothing with
him except trousers.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should untie its waistband and place it over his shoulder and pray."
And Imam {a.s} said: "And if he has a sword with him and no garment, then he should
hang the sword around his neck and pray standing."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بَنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ: سُبِلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ لَيْسَ
مَعَهُ إلاَّاسَرَاوِيلُ قَالَ «يَحُلُ التَّكَةَ مِنْهُ فَيَطْرَحُهَا عَلَى عَاتِقِهِ وَ يُصَلِّي» وَ قَالَ »وَ إِنْ كَانَ مَعَهُ سَيْفٌ وَ لَيْسَ مَعَهُ
ثَوْبٌ فَلْيَتَقَلَّدِ السَّيْفَ وَ يُصَلِّي قَائِماً».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, by Al-‘Amraki, by Ali ibn Ja‘far, by his brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja‘far {a.s}:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man, does it suffice for him to lead the prayer wearing
trousers and a cap?
Imam {a.s} said: "It does not suffice."
And I asked Imam {a.s} about trousers, if they be used in place of izar (lower garment)?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
text_ar:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنِ الرَّجُلِ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يَؤُمَّ فِي سَرَاوِيلَ وَ قَلَنْسُوَةٍ قَالَ «لا يَصْلُحُ» وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ السِّرَاوِيلِ هَلْ يَجُوزُ مَكَانَ
اَلْإِزَارِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Al-Nadr ibn Suwayd, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Sulayman ibn Khalid, said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who leads a group in prayer
wearing a shirt without a cloak over it.
Imam {a.s} said: "It is not appropriate unless he has a cloak or a turban with which he
drapes himself."
text_ar:
عَلِي بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ خَالِدِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ
عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَمَّ قَوْماً فِي قَمِيص لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ رِدَاءُ فَقَالَ «لا يَنْبَغِي إلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ عَلَيْهِ رِدَاءَ أَوْ عِمَامَةٌ يَرْتَدِي بِهَا».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Musa ibn Al-Qasim, from Ali ibn Ja‘far, from his brother (Imam) Musa {a.s},
peace be upon him, said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a wet mouse that fell into water and then walked over clothes,
may one pray in them?
Imam {a.s} said: "Wash whatever trace of it you see, and what you do not see, sprinkle it
with water."
text_ar:
أَحْمَد بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْفَأْرَةِ
اَلرَّظَبَةِ قَدْ وَقَعَتْ فِي الْمَاءِ فَتَمْشِي عَلَى التِّيَابِ يُصَلَّى فِيهَا قَالَ «اِغْسِلْ مَا رَأَيْتَ مِنْ أَثَرِهَا وَ مَا لَمْ تَرَهُ اِنْضِحْهُ
بِالْمَاءِ».
cross_references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.348 • Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.60 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.366 • Al- Wafi, Vol.6 p.206 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.460

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad Al-‘Alawi, from Al-‘Amraki, from Ali ibn Ja‘far, from his
brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon them both, said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about worms (maggots, parasitic worms, or decomposition worms)
that fall from the toilet onto the garment, may one pray in it?
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no problem unless you see a trace (of impurity), then you must
wash it."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ الْعَلَوِيِّ عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الدُّودِ يَقَعُ مِنَ ٱلْكَنِيفِ عَلَى الثَّوْبِ أَيُصَلَّى فِيهِ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَرَى أَثَراً فَتَغْسِلَهُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.367 • Al-Wafi, Vol.6 p.236 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.526 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.7 7 p.125

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Al-‘Abbas ibn Ma‘ruf, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Fadalah ibn Ayyub,
from Musa ibn Bakr, from Zurarah, said:
I heard (Imam) Abu Ja‘far, peace be upon him, forbid the wearing of silk for both men
and women, except for silk mixed with ‘khazz’ (a kind of fabric), the weft or the warp of
which is ‘khazz’ or linen or cotton. Pure silk alone is disliked for both men and women.
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ بْنِ أَيُوبَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ بَكْرٍ
عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ يَنْهَى عَنْ لِبَاسِ الْحَرِيرِ لِلرِّجَالِ وَ النَّسَاءِ إِلاَّ مَا كَانَ مِنْ حَرِيرٍ مَخْلُوطِ
بِخَزِّ لَحْمَتُهُ أَوْ سَدَاهُ خَذَّ أَوْ كَتَّانٌ أَوْ قُطْنُ وَ إِنَّمَا يُكْرَهُ الْحَرِيرُ الْمَحْضُ لِلرِّجَالِ وَ النَّسَاءِ.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.367 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.386 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.75 • Al- Wafi, Vol.2 0 p.729 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.374

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
From him, from Al-‘Abbas, from Ali, from Muhammad ibn Isma‘il, from Muhammad ibn Husayn ibn Kathir,
from his father, who said:
I saw on Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, a woolen cloak between two coarse
garments, so I asked Imam {a.s} about that.
Imam {a.s} said: "I saw my father wearing it. Indeed, when we intend to pray, we wear
the roughest of our clothes."
text_ar:
عَثَهُ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ عَلَى أَبِي
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ جُبَّةَ صُوفٍ بَيْنَ ثَوْبَيْنِ غَلِيظَيْنِ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ فِي ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ «رَأَيْتُ أَبِي يَلْبَسُهَا إِنَّا إِذَا أَرَدْنَا أَنْ
نُصَلِّيَ لَبِسْنَا أَخْشَنَ ثِيَابِنَا».

From him, from Al-‘Abbas, from Ali, from Muhammad ibn Isma‘il, from Muhammad ibn Husayn ibn Kathir,
from his father, who said:
I saw on Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, a woolen cloak between two coarse
garments, so I asked Imam {a.s} about that.
Imam {a.s} said: "I saw my father wearing it. Indeed, when we intend to pray, we wear
the roughest of our clothes."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
From him, from Ali ibn Al-Rayyan, who said:
I wrote to Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, asking: “Is it permissible to pray in a garment that has in it
human hair or fingernails, without shaking them off or removing them from it?”
So Imam {a.s} wrote in response, peace be upon him: "It is permissible."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الرِّيَّانِ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ هَلْ تَجُوزُ الصَّلاةُ فِي ثَوْبٍ يَكُونُ فِيهِ شَعْرٌ مِنْ
شَعْرٍ الْإِنْسَانِ وَ أَظْفَارُهُ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ يَنْفُضَهُ وَ يُلْقِيَهُ عَنْهُ فَوَقَّعَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ «يَجُوزُ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Jamil, from Al-Hasan ibn Shihab, said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about fox skins, if they have been purified
(lawfully slaughtered), may one pray in them?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ عَنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ بْنِ شِهَابٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
عَنْ جُلُودِ اَلتَّعَالِبِ إِذَا كَانَتْ ذَكِيَّةً أَيُصَلَّى فِيهَا قَالَ «نَعَمْ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.367 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.382 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.407

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Muhammad, from Ali ibn Al-Sindi, from Safwan, from Abdur-Rahman ibn Al-Hajjaj, said:
I asked Him {a.s} about footwear made from foxes or garments from them, may one pray
in them or not?
Imam {a.s} said: "If it has been purified (lawfully slaughtered), then there is no problem
with it."

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “We have already explained the interpretation of
reports like these previously, so there is no need to repeat it.”
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدٌ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ السِّنْدِيِّ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَجَّاجِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْخِفَافِ مِنَ التَّعَالِبِ أَوِ
الْجِزْزِ مِنْهُ أَيُصَلَّى فِيهَا أَمْ لا قَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ ذَكِيّاً فَلا بَأْسَ بِهِ».
قال محمد بن الحسن: قد بينا الوجه في امثال هذين الخبرين فيما مضى فلا وجه لاعادته.

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who goes to the market and buys a fur cloak but does
not know whether it is from a lawfully slaughtered animal or not, may he pray in it?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes. You are not required to ask. Abu Ja‘far, peace be upon him, used
to say: 'Indeed, the Khawarij imposed restrictions upon themselves out of their
ignorance. Surely, the religion is broader than that.'"
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَأْتِي السُّوقَ فَيَشتَرِي جُبَّةَ فِرَاءٍ
لاَيَدْرِي أَذَكِيَّةٌ هِيَ أَمْ غَيْرُ ذَكِيَّةِ أَيُصَلِّي فِيهَا قَالَ «نَعَمْ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَسْأَلَةُ إِنَّ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ كَانَ يَقُولُ
«إِنَّ الْخَوَارِجَ ضَيَّقُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ بِجَهَالَتِهِمْ إِنَّ أَلدِّينَ أَوْسَعُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ» ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.257 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.368 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.419 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.491 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.455 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.2 p.281

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughirah, from Abdullah ibn Muskan, from
Al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "There is no problem in praying in what is
made from the wool of a carcass, for wool does not have a soul in it."
Abdullah (ibn Muskan) said: “And Ali ibn Abi Hamzah narrated to me that a man asked
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, while I was with Imam {a.s}, about a man who
wears a sword around his neck and prays with it.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes."
So the man said: “There is ‘kaymukht’ in it.”
Imam {a.s} said: "And what is ‘kaymukht’?"
The man said: “Skins of animals, some of it is from a lawfully slaughtered animal, and
some of it is from a carcass.”
So Imam {a.s} said: "What you know to be from a carcass, do not pray in it."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ بِالصَّلاَةِ فِيمَا كَانَ مِنْ صُوفِ الْمَيْتَةِ إِنَّ الصُّوفَ لَيْسَ فِيهِ رُوحٌ» قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَهِ وَ حَدَّثَنِي
عَلِيْ بْنُ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ أَنَّ رَجُلاً سَأَلَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ وَ أَنَا عِنْدَهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَتَقَلِّدُ السَّيْفَ وَ يُصَلِّي فِيهِ قَالَ
«نَعَمْ» فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ إنَّ فِيهِ الْكَيْمُخْتَ فَقَالَ »وَ مَا الْكَيْمُختُ» فَقَالَ جُلُودُ دَوَابَ مِنْهُ مَا يَكُونُ ذَكِيّا وَ مِنْهُ مَا يَكُونُ
مَيْتَةً فَقَالَ »مَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّهُ مَيْتَةٌ فَلا تُصَلِّ فِيهِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.368 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.420

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Sa‘d, from Al-Husayn ibn Ali, from Ahmad ibn Hilal, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn
‘Uthman, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
I said to Imam {a.s}: “A cloth that is used for wiping, may a man place it on his shoulder
or wrap it around his waist and pray in it?”
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no problem."
text_ar:
سَعْدٌ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ هِلالٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي
عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ مِنْدِيلٌ يُتَمَنْدَلُ بِهِ أَيَجُوزُ لَهُ أَنْ يَضَعَهُ الرَّجُلُ عَلَى مَنكِبِهِ أَوْ يَتَّزِرَ بِهِ وَ يُصَلِّيَ
قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Sa‘d, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughirah, from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar, from the Righteous
Servant (Abd al Salih {a.s}), peace be upon him:
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no problem in praying in Yemeni silk and in what is made in
the lands of Islam."
I said to Imam {a.s}: “What if there are non-Muslims in it?”
Imam {a.s} said: "If Muslims are predominant in it, then there is no problem."
text_ar:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَيُوبَ بْنِ نُوحِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ إسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنِ ٱلْعَبْدِ الصَّالِحِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسّلاَمُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «لا
بَأسَ بِالصَّلاَةٍ فِي الْقَزَّ الْيَمَانِيِّ وَ فِيمَا صُنعَ فِي أَرْضِ الْإِسْلامِ» قُلْتُ لَهُ فَإِنْ كَانَ فِيهَا غَيْرُ أُهْلِ ٱلْإِسْلاَمِ قَالَ «إِذَا
كَانَ الْغَالِبَ عَلَيْهَا الْمُسْلِمُونَ فَلاَ بَأْسَ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Al-Rayyan ibn Al-Salt, said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha, peace be upon him, about wearing furs of samur
(sable), sinjab (squirrel), ‘hawasil’ (small animals with gathered pelts), and what
resembles them, and about belts, cloaks (al-kaymukht), clothing padded with silk,
and footwear made from various types of leather.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no problem with all of this, except for (what is made from)
foxes (al-tha’alib)."
text_ar:
أحْمَدُ بنُ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنِ الرَّيَّانِ بْنِ الصَّلْتِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الرَّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنْ لُبْسِ فِرَاءٍ
السَّمُورِ وَ السِّنْجَابٍ وَ الْحَوَاصِلِ وَ مَا أَشبَهَهَا وَ ٱلْمَنَاطِقِ وَ الْكَيْمُخْتِ وَ الْمَحْشُوّ بِالْقَزِّ وَ الْخِفَافِ مِنْ أَصْنَافِ
الْجُلُودِ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِهَذَا كُلِّهِ إِلاّ بِالتَّعَالِبِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.369 • Al-Wafi, Vol.2 0 p.721 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.352

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Fadalah, from Husayn ibn ‘Uthman, from Ibn Muskan, from Al-Halabi, said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about wearing ‘khazz’ (a type of fine fabric).
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no problem with it. Indeed, (Imam) Ali ibn Al-Husayn {a.s}, peace
be upon them both, used to wear a ‘khazz’ cloak in the winter, and when summer
came, He {a.s} would sell it and give its price in charity.
And He (Imam Ali ibn Husayn {a.s}) used to say: 'I feel ashamed before my Lord {AZJ} to eat
from the price of a garment in which I worshipped Allah {SWT}.'"
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ لُبْسِ الْخَزِّ فَقَالَ
«لاً بَأْسَ بِهِ إِنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ كَانَ يَلْبَسُ الْكِسَاءَ الْخَزَّ فِي الشَّتَاءِ فَإِذَا جَاءَ الصَّيْفُ بَاعَهُ وَتَصَدَّقَ
بِثَمَنِهِ وَ كَانَ يَقُولُ «إِنِّي لَأَسْتَحْبِي مِنْ رَبِّي أَنْ آكُلَ ثَمَنَ ثَوْبِ قَدْ عَبَدْتُ اللَّهَ فِيهِ» ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.369 • Al-Wafi, Vol.2 0 p.723 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.366 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.4 6 p.105 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.1 8 p.137
source_scholar: Implicit (Muzmar) & Abu Muhammad Imam Ali ibn Husayn Zayn al-Abidin {a.s}
text_chunk:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Fadalah, from Husayn ibn ‘Uthman, from Ibn Muskan, from Al-Halabi, said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about wearing ‘khazz’ (a type of fine fabric).
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no problem with it. Indeed, (Imam) Ali ibn Al-Husayn {a.s}, peace
be upon them both, used to wear a ‘khazz’ cloak in the winter, and when summer
came, He {a.s} would sell it and give its price in charity.
And He (Imam Ali ibn Husayn {a.s}) used to say: 'I feel ashamed before my Lord {AZJ} to eat
from the price of a garment in which I worshipped Allah {SWT}.'"

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
From him, from Safwan, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Ibrahim Al-Ahmari, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who prays while his buttons
are undone.
Imam {a.s} said: "That is not appropriate."
text_ar:
عَثْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْأَحْمَرِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ يُصَلِّي
وَ أزْرَارُهُ مُحَلَّلَةٌ قَالَ «لا يَنْبَغِي ذَلِكَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.369 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.392 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.375 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.394

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
From him, from Safwan, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the ‘shadhakunah’ (a type of thick
woolen or felt garment) that is affected by a wet dream, may one pray upon it?
Imam {a.s} said: "No."

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This report is to be understood as recommending
precaution (it is mustahabb), or it applies to a case where the impurity might still be
wet, so one should not pray upon it lest it transfer to him. But if it is dry and such
transfer is not feared, then there is no problem with it.”
What indicates this is what has been narrated:
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفُوَانَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الشَّاذَكُونَةِ يُصِيبُهَا الإِحْتِلامُ أَيُصَلَّى
عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَ »لا».
قال محمد بن الحسن : هذا الخبر محمول على الاستحباب أو على انه إذا كانت النجاسة ربما كانت رطبة فلا يصلي عليها
لئلا يتعدى ذلك إليه ، فاما إذا كانت يابسة يؤمن ذلك عليها فلا بأس بذلك ، والذي يدل على ذلك ما رواه:

precaution (it is mustahabb), or it applies to a case where the impurity might still be
wet, so one should not pray upon it lest it transfer to him. But if it is dry and such
transfer is not feared, then there is no problem with it.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Al-Hakam, from Aban ibn ‘Uthman, from Zurarah, from Abu Ja‘far,
peace be upon him, said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the ‘shadhakunah’ (a type of felt or coarse cloth) upon which
there is janabah (major ritual impurity) on it, is it permissible to pray on it in the litter
(mahmil) (a type of carriage or travel seat)?
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no problem."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي
جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَألْتُهُ عَنِ
الشَّاذَكُونَةٍ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهَا الْجَنَابَةُ أَ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا فِي الْمَحْمِلِ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.369 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.393 • Al-Wafi, Vol.6 p.230 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.454

From him, from Al-‘Abbas ibn Ma‘ruf, from Safwan, from Salih Al-Nili, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, who
said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “May I pray upon the ‘shadhakunah’ (a
thick or coarse cloth) while it has been affected by janabah (major ritual impurity)?”
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no problem."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَغْرُوفِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ صَالِحِ النِّيلِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ أُصَلِّي عَلَى الشَّاذَكُونَةِ وَ قَدْ أَصَابَثْهَا الْجَنَابَةُ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Sa‘d, from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan, from ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from ‘Ammar ibn Musa
Al-Sabati, said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a ‘bariyyah’ (a mat) whose reeds
were moistened with impure water, does it suffice to pray on it?
Imam {a.s} said: "If it has dried, then there is no problem in praying on it."
text_ar:
سَغدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى السَابَاطِيَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ
أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الْبَارِيَّةِ يُبَلُ قَصَبُهَا بِمَاءٍ قَذِرٍ هَلْ يَجُوزُ الصِّلاَةُ عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَ «إِذَا جَفَّتْ فَلاَ بَأْسَ
بِالصَّلاَةِ عَلَيْهَا».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.370 • Al-Wafi, Vol.6 p.233 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.454

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Sa‘d ibn Isma‘il, from his father, said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha, peace be upon him, about a prayer mat or carpet that
has figures on it, may one stand on it and pray or not?
Imam {a.s} said: "By Allah {SWT}, I dislike that."
And (Imam {a.s} was asked) regarding a man who entered upon another man who had a
carpet with a figure on it.
Imam {a.s} said: "Do you find an image here?"
Then Imam {a.s} said: "Do not sit on it and do not pray on it."

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This report is to be understood as indicating ‘dislike’
(karahah), based on the reports we have already presented which state that there is
no problem in sitting or standing upon such items, as long as one does not prostrate
on them.” What further clarifies this is what has been narrated:
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ عَنِ الْمُصَلَّى وَ الْبِسَاطِ
يَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ تَمَاثِيلُ أَيَقُومُ عَلَيْهِ فَيُصَلِّي أَمْ لا فَقَالَ «وَ اللَّهِ إِنَّي لَأَكْرَهُ ذَلِكَ» وَ عَنْ رَجُلٍ دَحَلَ عَلَى رَجُلٍ وَ عِنْدَهُ
بِسَاطْ عَلَيْهِ تِمْثَالُ فَقَالَ «أَتَجِدُ هَاهُنَا مِثَالاً» فَقَالَ «لا تَجْلِسُ عَلَيْهِ وَ لاَ تُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : هذا الخبر محمول على الكراهية بدلالة ما قدمناه من الاخبار وأنه لا بأس بالقعود عليه والوقوف
مالم يسجد عليها ، ويزيد ذلك بيانا ما رواه :

(karahah), based on the reports we have already presented which state that there is
no problem in sitting or standing upon such items, as long as one does not prostrate
on them.” What further clarifies this is what has been narrated:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Al-
‘Ala’, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, said:
I said to Abu Ja‘far, peace be upon him: “I pray while the figures are in front of me and
I am looking at them?”
Imam {a.s} said: "No. Cast a cloth over them. There is no problem if they are to your right,
or to your left, or behind you, or beneath your feet, or above your head. But if they are
in the direction of the Qiblah, then cover them with a cloth and pray."
text_ar:
محمد بن احمد بن يحيى عن محمد بن الحسين عن الحسن ابن محبوب عن العلا عن محمد بن مسلم قال قلت
لابي جعفر عليه السلام : أصلي والتماثيل قدامي وانا انظر إليها؟ قال : لا إطرح عليها ثوبا ، ولا بأس بها إذا
كانت عن يمينك أو شمالك أو خلفك أو تحت رجلك أو فوق رأسك ، وإن كانت في القبلة فالق عليها ثوبا وصل.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Al-Hakam, from Malik ibn ‘Atiyyah, who said: Ziyad ibn Al-Mundhir
informed me, from Abu Ja‘far, peace be upon him, who said:
A man asked Imam {a.s} while I was present about a man who comes out of the
bathhouse or performs ghusl, then drapes a cloth over himself and wears his shirt over
the ‘izar’ (lower garment), and prays in that state.
Imam {a.s} said: "This is the practice of the people of Lot."
I asked: “What if he drapes the cloth over the shirt?”
Imam {a.s} said: "This is from arrogance."
I asked: “The shirt is thin, so he wraps himself with it.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes (that is acceptable)."
Then Imam {a.s} said: "Indeed, unbuttoning one's shirt in prayer, flicking pebbles,
chewing frankincense in gatherings, and sitting on the roadsides, all of this is from the
actions of the people of Lot."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ عَطِيَّةً قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي زِيَادُ بْنُ الْمُنْذِرِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ
قَالَ: سَأَلَهُ رَجُلٌ وَ أَنَا حَاضِرُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَخْرُجُ مِنَ الْحَمَّامِ أَوْ يَفْتَسِلُ فَيَتَوَشِّحُ وَ يَلْبَس قَمِيصَهُ فَوْقَ الْإِزَارِ فَيُصَلِّي
وَ هُوَ كَذَلِكَ قَالَ «هَذَا عَمَلُ قَوْمِ لُوطِ» قَالَ قُلْتُ فَإِنَّهُ يَتَوَشَحْ فَوْقَ ٱلْقَمِيصِ فَقَالَ «هَذَا مِنَ التَّجَبُرِ» قَالَ قُلْتُ
إِنَّ الْقَمِيصَ رَقِيقٌ يَلْتَجِفُ بِهِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ» ثُمَّ قَالَ «إنَّ حَلَ الْأَزْرَارِ فِي الصَّلاةِ وَ الْخَذْفَ بِالْحَصَى وَ مَضْغَ ٱلْكُنْدُرِ
فِي الْمَجَالِسٍ وَ عَلَى ظَهْرِ الطَّرِيقِ مِنْ عَمَلِ قَوْمِ لُوطِ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim, from his father:
(Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "A woman should not pray uncovered."

text_en:
From him, from Sa‘d ibn Isma‘il, from his father Isma‘il ibn ‘Isa, who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}, about the fur skins which a man buys in the market from the
markets of the mountain region, should he ask about their slaughtering (dhakah) if the
seller is a Muslim but not one of the ‘Arif’ (not a ‘shia’)?
He said "It is upon you to ask about it if you see that the sellers are polytheists. But if
you see that (people) are praying in it, then do not ask about it."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ عِيسَى قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنْ جُلُودِ الْفِرَاءِ
يَشتَرِيهَا الرَّجُلُ فِي سُوقٍ مِنْ أَسْوَاقِ الْجَبَلِ أَيَسْأَلُ عَنْ ذَكَاتِهِ إِذَا كَانَ الْبَائعُ مُسْلِماً غَيْرَ عَارِفٍ قَالَ «عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْتُمْ
أَنْ تَسْأَلُوا عَنْهُ إِذَا رَأَيْثُمُ الْمُشرِكِينَ يَبِيعُونَ ذَلِكَ وَ إِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ يُصَلُونَ فِيهِ فَلاَ تَسْأَلُوا عَنْهُ».

chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Al-Ridha, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about leather socks, if a man goes to the market and buys leather
socks without knowing whether the leather is from a lawfully slaughtered animal or
not, what do you say about praying in them while he does not know? Should he pray in
them?
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes. I buy leather socks from the market, and they are made for me,
and I pray in them. And it is not obligatory upon you to ask."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلْخَفَّافِ يَأْتِي السُوقَ فَيَشْتَرِي ٱلْخُفَّ
لاَ يَدْرِي أَذَكِي هُوَ أَمْ لاَ مَا تَقُولُ فِي الصَّلاةِ فِيهِ وَ هُوَ لا يَدْرِي أَ يُصَلِّي فِيهِ قَالَ «نَعَمْ أَنَا أَشتَرِي ٱلْخُفَ مِنَ
السُّوقِ وَ يُصْنَعُ لِي وَ أُصَلِّي فِيهِ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَسْأَلَةُ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, by Ahmad, by his father, by Wahb ibn Wahb, from (Imam) Ja‘far {a.s}:
(Imam) Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "The sword is like a cloak, you may pray with
it as long as you do not see blood on it. And the bow is like a cloak."
text_ar:
مُحَمّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَنَّ عَلِياً عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ
قَالَ: «السَّيْفُ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الرِّدَاءِ تُصَلِّي فِيهِ مَا لَمْ تَرَ فِيهِ دَماً وَ الْقَوْسُ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الرِّدَاءِ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Barqi, from Sa‘d ibn Sa‘d, from Al-
Ridha, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the skins of ‘khazz’ (a type of fine cloth or fabric).
Imam {a.s} said: "Here we are, we wear it."
I asked: “That is fur, may I be your ransom.”
Imam {a.s} said: "When its fur is permissible, its skin is also permissible."
text_ar:
عَنَهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْبَرْقِيِّ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ سَعْدِ عَنِ الرَّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ جُلُودِ الْخَزِّ فَقَالَ
«هُوَ ذَا نَحْنُ نَلْبَسُ» فَقُلْتُ ذَاكَ ٱَلْوَبَرُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ فَقَالَ «إِذَا حَلَ وَبَرُهُ حَلَ جِلْدُهُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.452 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.372 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.411 • Al-Wafi, Vol.2 0 p.724 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.366

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
From him, by Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan, by ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id, by Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, by ‘Ammar ibn Musa:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who prays while
wearing an iron ring.
Imam {a.s} said: "No, and a man should not wear it, for it is from the dress of the people
of the Fire."
And Imam {a.s} said: "A man should not wear gold nor pray in it, for it is from the dress
of the people of Paradise."
And (Imam {a.s} was asked) about a garment that has a border of brocade.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should not pray in it."
And (Imam {a.s} was asked) about a garment whose border has the image of a bird or
something else, may one pray in it?
Imam {a.s} said: "No."
And (Imam {a.s} was asked) about a filthy spot that is in the house or elsewhere and is
not struck by sunlight but has dried.
Imam {a.s} said: "He should not pray on it, and mark its place until he washes it."
And (Imam {a.s} was asked) about the sun, does it purify the ground?
Imam {a.s} said: "If the place is filthy from urine or something else, and the sun strikes
it, and then the place dries, then prayer on that spot is permissible. But if the sun
strikes it and the filthy place has not dried and remains wet, then it is not permissible
to pray on it until it dries. And if your foot is wet, or your forehead is wet, or any other
part of you touches that filthy place, then do not pray on that spot until it dries, for it is
not permissible."
And (Imam {a.s} was asked) about a man who performs wudhu and walks barefoot while
his foot is wet.
Imam {a.s} said: "If your ground is paved, then it is sufficient for you to walk on it."
And Imam {a.s} said: "As for us, it is permissible for us, because our ground is paved",
meaning, covered with gravel.
And (Imam {a.s} was asked) about a man who wears a ring that has the engraved image
of a bird or something else.
Imam {a.s} said: "It is not permissible to pray with it."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقٍ بْنِ صَدَفَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ع : فِي
الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي وَ عَلَيْهِ خَاتَمُ حَدِيدِ قَالَ «لا وَ لا يَتَخَتَّمُ بِهِ الرَّجُلُ فَإِنَّهُ مِنْ لِبَاسِ أَهْلِ النَّارِ » وَ قَالَ «لا يَلْبَسُ الرَّجُلُ
الذَّهَبَ وَ لا يُصَلِّي فِيهِ لِأَنَّهُ مِنْ لِبَاسٍ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ » وَ عَنِ التَّوْبِ يَكُونُ عَلَمُهُ دِيبَاجاً قَالَ «لا يُصَلِّي فِيهِ » وَ عَنِ
الثَّوْبِ يَكُونُ فِي عَلَمِهِ مِثَالُ طَيْرٍ أَوْ غَيْرٍ ذَلِكَ أَ يُصَلِّي فِيهِ قَالَ «لا» وَ عَنِ الْمَوْضِعِ الْقَذِرِ يَكُونُ فِي الْبَيْتِ أَوْ
غَيْرِهِ فَلاَ تُصِيبُهُ الشَّمْسُ وَ لَكِنَّهُ قَدْ يَبِسَ الْمَوْضِعُ ٱلْقَذِرُ قَالَ «لا يُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ وَ أَعْلَمَ مَوْضِعَهُ حَتَّى يَغْسِلَهُ» وَ عَنِ
الشَّمْسِ هَلْ تُطَهّرُ الْأَرْضَ قَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ الْمَوْضِعُ قَذِراً مِنْ بَوْلِ أَوْ غَيْرٍ ذَلِكَ فَأَصَابَثَهُ الشَّمْسُ ثُمَّ يَبِسَ الْمَوْضِعُ
فَالصَّلاَةُ عَلَى الْمَوْضِعِ جَائِزَةٌ وَ إِنْ أَصَابَثْهُ الشَّمْسُ وَ لَمْ يَنْبَسِ الْمَوْضِعُ الْقَذِرُ وَ كَانَ رَطْباً فَلا تَجُوزُ ٱلصَّلاَةُ عَلَيْهِ
حَتَّى يَنْبَسَ وَ إنْ كَانَتْ رِجْلُكَ رَطْبَةً أَوْ جَبْهَثُكَ رَطْبَةً أَوْ غَيْرُ ذَلِكَ مِنْكَ مَا يُصِيبُ ذَلِكَ الْمَوْضِعَ الْقَذِرَ فَلا تُصَلِّ
عَلَى ذَلِكَ الْمَوْضِعِ حَتَّى بَنْبَسَ فَإِنَّهُ لا يَجُوزُ ذَلِكَ» وَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَتَوَضَّأْ وَ يَمْشِي حَافِياً وَ رِجْلُهُ رَطْبَةٌ قَالَ «إِنْ
كَانَتْ أَرْضُكُمْ مُبَلَّطَةً أَجْزَأَكُمُ ٱلْمَشيْ عَلَيْهَا» وَ قَالَ «أَمَّا نَحْنُ فَيَجُوزُ لَنَا ذَلِكَ لِأَنْ أَرْضَنَا مُبَلَّطَةٌ يَعْنِي مَفْرُوشَةً
بِالْحَصَى» وَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَلْبَسُ الْخَاتَمَ فِيهِ نَقْشُ مِثَالِ الطَّيْرِ أَوْ غَيْرٍ ذَلِكَ قَالَ « لا تَجُوزُ الصَّلاَةُ فِيهِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.372

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Mu‘awiyah ibn Hakim, from Ibn Faddal, from Hammad ibn ‘Uthman:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Prayer is disliked in a heavily dyed, deeply
colored, blood-red garment."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ حُكَيْمٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ حَمَادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ:
«تُكْرَهُ الصَّلاَةُ فِي الثَّوْبِ الْمَصْبُوعِ الْمُشبَعِ الْمُفْدَمِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.402 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.373 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.391 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.460

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from his father, from Abdullah ibn Al-Mughirah, from someone who narrated to
him, from Yazid ibn Khalifah, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam {a.s} disliked prayer in a garment saturated with safflower and dyed with saffron.
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَمَّنْ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ خَلِيفَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ :
أَنَّهُ كَرِهَ الصَّلَاةَ فِي الْمُشْبَعِ بِالْعُصْفُرِ الْمُضَرَّجِ بِالزَّعْفَرَانِ.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.373 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.391 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.461 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.3 p.230

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
From him, from Al-‘Amraki, from Ali ibn Ja‘far, from his brother (Imam) Musa {a.s}, peace be upon him, who
said:
I asked Him {a.s} about a man, does it suffice for him to gather the two ends of his cloak
over his left shoulder?
Imam {a.s} said: "It is not appropriate to gather them over the left shoulder; rather,
gather them over your right shoulder, or leave them."
He (narrator) said: “And I asked Imam {a.s} about reed mats (al-bawari’) that have been
soiled with urine, does prayer on them suffice if they have dried without being
washed?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Yes, there is no problem."
He (narrator) said: “And I asked Imam {a.s} about praying on the reed mats of Christians
and Jews, upon which they sit in their homes, does it suffice?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Do not pray on them."
And I asked Imam {a.s} about the sword, does it take the place of the cloak, such that
one may lead the people in prayer wearing only the sword?
Imam {a.s} said: "It is not appropriate to lead people in prayer while wearing only the
sword, except in battle."

عَنْهُ عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يَجْمَعَ

عَنِ اَلبَوَارِي يُصِيبُهَا الْبَوْلُ هَلْ تَصْلُحُ الصَّلاَةُ عَلَيْهَا إِذَا جَفَّتْ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَنْ تُغْسَلَ قَالَ «نَعَمْ لا بَأْسَ» قَالَ وَ سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنِ الصَّلَاَةِ عَلَى بَوَارِي النَّصَارَى وَ الْيَهُودِ الَّذِينَ يَقْعُدُونَ عَلَيْهَا فِي بُيُوتِهِمْ أَيَصْلُحُ قَالَ « لا تُصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا » وَ
سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ السَّيْفِ هَلْ يَجْرِي مَجْرَى الرِّدَاءِ يُؤْمُّ ٱلْقَوْمُ فِي السَّيْفِ قَالَ «لا يَصْلُحُ أَنْ يُؤْمَّ ٱلْقَوْمُ فِي السَّيْفِ إِلاَّ فِي
حَرْبٍ».

chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Al-Sayyari, from Abu Yazid Al-Qasmi, and Qasm is a tribe from Yemen residing
in Basrah, from Abu Al-Hasan Al-Ridha, peace be upon him:
He (narrator) asked Imam {a.s} about the skins of ‘al-Darish’ (a type of animal) from
which leather socks are made.
Imam {a.s} said: "Do not pray in them, for they are tanned using dog feces."
text_ar:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ السِّيَّارِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي يَزِيدَ ٱلْقَسْمِيِّ وَ قَسْمٌ حَيْ مِنَ ٱلْيَمَنِ بِالْبَصْرَةِ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ : أَنَّهُ سَأَلَهُ عَنْ جُلُودِ الدَّارِشِ الْتِي يُتَّخَذُ مِنْهَا الْخِفَافُ فَقَالَ «لا تُصَلَّ فِيهَا فَإِنَّهَا تُدْبَغُ بِخُرْءِ الْكِلاَبِ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Musa ibn Al-Qasim and Abu Qatadah together, from Ali ibn Ja‘far, from his
brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon them both, said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man, may he pray on a platform (raf) suspended between two
palm trees?
Imam {a.s} said: "If it is level, and he is able to perform the prayer on it, then there is no
harm."
He (narrator) said: “And I asked Imam {a.s} about beds or rugs made of silk or its like
from dibaj (brocade), and a prayer mat of silk or brocade, is it permissible for a man to
sleep on it, recline on it, and pray on it?”
Imam {a.s} said: "He may lay it out and stand on it, but he should not prostrate on it."
And I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who prays in a mosque whose walls are all covered
with embroidery (kiwa), the qiblah wall and both side walls, and his wife prays in front
of him, so that he sees her but she does not see him.
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no problem."
And I asked Imam {a.s} about mats whose reeds were wetted with impure water, may
one pray on them?
Imam {a.s} said: "If they have dried, then there is no problem."
And I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who prayed while having with him a saddle or other
item made from donkey skin, and he was wearing sandals made from donkey skin,
does his prayer suffice him or must he repeat it?
Imam {a.s} said: "It is not proper for him to pray while it is with him unless he fears that
it might be lost, then there is no problem in praying while it is with him."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ وَ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ جَمِيعاً عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا
السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ عَلَى الرَّفِّ الْمُعَلَّقِ بَيْنَ نَخْلَتَيْنِ قَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ مُسْتَوِياً يَقْدِرُ
عَلَى الصَّلاةِ عَلَيْهِ فَلا بَأْسَ» قَالَ وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ فِرَاشِ حَرِيرٍ وَ مِثلِهِ مِنَ الدِّيبَاجِ وَ مُصَلَّى حَرِيرٍ وَ مِثْلِهِ مِنَ الدِّيبَاجِ
يَصْلُحْ لِلرَّجُلِ النَّوْمُ عَلَيْهِ وَ التُكَأَةُ وَ الصَّلاةُ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ «يَفْرُشُهُ وَ يَقُومُ عَلَيْهِ وَ لاَ يَسْجُدُ عَلَيْهِ» وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجْلِ
يُصَلِّي فِي مَسْجِدٍ حِيطَانُهُ كِوَاءُ كُلُّهُ قِبْلَتُهُ وَ جَانِبَاهُ وَ اِمْرَأَتُهُ تُصَلَّي حِيَالَهُ يَرَاهَا وَ لا تَرَاهُ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ» وَ سَأْلْتُهُ
عَنِ الْبَوَارِي يُبَلُّ قَصَبُهَا بِمَاءٍ قَذِرٍ أ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا قَالَ «إِذَا يَبِسَتْ فَلا بَأْسَ» وَ سَأَلْثُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ صَلَّى وَ مَعَهُ دَبَّةً
مِنْ جَلْدٍ جِمَارٍ وَ عَلَيْهِ نَعْلٌ مِنْ جِلْدِ جِمَارِ هَلْ تُجْزِيهِ صَلاَتُهُ أَوْ عَلَيْهِ إِعَادَةً قَالَ «لا يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ وَ هِيَ مَعَهُ
إلا أَنْ يَتَخَوَّفَ عَلَيْهَا ذَهَابَهَا فَلا بَأْسَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ وَ هِيَ مَعَهُ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan, from ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id, from Musaddiq ibn
Sadaqah, from ‘Ammar Al-Sabati, said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about praying in the bathhouse.
Imam {a.s} said: "If it is a clean place, then there is no problem."

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “The interpretation of this report is that it refers
specifically to the changing room of the bathhouse, not to other areas within it, based
on the indication of previously mentioned reports.”
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدَّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةً عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَابَاطِيَّ
قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أُبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ فِي بَيْتِ الْحَمَّامِ قَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ مَوْضِعاً نَظِيفاً فَلاَ بَأْسَ ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : الوجه في هذا الخبر أن نحمله على بيت المسلخ دون غيره من البيوت بدلالة ما قدمناه من الاخبار.
commentary:

specifically to the changing room of the bathhouse, not to other areas within it, based
on the indication of previously mentioned reports.”

text_en:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Isa Al-‘Ubaydi, from Al-Husayn ibn Yaqtin, from his father Ali ibn Yaqtin,
who said:
I asked Abu Al-Hasan Al-Madi, peace be upon him, about praying between graves,
does it suffice?
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no problem."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى الْعُبَيْدِيّ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ ٱلْمَاضِيَ
عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ بَيْنَ الْقُبُورِ هَلْ تَصْلُحُ قَالَ «لاَ بَأْسَ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Al-Husayn, from Fadalah, from Hammad ibn ‘Uthman, from ‘Amir ibn Nu‘aym Al-Qummi, said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “The places where people lodge, there
are the urines of animals and manure, and Jews and Christians enter them, what
should be done about praying in them?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Pray upon your garment."
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ نُعَيْمِ الْقُمِّيَّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ٱلْمَنَازِلُ
الَّتِي يَنْزِلُهَا النَّاسُ فِيهَا أَبْوَالُ الدَّوَابِّ وَ السِّرْجِينُ وَ يَدْخُلُهَا الْيَهُودُ وَ النَّصَارَى كَيْفَ يُصْنَعُ بِالصَّلاَةِ فِيهَا قَالَ «صَلَ
عَلَى ثَوْبِكَ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be
upon him, said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who wades into water and the time of prayer comes
upon him.
Imam {a.s} said: "If he is in battle, then gesturing suffices him; But if he is a merchant,
then let him stop and not enter (the water) until he has prayed."
text_ar:
عَلِي عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَخُوضُ
الْمَاءَ فَتُدْرِكُهُ الصَّلاَةُ فَقَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ فِي حَرْبٍ فَإِنَّهُ يُجْزِيهِ الْإِيمَاءُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ تَاجِراً فَلْيُقِمْ وَ لا يَدْخُلُهُ حَتَّى يُصَلِّيّ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, said:
I said to Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}: “We were in Al-Bayda’ at the end of the night, so I performed
wudu and used a tooth-stick (siwak), and I was about to pray, then something entered
my heart (caused doubt), is it permissible to pray in Al-Bayda’ while in the litter (on the
camel)?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Do not pray in Al-Bayda’."
I asked: “Where is the boundary of Al-Bayda’?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Abu Ja‘far, peace be upon him, when He {a.s} reached Dhat Al-Jaysh, He
{a.s} would quicken his pace and would not pray until He {a.s} reached the resting place
of the Prophet {saws}, peace be upon him and his family."
I said to Imam {a.s}: “And where is Dhat Al-Jaysh?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Three miles before Al-Hafirah."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ إِنَّا كُنَّا فِي الْبَيْدَاءِ فِي آخِرٍ
اللَّيل فَتَوَضَّأتُ وَ اِسْتَكْتُ وَ أَنَا أَهُمُ بِالصَّلَاةِ ثُمَّ كَأَنَّهُ دَخَلَ قَلْبِي شَيْءُ فَهَلْ يُصَلَّى فِي الْبَيْدَاءِ فِي الْمَحْمِلِ فَقَالَ
«لا تُصَلَّ فِي البَيْدَاءِ » قُلْتُ وَ أَيْنَ حَدْ ٱلْبَيْدَاءِ فَقَالَ «كَانَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ إِذَا بَلَغَ ذَاتَ ٱلْجَيْشِ جَدَّ فِي
الْمَسِير وَلا يُصَلِّي حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ مُعَرَّسَ النَّبِيِّ صَلّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ » قُلْتُ لَهُ وَ أَيْنَ ذَاتُ اَلْجَيْشِ فَقَالَ «دُونَ
الْحَفِيرَةٍ بِثَلاَثَةِ أَمْيَالٍ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.389 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.375 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.467 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.155
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
text_chunk:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, said:
I said to Abu Al-Hasan {a.s}: “We were in Al-Bayda’ at the end of the night, so I performed
wudu and used a tooth-stick (siwak), and I was about to pray, then something entered
my heart (caused doubt), is it permissible to pray in Al-Bayda’ while in the litter (on the
camel)?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Do not pray in Al-Bayda’."
I asked: “Where is the boundary of Al-Bayda’?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Abu Ja‘far, peace be upon him, when He {a.s} reached Dhat Al-Jaysh, He
{a.s} would quicken his pace and would not pray until He {a.s} reached the resting place
of the Prophet {saws}, peace be upon him and his family."
I said to Imam {a.s}: “And where is Dhat Al-Jaysh?”
Imam {a.s} said: "Three miles before Al-Hafirah."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ayyub ibn Nuh, from Abu Al-Hasan Al-Akhir, peace be upon him,
said:
I said to Imam {a.s}: “The time of prayer comes while a man is at Al-Bayda”.
Imam {a.s} said: "Let him move away from the main paths to the right or the left, and
then pray."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَيُوبَ بْنِ نُوحِ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الْأَخِيرِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ تَحْضُرُ الصَّلاَةُ وَ
الرَّجُلُ بِالْبَيْدَاءِ قَالَ «يَتَنَحَى عَنِ الْجَوَادَ يَمْنَةً وَ يَسْرَةً وَ يُصَلِّي».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.389 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.375 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.468 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.156
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Fadalah, from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Prayer is disliked in three places along the
road: Al-Bayda’, which is Dhat Al-Jaysh, and Dhat Al-Salasil, and Dajnan."
And Imam {a.s} said: "There is no problem in praying between the side roads (zawahir),
meaning the side paths of the roads, but it is discouraged to pray on the main
thoroughfares (al-jawad)"
text_ar:
عَلِيُّ بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «الصَّلاَةُ تُكْرَهُ فِي ثَلاَثَةٍ
مَوَاطِنَ مِنَ الطَّرِيقِ - الْبَيْدَاءِ وَ هِيَ ذَاتُ الْجَيْشِ وَ ذَاتِ الصِّلاَصِلِ وَ ضَجْنَانَ » وَ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ بِأَنْ يُصَلَّى بَيْنَ
الظَّوَاهِرِ وَ هِيَ الْجَوَادْ جَوَادْ الطُّرُقِ وَ يُكْرَهُ أَنْ يُصَلَّى فِي الْجَوَادً».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.389 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.375 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.468
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Faddal, from some of our companions:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Do not pray in the Valley of Al-Shuqrah."
text_ar: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ بَعْضٍ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «لا تُصَلَّ فِي وَادِي الشُّقْرَةِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.375
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Do not pray in the Valley of Al-Shuqrah."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan, from ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from
‘Ammar Al-Sabati, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s}: “What is the extent of wet mud upon which prostration is not valid?”
Imam {a.s} said: "When the forehead sinks into it and does not remain firmly upon the
ground."
text_ar:
محمد بن أحمد عن أحمد بن الحسن عن عمرو بن سعيد عن مصدق بن صدقة عن عمار الساباطي عن أبي عبد
اللّه عليه السلام قال سألته عن حد الطين الذي لا يسجد عليه ما هو؟ قال : إذا غرق الجبهة ولم تثبت على
الارض.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

I asked Imam {a.s}: “What is the extent of wet mud upon which prostration is not valid?”
Imam {a.s} said: "When the forehead sinks into it and does not remain firmly upon the
ground."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Mahbub, from Ibn Ri’ab, from Jamil ibn Salih, from Al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “I stand in prayer and I see in front of me,
in the direction of the Qiblah, excrement.”
Imam {a.s} said: "Move away from it as much as you can, and do not pray on the roads."
text_ar:
اسهل بن زياد عن ابن محبوب عن ابن رئاب عن جميل ابن صالح عن الفضيل بن يسار قال قلت لابي عبد اللّٰه
عليه السلام: أقوم في الصلاة فأرى قدامي في القبلة العذرة قال : تنح عنها ما استطعت ولاتصل على الجواد.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id, from Fadalah, from Al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two (Imams
{a.s}), peace be upon them:
Imam {a.s} said: "Do not perform the obligatory prayer inside the Ka‘bah."
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ الْعَلَاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «لَا تُصَلِّ الْمَكْثُوبَةَ
فِي الْكَعْبَةِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.376 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.470 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.336
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}

{a.s}), peace be upon them:
Imam {a.s} said: "Do not perform the obligatory prayer inside the Ka‘bah."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
From him, from Fadalah, from Al-Husayn ibn ‘Uthman, from Ibn Muskan, from Khalid ibn Abi Isma‘il, said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “A man prays on top of Abu Qubays
(mountain), facing the Qiblah”
Imam {a.s} said: "There is no problem."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ أَبِي إسْمَاعِيلَ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَامُ الرَّجُلُ يُصَلِّي عَلَى أَبِي قُبَيْسِ مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسّ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.391 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.376 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.544 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.339
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Ali ibn Muhammad, from Ishaq ibn Muhammad, from Abd Al-Salam:
(Imam) Al-Ridha, peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding one who is overtaken by
the time of prayer while he is above the Ka‘bah.
Imam {a.s} said: "If he stands, he will have no Qiblah; rather, he should lie on his back
and raise his eyes toward the sky and direct his heart toward the Qiblah that is in the
heavens, the ‘Bayt al-Ma‘mur’, and recite. When he intends to bow, he should close
his eyes, and when he wants to raise his head from bowing, he should open his eyes.
And the prostration is to be done in the same manner."
text_ar:
عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ السَّلاَمِ عَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: فِي الَذِي تُدْرِكُهُ الصَّلاَةُ وَ هُوَ
قَوْقَ الْكَعْبَةِ فَقَالَ «إِنْ قَامَ لَمْ تَكُنْ لَهُ قِبْلَةٌ وَ لَكِنْ يَسْتَلْقِي عَلَى قَفَاهُ وَ يَفْتَحُ عَيْنَيْهِ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَاءِ وَ يَعْقِدُ بِقَلْبِهِ الْقِبْلَةَ
الْتِي فِي السَّمَاءِ الْبَيْتَ الْمَعْمُورَ وَ يَقْرَأَ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ غَمَّضَ عَيْنَيْهِ وَ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَرْفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ فَتَحَ
عَيْنَيْهِ وَ السُّجُودُ عَلَى نَحْوِ ذَلِكَ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.392 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.376 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.72 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.544 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.340

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah and Hadid ibn Hakim Al-Azdi, who said:
We said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “The rooftop upon which urine has
fallen and people urinate on it, may one pray in that place?”
Imam {a.s} said: "If the sun and wind reach it and it is dry, then there is no problem with
it, unless it is a place that is habitually used as a urinal."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ حَدِيدِ بْنِ حَكِيمِ الْأَزْدِيِّ قَالا: قُلْنَا لَأَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ
السَّطَحُ يُصِيبُهُ البَوْلُ وَ يُبَالُ عَلَيْهِ أَيُصَلَّى فِي ذَلِكَ الْمَوْضِعِ فَقَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ تُصِيبُهُ الشَّمْسُ وَ الرِّيحُ وَ كَانَ جَافَاً
فَلاَ بَأْسَ بِهِ إِلاَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ يُتَّخَذُ مَبَالاً».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.392 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.376 • Al-Wafi, Vol.6 p.231 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.451
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan, from ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from
‘Ammar Al-Sabati:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Do not pray in a house that contains wine
or an intoxicant."
text_ar:
محمد بن يحيى عن أحمد بن الحسن عن عمرو بن سعيد عن مصدق بن صدقة عن عمار الساباطي عن أبى عبد
اللّٰه عليه السلام قال: لا تصل في بيت فيه خمر أو مسكر
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Al-Hasan, from ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from
‘Ammar Al-Sabati:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Do not pray in a house that contains wine
or an intoxicant."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad, from Al-Washsha’, from Aban, from ‘Amr ibn
Khalid:
Abu Ja‘far, peace be upon him, said: "Jibra’il, peace be upon him, said:
‘O Messenger of Allah {SWT}, we do not enter a house in which there is an image of a
human being (image-making of animate beings), nor a house in which there is
urination (filth left exposed), nor a house in which there is a dog (ritually impure, najis
al-ʿayn).’"
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بَنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَلَّى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْوَشَاءِ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ قَالَ:
«قَالَ جَبْرَئِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا لا نَدْخُلُ بَيْتاً فِيهِ صُورَةُ إِنْسَانٍ وَ لا بَيْتاً يُبَالُ فِيهِ وَ لا بَيْتاً فِيهِ كَلْبٌ».
cross_references: Al-Muhasin, Vol.2 p.615 • Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.393 • Al-Kafi, Vol.6 p.528 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.377 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.458 • Al-Wafi, Vol.2 0 p.798 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.175 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.5 6 p.188 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.7 3 p.159 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.291

Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad, from Al-Washsha’, from Aban, from ‘Amr ibn

Abu Ja‘far, peace be upon him, said: "Jibra’il, peace be upon him, said:
‘O Messenger of Allah {SWT}, we do not enter a house in which there is an image of a
human being (image-making of animate beings), nor a house in which there is
urination (filth left exposed), nor a house in which there is a dog (ritually impure, najis
al-ʿayn).’"

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Abu Ali Al-Ash‘ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd Al-Jabbar, from Safwan, from Ibn Muskan, from Muhammad
ibn Marwan:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT}
bless him and his family, said: ‘Indeed, Jibra’il, peace be upon him, came to Me {saws}
and said:
‘We, the company of angels, do not enter a house in which there is a dog (ritually
impure, najis al-ʿayn), or a statue with a body (image-making of animate beings), or a
vessel in which there is urination (filth left exposed).’"
text_ar:
أَبُو عَلِيّ الْأَشعَرِيُّ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْجَبَّارِ عَنْ صَفَوَانَ عَنِ إِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «إنَّ جَبْرَئِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَانِي فَقَالَ إِنَّا مَعَاشِرَ ٱلْمَلاَئِكَةِ
لاَ نَدْخُلُ بَيْتاً فِيهِ كَلْبٌ وَ لا تِمْثَالُ جَسَدٍ وَ لا إِنَاءٌ يُبَالُ فِيهِ».

chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn Abd Al-Jabbar, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Abu
Jamilah:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: "Do not pray in a house in which there is a
Magian, and there is no problem in praying in a house in which there is a Jew or a
Christian."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْجَبَّارِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي جَمِيلَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ قَالَ: «لا تُصَلِّ فِي بَيْتِ فِيهِ مَجُوسِيٌّ وَ لا بَأْسَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ فِي بَيْتِ فِيهِ يَهُودِيّ أَوْ نَصْرَانِيٌّ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi

text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Al-Hakam, from Uthman ibn Abd Al-Malik Al-Hadrami, from Abu Bakr
Al-Hadrami, who said:
Abu Ja‘far, peace be upon him, said to me: "O Abu Bakr (Al Hadrami), everything upon
which the sun shines is pure."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ عُثمَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ الْحَضْرَمِيّ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ قَالَ قَالَ لِي أَبُو
جَغْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ : «يَا أَبَا بَكْرٍ كُلُّ مَا أَشرَقَتْ عَلَيْهِ الشَّمْسُ فَهُوَ طَاهِرٌ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Yahya Al-Mu‘adhi, from Al-Tayalisi, from Sayf ibn
Umayrah, from Ishaq, from Sa‘d ibn Abdullah, who said:
He (ibn Abdullah) said to (Imam) Ja‘far ibn Muhammad {a.s}, peace be upon him:
“I pray in Al-Masjid Al-Haram and I sit on my left leg because of the dampness (al-
nada).”
Imam {a.s} said: "Sit on your buttocks (al-yatayn), even if you are in the mud."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى الْمُعَاذِيِّ عَنِ الطَّيَالِسِيِّ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ إسْحَاقَ عَنْ سَعْدِ
بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ : أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِجَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ إِنَّي أَصَلِّي فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ فَأَقْعُدُ عَلَى رِجْلِيَ ٱلْيُسْرَى
مِنْ أَجْلِ النَّدَى فَقَالَ «أقْعُدْ عَلَى أَلْيَتَيْكَ وَ إِنْ كُنْتَ فِي الطّينِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.377 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.839 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.348
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Musa ibn ‘Amr, from Muhammad ibn Isma‘il:
(Imam) Al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who is praying.
Imam {a.s} said: "There should be in front of him a small mound of soil, or he should
draw a line in front of himself."
text_ar:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عَمْرِو عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السّلاَمُ : فِي الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي
قَالَ «يَكُونُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ كُومَةٌ مِنْ تُرَابٍ أَوْ يَخُطُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ بِخَطَّ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.378 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.407 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.483 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.137
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
From him, from Bunan ibn Muhammad, from Muhassin ibn Ahmad, from Yunus ibn Ya‘qub, from Maslamah
ibn ‘Ata’, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}: "What thing cuts (invalidates) the prayer?"
Imam {a.s} said: "A man’s fiddling with his beard."

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This report is to be understood as severe
discouragement (taghliz), because we have already clarified that fiddling with the
beard diminishes the quality of the prayer, but does not invalidate it.”
text_ar:
عَنَهُ عَنْ بُنَانِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَسِّنِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ عَطَاءِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ أَيَّ شَيْءٍ يَقْطَعُ الصَّلاَةَ قَالَ «عَبَثُ الرَّجُلِ بِلِحيَتِهِ».
قال محمد بن الحسن: هذا الخبر محمول على التغليظ لانا قد بينا ان العبث باللحية مما ينقص الصلاة لا مما ينقضها.
commentary:
Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan said: “This report is to be understood as severe
discouragement (taghliz), because we have already clarified that fiddling with the
beard diminishes the quality of the prayer, but does not invalidate it.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
From him, from Al-‘Amraki, from Ali ibn Ja‘far, from his brother (Imam) Musa ibn Ja‘far {a.s}, peace be upon
them both, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who has a wart or a wound, may he remove the wart
during his prayer or pluck some flesh from that wound and throw it away?
Imam {a.s} said: "If he does not fear that blood will flow, then there is no problem. But if
he fears that blood will flow, then he should not do it."
And I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who, while in prayer, was struck by someone who
caused a gash and blood flowed, so he left the prayer, washed it, and did not speak
until he returned to the mosque, does he count what he already prayed or must he
start over?
Imam {a.s} said: "He must start the prayer from the beginning and not count anything of
what he already prayed."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيِّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا ٱلسِّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ بِهِ
اَلثُوُلُولُ أَوِ الْجُرْحِ هَلْ يَصْلُحُ لَهُ أَنْ يَقْطَعَ الثُوُلُولَ وَ هُوَ فِي صَلاَتِهِ أَوْ يَنْتِفَ بَعْضَ لَحْمِهِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ ٱلْجُرْحِ وَ يَطْرَحَهُ
قَالَ «إِنْ لَمْ يَتَخَوَّف أَنْ يَسِيلَ الدَّمُ فَلاَ بَأْسَ وَ إِنْ تَخَوَّفَ أَنْ يَسِيلَ الدَّمُ فَلاَ يَفْعَلْهُ» وَ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي
صَلاتِهِ فَرَمَاهُ رَجْلْ فَشَجَّهُ فَسَالَ الدَّمُ فَانْصَرَفَ فَغَسَلَهُ وَ لَمْ يَتَكَلَّمْ حَتَّى رَجَعَ إلَى الْمَسْجِدِ هَلْ يَعْتَدّ بِمَا صَلَّى
أَوْ يَسْتَقْبِلُ الصَّلاةَ قَالَ «يَسْتَقْبِلُ الصَّلاَةَ وَ لاَ يَعْتَدُ بِشَيْءٍ مِمَّا صَلَّى».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.378 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.404 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.873 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.242

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
From him, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from (Imam) Ja‘far {a.s}, from his father
{a.s}, from his forefathers {a.s}, peace be upon them, who said:
The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, said:
"If one of you prays in an open desert, let him place in front of him something like the
rear of a saddle. If he does not find that, then a stone; if he does not find that, then an
arrow; and if he does not find that, then let him draw a line in the ground in front of
him."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ إبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمِ عَنِ النَّوْفَلِيّ عَنِ السّكُونِيّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ
اللَّه صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «إِذَا صَلَّى أَحَدُكُمْ بِأَرْضِ فَلَاةٍ فَلْيَجْعَلْ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِثْلَ مُؤْخِرَةِ الرَّحْلِ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ
فَحَجَراً فَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ فَسَهْمًا فَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ فَلْيَخُطَّ فِي الْأَرْضِ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.378 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.482 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.137 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.301

text_ar:
أحمد بن محمد عن أبيه عن عبد الله بن سنان عن غياث عن أبي عبد الله عليه السلام ان النبي صلى اللّٰه عليه

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Hammad ibn ‘Isa, from Hariz, from Al-Fudayl:
Abu Ja‘far, peace be upon him, said: "A woman may pray behind her husband, both
the obligatory and the recommended prayers, and she may follow him in the prayer."
text_ar:
عَلِيْ بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنِ الْفُضَيْلِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «الْمَرْأَةُ تُصَلِّي
خَلْفَ زَوْجِهَا الْفَرِيضَةَ وَ التَّطَوْعَ وَ تَأْتَمُ بِهِ فِي الصَّلاةِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.379 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.479 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.127 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.332
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
text_chunk:
Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Hammad ibn ‘Isa, from Hariz, from Al-Fudayl:
Abu Ja‘far, peace be upon him, said: "A woman may pray behind her husband, both
the obligatory and the recommended prayers, and she may follow him in the prayer."

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Ahmad, from Al-Hajjal, from Al-‘Ala’, from Muhammad ibn Muslim:
Abu Ja‘far, peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a woman who prays near a man.
Imam {a.s} said: "If there is a barrier between them, then there is no problem."
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ عَنِ الْحَجَّالِ عَنِ الْعَلَاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تُصَلِّي عِنْدَ الرَّجُلِ قَالَ
«إِذَا كَانَ بَيْنَهُمَا حَاجِزٌ فَلاَ بَأْسَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.379 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.478 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.129
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Ibn Faddal, from someone who
informed him, from Jamil:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, (was asked) regarding a man who is praying and
a woman is beside him or next to him.
Imam {a.s} said: "If her prostration occurs at the time of his bowing, then there is no
problem."
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اِبْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَمَّنْ أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَامُ : فِي الرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي وَ الْمَرْأَةُ بِجِذَاهُ أَوْ إِلَى جَنْبِهِ فَقَالَ «إِذَا كَانَ سُجُودُهَا مَعَ رُكُوعِهِ فَلا بَأْسَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.379 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.399 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.127

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
From him, from Ya‘qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from ‘Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, from Abu
Ja‘far, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a woman praying near a man.
Imam {a.s} said: "A woman should not pray directly in line with a man, unless he is in
front of her, even if only by the length of his chest."
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَذَيْنَةَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرِ عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْثُهُ
عَنِ الْمَرْأَةِ تُصَلِّي عِنْدَ الرَّجُلِ فَقَالَ «لَا تُصَلِّي الْمَرْأَةُ بِجِيَالِ الرَّجُلِ إِلَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ قُدَّامَهَا وَ لَوْ بِصَدْرِهِ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: WHAT IS PERMISSIBLE AND IMPERMISSIBLE TO PRAY IN - OF CLOTHING AND PLACE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Mas‘ud Al-‘Ayyashi, from Ja‘far ibn Muhammad, who said: Al-‘Amraki narrated to me from
Ali ibn Ja‘far, from his brother (Imam) Musa {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about an imam (of prayer) who was leading the Dhuhr prayer, and a
woman stood beside him praying, thinking it was the ‘Asr prayer, does that invalidate
the prayer of the group? And what is the ruling for the woman in her prayer with them,
given that she had already prayed Dhuhr?
Imam {a.s} said: "It does not invalidate the prayer of the congregation, but the woman
must repeat her prayer."
text_ar:
محمد بن مسعود العياشي عن جعفر بن محمد قال حدثني العمركي عن علي بن جعفر عن أخيه موسى قال :
سألته عن إمام كان في الظهر فقامت امرأة بحياله تصلي وهي تحسب انها العصر هل يفسد ذلك على القوم؟
وما حال المرأة في صلاتها معهم وقد كانت صلت الظهر؟ قال : لا يفسد ذلك على القوم وتعيد المرأة.
١٨ - باب الصبيان متى يؤمرون بالصلاة
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE AGES THAT CHILDREN ARE COMMANDED TO PRAY
text_en:
Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, narrated from his father {a.s}, peace be upon him,
said: "We command our children to pray when they are five years old, so command
your children to pray when they are seven years old.
And we command our children to fast when they are seven years old, according to
what they can handle of the day's fast, whether it be until midday, or more than that,
or less. Then, if thirst and hunger overpower them, they may break their fast, so that
they may get used to fasting and become able to bear it. So command your children,
when they are nine years old, to fast as much of the day as they can. Then, if thirst
overcomes them, they may break their fast."
text_ar:
عَلِيْ بْنُ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ قَالَ: « إِنَّا نَأْمُرُ صِبْيَانَنَا بِالصَّلاَةِ إِذَا كَانُوا بَنِي خَمْسِ سِنِينَ فَمُرُوا صِبْيَانَكُمْ بِالصَّلاَةِ إِذَا كَانُوا بَنِي سَبْعِ
سِنِينَ وَ نَحْنُ نَأُمُرُ صِبْيَانَنَا بِالصَّوْمِ إِذَا كَانُوا بَنِي سَبْعِ سِنِينَ بِمَا أَطَاقُوا مِنْ صِيَامِ ٱلْيَوْمِ إِنْ كَانَ إِلَى نِصْفِ النَّهَارِ
أَوْ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ أَوْ أَقَلَّ فَإِذَا غَلَبَهُمُ الْعَطَشُ وَ الْغَرَثْ أَفْطَرُوا حَتَّى يَتَعَوَّدُوا الصَّوْمَ فَيُطِيقُوهُ فَمُرُوا صِبْيَانَكُمْ إِذَا
كَانُوا بَنِي تِسْعِ سِنِينَ بِالصِّوْمِ مَا اِسْتَطَاعُوا مِنْ صِيَامِ ٱلْيَوْمِ فَإِذَا غَلَبَهُمُ الْعَطَشُ أَفْطَرُوا».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.409 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.380 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.409
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al- Baqir {a.s}
