Then you prostrate and say in your prostration:
“O’ Hearer of every voice, O’ Creator of souls after death, O’ He {AZJ} whom darknesses
do not veil, O’ He {AZJ} for whom voices do not become confused, O’ He {AZJ} whom
nothing distracts from anything else,
Grant (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} the best of what He {saws} has asked You {AZJ} for, and
the best of what has been asked for Him {saws}, and the best of what You {AZJ} are asked
for until the Day of Resurrection.
And I ask You {AZJ} to make me among those whom You {AZJ} have freed and released from
the Fire.
O’ Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and the family of
Muhammad {saws}, and make well-being my outer and inner garment, and a means of
salvation for me from every evil on the Day of Resurrection.”

text_ar:
ثم تسجد وتقول في سجودك :
يا سامع كل صوت ويا بارئ النفوس بعد الموت ويا من لا تغشاه الظلمات ، ويا من لا تتشابه عليه الاصوات ،
ويا من لا يشغله شئ عن شئ، اعط محمدا أفضل ما سألك وأفضل ما سئلت له وافضل ما أنت مسؤول له إلى
يوم القيامة ، وأسألك أن تجعلني من عتقائك وطلقائك من النار ، اللهم صل على محمد وآل محمد واجعل
العافية شعاري ودثاري ونجاة لي من كل سوء يوم القيامة.
الدعاء في الزيادة تمام المائة ركعة تقوم بعد العشاء الاخرة فتصلي ثلاثين ركعة بأدعيتها ، فإذا فرغت فصل ركعتين تقرأ
في كل ركعة الحمد وقل هو اللّٰه أحد عشر مرات من الثلاثين والسبعين تمام المائة،

text_en:
When you complete the thirty units, you rise and perform two units of prayer, then say
after them:
“You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, the Lord {AZJ} of the worlds.
And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, the Most High, the Most Great.
And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, the Almighty, the Wise.
And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, the Forgiving, the Merciful.
And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, the Most Compassionate, the
Most Merciful.
And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, the Master of the Day of
Judgment. And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}.
From You {AZJ} is the beginning of creation, and to You {AZJ} it returns. And You {AZJ} are
Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, the Creator of Paradise and the Fire.
And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, the Creator of good and evil.
And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, You {AZJ} have always existed and
will always remain.
And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, the One, the Unique, the Self-
Sufficient. You {AZJ} did not beget, nor were You {AZJ} begotten, and there is none equal to
You {AZJ}.
And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, ‘Knower of the unseen and the
seen, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.’ (Surah Al-Hashr 59:22–24)
And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, ‘the King, the Most Holy, the
Source of Peace, the Granter of Security, the Overseer, the Almighty, the Compeller,
the Supreme. Glory be to Allah {SWT} above what they associate with Him’. (Surah Al-
Hashr 59:23).
And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, ‘the Creator, the Maker, the
Fashioner’ (Surah Al-Hashr 59:24).
To You {AZJ} belong the most beautiful names. Whatever is in the heavens and the earth
glorifies You {AZJ}. And You {AZJ} are the Almighty, the Wise. And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT},
there is no God but You {AZJ}, the Great One, and Majesty is Your mantle.”

From the thirty and the seventy, this completes one hundred units.
Then you send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and the family of
Muhammad {saws} and supplicate with whatever you wish. This supplication has been

text_ar:
فإذا فرغت من الثلاثين قمت فصليت ركعتين ثم تقول بعدهما :
أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ أَنْتَ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ أَنْتَ الْعَلِيْ الْعَظِيمُ وَ أَنتَ اللَّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
وَ أَنْتَ اللهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّجِيمُ وَ أَنْتَ اللهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ أَنْتَ الرَّحْمَنُ الرَّحِيمُ وَ أَنْتَ اللّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ أَنْتَ مَلِكُ
يَوْمِ الدِّينِ وَ أَنْتَ اللّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ مِنْكَ بَدْءُ الْخَلْقِ وَ إِلَيْكَ يَعُودُ وَ أَنْتَ اللّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُ الْجَنَّةِ وَ النَّارِ وَ
أَنْتَ اللهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلاَ أَنْتَ خَالِقُ الْخَيْرِ وَ الشَّرِّ وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ لَمْ تَزَلْ وَ لا تَزَالُ وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
commentary:
The supplication continues during the additional prayers that complete one hundred
units. After the night (Isha) prayer, you stand to pray thirty units with their specific
supplications.
When you complete them, you perform two units, in each of which you recite ‘al-
Hamd’ (Surah al-Fatihah) and ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah al-Ikhlas) eleven times.
From the thirty and the seventy, this completes one hundred units.
Then you send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and the family of
Muhammad {saws} and supplicate with whatever you wish. This supplication has been
narrated:

text_chunk:
When you complete the thirty units, you rise and perform two units of prayer, then say
after them:
“You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, the Lord {AZJ} of the worlds.
And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, the Most High, the Most Great.
And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, the Almighty, the Wise.
And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, the Forgiving, the Merciful.
And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, the Most Compassionate, the
Most Merciful.
And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, the Master of the Day of
Judgment. And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}.
From You {AZJ} is the beginning of creation, and to You {AZJ} it returns. And You {AZJ} are
Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, the Creator of Paradise and the Fire.
And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, the Creator of good and evil.
And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, You {AZJ} have always existed and
will always remain.
And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, the One, the Unique, the Self-
Sufficient. You {AZJ} did not beget, nor were You {AZJ} begotten, and there is none equal to
You {AZJ}.
And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, ‘Knower of the unseen and the
seen, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.’ (Surah Al-Hashr 59:22–24)
And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, ‘the King, the Most Holy, the
Source of Peace, the Granter of Security, the Overseer, the Almighty, the Compeller,
the Supreme. Glory be to Allah {SWT} above what they associate with Him’. (Surah Al-
Hashr 59:23).
And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}, ‘the Creator, the Maker, the
Fashioner’ (Surah Al-Hashr 59:24).
To You {AZJ} belong the most beautiful names. Whatever is in the heavens and the earth
glorifies You {AZJ}. And You {AZJ} are the Almighty, the Wise. And You {AZJ} are Allah {SWT},
there is no God but You {AZJ}, the Great One, and Majesty is Your mantle.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: SUPPLICATION BETWEEN THE UNITS OF PRAYER (RAK‘AT)
text_en:
Ali ibn Hatim from Muhammad ibn Ja’far, who said: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab narrated
to me, who said: Muhammad ibn Hammad narrated to me from his father, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be
upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “There is no believing servant who supplicates to Allah {SWT}
with these (supplications), turning his heart sincerely to Allah {SWT}, Mighty and
Majestic, except that Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic, fulfills his need for him.
And even if he were wretched, I would hope that he would be transformed into one of
the blessed.”

Scholar's Note:
Then you perform two units of prayer, and when you have finished, say what has been
narrated:
text_ar:
تصلي ركعتين وتقول :
يَا حَسَنَ الْبَلايَا عِنْدِي يَا قَدِيمَ ٱلْعَفْوِ عَنِّي يَا مَنْ لاَ غِنَى لِشَيْءِ عَنْهُ يَا مَنْ لاَبُدْ لِكُلِّ شَيْءِ مِنْهُ يَا مَنْ مَرَدْ كُلِّ شَيْءِ
إلَيْهِ يَا مَنْ مَصِيرُ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ إِلَيْهِ تَوَلِّنِي سَيَّدِي وَ لا تُوَلَ أَمْرِي شِرَارَ خَلْقِكَ أَنْتَ خَالِقِي وَ رَازِقِي يَا مَوْلايَ فَلاَ
تُضَيَّفنِي».
ثم تصلي ركعتين وتقول :
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اِجْعَلْنِي مِنْ أَوْفَرِ عِبَادِكَ نَصِيباً مِنْ كُلِّ خَيْرٍ أَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي هَذِهِ اللِّيْلَةِ أَوْ أَنْتَ
مُنْزِلُهُ مِنْ نُورِ تَهْدِي بِهِ أَوْ رَحْمَةِ تَتْشُرُهَا وَ مِنْ رِزْقٍ تَبْسُطْهُ وَ مِنْ ضُرِّ تَكْشِفُهُ وَ مِنْ بَلاَءِ تَرْفَعُهُ وَ مِنْ سُوءِ تَذْفَعُهُ
وَ مِنْ فِتْنَةٍ تَصْرِفْهَا وَ أَكْتُبْ لِي مَا كَتَبْتَ لِأَوْلِيَائِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ ٱلّذِينَ اِسْتَوْجَبُوا مِنْكَ الثَّوَابَ وَ أَمِنُوا بِرِضَاكَ عَنْهُمْ
مِنْكَ اَلْعَذَابَ يَا كَرِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ يَا كَرِيمُ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَجِّلْ فَرَجَهُمْ وَ اِغْفِرْ لِي ذَنْبِي وَ بَارِكْ لِي
فِي كَسْبِي وَقَنَّعنِي بِمَا رَزَقْتَنِي وَ لا تَفْتِنِّي بِمَا زَوَيْتَ عَنِّي ».
ثم تصلي ركعتين وتقول :
اَللَّهُمَّ إِلَيْكَ نَصَبْتُ يَدِي وَ فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ عَظُمَتْ رَغْبَتِي فَاقْبَلْ سَيِّدِي تَوْبَتِي وَ اِرْحَمْ ضَعْفِي وَ اِغْفِرْ لِي وَ اِرْحَمْنِي
وَ اِجْعَلْ لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ نَصِيباً وَ إِلَى كُلِّ خَيْرٍ سَبِيلا اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكِبْرِ وَ مَوَاقِفِ الْخِزْي فِي الدُّنْيَا وَ
اَلْآخِرَةِ اللَّهُمّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمِّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اِغْفِرْ لِي مَا سَلَفَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي وَ اِعْصِمْنِي فِيمَا بَقِيَ مِنْ عُمُرِي وَ أَوْرِدْ
عَلَيَّ أَسْبَابَ طَاعَتِكَ وَ اِسْتَعْمِلْنِي بِهَا وَ اِصْرِفْ عَنِّي أَسْبَابَ مَعْصِيَتِكَ وَ حُلْ بَيْنِي وَ بَيْنَهَا وَ اِجْعَلْنِي وَ أَهْلِي وَ
وُلْدِي فِي وَدَائِعِكَ الَّتِي لا تَضِيعُ وَ اِعْصِمْنِي مِنَ النَّارِ وَ اِصْرِفْ عَنِّي شَرَّ قَسَقَةِ الْجِنِّ وَ ٱلْإِنْسِ وَ شَرَّ كُلِّ ذِي شَرَّ
وَ شَرَّ كُلِّ ضَعِيفٍ أَوْ شَدِيدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ وَ شَرَّ كُلِّ دَابَّةِ أَنْتَ «آخِذٌ بِناصِيَتِها» «إِنَّكَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ» ».
ثم تصلي ركعتين وتقول :
اللَّهُمّ أَنْتَ مُتَعَالِي الشَّأْنِ عَظِيمُ الْجَبَرُوتِ شَدِيدُ الْمِحَالِ عَظِيمُ الْكِبْرِيَاءِ قَادِرْ قَاهِرْ قَرِيبُ الرَّحْمَةِ صَادِقُ الْوَعْدِ
وَفِيْ ٱلْعَهْدِ قَرِيبٌ مُجِيبٌ سَامِعُ الدُعَاءِ قَابِلُ التَّوْبَةِ مُخْصٍ لِمَا خَلَقْتَ قَادِرْ عَلَى مَا أَرَدْتَ مُدْرِكٌ مَنْ طَلَبْتَ رَازِقْ
مَنْ خَلَقْتَ شَكُورٌ إِنْ شُكِرْتَ ذَاكِرْ إِنْ ذْكِزْتَ فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا إِلَهِي مُحْتَاجا وَ أَرْغَبُ إِلَيْكَ فَقِيراً وَ أَتَضَرَّعُ إِلَيْكَ خَائِفاً وَ
أَبْكِي إِلَيْكَ مَكْرُوباً وَ أَرْجُوكَ نَاصِراً وَ أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ ضَعِيفاً وَ أَتَوَكَّلُ عَلَيْكَ مُحْتَسِباً وَ أَسْتَرْزِقُكَ مُتَوَسِّعاً وَ أَسْأَلُكَ يَا
إلَهِي أَن تُصَلَّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي وَ تَتَقَبَّلَ لِي عَمَلِي وَ تُيَسِّرَ مُنْقَلَبِي وَ تُفَرَّجَ قَلْبِي
إلَهِي أَسْأَلْكَ أَنْ تُصَدِّقَ ظَنِّي وَ تَعْفُوَ عَنْ خَطِيئَتِي وَ تَعْصِمَنِي مِنَ ٱلْمَعَاصِي إِلَهِي ضَعْفُتُ فَلا قُوَّةَ لِي وَ عَجَزْتُ
فَلاَ حَوْلَ لِي إِلَهِي جِئُتُكَ مُسْرِفاً عَلَى نَفْسِي مُقِرَأ بِسُوءِ عَمَلِي قَدْ ذَكَرْتُ غَفْلَتِي وَ أَشفَقْتُ مِمَا كَانَ مِنِّي فَصَلَ
عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اِرْضَ عَنِّي وَ اِقْضٍ لِي جَمِيعَ حَوَائِجِي مِنْ حَوَائِجِ الدُّنْيَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاجِمِينَ».
ثم تصلي ركعتين وتقول :
اللّهُمْ إِنَّي أَسَأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ مِنْ جَهْدِ الْبَلَاءِ وَ شَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ وَ سُوءِ الْقَضَاءِ وَ دَرَكِ الشَّقَاءِ وَ مِنَ الضَّرَرِ فِي الْمَعِيشَةِ
وَ أَنْ تَبْتَلِيَنِي بِبَلاءِ لا طَاقَةَ لِي بِهِ أَوْ تُسَلَّطَ عَلَيْ طَاغِياً أَوْ تَهْتِكَ لِي سِثْراً أَوْ ثُبْدِيَ لِي عَوْرَةً أَوْ تُحَاسِبَنِي يَوْمَ
الْقِيَامَةِ مُقَاصًا أَحْوَجَ مَا أَكُونُ إِلَى عَفْوِكَ وَ تَجَاوُزِكَ عَنِّي فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِوَجْهِكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ وَ كَلِمَاتِكَ التَامَةِ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى
مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَنِي مِنْ عَتَقَائِكَ وَ طُلَقَائِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ اللَّهُمّ صَلَّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَدْخِلْنِي
الْجَنَّةَ وَ اِجْعَلْنِي مِنْ سُكَّانِهَا وَ عُمَّارِهَا اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ سَفَعَاتِ النَّارِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمِّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمِّدٍ وَ
أُرْزُقْنِي الْحَجِّ وَ الْعُمْرَةَ وَ الصِّيَامَ وَ الصَّدَقَةَ لِوَجْهِكَ ».
ثم تسجد وتقول في سجودك :
يا سامع كل صوت ويا بارئ النفوس بعد الموت ويا من لا تغشاه الظلمات ، ويا من لا تتشابه عليه الاصوات ،
ويا من لا يشغله شئ عن شئ ، اعط محمدا أفضل ما سألك وأفضل ما سئلت له وافضل ما أنت مسؤول له إلى
يوم القيامة ، وأسألك أن تجعلني من عتقائك وطلقائك من النار ، اللهم صل على محمد وآل محمد واجعل
العافية شعاري ودثاري ونجاة لي من كل سوء يوم القيامة.
الدعاء في الزيادة تمام المائة ركعة تقوم بعد العشاء الاخرة فتصلي ثلاثين ركعة بأدعيتها ، فإذا فرغت فصل ركعتين تقرأ
في كل ركعة الحمد وقل هو اللّٰه أحد عشر مرات من الثلاثين والسبعين تمام المائة،
فإذا فرغت من الثلاثين قمت فصليت ركعتين ثم تقول بعدهما :
أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ أَنْتَ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّ أَنْتَ الْعَلِي الْعَظِيمُ وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ
وَ أَنْتَ اللهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ وَ أَنْتَ اللهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ أَنْتَ الرَّحْمَنُ الرَّجِيمُ وَ أَنْتَ اللّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ أَنْتَ مَلِكُ
يَوْمِ الدِّينِ وَ أَنْتَ اللّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ مِنْكَ بَدْءُ الْخَلْقِ وَ إِلَيْكَ يَعُودُ وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ خَالِقُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَ النَّارِ وَ
أَنْتَ اللّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلا أَنْتَ خَالِقُ الْخَيْرِ وَ الشَّرِّ وَ أَنْتَ اللهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّ أَنْتَ لَمْ تَزَلْ وَ لَا تَزَالُ وَ أَنْتَ اللهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَ أَنْتَ
اَلْوَاجِدُ الْأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ لَمْ تَلِدْ وَ لَمْ تُولَدْ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَكَ كُفُوا أَحَدٌ وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّ أَنْتَ «عَالِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَ ٱلشَّهَادَةِ»...
«الرَّحْمْنُ الرَّحِيمُ» وَ أَنْتَ اللّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ «الْمَلِكُ ٱلْقُدْوسُ ٱلسَّلامُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُ ٱلْمُهَيْمِنُ الْعَزِيزُ ٱلْجَبَّارُ الْمُتَكَبَّرُ سُبْحَانَ
الله عَمّا يُشرِكُونَ» وَ أَنْتَ اللهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ «الْخَالِقُ الْبَارِي الْمُصَوَّرُ» لَكَ الْأَسْمَاءُ الْحُسْنَى يُسَبَّحُ لَكَ مَا فِي
السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ وَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ وَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ أَنْتَ الْكَبِيرُ وَ الْكِبْرِيَاءُ رِدَاؤُكَ ».
ثم تصلي على محمد وآله محمد وتدعو بما أحببت روى هذا الدعاء :

text_chunk:
Ali ibn Hatim from Muhammad ibn Ja’far, who said: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab narrated
to me, who said: Muhammad ibn Hammad narrated to me from his father, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be
upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “There is no believing servant who supplicates to Allah {SWT}
with these (supplications), turning his heart sincerely to Allah {SWT}, Mighty and
Majestic, except that Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic, fulfills his need for him.
And even if he were wretched, I would hope that he would be transformed into one of
the blessed.” Scholar's Note:

narrated:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: SUPPLICATION BETWEEN THE UNITS OF PRAYER (RAK‘AT)
text_en:
Ali ibn Hatim from Muhammad ibn Amr from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Ziyad from Ja’far ibn Muhammad ibn
Ubaydullah from Abdillah ibn Maymun from his father from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said:
“There is no God but Allah {SWT}, the Forbearing, the Generous. There is no God but Allah
{SWT}, the Most High, the Most Great.
Glory be to Allah {SWT}, the Lord {AZJ} of the seven heavens and the Lord {AZJ} of the seven
earths and the Lord {AZJ} of the Great Throne.
‘And all praise is due to Allah {SWT}, Lord of the worlds’. (Surah As-Saffat 37:182)
O’ Allah {SWT}, I ask You {AZJ} by Your impenetrable armor, by Your power, Your greatness,
and Your authority, to protect me from the accursed Satan and from the evil of every
obstinate tyrant.
O’ Allah {SWT}, I ask You {AZJ} by my love for You {AZJ}, and by my love for Your Messenger
may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family,
And by my love for the family of Your Messenger {saws}, may Your blessings be upon him
and upon all of them.
O’ One who is better for me than my father and my mother and all people,
Ordain for me better than what I would ordain for myself, and better than what my
father and my mother would ordain for me.
You {AZJ} are Generous and do not withhold, Forbearing and not ignorant, Mighty and
never humiliated.
O’ Allah {SWT}, for the one whose trust and hope is in the people, You {AZJ} are my trust
and my hope.
Ordain for me the best of outcomes, with well-being, and make me content with what
You {AZJ} have decreed for me.
O’ Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and the family of
Muhammad {saws}, and clothe me in Your protective well-being.
And if You {AZJ} try me with affliction, then grant me patience, though well-being is more
beloved to me.”

Scholar's Note:
Then you perform two units of prayer and say what has been narrated:
text_ar:
عَلِي بْنُ حَاتِمِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ
مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ : « لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ اللّهُ ٱلْحَلِيمُ الْكَرِيمُ لا إِلَهَ إِلاَ اللّهُ الْعَلِي الْعَظِيمُ سُبْحَانَ
اللّهِ رَبِّ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَرَبِّ الْأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ «وَ الْحَمْدُ لِلهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ» اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّي أَسأَلُكَ
بِدِرْعِكَ الْحَصِينَةِ وَ بِقُوّتِكَ وَ عَظَمَتِكَ وَ سُلْطَانِكَ أَنْ تُجِيرَنِي مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدِ اللَّهُمَّ
إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحُبِّي إِيَّاكَ وَ بِحُبِّي رَسُولَكَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ بِحُبِّي أَهْلَ بَيْتِ رَسُولِكَ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلَيْهِمْ
أَجْمَعِينَ يَا خَيْراً لِي مِنْ أَبِي وَ أُمِّي وَ مِنَ النَّاسِ جَمِيعاً اِقْدِرْ لِي خَيْراً مِنْ قَدْرِي لِنَفْسِي وَ خَيْراً لِي مِمَّا يَقْدِرُ لِي
أَبِي وَ أَمِّي أَنْتَ جَوَادٌ لا تَبْخَلُ وَ حَلِيمٌ لا تَجْهَلُ وَ عَزِيزٌ لا تُسْتَذَلُ اللَّهُمَّ مَنْ كَانَ النَّاسُ ثِقَتَهُ وَ رَجَاءَهُ فَأَنْتَ ثِقَتِي
وَ رَجَائِي اِقْدِرْ لِي خَيْرَهَا عَافِيَةً وَ رَضِّنِي بِمَا قَضَيْتَ لِي اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَلْبِسْنِي عَافِيَتَكَ
الْحَصِينَةَ فَإِنِ ابْتَلَيْتَنِي فَصَبُّرْنِي وَ الْعَافِيَةُ أَحَبُّ إِلَيّ».
ثم تصلي ركعتين وتقول ما رواه:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: SUPPLICATION BETWEEN THE UNITS OF PRAYER (RAK‘AT)
text_en:
Ali ibn Hatim from Muhammad ibn Ja’far from Muhammad ibn Amr from Ali ibn Muhammad from Ja’far ibn
Muhammad from Abdillah ibn Maymun from Ja’far ibn Muhammad from his father Muhammad from Ali ibn
al-Husayn from the Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, peace be upon them, who said:
Imam Ali {a.s} said:
“O’ Allah {SWT}, indeed You {AZJ} have proclaimed one of Your paths and made Your
pleasure reside in it.
And You {AZJ} have invited Your chosen ones to it, and made it the most honorable of
Your paths in reward with You {AZJ}, the noblest of them in ultimate return, and the most
beloved of them to You {AZJ} as a course.
Then You {AZJ} purchased in it from the believers their souls and their wealth in exchange
for Paradise; they fight in Your way, ‘so they kill and are killed’ (Surah At-Tawbah
9:111), a true promise binding upon You {AZJ}.
So make me among those who sold their soul to You {AZJ} in this way,
And then fulfilled for You {AZJ} the sale with which they pledged You {AZJ}, without ever
breaking that pledge.
And without breaking a covenant, nor changing anything except in pursuit of the
fulfillment of Your promise, in response to Your love, and seeking nearness to You {AZJ}
through it.
So send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and his family {a.s}, and make it the
seal of my deeds.
And grant me in it a witnessing for Your sake and by Your command, through which
You {AZJ} make Your pleasure incumbent upon me and by which You {AZJ} erase my sins.
Place me among the living who are provided for at the hands of the disobedient
enemies, under the banner of truth and the flag of guidance, proceeding forward in
their support without turning back nor introducing doubt.
And I seek refuge in You {AZJ} at that moment from sin that nullifies deeds.

Scholar's Note:
Then you perform two units of prayer and say what has been narrated:
text_ar:
عَلِيّ بْنُ حَاتِمِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ
مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُوْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسِّلامُ : « اَللَّهُمّ إِنَّكَ
أَغْلَنْتَ سَبِيلاً مِنْ سُبْلِكَ فَجَعَلْتَ فِيهِ رِضَاكَ وَ نَدَبْتَ إِلَيْهِ أَوْلِيَاءَكَ وَ جَعَلْتَهُ أَشرَفَ سُبْلِكَ عِنْدَكَ ثَوَاباً وَ أَكْرَمَهَا
لَدَيْكَ مَآباً وَ أَحَبَّهَا إِلَيْكَ مَسْلَكاً ثُمَّ اِشتَرَيْتَ فِيهِ مِنَ الْمُوْمِنِينَ أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ بِأَنَّ لَهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ يُقَاتِلُونَ فِي
سَبِيلِكَ «فَيَقْتُلُونَ وَ يُقْتَلُونَ» وَغدا عَلَيْكَ حَقّاً فَاجْعَلْنِي مِمَّنِ اِشتَرَى فِيهِ مِنْكَ نَفْسَهُ ثُمَّ وَفَى لَكَ بِبَيْعِهِ الَّذِي
بَايَعَكَ عَلَيْهِ غَيْرَ نَاكِتٍ وَلَا نَاقِضٍ عَهْداً وَ لاَ مُبَدِّلٍ تَبْدِيلاً إِلاَّ اِسْتِنْجَازاً لِمَوْعُودِكَ وَ اِسْتِيجَاباً لِمَحَبَّتِكَ وَ تَقَرُّباً بِهِ
إِلَيْكَ فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ اِجْعَلْهُ خَاتِمَةَ عَمَلِي وَ أَرْزُقْنِي فِيهِ لَكَ وَ بِكَ مَشَهَداً تُوجِبُ لِي بِهِ اَلرِّضَا وَ تَحْطُّ
عَنِّي بِهِ الْخَطَايَا اِجْعَلْنِي فِي الْأَحْيَاءِ الْمَرْزُوقِينَ بِأَيْدِي الْعُدَاةِ الْعُصَاةِ تَحْتَ لِوَاءِ الْحَقُّ وَ رَايَةِ الْهُدَى مَاضٍ عَلَى
نُصْرَتِهِمْ قُدُما غَيْرَ مُوَلِّ دُبُراً وَ لاَ مُحْدِثِ شَكَاً وَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ مِنَ الذَّنْبِ ٱلْمُحْبِطِ لِلْأَعْمَالِ ».
ثم تصلي ركعتين وتقول ما رواه:
commentary: Then you perform two units of prayer and say what has been narrated:
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.81 • Iqbal Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.170 • Al-Wafi, Vol.11 p.449 • Bihar Al- Anwar, Vol.95 p.126
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
text_chunk:
Ali ibn Hatim from Muhammad ibn Ja’far from Muhammad ibn Amr from Ali ibn Muhammad from Ja’far ibn
Muhammad from Abdillah ibn Maymun from Ja’far ibn Muhammad from his father Muhammad from Ali ibn
al-Husayn from the Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, peace be upon them, who said:
Imam Ali {a.s} said:
“O’ Allah {SWT}, indeed You {AZJ} have proclaimed one of Your paths and made Your
pleasure reside in it.
And You {AZJ} have invited Your chosen ones to it, and made it the most honorable of
Your paths in reward with You {AZJ}, the noblest of them in ultimate return, and the most
beloved of them to You {AZJ} as a course.
Then You {AZJ} purchased in it from the believers their souls and their wealth in exchange
for Paradise; they fight in Your way, ‘so they kill and are killed’ (Surah At-Tawbah
9:111), a true promise binding upon You {AZJ}.
So make me among those who sold their soul to You {AZJ} in this way,
And then fulfilled for You {AZJ} the sale with which they pledged You {AZJ}, without ever
breaking that pledge.
And without breaking a covenant, nor changing anything except in pursuit of the
fulfillment of Your promise, in response to Your love, and seeking nearness to You {AZJ}
through it.
So send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and his family {a.s}, and make it the
seal of my deeds.
And grant me in it a witnessing for Your sake and by Your command, through which
You {AZJ} make Your pleasure incumbent upon me and by which You {AZJ} erase my sins.
Place me among the living who are provided for at the hands of the disobedient
enemies, under the banner of truth and the flag of guidance, proceeding forward in
their support without turning back nor introducing doubt.
And I seek refuge in You {AZJ} at that moment from sin that nullifies deeds. Scholar's Note:
Then you perform two units of prayer and say what has been narrated:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: SUPPLICATION BETWEEN THE UNITS OF PRAYER (RAK‘AT)
text_en:
Ali ibn Hatim from Muhammad ibn Ja’far from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Hammad
from his father from Abu Abdillah {a.s} from his father {a.s} from Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn {a.s}, who said:
Imam Zayn al-Abidin {a.s} said:
“O’ Allah {SWT}, I ask You {AZJ} by Your mercy through which none can attain anything from
You {AZJ} except by Your pleasure, by abstaining from disobedience to You {AZJ},
And by entering into all that pleases You {AZJ} and for deliverance from every
entanglement, and an exit from every arrogance,
And for pardon for every evil deed that comes from me whether intentionally or by
mistake, or by thoughts that occurred to me and I forgot.
That I ask You {AZJ} for a fear (of You {AZJ}) through which You {AZJ} help me to uphold the
boundaries of Your pleasure.
And I ask You {AZJ} to guide me to act upon the best of what I know, and to leave the
worst of what I know.
And I ask You {AZJ} for protection from disobeying You {AZJ} knowingly, or from erring in
that which I do not know.
And I ask You {AZJ} for abundance in sustenance, and detachment from that which is a
burden.
And I ask You {AZJ} for a clear exit from every doubt, and for triumph through correctness
in every argument, and for truthfulness therein for me and upon me.
And humble me by granting me fairness from myself in all situations in times of
contentment and anger, in humility and generosity and enable me to abandon both
the small and great of injustice in my words and deeds.
And grant me the perfection of blessings in all matters, and the ability to show
gratitude for them until You {AZJ} are pleased, and even after Your pleasure.
And grant me what is best in matters where goodness lies, through ease in all affairs
and not through hardship. O’ Generous One!”

Scholar's Note:
Then you perform two units of prayer and say what has been narrated.
text_ar:
عَلِيْ بْنُ حَاتِمِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ
عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ : « اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ آَلَّتِي لا تُنَالُ مِنْكَ إِلاَّ بِالرِّضَا وَ الْخُرُوجِ عَنْ
مَعَاصِيكَ وَ الدُّخُولِ فِي كُلِّ مَا يُرْضِيكَ وَ نَجَاةً مِنْ كُلِّ وَرْطَةٍ وَ الْمَخْرَجَ مِنْ كُلِّ كِبْرٍ وَ الْعَفْوَ عَنْ كُلِّ سَيِّئَةٍ يَأْتِي
بِهَا مِنِّي عَمْدٌ أَوْ زَلَ بِهَا مِنَّي خَطَأ أَوْ خَطَرَتْ بِهَا مِنَّي خَطَرَاتْ نَسِيتُ أَنْ أَسْأَلَكَ خَوْفاً تُعِينُنِي بِهِ عَلَى حُدُودِ
رِضَاكَ وَ أَسْأَلْكَ الْأَخْذَ بِأَحْسَنِ مَا أَعْلَمُ وَ التَّرْكَ لِشَرِّ مَا أَعْلَمُ وَ الْعِضْمَةَ لِي مِنْ أَنْ أَعْصِيَ وَ أَنَا أَعْلَمُ أَوْ أُخْطِئَ مِنْ
حَيْثُ لاَ أَعْلَمُ وَ أَسْأَلُكَ السِّعَةَ فِي الرِّزْقِ وَ ٱلزُّهْدَ فِيمَا هُوَ وَبَالَ وَ أُسْأَلُكَ الْمَخْرَجَ بِالْبَيَانِ مِنْ كُلّ شُبْهَةِ وَ ٱلْفَلْجَ
بِالصَّوَابِ فِي كُلِّ حُجَّةٍ وَ الصِّدْقَ فِيهَا عَلَيَّ وَ لِي وَ ذَلَلْنِي بِإِعْطَاءِ النَّصَفِ مِنْ نَفْسِي فِي جَمِيعِ الْمَوَاطِنِ فِي الرِّضَا
وَ اَلسَّخَطِ وَ التَّوَاضُعِ وَ الْفَضْلِ وَ تَرْكِ قَلِيلِ الْبَعْيِ وَ كَثِيرِهِ فِي الْقَوْلِ مِنّي وَ الْفِعْلِ وَ تَمَامِ النَّعْمَةِ فِي جَمِيعٍ
اَلْأَشيَاءٍ وَ الشُّكْرِ بِهَا عَلَيَّ حَتَّى تَرْضَى وَ بَعْدَ الرِّضَا وَ الْخِيَرَةِ فِيمَا يَكُونُ فِيهِ الْخِيَرَةُ بِمَيْسُورٍ جَمِيعِ الْأُمُورِ لا
بِمَعْسُورِهَا يَا كَرِيمُ ».
ثم تصلي ركعتين وتقول ما رواه.
commentary: Then you perform two units of prayer and say what has been narrated.

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: SUPPLICATION BETWEEN THE UNITS OF PRAYER (RAK‘AT)
text_en:
Ali ibn Hatim from Muhammad ibn Amr from Muhammad ibn Ammar from al-Husayn ibn Abdillah al-Abdawi
and al-Hasan ibn Muhammad, said: Ahmad ibn Abdillah ibn Rabiah al-Hashimi narrated to us. He said:
Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Muhammad narrated to me from Ali ibn Abdillah from his father from his grandfather
from Imam al-Husayn ibn Ali {a.s} from the Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam Ali {a.s} said:
“All praise is due to Allah {SWT}, the Lord {AZJ} of the worlds, and may Allah {SWT} send
blessings upon the purest of the messengers; (Prophet) Muhammad ibn Abdillah {saws},
the chosen one, the splitter and the joiner.
O’ Allah {SWT}, so single out (Prophet) Muhammad {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, with the praised remembrance and the appointed pool.
O’ Allah {SWT}, grant (Prophet) Muhammad {saws}, Your blessings be upon him and his
family, the means, the elevation, and the excellence, and place his love among the
chosen ones, his rank among the most exalted, and his honor among the nearest.
O’ Allah {SWT}, give (Prophet) Muhammad {saws}, Your blessings be upon him and his
family, from every honor, the most excellent of that honor,
And from every bliss, the most abundant of that bliss,
And from every gift, the greatest of that gift,
And from every ease, the most delightful of that ease,
And from every share, the most plentiful of that share, so that none of Your creation is
nearer than him in station, nor higher than him with You {AZJ} in remembrance and
position, nor greater in right upon You {AZJ}, nor closer in means than (Prophet)
Muhammad {saws}, Your blessings be upon him and his family, the leader of goodness
and its guide, the caller to it, and a blessing upon all servants and lands, and a mercy
to the worlds.
O’ Allah {SWT}, join us with (Prophet) Muhammad {saws}, Your blessings be upon him and
his family, in the comfort of life, the refreshment of the soul, the stability of blessings,
the desire of the selves, the fulfillment of longings, the delights of pleasures, the hope
for excellence, the witnessing of tranquility, the nobility of honor, the coolness of the
eye, the radiance of bliss, and a joy unlike the joys of this world.
We bear witness that He {saws} has conveyed the message, fulfilled the trust, strived for
the sake of the nation, and was harmed for Your sake.
And He {saws} strove in Your path and worshipped You {AZJ} until certainty (death) came to
him. So may Allah {SWT} send blessings upon Him {saws}, and his pure family {a.s}.
O’ Allah {SWT}, Lord {AZJ} of the Sacred Land, and Lord {AZJ} of the Corner and the Station,
and Lord {AZJ} of the Sacred Monument, and Lord {AZJ} of the sanctuary and the sacred,
convey to the soul of (Prophet) Muhammad {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, our peace.
O’ Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon Your nearest angels, and upon all of Your prophets
and messengers,
And O’ Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon the noble recording guardians, and upon the
people of Your obedience from among the inhabitants of the seven heavens and the
seven earths from among all the believers.”
(Imam {a.s} then continued) “Then, when you have completed the supplication, you
prostrate and say:
“O’ Allah {SWT}, to You {AZJ} I have turned, in You {AZJ} I have taken refuge, and upon You {AZJ}
I have relied.
O’ Allah {SWT}, You {AZJ} are my trust, and You {AZJ} are my hope. O’ Allah {SWT}, suffice me in
that which concerns me and that which does not concern me, and in that which You
{AZJ} know better than I do.
Mighty is Your protection, exalted is Your praise, and there is no God {AZJ} other than You
{AZJ}. Send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and the family of Muhammad
{saws}, and hasten their relief.’”
(Imam {a.s} then continued) “Then raise your head and say:
‘O’ Allah {SWT}, I seek refuge in You {AZJ} from everything that has distanced me from You
{AZJ}, or by which Your noble face has been turned away from me, or has diminished my
portion with You {AZJ}. O’ Allah {SWT}, so send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws}
and the family of Muhammad {saws}, and grant me success in everything that pleases
You {AZJ} about me and brings me closer to You {AZJ}.
And raise my rank with You {AZJ}, and increase my portion, and improve my final abode,
and make me firm with the ‘firm word in the worldly life and in the Hereafter’ (Surah
Ibrahim 14:27),
And grant me success in every praised station in which You {AZJ} love to be called upon
by Your names and asked from Your bounty.
My Lord {AZJ}, do not uncover Your covering from me, and do not expose my faults to the
worlds.
And send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and family of Muhammad {saws},
and place my name this night among the fortunate.” Until you complete the
supplication.
(Imam {a.s} then continued) “Then you perform two units of prayer. When you finish, say:
“O’ Allah {SWT}, You {AZJ} are my trust in every distress,
And You {AZJ} are my hope in every hardship,
And You {AZJ} are my reliance and provision in every matter that befalls me.
How many a distress weakens the heart, and solutions become limited, and the close
ones fail to help, and the enemy rejoices over it, and matters become difficult for me
yet I presented it to You {AZJ} and complained of it to You {AZJ}, turning to You {AZJ} in it, away
from all others besides You {AZJ}.
And You {AZJ} relieved it, and I complained of it, and You {AZJ} sufficed me in it.
So You {AZJ} are the Guardian of every blessing, the Companion in every need, and the
ultimate goal of every desire.
To You {AZJ} belongs abundant praise, and to You {AZJ} belongs gracious favor.”
text_ar:
عَلِيّ بْنُ حَاتِمِ عَنْ مُحَمّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو عَنْ مُحَمِّدٍ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ الْعَبْدَوِيِّ وَ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالاً
حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ الْهَاشِمِيْ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ
أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ : « «اَلْحَمْدُ لِلهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ» وَ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَى
طَيِّبِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ - مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُنْتَجَبِ الْفَاتِقِ الرَّاتِقِ اللَّهُمَّ فَخَصَّ مُحَمَّداً صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ بِالذَّكْرِ
الْمَحْمُودِ وَ الْحَوْضِ الْمَوْرُودِ اللَّهُمَّ آتِ مُحَمَّداً صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ الْوَسِيلَةَ وَ اَلرِّفْعَةَ وَ الْفَصِيلَةَ وَ اِجْعَلْ فِي
الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ مَحَبَّتَهُ وَ فِي الْعِلَّيْينَ دَرَجَتَهُ وَ فِي الْمُقَرِّبِينَ كَرَامَتَهُ اللَّهُمّ أَعْطِ مُحَمَّداً صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلهِ مِنْ كُلِّ
كَرَامَةٍ أَفْضَلَ تِلْكَ ٱلْكَرَامَةِ وَ مِنْ كُلِّ نَعِيمِ أَوْسَعَ ذَلِكَ النِّعِيمِ وَ مِنْ كُلِّ عَطَاءِ أَجْزَلَ ذَلِكَ الْعَطَاءِ وَ مِنْ كُلَّ يُسْرٍ
أَنْضَرَ ذَلِكَ الْيُسْرِ وَ مِنْ كُلِّ قِسْمِ أَوْفَرَ ذَلِكَ الْقِسْمِ حَتَّى لا يَكُونَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ أَقْرَبَ مِنْهُ مَجْلِساً وَ لاَ أَرْفَعَ مِنْهُ
عِنْدَكَ ذِكْراً وَ مَنْزِلَةً وَ لا أُعْظَمَ عَلَيْكَ حَقَا وَ لاَ أَقْرَبَ وَسِيلَةً مِنْ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَوَاتُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ إِمَامِ الْخَيْرِ وَ قَائِدِهِ وَ
الدَّاعِي إِلَيْهِ وَ الْبَرَكَةِ عَلَى جَمِيعِ الْعِبَادِ وَ الْبِلاَدِ وَ رَحْمَةٍ لِلْعَالَمِينَ اللّهُمَّ اِجْمَعْ بَيْنَنَا وَ بَيْنَ مُحَمَّدِ صَلَوَاثُكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ
آلِهِ فِي بَرْدِ ٱلْعَيْشِ وَ تَرَوْحِ الرَّوْحِ وَ قَرَارِ النَّعْمَةِ وَ شَهْوَةِ الْأَنْفُسِ وَ مُنَى الشَّهَوَاتِ وَ نِعَمِ اللَّذَّاتِ وَ رَجَاءِ الْفَضِيلَةِ
وَ شُهُودِ الطُّمَأْنِينَةِ وَ سُوْدُدِ الْكَرَامَةِ وَ قُرَّةِ الْعَيْنِ وَ نَضْرَةِ النَّعِيمِ وَ بَهْجَةٍ لا تُشْبِهُ بَهَجَاتِ الدُّنْيَا نَشْهَدُ أَنَّهُ قَدْ بَلَّغَ
الرِّسَالَةَ وَ أَدَّى النَّصِيحَةَ وَ اِجْتَهَدَ لِلْأُمَّةِ وَ أُوذِيَ فِي جَئِبِكَ وَ جَاهَدَ فِي سَبِيلِكَ وَ عَبَدَكَ حَتَّى أَتَاهُ الْيَقِينُ فَصَلَّى
اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ اَللّهُمْ رَبَّ الْبَلَدِ الْحَرَامِ وَ رَبَّ الرُّكْنِ وَ الْمَقَامِ وَ رَبَّ الْمَشعَرِ الْحَرَامِ وَ رَبَّ اَلْحِلِّ وَ الْحَرَامِ
بَلِّغْ رُوحَ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ عَنَّا ٱلسَّلاَمَ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَلاَئِكَتِكَ ٱلْمُقَرِّبِينَ وَ عَلَى أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَ رُسُلِكَ
أَجْمَعِينَ وَ صَلِّ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الْحَفَظَةِ الْكِرَامِ الْكَاتِبِينَ وَ عَلَى أَهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّمَاوَاتِ السَّبْعِ وَ أَهْلِ الْأَرَضِينَ
السَّبْعِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَجْمَعِينَ فَإِذَا فَرَعْتَ مِنَ الدُّعَاءِ سَجَدْتَ وَ قُلْتَ اللَّهُمَّ إِلَيْكَ تَوَجَّهْتُ وَ بِكَ اِعْتَصَمْتُ وَ عَلَيْكَ
تَوَكِّلْتُ اللَّهُمَّ أَنتَ ثِقَتِي وَ أَنْتَ رَجَائِي اللَّهُمَّ فَاكْفِنِي مَا أَهَمَّنِي وَ مَا لا يُهِمْنِي وَ مَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي عَزَّ جَارُكَ وَ
جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ وَ لاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُكَ صَلَّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَجَّلْ فَرَجَهُمْ ثُمَّ اِرْفَعْ رَأْسَكَ وَ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّي أُعُوذُ بِكَ
مِنْ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ زَحْرَحَ بَيْنِي وَ بَيْنَكَ أَوْ صُرِفَ بِهِ عَنِّي وَجَهُكَ الْكَرِيمُ أَوْ نَقَصَ مِنْ حَظَّي عِنْدَكَ اللَّهُمَّ فَصَلَ عَلَى
مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ وَفَقْنِي لِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ يُرْضِيكَ عَنِّي وَ يُقَرَّبُنِي إِلَيْكَ وَ اِرْفَعْ دَرَجَتِي عِنْدَكَ وَ أَعْظِمْ حَظِّي وَ
أَحْسِنْ مَثْوَايَ وَ ثَبَّثْنِي «بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّثيا وَ فِي الآجِرَةِ» وَ وَفَّقْبِي لِكُلِّ مَقَامِ مَحْمُودٍ تُجِبُّ أَنْ
تُذْعَى فِيهِ بِأَسْمَائِكَ وَ تُسْأَلَ فِيهِ مِنْ عَطَائِكَ رَبِّ لا تَكْشِفْ عَنِّي سِثْرَكَ وَ لاَ تُبْدِ عَوْرَتِي لِلْعَالَمِينَ وَ صَلِّ عَلَى
مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اِجْعَلِ اِسْمِي فِي هَذِهِ اللِّيْلَةِ فِي السُّعَدَاءِ حَتَّى تُتِمَّ الدُّعَاءَ». ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ
فَقُلِ اللَّهُمَ أَنْتَ ثِقَتِي فِي كُلَّ كَزْبِ وَ أَنْتَ رَجَائِي فِي كُلَّ شِدَّةٍ وَ أَنْتَ لِي فِي كُلِّ أَمْرِ نَزَلَ بِي ثِقَةٌ وَ عُدَّةٌ كَمْ مِنْ
كَزْبِ يَضْعُفُ عَنْهُ ٱَلْفُوَادُ وَ تَقِلُ فِيهِ الْحِيلَةُ وَ يَخْذُلُ عَنْهُ ٱلْقَرِيبُ وَ يَشمَتُ بِهِ الْعَدُوْ وَ تُعْيِينِي فِيهِ الْأُمُورُ أَنْزَلْتُهُ
بِكَ وَ شَكَوْتُهُ إِلَيْكَ رَاغِباً إِلَيْكَ فِيهِ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ فَفَرَّجْتَهُ وَ شَكَوْتُهُ فَكَفَيْتَنِيهِ فَأَنْتَ وَلِيْ كُلَّ نِعْمَةٍ وَ صَاحِبُ كُلِّ
حَاجَةٍ وَ مُنْتَهَى كُلِّ رَغْبَةٍ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ كَثِيراً وَ لَكَ الْمَنّ فَاضِلاً.

source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Husayn ibn Ali Sayyid al-Shuhada {a.s} & Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
text_chunk:
Ali ibn Hatim from Muhammad ibn Amr from Muhammad ibn Ammar from al-Husayn ibn Abdillah al-Abdawi
and al-Hasan ibn Muhammad, said: Ahmad ibn Abdillah ibn Rabiah al-Hashimi narrated to us. He said:
Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Muhammad narrated to me from Ali ibn Abdillah from his father from his grandfather
from Imam al-Husayn ibn Ali {a.s} from the Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam Ali {a.s} said:
“All praise is due to Allah {SWT}, the Lord {AZJ} of the worlds, and may Allah {SWT} send
blessings upon the purest of the messengers; (Prophet) Muhammad ibn Abdillah {saws},
the chosen one, the splitter and the joiner.
O’ Allah {SWT}, so single out (Prophet) Muhammad {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, with the praised remembrance and the appointed pool.
O’ Allah {SWT}, grant (Prophet) Muhammad {saws}, Your blessings be upon him and his
family, the means, the elevation, and the excellence, and place his love among the
chosen ones, his rank among the most exalted, and his honor among the nearest.
O’ Allah {SWT}, give (Prophet) Muhammad {saws}, Your blessings be upon him and his
family, from every honor, the most excellent of that honor,
And from every bliss, the most abundant of that bliss,
And from every gift, the greatest of that gift,
And from every ease, the most delightful of that ease,
And from every share, the most plentiful of that share, so that none of Your creation is
nearer than him in station, nor higher than him with You {AZJ} in remembrance and
position, nor greater in right upon You {AZJ}, nor closer in means than (Prophet)
Muhammad {saws}, Your blessings be upon him and his family, the leader of goodness
and its guide, the caller to it, and a blessing upon all servants and lands, and a mercy
to the worlds.
O’ Allah {SWT}, join us with (Prophet) Muhammad {saws}, Your blessings be upon him and
his family, in the comfort of life, the refreshment of the soul, the stability of blessings,
the desire of the selves, the fulfillment of longings, the delights of pleasures, the hope
for excellence, the witnessing of tranquility, the nobility of honor, the coolness of the
eye, the radiance of bliss, and a joy unlike the joys of this world.
We bear witness that He {saws} has conveyed the message, fulfilled the trust, strived for
the sake of the nation, and was harmed for Your sake.
And He {saws} strove in Your path and worshipped You {AZJ} until certainty (death) came to
him. So may Allah {SWT} send blessings upon Him {saws}, and his pure family {a.s}.
O’ Allah {SWT}, Lord {AZJ} of the Sacred Land, and Lord {AZJ} of the Corner and the Station,
and Lord {AZJ} of the Sacred Monument, and Lord {AZJ} of the sanctuary and the sacred,
convey to the soul of (Prophet) Muhammad {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, our peace.
O’ Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon Your nearest angels, and upon all of Your prophets
and messengers,
And O’ Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon the noble recording guardians, and upon the
people of Your obedience from among the inhabitants of the seven heavens and the
seven earths from among all the believers.”
(Imam {a.s} then continued) “Then, when you have completed the supplication, you
prostrate and say:
“O’ Allah {SWT}, to You {AZJ} I have turned, in You {AZJ} I have taken refuge, and upon You {AZJ}
I have relied.
O’ Allah {SWT}, You {AZJ} are my trust, and You {AZJ} are my hope. O’ Allah {SWT}, suffice me in
that which concerns me and that which does not concern me, and in that which You
{AZJ} know better than I do.
Mighty is Your protection, exalted is Your praise, and there is no God {AZJ} other than You
{AZJ}. Send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and the family of Muhammad
{saws}, and hasten their relief.’”
(Imam {a.s} then continued) “Then raise your head and say:
‘O’ Allah {SWT}, I seek refuge in You {AZJ} from everything that has distanced me from You
{AZJ}, or by which Your noble face has been turned away from me, or has diminished my
portion with You {AZJ}. O’ Allah {SWT}, so send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws}
and the family of Muhammad {saws}, and grant me success in everything that pleases
You {AZJ} about me and brings me closer to You {AZJ}.
And raise my rank with You {AZJ}, and increase my portion, and improve my final abode,
and make me firm with the ‘firm word in the worldly life and in the Hereafter’ (Surah
Ibrahim 14:27),
And grant me success in every praised station in which You {AZJ} love to be called upon
by Your names and asked from Your bounty.
My Lord {AZJ}, do not uncover Your covering from me, and do not expose my faults to the
worlds.
And send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and family of Muhammad {saws},
and place my name this night among the fortunate.” Until you complete the
supplication.
(Imam {a.s} then continued) “Then you perform two units of prayer. When you finish, say:
“O’ Allah {SWT}, You {AZJ} are my trust in every distress,
And You {AZJ} are my hope in every hardship,
And You {AZJ} are my reliance and provision in every matter that befalls me.
How many a distress weakens the heart, and solutions become limited, and the close
ones fail to help, and the enemy rejoices over it, and matters become difficult for me
yet I presented it to You {AZJ} and complained of it to You {AZJ}, turning to You {AZJ} in it, away
from all others besides You {AZJ}.
And You {AZJ} relieved it, and I complained of it, and You {AZJ} sufficed me in it.
So You {AZJ} are the Guardian of every blessing, the Companion in every need, and the
ultimate goal of every desire.
To You {AZJ} belongs abundant praise, and to You {AZJ} belongs gracious favor.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: SUPPLICATION BETWEEN THE UNITS OF PRAYER (RAK‘AT)
text_en:
This supplication was narrated by Abu al-Qasim Ja’far ibn Muhammad ibn Qulawayh. He said: al-Husayn
ibn Muhammad ibn Amir narrated to me from a man from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hafs ibn al-Bukhtari from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “This was among the supplications of the Prophet {saws}, may
Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, on the Day of al-Ahzab:
‘O’ Allah {SWT}, You {AZJ} are my trust...’ until the end of the supplication.”

Scholar's Note:
Then you perform two units of prayer. When you finish, say:
“O’ He {AZJ} who reveals the beautiful and conceals the ugly,
O’ He {AZJ} who does not tear the veil and does not seize for wrongdoing,
O’ Most Great in pardon,
O’ Excellent in overlooking,
O’ Vast in forgiveness,
O’ Extender of both hands in mercy,
O’ Companion of every secret and ultimate goal of every complaint,
O’ Remover of stumbles,
O’ Generous in forgiveness,
O’ Magnificent in bestowal,
O’ Beginner of blessings before they are deserved.
O’ my Lord {AZJ}, O’ my Master, O’ my Protector,
O’ ultimate aim of my desire I ask You {AZJ}, by You {AZJ}.
O’ Allah {SWT}, not to disfigure my form with the Fire, and to fulfill for me the needs of my
Hereafter and my worldly life, and to do for me such and such.”
And then you send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and the family of
Muhammad {saws}, and you supplicate with whatever you wish.
Then you perform two units of prayer. When you finish, say:
“O’ Allah {SWT}, You {AZJ} created me, then You {AZJ} commanded me and forbade me.
You {AZJ} made me desirous of the reward for that which You {AZJ} commanded me with,
and fearful of the punishment for that which You {AZJ} forbade me from.
And You {AZJ} appointed for me an enemy who plots against me, and You {AZJ} gave him
power over me in that which I have no power over him.
So You {AZJ} caused him to dwell in my chest and made him flow within me like blood.
He (enemy) does not become heedless if I am heedless, and he (enemy) does not
forget if I forget. He makes me feel safe from Your punishment and frightens me with
other than You {AZJ}. If I intend to commit an indecency, he encourages me, And if I
intend to do good, he discourages me. He sets up desires before me and displays them
to me. If he promises me, he lies to me; and if he fills me with hope, he makes me
despair. And if I follow his desire, he leads me astray.
And if You {AZJ} do not turn away his (enemy) plotting from me, he will cause me to slip;
and if You {AZJ} do not rescue me from his traps, he will hinder me; and if You {AZJ} do not
protect me from him, he will tempt me.
O’ Allah {SWT}, so send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and his family {a.s},
And subdue his (enemy) authority over me with Your authority over him, until You {AZJ}
restrain him from me through my frequent supplication to You {AZJ} so I may be among
those protected from him through You {AZJ}.
And there is no power and no strength except through You.”
This supplication and the one before it were narrated by:
text_ar:
رَوَى هَذَا الدُّعَاءَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قُولَوَيْهِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنِ
اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ الْبَخْتَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «كَانَ مِنْ دُعَاءِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ
آلِهِ يَوْمَ الْأَحْزَابِ « اَللّهُمَ أَنْتَ ثِقَتِي » تَمَامَ الدُّعَاءِ.
ثم تصلي ركعتين فإذا فرغت فقل : يا من اظهر الجميل وستر القبيح يا من لم يهتك السترو لم يؤاخذ بالجريرة يا عظيم
العفو ياحسن التجاوز يا واسع المغفرة يا باسط اليدين بالرحمة يا صاحب كل نجوى ومنتهى كل شكوى يا مقيل العثرات
يا كريم الصفح يا عظيم المن يا مبتدأ بالنعم قبل استحقاقها يا رباه يا سيداه يا أملاه يا غاية رغبتي أسألك بك يا اللّٰه ألا
تشوه خلقي بالنار وان تقضي لي حوائج آخرتي ودنياي وتفعل بي كذا وكذا.
وتصلي على محمد وآل محمد وتدعو بما بدا لك. ثم تصلي ركعتين فإذا فرغت فقل : اللهم خلقتني فأمرتني ونهيتني ،
ورغبتني في ثواب ما به أمرتني ، ورهبتني عقاب ما عنه نهيتني ، وجعلت لي عدوا يكيدني وسلطته منى على ما لم
تسلطنى عليه منه فأسكنته في صدري وأجريته مجرى الدم منى لا يغفل ان غفلت ولا ينسى ، إن نسيت يؤمنى عذابك
ويخوفني بغيرك، ان هممت بفاحشة شجعني، وان هممت بصالح ثبطني، ينصب لي بالشهوات ويعرض لي بها، إن وعدني
كذبني وان مناني قنطني وان اتبعت هواه أضلني وإن لا تصرف عني كيده يستزلني وإن لا تفلتني من حبائله يصدني وإن
لا تعصمني منه يفتني اللهم فصل على محمد وآله واقهر سلطانه علي بسلطانك عليه حتى تحبسه عني بكثرة الدعاء لك
مني فأفوز في المعصومين منه بك ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بك. روى هذا الدعاء والذي قبله:

رَوَى هَذَا الدُّعَاءَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قُولَوَيْهِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنِ
اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ الْبَخْتَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «كَانَ مِنْ دُعَاءِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ
آلِهِ يَوْمَ الْأَحْزَابِ « اَللّهُمَ أَنْتَ ثِقَتِي » تَمَامَ الدُّعَاءِ.
ثم تصلي ركعتين فإذا فرغت فقل : يا من اظهر الجميل وستر القبيح يا من لم يهتك السترو لم يؤاخذ بالجريرة يا عظيم
العفو ياحسن التجاوز يا واسع المغفرة يا باسط اليدين بالرحمة يا صاحب كل نجوى ومنتهى كل شكوى يا مقيل العثرات
يا كريم الصفح يا عظيم المن يا مبتدأ بالنعم قبل استحقاقها يا رباه يا سيداه يا أملاه يا غاية رغبتي أسألك بك يا اللّٰه ألا
تشوه خلقي بالنار وان تقضي لي حوائج آخرتي ودنياي وتفعل بي كذا وكذا.
وتصلي على محمد وآل محمد وتدعو بما بدا لك. ثم تصلي ركعتين فإذا فرغت فقل : اللهم خلقتني فأمرتني ونهيتني ،
ورغبتني في ثواب ما به أمرتني ، ورهبتني عقاب ما عنه نهيتني ، وجعلت لي عدوا يكيدني وسلطته منى على ما لم
تسلطنى عليه منه فأسكنته في صدري وأجريته مجرى الدم منى لا يغفل ان غفلت ولا ينسى ، إن نسيت يؤمنى عذابك
ويخوفني بغيرك، ان هممت بفاحشة شجعني، وان هممت بصالح ثبطني، ينصب لي بالشهوات ويعرض لي بها، إن وعدني
كذبني وان مناني قنطني وان اتبعت هواه أضلني وإن لا تصرف عني كيده يستزلني وإن لا تفلتني من حبائله يصدني وإن
لا تعصمني منه يفتني اللهم فصل على محمد وآله واقهر سلطانه علي بسلطانك عليه حتى تحبسه عني بكثرة الدعاء لك
مني فأفوز في المعصومين منه بك ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بك. روى هذا الدعاء والذي قبله:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: SUPPLICATION BETWEEN THE UNITS OF PRAYER (RAK‘AT)
text_en:
Ali ibn Hatim from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama’ah from Safwan ibn
Yahya from Ja’far ibn Sama’ah from al-Isi from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
“O’ Most Generous of those who give, and Best of those who are asked, and Most
Merciful of those from whom mercy is sought.
O’ One, O’ Unique, O’ Self-Sufficient, O’ He {AZJ} who ‘has not begotten and was not
begotten, and there is none comparable to Him’,
O’ He {AZJ} who has not taken a consort nor a son, O’ He {AZJ} who does whatever He wills
and rules as He {AZJ} desires.” (Surah Al-Ikhlas 112:3-4),
And He {AZJ} decrees whatever He {AZJ} wills. O’ He {AZJ} who ‘comes between a man and
his heart’ (Surah Al-Anfal 8:24),
O’ He {AZJ} who is in ‘the highest observation’,
O’ He {AZJ} of whom ‘there is nothing like unto Him’ (Surah Ash-Shura 42:11),
O’ Wise, O’ All-Hearing, O’ All-Seeing,
Send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and his family {a.s}, and expand for me
from Your lawful sustenance that by which I may cover my face, fulfill my trusts,
maintain my family ties, and have support for performing Hajj and Umrah.
SUPPLICATION.
Then you should pray two rak‘ahs, and when you have finished, say:
“O’ He {AZJ} who reveals the beautiful and conceals the ugly,
O’ He {AZJ} who does not tear away the covering and does not take one to task for the
offense,
O’ Great in pardon, O’ Excellent in overlooking, O’ Vast in forgiveness,
O’ Extender of the two hands with mercy,
O’ Companion of every whispered conversation and the end of every complaint,
O’ Remover of stumblings, O’ Noble in pardoning, O’ Great in benefaction,
O’ Beginner of blessings before their worthiness.
O’ my Lord {AZJ}, O’ my Master, O’ my Hope,
O’ Ultimate of my desire, I ask You {AZJ} by You {AZJ},
O’ Allah {SWT}, not to disfigure my form with the Fire,
And that You {AZJ} fulfill for me the needs of my Hereafter and my world,
And that You {AZJ} do for me (such-and-such) and (such-and-such),
And that You {AZJ} send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and the family of
Muhammad {saws}.”
And you may supplicate with whatever occurs to you. Then pray two rak‘ahs, and when
you have finished, say:
“O Allah {SWT}, You {AZJ} created me, then You {AZJ} commanded me and forbade me,
And encouraged me with the reward of what You {AZJ} commanded me with,
And warned me of the punishment for what You {AZJ} forbade me from.
And You {AZJ} made for me an enemy who plots against me,
And You {AZJ} gave him authority over me in ways You {AZJ} did not give me authority over
him. You {AZJ} placed him within my chest and made him flow like blood within me.
He (this enemy) does not become heedless if I am heedless, and he does not forget if
I forget.
He makes me feel secure from Your punishment and frightens me with other than You.
If I intend an indecency, he encourages me, and if I intend a righteous deed, he
discourages me.
He sets up for me desires and presents them to me.
If he promises me, he lies to me; if he gives me hope, he causes me to despair.
If I follow his desire, he leads me astray.
And if You {AZJ} do not turn away from me his plotting, he will cause me to slip.
And if You {AZJ} do not rescue me from his snares, he will divert me.
And if You {AZJ} do not protect me from him, he will tempt me.
O’ Allah {SWT}, so send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and his family,
And subdue his (enemy) power over me with Your power over him, until You {AZJ} restrain
him from me through my abundant supplication to You {AZJ}.
So I may be victorious among those who are protected from him through You {AZJ}.
And there is no power and no strength except through You {AZJ}.”

Scholar's Note:
Then you perform two units of prayer. When you finish, say what was narrated:
This supplication and the one before it were narrated by:
Ali ibn Hatim from Muhammad ibn Ja’far from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from
Muhammad ibn Hammad from his father from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him.
text_ar:
عَلِيُ بْنُ حَاتِمِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَمَاعَةً عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ سَمَاعَةَ
عَنِ الْعِيصِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : « يَا أَجْوَدَ مَنْ أَعْطَى وَ يَا خَيْرَ مَنْ سُئِلَ وَ يَا أَرْحَمَ مَنِ اُسْتُرْحِمَ يَا
وَاجِدُ يَا أَحَدُ يَا صَمَدُ يَا مَنْ «لَمْ يَلِذْ وَ لَمْ يُولَدْ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُواَ أَحَدٌ» يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ «صاحِبَةً وَ لا وَلَداً» يَا مَنْ
«يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشاءُ» وَ «يَحْكُمُ مَا يُرِيدُ» وَ يَقْضِي مَا أَحَبَ يَا مَنْ «يَحُولُ بَيْنَ ٱلْمَرْء وَ قَلْبِهِ» يَا مَنْ هُوَ بِالْمَنْظَرِ ٱلْأَعْلَى
يَا مَنْ «لَيْسَ كَمِثُلِهِ شَيْء» يَا حَكِيمُ يَا سَمِيعُ يَا بَصِيرُ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَوْسِعْ عَلَيَّ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ ٱلْحَلَالِ مَا
أَكُفَّ بِهِ وَجْهِي وَ أُوَدِّي بِهِ عَنِّي أَمَانَتِي وَ أَصِلُ بِهِ رَجِمِي وَ يَكُونُ عَوْناً لِي عَلَى الْحَجِّ وَ الْعُمْرَةِ ».
ثم تصلي ركعتين فإذا فرغت فقل ما رواه:
ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلْ » يَا مَنْ أَطْهَرَ الْجَمِيلَ وَ سَتَرَ الْقَبِيحَ يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَهْتِكِ السِّثْرَ وَ لَمْ يُوَاجِذْ
بِالْجَرِيرَةِ يَا عَظِيمَ اَلْعَفْوِ يَا حَسَنَ التَّجَاوُزِ يَا وَاسِعَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ يَا بَاسِطَ الْيَدَيْنِ بِالرَّحْمَةِ يَا صَاحِبَ كُلِّ نَجْوَى وَ
مُنْتَهَى كُلِّ شَكْوَى يَا مُقِيلَ الْعَثَرَاتِ يَا كَرِيمَ الصَّفْحِ يَا عَظِيمَ الْمَنِّ يَا مُبْتَدِئاً بِالنَّعَمِ قَبْلَ اِسْتِحْقَاقِهَا يَا رَبَّاهْ يَا
سَيِّدَاهْ يَا أَمَلاَهْ يَا غَايَةً رَغْبَتِي أَسْأَلُكَ بِكَ يَا اللَّهُ أَلَ تُشَوِّهَ خَلْقِي بِالنَّارِ وَ أَنْ تَقْضِيَ لِي حَوَائِجَ آخِرَتِي وَ دُنْيَايَ وَ
تَفْعَلَ بِي كَذَا وَ كَذَا وَ تُصَلِّي عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدِ » وَ تَدْعُو بِمَا بَدَا لَكَ. ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا قَرَغْتَ فَقُلٍ »
اللَّهُمَّ خَلَقْتَنِي فَأَمَرْتَنِي وَ نَهَيْتَنِي وَ رَغَبْتَنِي فِي ثَوَابٍ مَا بِهِ أَمَرْتَنِي وَ رَهَّبْتَنِي عِقَابَ مَا عَنْهُ نَهَيْتَنِي وَ جَعَلْتَ لِي
عَدُوَا يَكِيدُنِي وَ سَلَّظْتَهُ مِنَّي عَلَى مَا لَمْ تُسَلَّظْنِي عَلَيْهِ مِنْهُ فَأَسْكَنْتَهُ فِي صَدْرِي وَ أَجْرَيْتَهُ مَجْرَى الدَّمِ مِنَّي لا
يَغْفُلُ إِنْ غَفَلْتُ وَ لاَ يَنْسَى إِنْ نَسِيتُ يُوْمِنُنِي عَذَابَكَ وَ يُخَوِّفْنِي بِغَيْرِكَ إنْ هَمَمْتُ بِفَاحِشَةٍ شَجَعَنِي وَ إِنْ هَمَمْتُ
بِصَالِحِ تَبَّطَنِي يَنْصِبُ لِي بِالشَّهَوَاتِ وَ يَعْرِضُ لِي بِهَا إِنْ وَعَدَنِي كَذَبَنِي وَ إِنْ مَنَّانِي قَنَّطَنِي وَ إِنِ اِنَّبَعْتُ هَوَاهُ
أَضَلِّنِي وَ إِنْ لا تَصْرِفُ عَنِّي كَيْدَهُ يَسْتَزِلِّنِي وَ إِنْ لا ثُفْلِثْنِي مِنْ حَبَائِلِهِ يَصُدِّنِي وَ إِنْ لا تَعْصِمْنِي مِنْهُ يَفْتِنِّي اللَّهُمّ
فَصَلٌ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ اِقْهَزْ سُلْطَانَهُ عَلَيْ بِسُلْطَانِكَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى تَحْبِسَهُ عَنِّي بِكَثِرَةِ الدُعَاءِ لَكَ مِنِّي فَأَفُوزَ فِي
الْمَعْصُومِينَ مِنْهُ بِكَ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَ لاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّا بِكَ ».
رَوَى هَذَا الدُّعَاءَ وَ ٱلَّذِي قَبْلَهُ: عَلِيْ بْنُ حَاتِمِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَمَادٍ عَنْ أَبِبِهِ عَنْ أَبِي
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ.

source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Ali ibn Hatim from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama’ah from Safwan ibn
Yahya from Ja’far ibn Sama’ah from al-Isi from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
“O’ Most Generous of those who give, and Best of those who are asked, and Most
Merciful of those from whom mercy is sought.
O’ One, O’ Unique, O’ Self-Sufficient, O’ He {AZJ} who ‘has not begotten and was not
begotten, and there is none comparable to Him’,
O’ He {AZJ} who has not taken a consort nor a son, O’ He {AZJ} who does whatever He wills
and rules as He {AZJ} desires.” (Surah Al-Ikhlas 112:3-4),
And He {AZJ} decrees whatever He {AZJ} wills. O’ He {AZJ} who ‘comes between a man and
his heart’ (Surah Al-Anfal 8:24),
O’ He {AZJ} who is in ‘the highest observation’,
O’ He {AZJ} of whom ‘there is nothing like unto Him’ (Surah Ash-Shura 42:11),
O’ Wise, O’ All-Hearing, O’ All-Seeing,
Send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and his family {a.s}, and expand for me
from Your lawful sustenance that by which I may cover my face, fulfill my trusts,
maintain my family ties, and have support for performing Hajj and Umrah.
SUPPLICATION.
Then you should pray two rak‘ahs, and when you have finished, say:
“O’ He {AZJ} who reveals the beautiful and conceals the ugly,
O’ He {AZJ} who does not tear away the covering and does not take one to task for the
offense,
O’ Great in pardon, O’ Excellent in overlooking, O’ Vast in forgiveness,
O’ Extender of the two hands with mercy,
O’ Companion of every whispered conversation and the end of every complaint,
O’ Remover of stumblings, O’ Noble in pardoning, O’ Great in benefaction,
O’ Beginner of blessings before their worthiness.
O’ my Lord {AZJ}, O’ my Master, O’ my Hope,
O’ Ultimate of my desire, I ask You {AZJ} by You {AZJ},
O’ Allah {SWT}, not to disfigure my form with the Fire,
And that You {AZJ} fulfill for me the needs of my Hereafter and my world,
And that You {AZJ} do for me (such-and-such) and (such-and-such),
And that You {AZJ} send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and the family of
Muhammad {saws}.”
And you may supplicate with whatever occurs to you. Then pray two rak‘ahs, and when
you have finished, say:
“O Allah {SWT}, You {AZJ} created me, then You {AZJ} commanded me and forbade me,
And encouraged me with the reward of what You {AZJ} commanded me with,
And warned me of the punishment for what You {AZJ} forbade me from.
And You {AZJ} made for me an enemy who plots against me,
And You {AZJ} gave him authority over me in ways You {AZJ} did not give me authority over
him. You {AZJ} placed him within my chest and made him flow like blood within me.
He (this enemy) does not become heedless if I am heedless, and he does not forget if
I forget.
He makes me feel secure from Your punishment and frightens me with other than You.
If I intend an indecency, he encourages me, and if I intend a righteous deed, he
discourages me.
He sets up for me desires and presents them to me.
If he promises me, he lies to me; if he gives me hope, he causes me to despair.
If I follow his desire, he leads me astray.
And if You {AZJ} do not turn away from me his plotting, he will cause me to slip.
And if You {AZJ} do not rescue me from his snares, he will divert me.
And if You {AZJ} do not protect me from him, he will tempt me.
O’ Allah {SWT}, so send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and his family,
And subdue his (enemy) power over me with Your power over him, until You {AZJ} restrain
him from me through my abundant supplication to You {AZJ}.
So I may be victorious among those who are protected from him through You {AZJ}.
And there is no power and no strength except through You {AZJ}.”

text_ar:
عَلِيُ بْنُ حَاتِمِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَمَاعَةً عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ سَمَاعَةَ
عَنِ الْعِيصِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : « يَا أَجْوَدَ مَنْ أَعْطَى وَ يَا خَيْرَ مَنْ سُئِلَ وَ يَا أَرْحَمَ مَنِ اُسْتُرْحِمَ يَا
وَاجِدُ يَا أَحَدُ يَا صَمَدُ يَا مَنْ «لَمْ يَلِذْ وَ لَمْ يُولَدْ وَ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُواَ أَحَدٌ» يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ «صاحِبَةً وَ لا وَلَداً» يَا مَنْ
«يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشاءُ» وَ «يَحْكُمُ مَا يُرِيدُ» وَ يَقْضِي مَا أَحَبَ يَا مَنْ «يَحُولُ بَيْنَ ٱلْمَرْء وَ قَلْبِهِ» يَا مَنْ هُوَ بِالْمَنْظَرِ ٱلْأَعْلَى
يَا مَنْ «لَيْسَ كَمِثُلِهِ شَيْء» يَا حَكِيمُ يَا سَمِيعُ يَا بَصِيرُ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَوْسِعْ عَلَيَّ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ ٱلْحَلَالِ مَا
أَكُفَّ بِهِ وَجْهِي وَ أُوَدِّي بِهِ عَنِّي أَمَانَتِي وَ أَصِلُ بِهِ رَجِمِي وَ يَكُونُ عَوْناً لِي عَلَى الْحَجِّ وَ الْعُمْرَةِ ».
ثم تصلي ركعتين فإذا فرغت فقل ما رواه:
ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلْ » يَا مَنْ أَطْهَرَ الْجَمِيلَ وَ سَتَرَ الْقَبِيحَ يَا مَنْ لَمْ يَهْتِكِ السِّثْرَ وَ لَمْ يُوَاجِذْ
بِالْجَرِيرَةِ يَا عَظِيمَ اَلْعَفْوِ يَا حَسَنَ التَّجَاوُزِ يَا وَاسِعَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ يَا بَاسِطَ الْيَدَيْنِ بِالرَّحْمَةِ يَا صَاحِبَ كُلِّ نَجْوَى وَ
مُنْتَهَى كُلِّ شَكْوَى يَا مُقِيلَ الْعَثَرَاتِ يَا كَرِيمَ الصَّفْحِ يَا عَظِيمَ الْمَنِّ يَا مُبْتَدِئاً بِالنَّعَمِ قَبْلَ اِسْتِحْقَاقِهَا يَا رَبَّاهْ يَا
سَيِّدَاهْ يَا أَمَلاَهْ يَا غَايَةً رَغْبَتِي أَسْأَلُكَ بِكَ يَا اللَّهُ أَلَ تُشَوِّهَ خَلْقِي بِالنَّارِ وَ أَنْ تَقْضِيَ لِي حَوَائِجَ آخِرَتِي وَ دُنْيَايَ وَ
تَفْعَلَ بِي كَذَا وَ كَذَا وَ تُصَلِّي عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدِ » وَ تَدْعُو بِمَا بَدَا لَكَ. ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا قَرَغْتَ فَقُلٍ »
اللَّهُمَّ خَلَقْتَنِي فَأَمَرْتَنِي وَ نَهَيْتَنِي وَ رَغَبْتَنِي فِي ثَوَابٍ مَا بِهِ أَمَرْتَنِي وَ رَهَّبْتَنِي عِقَابَ مَا عَنْهُ نَهَيْتَنِي وَ جَعَلْتَ لِي
عَدُوَا يَكِيدُنِي وَ سَلَّظْتَهُ مِنَّي عَلَى مَا لَمْ تُسَلَّظْنِي عَلَيْهِ مِنْهُ فَأَسْكَنْتَهُ فِي صَدْرِي وَ أَجْرَيْتَهُ مَجْرَى الدَّمِ مِنَّي لا
يَغْفُلُ إِنْ غَفَلْتُ وَ لاَ يَنْسَى إِنْ نَسِيتُ يُوْمِنُنِي عَذَابَكَ وَ يُخَوِّفْنِي بِغَيْرِكَ إنْ هَمَمْتُ بِفَاحِشَةٍ شَجَعَنِي وَ إِنْ هَمَمْتُ
بِصَالِحِ تَبَّطَنِي يَنْصِبُ لِي بِالشَّهَوَاتِ وَ يَعْرِضُ لِي بِهَا إِنْ وَعَدَنِي كَذَبَنِي وَ إِنْ مَنَّانِي قَنَّطَنِي وَ إِنِ اِنَّبَعْتُ هَوَاهُ
أَضَلِّنِي وَ إِنْ لا تَصْرِفُ عَنِّي كَيْدَهُ يَسْتَزِلِّنِي وَ إِنْ لا ثُفْلِثْنِي مِنْ حَبَائِلِهِ يَصُدِّنِي وَ إِنْ لا تَعْصِمْنِي مِنْهُ يَفْتِنِّي اللَّهُمّ
فَصَلٌ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ اِقْهَزْ سُلْطَانَهُ عَلَيْ بِسُلْطَانِكَ عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى تَحْبِسَهُ عَنِّي بِكَثِرَةِ الدُعَاءِ لَكَ مِنِّي فَأَفُوزَ فِي
الْمَعْصُومِينَ مِنْهُ بِكَ وَلَا حَوْلَ وَ لاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّا بِكَ ».
رَوَى هَذَا الدُّعَاءَ وَ ٱلَّذِي قَبْلَهُ: عَلِيْ بْنُ حَاتِمِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَمَادٍ عَنْ أَبِبِهِ عَنْ أَبِي
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ.

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: SUPPLICATION BETWEEN THE UNITS OF PRAYER (RAK‘AT)
text_en:
Ali ibn Hatim from Ali ibn al-Husayn from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah from his father from Ibn al-Mughirah from
Imam al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Ridha {a.s} said:
“O’ Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and his family {a.s} among
the first,
And send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and his family {a.s} among the last,
And send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and his family {a.s} in the highest
assembly,
And send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and his family {a.s} among the
prophets and the messengers.
O’ Allah {SWT}, grant (Prophet) Muhammad {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family,
the means, the honor, the excellence, and the great rank.
O’ Allah {SWT}, I have believed in (Prophet) Muhammad {saws}, peace be upon him and his
family, though I have not seen him, so do not deprive me on the Day of Resurrection of
seeing him.
Grant me his companionship, cause me to die upon his religion, and give me to drink
from his pool a satisfying drink after which I shall never thirst again. Indeed, You {AZJ}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: SUPPLICATION BETWEEN THE UNITS OF PRAYER (RAK‘AT)
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Ibrahim ibn Abi Rafi‘ from Abu Ja’far Ahmad ibn Ya‘qub al-Asbahani said: Abu Ja’far Ahmad ibn
‘Alawiyyah narrated to me, who said: Abu Ishaq Ibrahim ibn Muhammad ibn Sa’id al-Thaqafi narrated to us,
who said: Ali ibn Mu‘alla narrated to me from Ibrahim ibn Abi Sammak from Sa’ad ibn Yasar from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, from his father {a.s}, from his forefathers {a.s}, peace be upon them:
From the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family.
text_ar:
أُحْمَدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ الْأَصْبَهَانِيِّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو جَعْفَرِ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَلَوِيَّةَ
قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إسْحَاقَ إبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُحَمَدِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ الثَقَفِي قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عَلِيْ بْنُ مُعَلَّى عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ أَبِي سَمَّاكِ
عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَاَمُ : عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَ.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.86
source_scholar: Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
text_chunk:
Ahmad ibn Ibrahim ibn Abi Rafi‘ from Abu Ja’far Ahmad ibn Ya‘qub al-Asbahani said: Abu Ja’far Ahmad ibn
‘Alawiyyah narrated to me, who said: Abu Ishaq Ibrahim ibn Muhammad ibn Sa’id al-Thaqafi narrated to us,
who said: Ali ibn Mu‘alla narrated to me from Ibrahim ibn Abi Sammak from Sa’ad ibn Yasar from Abu

From the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family.

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: SUPPLICATION BETWEEN THE UNITS OF PRAYER (RAK‘AT)
text_en:
And Abu Muhammad Harun ibn Musa narrated: Abu Ali Muhammad ibn Hammam narrated from Ali ibn
Abdillah ibn Kushid al-Asbahani narrated from Abu Ishaq Ibrahim ibn Muhammad (with) the same as first.
“O’ Allah {SWT}, to You {AZJ} belongs all praise. O’ Allah {SWT}, there is no guide for the one
You {AZJ} have led astray, and no one can misguide the one You {AZJ} have guided.
O’ Allah {SWT}, there is no withholder of what You {AZJ} give, and no giver of what You {AZJ}
withhold. O’ Allah {SWT}, there is no restrainer of what You {AZJ} extend, and no extender
of what You {AZJ} restrain.
O’ Allah {SWT}, there is no advancer of what You {AZJ} delay, and no delayer of what You
{AZJ} advance. O’ Allah {SWT}, You {AZJ} are the Forbearing, so do not hasten.
O’ Allah {SWT}, You {AZJ} are the Generous, so do not withhold. O’ Allah {SWT}, You {AZJ} are
the Mighty, so do not be overcome.
O’ Allah {SWT}, You {AZJ} are the Inaccessible, so none may reach You {AZJ}. O’ Allah {SWT},
You {AZJ} are the Possessor of Majesty and Honor send blessings upon (Prophet)
Muhammad {saws} and the family of Muhammad {saws}.”
And supplicate with whatever you wish.

Scholar's Note:
Then you perform two units of prayer and say what was narrated:
text_ar:
وروى أبو محمد هارون بن موسى قال حدثني أبو علي محمد بن همام قال حدثني علي بن عبد اللّٰه بن كوشيد
الاصبهاني عن ابي إسحاق ابراهيم بن محمد مثل الاول : « اللهم لك الحمد كله ، اللهم لا هادي للمن أضللت ولا
مضل لمن هديت ، اللهم لا مانع لما أعطيت ولا معطي لما منعت ، اللهم لا قابض لما بسطت ولا باسط لما قبضت
، اللهم لا مقدم لما أخرت ولا مؤخر لما قدمت، اللهم انت الحليم فلا تعجل ، اللهم انت الجواد فلا تبخل ، اللهم
انت العزيز فلا تستذل، اللهم انت المنيع فلا ترام، اللهم انت ذو الجلال والاكرام صل على محمد وآل محمد
» وادع بما شئت.
ثم تصلي ركعتين وتقول ما رواه:

chapter_title: SUPPLICATION BETWEEN THE UNITS OF PRAYER (RAK‘AT)
text_en:
Ali ibn Hatim, from Ali ibn Sulayman al-Zurari, from Ahmad ibn Ishaq, from Sa’adan, who raised it (in isnad)
to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said:
“O’ Allah {SWT}, I ask You {AZJ} for well-being from the severity of affliction, and from the
gloating of enemies, and from an evil decree, and from reaching misery, and from
harm in livelihood,
And that You {AZJ} not test me with a trial for which I have no strength,
Or that You {AZJ} give power over me to a tyrant,
Or that You {AZJ} tear away from me a covering,
Or expose a private fault of mine,
Or call me to account on the Day of Resurrection with thorough interrogation at the
very time I am most in need of Your pardon and Your overlooking of what has passed.
O’ Allah {SWT}, I ask You {AZJ} by Your Noble Name and Your perfect words to send
blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and the family of Muhammad {saws},
And to make me among Your freed and released ones from the Fire.”

Scholar's Note:
Then you perform two units of prayer (rak‘atayn) and say what has been narrated:
text_ar:
عَلِيُّ بْنُ حَاتِمِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ الزُّرَارِيِّ عَنْ أُحْمَدَ بْنِ إسْحَاقَ عَنْ سَعْدَانَ رَفَعَهُ إِلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ آللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ
: « اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأُلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ مِنْ جَهْدِ الْبَلاءِ وَ شَمَاتَةِ الْأَعْدَاءِ وَ سُوءِ اَلْقَضَاءِ وَ دَرَكِ الشَّقَاءِ وَ مِنَ الضَّرَرِ فِي
الْمَعِيشَةِ وَ أَنْ تَبْتَلِيَنِي بِبَلاءٍ لا طَاقَةَ لِي بِهِ أَوْ تُسَلَّطَ عَلَيْ طَاغِياً أَوْ تَهْتِكَ لِي سِثْراً أَوْ تُبْدِيَ لِي عَوْرَةً أَوْ تُحَاسِبَنِي
يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مُنَاقِشاً أَحْوَجَ مَا أَكُونُ إِلَى عَفْوِكَ وَ تَجَاوُزِكَ عَنِّي فِيمَا سَلَفَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الْكَرِيمِ وَ
كَلِمَاتِكَ التَّامَةِ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ أَنْ تَجْعَلَنِي مِنْ عُتَقَائِكَ وَ طُلَقَائِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ».
ثم تصلي ركعتين وتقول ما رواه :

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: SUPPLICATION BETWEEN THE UNITS OF PRAYER (RAK‘AT)
text_en:
Ali ibn Hatim, from Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from some who narrated it from Abu al-
Hasan Musa {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} said:
“O’ Allah {SWT}, there is no God but You {AZJ}. I worship none but You {AZJ}, and I associate
nothing with You {AZJ}.
O’ Allah {SWT}, ‘Indeed, I have wronged myself, so forgive me’ (Surah Al-Qasas 28:16),
and have mercy on me, for indeed none forgives sins except You {AZJ}.
O’ Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and the family of
Muhammad {saws},
And forgive me for what I have done before and what I will do later, what I have made
public and what I have kept secret, and what You {AZJ} know better than I do.
And You {AZJ} are the One who brings forward and the One who delays.
O’ Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and the family of
Muhammad {saws},
And guide me to justice, guidance, correctness, and the firm establishment of the
religion.
O’ Allah {SWT}, make me one who guides and is rightly guided, content and pleasing (to
You {AZJ}), not astray and not leading others astray.
O’ Allah {SWT}, Lord {AZJ} of the seven heavens and Lord {AZJ} of the seven earths and Lord
{AZJ} of the Mighty Throne, suffice me in that which concerns me of my affairs, however
You {AZJ} will and in whatever way You {AZJ} will,
And send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and his family {a.s},”
Then supplicate with whatever you wish.
(Imam {a.s} then continued) “Then perform two units of prayer, and when you finish, say:
“O’ Allah {SWT}, none can repel Your wrath except Your forbearance,
And none can save from Your punishment except Your mercy,
And none can deliver from Your chastisement except turning humbly to You {AZJ}.
So grant me, O’ my God, ‘a mercy from Yourself’ (Surah Al Imran 3:8),
Through which You {AZJ} make me free of need for the mercy of anyone besides You {AZJ},
By the power through which You {AZJ} revive the dead land,
And by which You {AZJ} resurrect the dead among the servants,
And do not destroy me with grief until You {AZJ} forgive me and have mercy on me,
And make me recognize the answer to my supplication,
And let me taste the sweetness of well-being until the end of my term.
And do not allow my enemy to gloat over me,
And do not give him control over my neck.
My God {AZJ}, if You {AZJ} lower me, then who is there to raise me?
And if You {AZJ} raise me, then who is there to lower me?
And if You {AZJ} destroy me, then who is there to stand between You {AZJ} and me, or to
interfere with You {AZJ} in any matter of mine?
And I have indeed known, O’ my God {AZJ}, that there is no injustice in Your judgment,
and there is no haste in Your punishment and only one who fears losing something
hastens, and only the weak have need to commit injustice and You {AZJ}, O’ my God, are
exalted far above that, with great exaltation.
So do not make me a target for affliction, nor a sign for Your vengeance.
Grant me respite, grant me relief, overlook my slip, and do not try me with a trial
following another trial for surely, You {AZJ} see my weakness and the lack of my means.
I seek refuge in You {AZJ}, O’ Allah {SWT}, so grant me refuge.
I seek protection with You {AZJ} from the Fire, so protect me.
And I ask You {AZJ} for Paradise, so do not deprive me of it.”
(Imam {a.s} then continued) “Then you do two units of prayer, and when you finish, say:
“O’ Allah {SWT}, indeed, Your pardon of my sin,
And Your overlooking of my fault,
And Your forgiveness of my wrongdoing,
And Your covering over my disgraceful deeds,
And Your forbearance despite the magnitude of my crimes whether they were
committed in error or deliberately, has encouraged me to ask You {AZJ} for that which I
do not deserve from You {AZJ}: that which You {AZJ} have granted me from Your mercy, And
made me acquainted with from Your responsiveness, and shown me from Your power.
Thus I have begun calling upon You {AZJ} in safety, and asking You {AZJ} with familiarity,
not in fear or dread, relying upon You {AZJ} in what I turn to You {AZJ} for.
And if You {AZJ} delay in responding to me, I blame You {AZJ} out of my ignorance and
perhaps what You {AZJ} delayed for me is better for me, due to Your knowledge of the
outcome of matters.
I have never seen a generous Master, more patient with a disgraceful servant, than You
{AZJ} are with me.
O’ my Lord {AZJ}, indeed You {AZJ} call me, and I turn away from You {AZJ};
And You {AZJ} show love toward me, but I become hostile toward You {AZJ};
And You {AZJ} show affection toward me, but I do not accept it from You {AZJ} as though I
have the upper hand over You {AZJ}.
Yet none of that prevents You {AZJ} from having mercy on me, doing good to me, and
bestowing generously upon me out of Your bounty and generosity.
So have mercy on Your ignorant servant,
And bestow upon him from the excellence of Your kindness indeed, You {AZJ} are
Generous and Noble.”
(Imam {a.s} then continued) “And when you finish the supplication, go into prostration
(sujud) and say in your prostration:
‘O’ the One {AZJ} who existed before everything,
And the One {AZJ} who will exist after everything,
And the One {AZJ} who brings all things into being do not expose me, for You {AZJ} know all
about me, and do not punish me, for You {AZJ} have power over me.
O’ Allah {SWT}, I seek refuge in You {AZJ} from turning away (from faith) at the time of death,
And from the evil of the return to the graves,
And from regret on the Day of Resurrection.
O’ Allah {SWT}, I ask You {AZJ} for a pleasant life, a peaceful death, and an honourable
return; which is not disgraceful and not shameful.’”

Scholar's Note:
Then raise your head from the prostration and supplicate with whatever you wish. Then
perform two units of prayer (rak‘atayn), and say what has been narrated:
text_ar:
عَلِيْ بْنُ حَاتِمِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ بَعْضِ مَنْ رَوَاهُ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ
السَّلامُ : « اللَّهُمّ لا إِلَهَ إِلَّ أَنْتَ لا أَعْبُدُ إِلَّ إِيَّاكَ وَ لا أُشرِكُ بِكَ شَيْئا اللَّهُمَّ «إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِزْ لِي» وَ اِزْحَمْنِي
إِنَّهُ لا يَغْفِرُ الذُنُوبَ إِلَّ أَنْتَ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اِغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَ أَخَرْتُ وَ أَعْلَئْتُ وَ أَسْرَرْتُ
وَ مَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي وَ أَنْتَ ٱلْمُقَدَّمُ وَ أَنْتَ ٱلْمُؤَخِّرُ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ دُلَّنِي عَلَى الْعَدْلِ وَ
الْهُدَى وَ الصَّوَابِ وَ قِوَامِ الدِّينِ اللَّهُمْ اِجْعَلْنِي هَادِياً مَهْدِيّاً رَاضِياً مَرْضِيَاً غَيْرَ ضَالَ وَ لاَ مُضِلَّ اللَّهُمَ رَبَّ السَّمَاوَاتِ
اَلسَّبْعِ وَ رَبَّ الْأَرَضِينَ السَّبْعِ وَ رَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ اِكْفِنِي الْمُهِمَّ مِنْ أَمْرِي بِمَا شِئْتَ وَ كَيْفَ شِئُتَ وَ صَلِّ عَلَى
مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَدْعُ بِمَا أَحْبَبْتَ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلْ يَا اللَّهُ لَيْسَ يَرُدْ غَضَّبَكَ إِلاّ جِلْمُكَ وَ لاَ يُنْجِي
مِنْ نَقِمَتِكَ إِلَّ رَحْمَتُكَ وَ لاَ يُنْجِي مِنْ عَذَابِكَ إِلاَّ التَّضَرُّعُ إِلَيْكَ فَهَبْ لِي يَا إِلَهِي «مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً» تُغْنِينِي بِهَا عَنْ
رَحْمَةٍ مَنْ سِوَاكَ بِالْقُدْرَةِ الَّتِي بِهَا تُحْبِي مَيْتَ الْبِلاَدِ وَ بِهَا تَنْشُرُ مَيْتَ اَلْعِبَادِ وَ لا تُهْلِكْنِي غَمّاً حَتَّى تَغْفِرَ لِي وَ
تَرْحَمَنِي وَ ثُعَرَّفَنِي الْإِسْتِجَابَةَ فِي دُعَائِي وَ أَذِقْنِي طَعْمَ الْعَافِيَةِ إِلَى مُنْتَهَى أَجَلِي وَ لا تُشِمِثْ بِي عَدُوِّي وَ لا
تُمَكِّنْهُ مِنْ رَقَبَتِي إِلَهِي إِنْ وَضَعْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَرْفَعُنِي وَ إِنْ رَفَعْتَنِي فَمَنْ ذَا الّذِي يَضَعَنِي وَ إِنْ أَهْلَكْتَنِي فَمَنْ
ذَا الَّذِي يَحُولُ بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنِي أَوْ يَتَعَرْضُ لَكَ فِي شَيْءٍ مِنْ أَمْرِي وَ قَدْ عَلِمْتُ يَا إِلَهِي أَنْ لَيْسَ فِي حُكْمِكَ ظُلْمٌ وَ
لاَ فِي نَقِمَتِكَ عَجَلَةٌ وَ إِنَّمَا يَعْجَلُ مَنْ يَخَافُ الْفَوْتَ وَ إِنَّمَا يَحْتَاجُ إِلَى الظُلْمِ الضَّعِيفُ وَ قَدْ تَعَالَيْتَ يَا إِلَهِي عَنْ
ذَلِكَ عُلُواً كَبِيراً فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِي لِلْبَلاءِ غَرَضاً وَلَا لِنَقِمَتِكَ نَصَباً وَ مَهْلْنِي وَ نَفّسْنِي وَ أَقِلْنِي عَثِرَتِي وَ لا تَبْتَلِيَنِّي بِبَلاَءٍ
عَلَى أَثَرِ بَلاءِ فَقَدْ تَرَى ضَعْفِي وَ قِلَّةَ جِيلَتِي وَ أَسْتَجِيرُ بِكَ يَا اللّهُ فَأْجِرْنِي وَ أَسْتَعِيذُ بِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ فَأَعِذْنِي وَ
أَسْأَلُكَ الْجَنَّةَ فَلا تَحْرِمْنِي ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَقُلِ اللَّهُمّ إنَّ عَفْوَكَ عَنْ ذَنْبِي وَ تَجَاوُرَكَ عَنْ خَطِيئَتِي
وَ صَفْحَكَ عَنْ ظُلْمِي وَ سَثْرَكَ عَلَى قَبِيحِ عَمَلِي وَ حِلْمَكَ عَنْ كَثِيرِ جُرْمِي عِنْدَ مَا كَانَ مِنْ خَطَبِي وَ عَمْدِي أَطْمَعَنِي
فِي أَنْ أَسْألَكَ مَا لا أَسْتَوْجِبُهُ مِنْكَ اَلَّذِي رَزَقْتَنِي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ وَ عَرَّفْتَنِي مِنْ إِجَابَتِكَ وَ أَرَيْتَنِي مِنْ قُدْرَتِكَ فَصِرْتُ
أَدْعُوكَ آمِناً وَ أَسْأَلُكَ مُسْتَأْنِساً لا خَائِفاً وَ لا وَجِلاً مُدِلاً عَلَيْكَ فِيمَا قَصَدْتُ بِهِ إِلَيْكَ فَإِنْ أَبْطَأَ عَنِّي عَتَبْتُ بِجَهْلِي
عَلَيْكَ وَ لَعَلَّ آلَّذِي أَبْطَأً عَنِّي هُوَ خَيْرٌ لِي لِعِلْمِكَ بِعَاقِبَةِ الْأُمُورِ فَلَمْ أَرَ مَوْلَى كَرِيما أَصْبَرَ عَلَى عَبْدِ لَئِيمِ مِثْكَ عَلَيَّ
يَا رَبِّ إِنَّكَ تَدْعُونِي فَأْوَلِّي عَنْكَ وَ تَتَحَبَّبُ إِلَيْ فَأَتَبَغَضُ إِلَيْكَ وَ تَتَوَدَّدُ إِلَيْ فَلا أَقْبَلُ مِنْكَ كَأَنّ لِيَ التَّطَوْلَ عَلَيْكَ
وَ لَمْ يَمْنَعْكَ ذَلِكَ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ بِي وَ ٱلْإِحْسَانِ إِلَيّ وَ التَّفَضُّلِ عَلَيَّ بِجُودِكَ وَ كَرَمِكَ فَارْحَمْ عَبْدَكَ الْجَاهِلَ وَ جُذْ
عَلَيْهِ بِفَضْلِ إِحْسَانِكَ إِنَّكَ جَوَادْ كَرِيمٌ فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ مِنَ الدُّعَاءِ فَاسْجُدْ وَ قُلْ فِي سُجُودِكَ يَا كَائِناً قَبْلَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَ
يَا كَائِناً بَعْدَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَ يَا مُكَوِّنَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ لا تَفْضَحْنِي فَإِنَّكَ بِي عَالِمْ وَ لا تُعَذِّبْنِي فَإِنَّكَ عَلَيَّ قَادِرْ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي
أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَدِيلَةِ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ وَ مِنْ شَرِّ الْمَرْجِعِ فِي الْقُبُورِ وَ مِنَ النَّدَامَةِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِيشَةً
هَنِيئَةٌ وَ مِيتَةً سَوِيَّةً وَ مُنْقَلَباً كَرِيما غَيْرَ مُخْزٍ وَ لاَ فَاضِحٍ ».
ثم ارفع رأسك من السجود وادع بما شئت ثم تصلي ركعتين وتقول ما رواه :
