author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ya‘qub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr,
from Umar ibn Udhaynah, from Zurarah, who said:
Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “The Friday prayer is obligatory upon the one
who, if he performs the morning prayer with his family, can reach the Friday prayer.
And the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, used to
perform the afternoon prayer, at the time of the noon prayer, on the rest of the days so
that when they completed the prayer with the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, May Allah {SWT}
bless him and his family, they would return to their dwellings before nightfall, and that
is a sunnah until the Day of Resurrection.”

Scholar's Note:
So this does not contradict the first report, because this report is to be understood as
recommending (the act), since the obligation is upon the one who is within two
farsakhs, and if the distance is more than that, then it is recommended.
And what further clarifies this is what was narrated by the transmitter of this hadith
himself, namely Zurarah.
text_ar:
فأما ما رواه محمد بن علي بن محبوب عن يعقوب بن يزيد عن ابن ابي عمير عن عمر بن اذينة عن زرارة قال
قال أبو جعفر عليه السلام : الجمعة واجبة على من إن صلى الغداة في أهله أدرك الجمعة ، وكان رسول الله
صلى الله عليه وآله انما يصلي العصر في وقت الظهر في سائر الايام كي إذا قضوا الصلاة مع رسول الله
صلى الله عليه وآله رجعوا إلى رحالهم قبل الليل وذلك سنة إلى يوم القيامة.
فلا ينافي الخبر الاول لان هذا الخبر محمول على الاستحباب لان الفرض يتعلق على من كان على رأس فرسخين فإذا زاد
على ذلك كان مندوبا إليه، والذي يزيد ذلك بيانا ما رواه راوي هذا الحديث وهو زرارة.
commentary:
So this does not contradict the first report, because this report is to be understood as
recommending (the act), since the obligation is upon the one who is within two
farsakhs, and if the distance is more than that, then it is recommended.
And what further clarifies this is what was narrated by the transmitter of this hadith
himself, namely Zurarah.

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn al-Sindi, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil
ibn Darraj, from Zurarah and Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “The Friday prayer is obligatory upon one who is at a distance
of two farsakhs (farsakhayn) from it.”
text_ar:
رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ السِّنْدِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ بْنِ دَرَّاجِ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ وَ
مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «تَجِبُ الْجُمُعَةُ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ مِنْهَا عَلَى فَرْسَخَيْنِ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Abu Hammam, from Abu al-Hasan {a.s}:
Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} said: “If a woman performs the Friday prayer in the mosque with
the (just) imam of two rak‘ahs for Friday, then her prayer is deficient.
And if she performs four rak‘ahs in the mosque, her prayer is deficient.
Let her pray four rak‘ahs in her house; for that is better.”
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي هَمَّامِ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا صَلَّتِ ٱلْمَرْأَةُ
فِي الْمَسْجِدِ مَعَ الْإِمَامِ - يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ الْجُمُعَةَ رَكْعَنَيْنِ فَقَدْ نَقَصَتْ صَلاَتَهَا وَ إِنْ صَلَّتْ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ أَرْبَعاً نَقَصَتْ
صَلاَتَهَا لَتُصَلِّي فِي بَيْتِهَا أَرْبَعاً أَفْضَلُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.241 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1130 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.340
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
Sa’ad narrated from Ahmad, from al-Husayn, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Abdur-Rahman ibn Abi
Abdillah, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “There is no harm in abandoning the Friday
prayer due to rain.”
text_ar:
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
سَعَدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ
السَّلاَمُ : «لَا بَأْسَ بِأنْ تَدَعَ الْجُمُعَةَ فِي الْمَطَرِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.241
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:

Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “There is no harm in abandoning the Friday

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muawiyah ibn Hakeem, from Abdillah ibn al-Mughirah,
from Dhareeh, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked if a man, needs to make up the Friday ghusl (ritual bath)?
(meaning to make it up as ‘qadha’)
Imam {a.s} said: “No.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ حُكَيْمِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ ذَرِيحِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
: فِي الرَّجُلِ هَلْ يَقْضِي غُسْلَ الْجُمُعَةِ قَالَ «لا».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.241 • Al-Wafi, Vol.6 p.394 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.321
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Saeed narrated from Fadalah, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said regarding the saying of Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic:
“Take your adornment at every place of worship” (Surah Al Araf 7:31)
Imam {a.s} said: “(it is regarding) On the two Eids and on Fridays.”
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ «خُذُوا زِينَتَكُمْ
عِندَ كُلٍّ مَسْجِدٍ» قَالَ «فِي الْعِيدَيْنِ وَ الْجُمُعَةِ».
cross_references: Tafsir Al-’Ayyashi, Vol.2 p.13 • Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.424 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.241 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1147 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.395 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.13 p.561 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.2 p.530 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.2 p.531 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.195 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.87 p.369

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
Ali narrated from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the Friday prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: “There is an adhan and an iqamah.
The (just) imam comes out after the adhan and ascends the pulpit and delivers the
sermon, and the people do not pray as long as the (just) imam is on the pulpit.
Then the (just) imam sits on the pulpit for the duration it takes to recite ‘Qul huwa
Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas),
then he stands and begins his sermon,
then he descends and leads the people in prayer.
Then he recites for them in the first rak‘ah Surah ‘al-Jumu‘ah’ and in the second
(rak’ah) Surah ‘al-Munafiqun’.”
text_ar:
عَلِيّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْثُهُ عَنِ الْجُمُعَةِ فَقَالَ «أَذَانْ وَ إِقَامَةٌ يَخْرُجُ ٱلْإِمَامُ
بَعْدَ الْأَذَانِ فَيَصْعَدُ ٱلْمِنْبَرَ فَيَخْطُبُ وَ لا يُصَلِّي النَّاسُ مَا دَامَ ٱلْإِمَامُ عَلَى ٱلْمِنْبَرِ ثُمَّ يَقْعُدُ ٱلْإِمَامُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ قَدْرَ مَا
يَقْرَأْ «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيَفْتَتِحُ خُطْبَتَهُ ثُمَّ يَنْزِلُ فَيْصَلِّي بِالنَّاسِ ثُمَّ يَقْرَأْ بِهِمْ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ ٱلْأُولَى بِالْجُمُعَةِ
وَ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ بِالْمُنَافِقِينَ ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.424 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.241 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1147 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.313 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.343

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one
of the two Imams {a.s}, peace be upon them:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said regarding a man who wants to recite Surah ‘al-Jumu‘ah’ on
Friday, but recites ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas).
Imam {a.s} said: “He should return to Surah al-Jumu‘ah.” (meaning it is preferred)
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنِ الْعَلَاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ : فِي الرَّجُلِ يُرِيدُ
أَنْ يَقْرَأَ سُورَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ فِي الْجُمُعَةِ فَيَقْرَأْ قُلْ هُوَ اللّهُ أَحَدٌ قَالَ «يَرْجِعُ إِلَى سُورَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.241 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.242 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1134 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.152
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Saeed narrated from Fadalah, from Husayn, from Ibn Muskan, and Muhammad ibn Sinan
from Ibn Muskan, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “If you begin your prayer with ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah
Ikhlas) while you intended to recite something else, then proceed with it and do not go
back except if it is on the day of Friday, then you return to Surah ‘al-Jumu‘ah’ and Surah
‘al-Munafiqun’ from it.”
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيّ عَنْ أَبِي
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «إِذَا اِفْتَتَحْتَ صَلاَتَكَ بِ «قُلْ هُوَ اللَهُ أَحَدٌ» وَ أَنتَ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَقْرَأَ بِغَيْرِهَا فَامْضِ فِيهَا وَ
لا تَرْجِع إِلَّ أَنْ تَكُونَ فِي يَوْمِ جُمُعَةٍ فَإِنَّكَ تَرْجِعُ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ وَ ٱلْمُنَافِقِينَ مِنْهَا».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.242 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1135 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.153
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Al-Husayn ibn Saeed narrated from Fadalah, from Husayn, from Ibn Muskan, and Muhammad ibn Sinan
from Ibn Muskan, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “If you begin your prayer with ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah
Ikhlas) while you intended to recite something else, then proceed with it and do not go

‘al-Munafiqun’ from it.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
From him, from Safwan, from Abdillah ibn Bukayr, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who intended to recite a
surah but began reciting another.
Imam {a.s} said: “Then let him return to the first surah, except if he recites ‘Qul huwa
Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas)’”
I asked: “A man performed the Friday prayer and intended to recite Surah ‘al-Jumu‘ah’
but recited ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas) instead.
Imam {a.s} said: “He should return to Surah al-Jumu‘ah.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ آللّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلامُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أَرَادَ أَنْ
يَقْرَأَ فِي سُورَةٍ فَأَخَذَ فِي أُخْرَى قَالَ «فَلْيَرْجِعْ إِلَى السُورَةِ الْأُولَى إِلاَّ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ بٍ «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» » قُلْتُ رَجُلٌ
صَلَّى الْجُمُعَةَ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ سُورَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَقَرَأَ «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» قَالَ «يَعُودُ إِلَى سُورَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.242 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.6 p.153
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
From him, from Safwan, from Abdillah ibn Bukayr, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who intended to recite a
surah but began reciting another.
Imam {a.s} said: “Then let him return to the first surah, except if he recites ‘Qul huwa
Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas)’”
I asked: “A man performed the Friday prayer and intended to recite Surah ‘al-Jumu‘ah’
but recited ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas) instead.
Imam {a.s} said: “He should return to Surah al-Jumu‘ah.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
And from him, from Safwan, from al-Ala, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two (Imams {a.s}):
Imam {a.s} said regarding a man who wants to recite Surah al-Jumu‘ah in the Friday
prayer but recites ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas).
Imam {a.s} said: “He should return to Surah al-Jumu‘ah.”
text_ar:
وعنه عن صفوان عن العلا عن محمد بن مسلم عن أحدهما عليه السلام في الرجل يريد أن يقرأ في الجمعة
بالجمعة فيقرأ بقل هو اللّٰه احد قال : يرجع إلى سورة الجمعة.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.242
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
Sa’ad narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah
{a.s}, peace be upon him:
I (Abdillah ibn Sinan) heard Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} say:
“In the Friday prayer, there is no harm in reciting other than Surah ‘al-Jumu‘ah’ and
Surah ‘al-Munafiqun’, if you are in a hurry.”
text_ar:
سَعدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفَوَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلَاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ:
«فِي صَلاَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ لا بَأْسَ أَنْ تَقْرَأ فِيهَا بِغَيْرِ الْجُمُعَةِ وَ الْمُنَافِقِينَ إِذَا كُنْتَ مُسْتَعْجِلاً».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.416 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.242
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Muawiyah ibn Hakeem, from Aban, from Yahya al-Azraq, the seller of
al-Sabiri, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, and said:
“A man performed the Friday prayer and recited ‘Sabbih isma rabbika’ (Surah Al A'la)
and ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas).
Imam {a.s} said: “It sufficed him.”
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ حُكَيْمٍ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ يَحْيَى الْأَزْرَقِ بَيَّاعِ السَّابِرِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أُبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ قُلْتُ رَجُلٌ صَلَّى الْجُمُعَةَ فَقَرَاً «سَبِّحِ اِسْمَ رَبِّكَ» وَ «قُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ» قَالَ «أَجْزَأَهُ».

source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Saeed narrated from al-Hasan, from Zur’ah, from Sama’ah, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “It is befitting for the Imam who delivers the
sermon to the people, on the day of Friday, to wear a turban in both winter and
summer, and to drape himself with a Yemeni or Adani cloak.
And he should deliver the sermon while standing, praising Allah {SWT} and extolling Him
{AZJ}, then advising with the fear of Allah {SWT}, then reciting a surah from the Quran, then
he sits.
Then he stands and praises Allah {SWT} and extols Him {AZJ}, and sends blessings upon
Muhammad {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, and upon the Imams {a.s} of
the Muslims, and seeks forgiveness for the believing men and believing women.
When he finishes this, the mu’adhdhin stands and gives the iqamah, then he leads the
people in two rak‘ahs, reciting in the first with Surah ‘al-Jumu‘ah’ and in the second
(rak’ah) with Surah ‘al-Munafiqun’.
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ : «يَنْبَغِي لِلْإِمَامِ الَّذِي
يَخْطُبُ بِالنَّاسِ - يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ أَنْ يَلْبَسَ عِمَامَةً فِي الشَّتَاءِ وَ الصِّيْفِ وَ يَتَرَدَّى بِبُرْدِ يَمَنِيَّةِ أَوْ عَدَنِيٍّ وَ يَخْطُبُ وَ
هُوَ قَائِمٌ يَحْمَدُ اللّهَ وَ يُثْنِي عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُوصِي بِتَقْوَى اللّهِ ثُمَّ يَقْرَأْ سُورَةً مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ قَصِيرَةً ثُمَّ يَجْلِسُ ثُمَّ يَقُومُ
فَيَحْمَدُ اللَّهَ وَ يُثُنِي عَلَيْهِ وَ يُصَلِّي عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ عَلَى أَئِمَّةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَ يَسْتَغْفِرُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ
الْمُوْمِنَاتِ فَإِذَا فَرَغَ مِنْ هَذَا قَامَ ٱلْمُؤَذِّنُ فَأَقَامَ فَصَلَّى بِالنَّاسِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ يَقْرَأَ فِي الْأُولَى بِسُورَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ وَ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ
بِسُورَةٍ الْمُنَافِقِينَ ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.421 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.243 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1145

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
Ali narrated from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from al-Halabi, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s} about one who did not catch the sermon on the day of Friday.
Imam {a.s} said: “He should pray two rak‘ahs. But if he misses the prayer and does not
catch it, then let him pray four (rak’ah).”
And Imam {a.s} said: “If you catch the Imam before he bows in the last rak‘ah, then you
have caught the prayer. But if you catch him after he has bowed, then it is the Dhuhr
prayer, (which is) four rak‘ahs.”
text_ar:
علي عن ابيه عن ابن ابي عمير عن حماد بن عثمان عن الحلبي قال سألت ابا عبد اللّه عليه السلام : عمن لم
يدرك الخطبة يوم الجمعة فقال : يصلي ركعتين فان فاتته الصلاة فلم يدركها فليصل اربعا، وقال : إذا أدركت
الامام قبل أن يركع الركعة الاخيرة فقد ادركت الصلاة، فان انت ادركته بعد ما ركع فهي الظهر اربع.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.243
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Saeed narrated from al-Qasim, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abu Basir and Abu al-Abbas al-
Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “If a man catches one rak‘ah, then he has caught the Friday
prayer. But if he misses it, then let him pray four (rak’ahs of Dhuhr instead).”
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ وَ أَبِي الْعَبَّاسِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ
اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا أَدْرَكَ الرَّجُلُ رَكْعَةً فَقَدْ أَدْرَكَ الْجُمُعَةَ وَ إِنْ فَاتَثهُ فَلْيُصَلِّ أَرْبَعا».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.418 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.243 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.422 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1159 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.345 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.346

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Saeed from Fadalah, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace
be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The Friday prayer is not valid except for the one who catches
both sermons.”

Scholar's Note:
So the meaning in this narration is that the virtuous and complete Friday prayer is only
for the one, who catches both sermons.
And what confirms what we have presented is what was narrated:
text_ar:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةً عَنِ إِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السّلامُ قَالَ: «الْجُمُعَةُ لا تَكُونُ إِلا
لِمَنْ أُدْرَكَ الْخُطْبَتَيْنِ».
فالمعنى في هذا الخبر انه لا تكون جمعة فاضلة كاملة إلا لمن أدرك الخطبتين، والذي يؤكد ما قدمناه ما رواه:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abdur-Rahman al-Arzami, from Abu Abdillah
{a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “If you catch the Imam on the day of Friday and he has
preceded you by one rak‘ah, then add to it another rak‘ah and recite aloud in it.
But if you catch him while he is reciting the tashahhud, then pray four rak‘ahs (of
Dhuhr).”
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْن مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْعَرْزَمِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا أَدْرَكْتَ
الْإِمَامَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَ قَدْ سَبَقَكَ بِرَكْعَةٍ فَأَضِف إِلَيْهَا رَكْعَةً أُخْرَى وَ اِجْهَزْ فِيهَا فَإِنْ أَدْرَكْتَهُ وَ هُوَ يَتَشَهَدُ فَصَلِّ
أزبَعاً».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.244 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.422 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1160 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.346
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
Abu Ali al-Ash‘ari narrated from Muhammad ibn Salim, from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr, from Amr ibn Shimr, from
Jabir, who said:
Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, used to go early to the mosque on the day of Friday,
when the sun had risen to the height of a spear.
But if it was the Month of Ramadan, Imam {a.s} would go earlier than that, and He {a.s}
used to say: “Indeed, the Fridays of the Month of Ramadan have a superiority over the
Fridays of the other months, just as the Month of Ramadan has a superiority over the
other months.”
text_ar:
أَبُو عَلِيَّ الْأَشعَرِي عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شِمْرٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ: كَانَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ يُبَكَّرُ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ حِينَ تَكُونُ الشَّمْسُ قِيدَ رُمْحِ فَإِذَا كَانَ شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ يَكُونُ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ وَ كَانَ
يَقُولُ «إِنَّ لِجُمَعِ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ عَلَى جُمَعِ سَائِرِ الشُّهُورِ فَضْلاً كَفَضْلٍ شَهْرٍ رَمَضَانَ عَلَى سَائِرِ الشُّهُورِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.429 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.244 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1113 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.348
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}

other months.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from Muhammad ibn Abi al-Suhban, from Abdur-Rahman ibn Abi
Najran, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Qasri, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “I fear that we may be performing the
Friday prayer before the sun has passed the zenith.”
So Imam {a.s} said: “This is upon the mu’adhdhins.”
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي الصُّهْبَانِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ
مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدِ الْقَسْرِيِّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ إِنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ نَكُونَ نُصَلِّي الْجُمُعَةَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَزُولَ
الشَّمْسُ قَالَ فَقَالَ «إِنَّمَا هَذَا عَلَى الْمُؤَذِّنِينَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.244 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1112 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.79 p.357

عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ قَالَ: «مِنَ السُّنَّةِ إِذَا صَعِدَ الْإِمَامُ الْمِنْبَرَ أَنْ يُسَلَّمَ إِذَا اِسْتَقْبَلَ النَّاسَ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
From him, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Ja’far ibn Muhammad, from Abdillah ibn Maymun, from Imam Ja’far
{a.s}, from his father {a.s}, peace be upon them both, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, when He {saws} went out for the Friday prayer, would sit on the pulpit until the
mu’adhdhins finished.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَيْمُونِ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «كَانَ
رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ إِذَا خَرَجَ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ قَعَدَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ حَتَّى يَفْرُغَ الْمُؤْذِّنُونَ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
From him, from al-Abbas, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Rib‘i, from Umar ibn Yazid, from Abu Abdillah {a.s},
peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “If there are seven people on the day of Friday, then let them
pray in congregation.
And let him (the ‘just’ imam) wear the cloak and the turban,
And lean on a bow or a staff,
And let him (the ‘just’ imam) sit between the two sermons,
And recite aloud,
And perform qunut in the first rak‘ah, of them before the bowing.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ رِبْعِيّ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا كَانُوا
سَبْعَةً يَوْمَ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ فَلْيْصَلُوا فِي جَمَاعَةٍ وَ لَيَلْبَسِ الْبُرْدَ وَ الْعِمَامَةَ وَ يَتَوَكَأُ عَلَى قَوْسِ أَوْ عَصًا وَ لَيَقْعُذْ قَعْدَةً بَيْنَ
اَلْخُطَبَتَيْنِ وَ يَجْهَرُ بِالْقِرَاءَةِ وَ يَقْنُتُ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الْأُولَى مِنْهُمَا قَبْلَ الرُكُوعِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.245 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1124 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.313
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

From him, from al-Abbas, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Rib‘i, from Umar ibn Yazid, from Abu Abdillah {a.s},

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Saeed narrated from al-Hasan, from Zur’ah, from Sama’ah, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the qunut in the Friday prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: “As for the (just) imam, upon him is the qunut in the first rak‘ah after he
finishes the recitation, before he bows;
And in the second, after he raises his head from the bowing, before the prostration.
And indeed, the Friday prayer with the (just) imam is two rak‘ahs.
So whoever prays without an (just) imam, alone, then it is four rak‘ahs like the Dhuhr
prayer.
So whoever wishes, may perform qunut in the second rak‘ah before bowing, and if he
wishes, he may not perform qunut and that is if he prays alone.”
text_ar:
اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةً عَنْ سَمَاعَةً قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلْقُنُوتِ فِي الْجُمُعَةِ فَقَالَ «أَمَّا ٱلْإِمَامُ فَعَلَيْهِ
الْقُنُوتُ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الْأُولَى بَعْدَ مَا يَفْرُغُ مِنَ الْقِرَاءَةِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ وَ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ بَعْدَ مَا يَرْفَعُ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ قَبْلَ
اَلسَّجْودِ وَ إِنَّمَا صَلاَةُ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ مَعَ الْإِمَامِ رَكْعَتَانٍ فَمَنْ صَلَّى مِنْ غَيْرِ إِمَامٍ وَحْدَهُ فَهِيَ أَرْبَعُ رَكَعَاتٍ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الظُّهْرِ
فَمَنْ شَاءَ قَنَتَ فِي الرَّكْعَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ قَبْلَ أنْ يَرْكَعَ وَ إِنْ شَاءَ لَمْ يَقْنُتْ وَ ذَلِكَ إِذَا صَلَّى وَحْدَهُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.245 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1143

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Saeed narrated from al-Nadr, from Musa ibn Bakr, from Zurarah, from Umar ibn Hanzalah,
from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The voluntary prayer on the day of Friday, if you wish, from the
beginning of the day and whatever you intend to pray on the day of Friday.
If you wish, hasten it and pray it from the beginning of the day, whichever part of the
day you wish, before the sun passes the zenith.”
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بَنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ بَكْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ حَنْظَلَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ:
«صَلاَةُ اَلتَطَوْعِ يَوْمَ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ إِنْ شِئْتَ مِنْ أَوْلِ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَ مَا تُرِيدُ أَنْ تُصَلَّيَهُ يَوْمَ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ فَإِنْ شِئْتَ عَجِّلْتَهُ فَصَلَّيْتَهُ
مِنْ أَوَّلِ النَّهَارِ أَيَّ النَّهَارِ شِئْتَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَزُولَ الشَّمْسُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.245 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.413 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1104 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.324
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
Ahmad narrated from al-Husayn, from al-Nadr, from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah, from Sa’id al-A‘raj, said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the nafilah (supererogatory prayer)
on the day of Friday.
Imam {a.s} said: “Sixteen rak‘ahs before Asr.”
Then Imam {a.s} said: “And Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, used to say:
‘Whatever is added is good.’”
And Imam {a.s} said: “If a man wishes, he may perform six rak‘ahs at the beginning of
the day, and six rak‘ahs at midday,
then pray Dhuhr and along with it four rak‘ahs, then pray Asr.”
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنْ سَعِيدِ الْأَعْرَجِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ -
عَنْ صَلاَةِ النَّافِلَةِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَقَالَ «سِتَّ عَشرَةَ رَكْعَةً قَبْلَ الْعَصْرِ» ثُمَّ قَالَ »وَ كَانَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ «مَا
زَادَ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ»» وَ قَالَ «إِنْ شَاءَ رَجُلٌ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ مِنْهَا سِنَّ رَكَعَاتٍ فِي صَدْرِ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَ سِتَّ رَكَعَاتٍ نِصْفَ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَ
يُصَلِّي الظُّهْرَ وَ يُصَلِّي مَعَهَا أَرْبَعَةً ثُمَّ يُصَلِّي الْعَصْرَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.245 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.413 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1102 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.323
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Muhammad ibn Abdillah,
who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, about voluntary prayer on day of Friday.
Imam {a.s} said: “Six rak‘ahs at the beginning of the day,
six rak‘ahs before the zenith,
two rak‘ahs when the sun passes the zenith,
and six rak‘ahs after the Friday prayer so that is twenty rak‘ahs, besides the obligatory
prayer.”
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ
التَّطَوْعِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَقَالَ «سِتّ رَكَعَاتٍ فِي صَدْرِ النَّهَارِ وَ سِتُّ رَكَعَاتٍ قَبْلَ الزَّوَالِ وَ رَكْعَتَانِ إِذَا زَالَتْ وَ سِتُّ
رَكَعَاتٍ بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ فَذَلِكَ عِشرُونَ رَكْعَةً سِوَى الْفَرِيضَةِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.246 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.410 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1103 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.323
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
text_chunk:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
From him, from al-Barqi, from Sa’ad ibn Sa’ad al-Ash‘ari, from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha {a.s}, who said:
I asked Imam al-Ridha {a.s} about the prayer on the day of Friday, how many rak‘ahs are
there before the zenith?
Imam {a.s} said: “Six rak‘ahs early, and six rak‘ahs after that; that makes twelve rak‘ahs.
And six rak‘ahs after that; that makes eighteen rak‘ahs, And two rak‘ahs after the
meridian; that makes twenty rak‘ahs.
And two rak‘ahs after Asr; and that makes twenty-two rak‘ahs.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْبَرْقِيِّ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ سَعْدِ الْأَشعَرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الصَّلاةِ يَوْمَ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ كَمْ رَكْعَةً
هِيَ قَبْلَ الزَّوَالِ قَالَ «سِتُّ رَكَعَاتٍ بُكْرَةً وَ سِتُّ رَكَعَاتٍ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ اِثْنَتَا عَشَرَةَ رَكْعَةً وَ سِتُّ رَكَعَاتٍ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ ثَمَانِيَ
عَشَرَةَ رَكْعَةً وَ رَكْعَتَانِ بَعْدَ ٱلزَّوَالِ فَهَذِهِ عِشَرُونَ رَكْعَةُ وَ رَكْعَتَانِ بَعْدَ ٱلْعَصْرِ فَهَذِهِ ثِنْتَانٍ وَ عِشْرُونَ رَكْعَةُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.246 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.411 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1103 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.323
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
text_chunk:
From him, from al-Barqi, from Sa’ad ibn Sa’ad al-Ash‘ari, from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha {a.s}, who said:
I asked Imam al-Ridha {a.s} about the prayer on the day of Friday, how many rak‘ahs are
there before the zenith?
Imam {a.s} said: “Six rak‘ahs early, and six rak‘ahs after that; that makes twelve rak‘ahs.
And six rak‘ahs after that; that makes eighteen rak‘ahs, And two rak‘ahs after the
meridian; that makes twenty rak‘ahs.
And two rak‘ahs after Asr; and that makes twenty-two rak‘ahs.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Ismail, from Ali ibn al-Nu‘man, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, from Uqbah ibn
Musab, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, and said: “Which is better, that I perform
the rak‘ahs on the day of Friday before the obligatory prayer, or that I perform them
after the obligatory prayer?”
Imam {a.s} said: “No, rather perform them after the obligatory prayer.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ النَّعْمَانِ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ مُصْعَبِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ
اللّهِ عَ فَقُلْتُ أَيُّمَا أَفْضَلُ أُقَدَّمُ الرَّكَعَاتِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ أَوْ أُصَلِّيهَا بَعْدَ الْفَرِيضَةِ فَقَالَ «لا بَل تُصَلِّيهَا بَعْدَ الْفَرِيضَةِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.246 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.411 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1103 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.328
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
Ahmad narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Sayf ibn Umayrah, from Abu Bakr al-Hadrami, who said:
I said to Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him: “What do you do on the day of Friday?”
Imam {a.s} said: “What do you do?”
I said: “I pray in my home, then I go out and pray with them.”
Imam {a.s} said: “That is what I do as well.”
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ كَيْفَ
تَصْنَعُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ قَالَ «كَيْفَ تَصْنَعُ أَنتَ» قُلْتُ أُصَلِّي فِي مَنْزِلِي ثُمَّ أَخْرُجْ فَأَصَلِّي مَعَهُمْ قَالَ «كَذَلِكَ أَصْنَعُ أَنا».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.246 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1216 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.350
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
From him, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin, from his brother al-Husayn, from Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the nafilah that is prayed on the
day of Friday, at the time of the obligatory prayer, whether it is better before the Friday
prayer or after it.
Imam {a.s} said: “Before the prayer.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينِ عَنْ أَخِيهِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ
عَنِ النَّافِلَةِ الَّتِي تُصَلَّى فِي يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ وَقْتَ ٱلْفَرِيضَةِ قَبْلَ الْجُمُعَةِ أَفْضَلُ أَوْ بَعْدَهَا قَالَ «قَبْلَ الصَّلاةِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.246 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.322
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
text_chunk:
From him, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin, from his brother al-Husayn, from Ali ibn Yaqtin, who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the nafilah that is prayed on the
day of Friday, at the time of the obligatory prayer, whether it is better before the Friday
prayer or after it.
Imam {a.s} said: “Before the prayer.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
And from him, Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} said:
“Pray on the day of Friday, ten rak‘ahs before the prayer, and ten rak‘ahs after it.”
text_ar: وَ عَنْهُ قَالَ: «صَلِّ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ عَشْرَ رَكَعَاتٍ قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ وَ عَشْرَ رَكَعَاتٍ بَعْدَهَا».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.247 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1104 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.322
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
text_chunk:
And from him, Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} said:
“Pray on the day of Friday, ten rak‘ahs before the prayer, and ten rak‘ahs after it.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from
Imam Ja’far {a.s}, from his father {a.s}, from his forefathers {a.s}, peace be upon them, who said:
Imam {a.s} said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family,
said: ‘If you see an old man narrating the stories of ‘the Age of Ignorance’ in the
mosque on the day of Friday, then strike his head, even if it is with pebbles.’”
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ إبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمِ عَنِ النَّوْفَلِيّ عَنِ السّكُونِيّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «إِذَا رَأَيْثُمُ الشَّيْخَ يُحَدِّثُ يَوْمَ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ فِي ٱلْمَسْجِدِ بِأَحَادِيثِ
الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَارْمُوا رَأْسَهُ وَ لَوْ بالحَصَّى».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.423 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.247 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1090 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.401
source_scholar: Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Amr ibn Saeed, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar
ibn Musa, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about a man who catches the (just) imam while he is praying
four rak‘ahs, and the (just) imam has already prayed two rak‘ahs.
Imam {a.s} said: “He should begin the prayer and join with him, and recite behind him in
the two rak‘ahs.
He should recite in the first, ‘al-Hamd’ and whatever he catches from ‘Surah al-
Jumu‘ah’, and bow with the (just) imam;
and in the second, ‘al-Hamd’ and whatever he catches from ‘Surah al-Munafiqun’, and
bow with the (just) imam.
When the (just) imam sits for the tashahhud, he should not recite the tashahhud but
should instead glorify (tasbih),
and when the (just) imam says the taslim, he should stand and pray two rak‘ahs, in
which he glorifies (tasbih), then recites the tashahhud and gives the taslim.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقٍ بْنِ صَدَقَةً عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ
اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُذْرِكُ الْإِمَامَ وَ هُوَ يُصَلِّي أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ وَ قَدْ صَلَّى الْإِمَامُ رَكَعَتَيْنِ قَالَ
«يَفْتَتِحُ الصَّلاةَ وَ يَدْخُلُ مَعَهُ وَ يَقْرَأَ خَلْفَهُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ يَقْرَأَ فِي الْأُولَى الْحَمْدَ وَ مَا أَدْرَكَ مِنْ سُورَةِ الْجُمُعَةِ وَ
يَرْكَعُ مَعَ الْإِمَامِ وَ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ الْحَمْدَ وَ مَا أَدْرَكَ مِنْ سُورَةِ ٱلْمُنَافِقِينَ وَ يَرْكَعُ مَعَ ٱلْإِمَامِ فَإِذَا قَعَدَ ٱلْإِمَامُ لِلتَشَهْدِ فَلا
يَتَشَهَدْ وَ لَكِنْ يُسَبَّحُ فَإِذَا سَلَّمَ ٱلْإِمَامُ رَكَعَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ يُسَبَّحُ فِيهِمَا وَ يَتَشَهَدُ وَ يُسَلَّمُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.247 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1136 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.350
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
From him, from Abu Ja’far, from his father, from Wahb, from Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, that Imam Ali {a.s},
peace be upon him, used to say:
Imam Ali {a.s} said: “To miss attending the Eid al-Adha, ten times, is more beloved to me
than to miss attending the Friday prayer, (even) once, without an excuse.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ وَهْبٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ كَانَ يَقُولُ: «لَأَنْ أَدَعَ شُهُودَ
حُضُورِ الْأَضْحَى عَشَرَ مَرَّاتِ أَحَبٌ إلَيْ مِنْ أَنْ أَدَعَ شُهُودَ حُضُورِ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةَ مِنْ غَيْرٍ عِلَّةِ».
cross_references: Qurb Al-Isnad, Vol.1 p.153 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.247 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1115 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.300 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.101 p.316
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
From him, from al-Amraki, from Ali ibn Ja’far, from his brother Imam Musa {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} about the two rak‘ahs of midday (al-zawal) on the day of
Friday, Are they before the adhan or after it?
Imam {a.s} said: “Before the adhan.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَكْعَتَيِ ٱلزَّوَالِ يَوْمَ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ
قَبْلَ الْأَذَانِ أَوْ بَعْدَهُ قَالَ «قَبْلَ الْأَذَانِ ».
cross_references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.245 • Qurb Al-Isnad, Vol.1 p.214 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.247 • Al-Sarair, Vol.3 p.573 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1105 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.322 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.326 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.86 p.209 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.6 p.21
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}
text_chunk:
From him, from al-Amraki, from Ali ibn Ja’far, from his brother Imam Musa {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} about the two rak‘ahs of midday (al-zawal) on the day of
Friday, Are they before the adhan or after it?
Imam {a.s} said: “Before the adhan.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
From him, from Abu Ja’far, from his father, from Zur’ah, from Sama’ah, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, from his father
{a.s}, from Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam Ali {a.s} was asked about a man who is in the middle of a crowd, on the day of
Friday or the day of Arafah, and he experiences a hadath (state of ritual impurity) or
remembers that he is not in a state of wudu.
And he is unable to leave due to the intensity of the crowd.
Imam {a.s} said: “He should perform tayammum and pray with them, and repeat the
prayer when he returns.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ زُرْعَةً عَنْ سَمَاعَةً عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ آللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ - عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ : أَنَّهُ سُيْلَ عَنْ
رَجْلٍ يَكُون وَسْطَ الزِّحَامِ - يَوْمَ ٱلْجُمُعَةِ أَوْ يَوْمَ عَرَفَةَ فَأَحْدَتَ أَوْ ذَكَرَ أَنَّهُ عَلَى غَيْرِ وُضُوءٍ وَ لا يَسْتَطِيعُ الْخُرُوجَ
مِنْ كَثِرَةِ الزِّحَامِ قَالَ «يَتَيَمَّمُ وَ يُصَلِّي مَعَهُمْ وَ يُعِيدُ إِذَا هُوَ اِنْصَرَقَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.248 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1274 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.371
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}

From him, from Abu Ja’far, from his father, from Zur’ah, from Sama’ah, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, from his father

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
From him, from Abu Ja’far, from his father, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from Imam Ja’far {a.s}, from his father {a.s},
peace be upon them both, who said:
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no Friday prayer (Jumu'ah) upon the people of the villages, nor
any going out on the two Eids.”

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “The meaning of this report is that if they are at a
distance of more than two farsakhs, then attendance is not obligatory upon them,
rather they have a choice in the matter.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاتٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا السِّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «لَيْسَ عَلَى أَهْلِ ٱلْقُرَى
جُمُعَةٌ وَ لاَ خُرُوجٌ فِي الْعِيدَيْنِ ».
قال محمد بن الحسن: معنى هذا الخبر انهم إذا كانوا على اكثر من فرسخين ليس عليهم حضور بل هم مخيرون في ذلك.
commentary:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “The meaning of this report is that if they are at a
distance of more than two farsakhs, then attendance is not obligatory upon them,
rather they have a choice in the matter.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE DEEDS TO BE ATTAINED ON NIGHT OF FRIDAY AND ITS DAY
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sulayman,
from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: “About a man who is in the mosque,
either on the day of Jumu'ah or on other days, and the people press him; either towards
a wall or towards a pillar, and he is not able to bow (ruku) or prostrate (sujud) until the
people raise their heads.
So is it permissible for him to bow and prostrate alone and then align himself with the
people in the row?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, there is no harm in that.”
AND ITS RULINGS
AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER AND ITS RULINGS
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَجَّاجِ قَالَ:
سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونْ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ إِمَّا فِي يَوْمِ جُمُعَةِ وَ إِمَّا غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ مِنَ الْأَيَامِ فَيَزْحَمُهُ
النَّاسُ إِمَّا إِلَى حَائِطِ وَ إِمَّا إِلَى أَسْطُوَانَةٍ فَلَا يَقْدِرُ عَلَى أَنْ يَرْكَعَ وَ لا يَسْجُدَ حَتَّى يَرْفَعَ النَّاسُ رُءُوسَهُمْ فَهَلْ
يَجُوزُ لَهُ أَنْ يَرْكَعَ وَ يَسْجُدَ وَحْدَهُ ثُمَّ يَسْتَوِيَ مَعَ النَّاسِ فِي الصِّفَّ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ لا بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ».
٢٥ - باب فضل المساجد والصلاة فيها وفضل الجماعة وأحكامها

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM,
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from Ibn Abi Umayr from Ibrahim ibn Abd al-Hamid
from Sa’ad al-Iskaf from Ziyad ibn Isa from Abu al-Jarud from al-Asbagh from Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib {a.s},
peace be upon him:
Imam Ali {a.s} used to say: “Whoever frequents the mosque will attain one of eight
things;
a brother benefitted in Allah {SWT}, or newly acquired knowledge, or a decisive verse, or
hears a word that guides him to guidance, or a mercy awaited, or a word that repels
him from destruction, or he leaves a sin out of fear, or out of shame.”
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ عَنْ سَعْدِ الْإِسْكَافِ
عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَبِي الْجَارُودِ عَنِ الْأَصْبَعِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ كَانَ يَقُولُ: «مَنِ اِخْتَلَفَ
إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ أَصَابَ إِحْدَى الثَّمَانِ أَخاً مُسْتَفَاداً فِي اللّهِ أَوْ عِلْماً مُسْتَطْرَفاً أَوْ آيَةً مُحْكَمَةً أَوْ سَمِعَ كَلِمَةً تَدُلُّهُ عَلَى
هُدى أَوْ رَحْمَةً مُنْتَظَرَةً أَوْ كَلِمَةً تَرُدُّهُ عَنْ رَدَّى أَوْ يَثَرُكُ ذَنْباً خَشيَةً أَوْ حَيَاءَ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.237 • Thawab Al-A’mal wa ‘Iqab Al-A’mal, Vol.1 p.27 • Al-Khisal, Vol.2 p.409 • Al-Amali (Lil-Saduq), Vol.1 p.389 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.248 • Al-Amali (Lil-Tusi), Vol.1 p.432 • Rawdat Al-Wa’izin, Vol.2 p.338 • Falah Al-Sa’il, Vol.1 p.90 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.1 p.407 • Al- Misbah (Lil-Kaf’ami), Vol.1 p.13

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM,
text_en:
And from him, from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashshab, from Ali ibn Asbat, from some of his men, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said:
“Keep your mosques free from; trade and buying and selling, and the insane, and
children, and legal judgments, and lost property, and the carrying out of punishments,
and raising the voice.”
AND ITS RULINGS
text_ar:
وَعَنْهُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُوسَى الْخَشَابِ عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ أَسْبَاطِ عَنْ بَعْضِ رِجَالِهِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ :
«جَنّبُوا مَسَاجِدَكُمُ الْبَيْعَ وَ الشَّرَاءَ وَ ٱلْمَجَانِينَ وَ الصِّبْيَانَ وَ ٱلْأَحْكَامَ وَ الضَّالَةَ وَ الْحُدُودَ وَ رَفْعَ الصَّوْتِ».
cross_references: Al-Khisal, Vol.2 p.410 • ‘Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.319 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.249 • Al- Wafi, Vol.7 p.506 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.233 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.362

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
text_en:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Hashimi, from al-Amraki, from Ali ibn Ja’far, from his brother
Imam Musa {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} about poetry, is it proper for it to be recited in the mosque?
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no harm.”
And I asked Imam {a.s} about a lost item, is it proper for it to be announced in the
mosque?
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no harm.”

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “So there is no contradiction between the two reports,
because the first report is to be understood as indicating a type of dislike (karaha)
rather than prohibition (hazr), and the other is to be understood as indicating
permissibility (jawaz).”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ الْهَاشِمِيَّ عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيَّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ
الشِّعْرِ أَ يَصْلُحُ أَنْ يُنْشَدَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ» وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الضَّالَّةِ أَيَصْلُحُ أَنْ تُنْشَدَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ قَالَ «لا
بَأْسَ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : فلا تنافى بين الخبرين لان الخبر الاول محمول على ضرب من الكراهية دون الحظر والاخر محمول
على الجواز.
commentary:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “So there is no contradiction between the two reports,
because the first report is to be understood as indicating a type of dislike (karaha)
rather than prohibition (hazr), and the other is to be understood as indicating
permissibility (jawaz).”
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.249 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.506
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Hassan al-Razi from Abu Muhammad al-Razi from Isma'il ibn
Abi Abdillah {a.s} from his father {a.s}, peace be upon them both, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, said:
‘Reclining in the mosque is the monasticism (‘rahbaniyyah’) of the Arabs, and the
mosque is the gathering place for the believer, and his monastery (‘sawm'ah’) is his
house.’”
AND ITS RULINGS
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ الرَّازِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي مُحَمَّدِ الرَّازِيِّ عَنْ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِمَا
السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «الإِتَّكَاءُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ رَهْبَانِيَّةُ اَلْعَرَبِ وَ الْمُؤْمِنُ مَجْلِسُهُ مَسْجِدُهُ
وَ صَوْمَعَتُهُ بَيْتُهُ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ibrahim ibn Hashim from Amr ibn Uthman from Muhammad ibn Udhafir
from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “In Kufah, there are cursed mosques and blessed mosques.
As for the blessed; the ‘Mosque of Ghani’. By Allah, its qiblah is upright, and its soil is
pure, and it was established by a believing man. And the world will not end until two
springs burst forth at it, and there will be two gardens upon it. But its people are
cursed, and it has been taken away from them.
And the mosque of ‘Banu Zafar’, and that is the ‘Mosque of al-Sahlah’, and the
‘Mosque of al-Hamra’, and the ‘Mosque of Ju‘fi’ and it is not their mosque today, (and
It has disappeared.)”
Imam {a.s} said: “As for the cursed mosques; the ‘Mosque of Thaqif’, the ‘Mosque of al-
Ash‘ath’, the ‘Mosque of Jarir ibn Abdillah al-Bajali’, the ‘Mosque of Simak’, and the
‘Mosque of al-Hamra’, it was built over the grave of a Pharaoh from among the
Pharaohs.”
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُذَافِرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ بْنِ مُسْلِهِ
عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: « بِالْكُوفَةِ مَسَاجِدُ مَلْعُونَةٌ وَ مَسَاجِدُ مُبَارَكَةٌ فَأَمَّا الْمُبَارَكَةُ فَمَسْجِدُ غَنِيٍّ وَ اللّهِ
إِنَّ قِبْلَتَهُ لَقَاسِطَةٌ وَ إِنَّ طِينَتَهُ لَطَيِّبَةٌ وَ لَقَدْ وَضَعَهُ رَجُلُ مُؤْمِنْ وَ لا تَذْهَبُ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَتَّى تَنْفَجِرَ عِنْدَهُ عَيْنَانٍ وَ تَكُونَ
عَلَيْهِ جَنَّتَانٍ وَ أَهْلُهُ مَلْعُونُونَ وَ هُوَ مَسْلُوبٌ مِنْهُمْ وَ مَسْجِدُ بَنِي ظَفَرِ وَ هُوَ مَسْجِدُ ٱلسَّهَلَةِ وَ مَسْجِدُ ٱلْحَمْرَاءِ وَ
مَسْجِدُ جُعْفِيَّ وَ لَيْسَ هُوَ مَسْجِدَهُمُ ٱليَوْمَ» قَالَ «دَرَسَ وَ أَمّا ٱلْمَسَاجِدُ ٱلْمَلْعُونَةُ فَمَسْجِدُ تَقِيفٍ وَ مَسْجِدُ الْأَشعَبِ
وَ مَسْجِدُ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ الْبَجَلِيِّ وَ مَسْجِدُ سِمَاكِ وَ مَسْجِدُ الْحَمْرَاءِ بُنِيَ عَلَى قَبْرِ فِرْعَوْنٍ مِنَ ٱلْفَرَاعِنَةِ».
cross_references: Al-Khisal, Vol.1 p.300 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.249 • Rawdat Al-Wa’izin, Vol.2 p.336 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.97 p.437 • Mustadrak Al-Wasa’il, Vol.3 p.397

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha from Imam al-
Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Ridha {a.s} about the prayer in the ‘Sacred Mosque’ (al-Masjid al-
Haram) and the prayer in the ‘Mosque of the Messenger’, may Allah {SWT} bless him and
his family, are they equal in virtue?
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, and the prayer in between them equals one thousand prayers.”
AND ITS RULINGS
text_ar:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ الْوَشَّاءِ عَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ وَ الصَّلاَةِ فِي مَسْجِدِ الرّسُولِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فِي الْفَضْلِ سَوَاءً قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ
الصَّلَاَةُ فِيمَا بَيْنَهُمَا تَعْدِلُ أَلْفَ صَلاةٍ».

text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha from Imam al-
Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Ridha {a.s} about the prayer in the ‘Sacred Mosque’ (al-Masjid al-
Haram) and the prayer in the ‘Mosque of the Messenger’, may Allah {SWT} bless him and
his family, are they equal in virtue?
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, and the prayer in between them equals one thousand prayers.”

text_en:
Muhammad ibn Yahya from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abdillah from Sulayman ibn Hisham from Salim from Abu
Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “Four mosques in Kufah were renovated out of joy for the killing
of Imam al-Husayn {a.s}, peace be upon him;
the ‘Mosque of al-Ash'ath’,
the ‘Mosque of Jarir’,
the ‘Mosque of Simak’,
and the ‘Mosque of Shabath ibn Rib'i’. May Allah {SWT} curse them.”
(meaning may Allah {SWT} curse those involved in the killing of Imam al-Husayn {a.s}, those
who renovated these ‘mosques’ out of joy for killing Imam al-Husayn {a.s})
AND ITS RULINGS
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ هِشَامٍ عَنْ سَالِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَاَمُ
قَالَ: «جُدِّدَتْ أَرْبَعَةُ مَسَاجِدَ بِالْكُوفَةِ فَرَحاً لِقَثلِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ - مَسْجِدُ الْأَشَعَتِ وَ مَسْجِدُ جَرِيرٍ وَ مَسْجِدُ
سِمَاكٍ وَ مَسْجِدُ شَبَتِ بْنِ رِبْعِيَّ لَعَنَهُمُ آَللَّهُ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
text_en:
Sahl ibn Ziyad from Amr ibn Uthman from Muhammad ibn Abdillah al-Khazzaz from Harun ibn Kharijah from
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said to me:
“O Harun ibn Kharijah, how far is it between you and the ‘Mosque of Kufa’? Is it a mile?”
I said: “No”.
Imam {a.s} said: “Then do you perform all the prayers in it?”
I said: “No”.
So Imam {a.s} said: “If I were present near it, I would hope that not a single prayer would
pass me by in it. And do you know the merit of that place? There is not a single
righteous servant nor a prophet except that he has prayed in your mosque, even the
Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family.
Indeed, when Allah {SWT} caused the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him
and his family, to be taken on the ‘Night Journey’ (Mi’raj), Jibra'il {a.s}, said to him:
‘Do you know where you are, O’ Messenger of Allah {saws}? At this moment you are facing
the ‘Mosque of Kufa’.”
Prophet {saws} said: “Then ask permission from my Lord {AZJ}, Mighty and Majestic, that I
may go to it and pray two units of prayer in it.”
So Jibra’il {a.s} asked Allah {SWT}, the Majestic, for permission, and He {AZJ} permitted.
And indeed, its right side is a garden from the gardens of Paradise,
And its center is a garden from the gardens of Paradise,
And its rear is a garden from the gardens of Paradise.
And indeed the obligatory prayer performed in it is equal to one thousand prayers, and
the supererogatory prayer in it is equal to five hundred prayers.
And sitting in it without recitation or remembrance is worship.
And if the people knew what was in it, they would come to it even crawling.”
AND ITS RULINGS
text_ar:
سَهْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ الْخَزَّازِ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ خَارِجَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قَالَ لِي «يَا هَارُونَ بْنَ خَارِجَةَ كَمْ بَيْنَكَ وَ بَيْنَ مَسْجِدِ الْكُوفَةِ يَكُونُ مِيلاً)» قُلْتُ لاَ قَالَ «أَ فَتُصَلِّي
فِيهِ الصِّلَوَاتِ كُلَّهَا» قُلْتُ لا فَقَالَ « أَمَا لَوْ كُنْتُ حَاضِراً بِحَضْرَتِهِ لَرَجَوْتُ أَنْ لا تَفُوتَنِي فِيهِ صَلاَةٌ وَ تَدْرِي مَا فَضْلُ
ذَلِكَ الْمَوْضِعِ مَا مِنْ عَبْدِ صَالِحِ وَ لاَ نَبِيَّ إِلاَّ وَ قَدْ صَلَى فِي مَسْجِدِكُمْ حَتَّى إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللْهِ صَلَّى اللَهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
لَمَّا أَسْرَى اللهُ بِهِ قَالَ لَهُ جَبْرَئِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَتَدْرِي أَيْنَ أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ السَّاعَةَ أَنْتَ مُقَابِلُ مَسْجِدِ كُوفَانَ
قَالَ «فَاسْتَأْذِنْ لِي رَبِّي عَزَّ وَ جَلّ حَتَّى آتِيَهُ فَأْصَلِّيَ فِيهِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ» فَاسْتَأْذَنَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فَأَذِنَ لَهُ وَ إِنَّ مَيْمَنَتَهُ
لَرَوْضَةٌ مِنْ رِيَاضٍ الْجَنَّةِ وَ إِنَّ وَسَطَهُ لَرَوْضَةٌ مِنْ رِيَاضِ الْجَنَّةِ وَ إِنَّ مُؤَخَرَهُ لَرَوْضَةٌ مِنْ رِيَاضِ الْجَنَّةِ وَ إِنَّ ٱلصَّلاَةَ
الْمَكْتُوبَةَ فِيهِ لَتَعْدِلُ بِأَلْفِ صَلَاةٍ وَ إِنَّ النَّافِلَةَ فِيهِ لَتَعْدِلُ بِخَمْسِمَائَةِ صَلَاةٍ وَ إِنَّ الْجُلُوسَ فِيهِ بِغَيْرِ تِلاَوَةٍ وَ لا ذِكْرٍ
الَعِبَادَةٌ وَلَوْ عَلِمَ النَّاسُ مَا فِيهِ لَأَتَوْهُ وَ لَوْ حَبْواً».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.490 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.250 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.252

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Abu Yusuf Ya'qub ibn Abdillah from the descendants of Abu Fatimah, from
Isma'il ibn Zayd, the mawla of Abdillah ibn Yahya al-Kahili, from Abdillah ibn Yahya al-Kahili, from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
A man came to the Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, peace be upon him, while he was
in the Mosque of Kufa.
He said: “Peace be upon you, O’ Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, and the mercy of Allah
{SWT} and His {AZJ} blessings.”
Imam Ali {a.s} returned the greeting.
The man said: “May I be your ransom, I intended to go to the ‘al-Masjid al-Aqsa’, and I
wanted to greet you and bid you farewell.”
So Imam {a.s} said to him: “What do you intend by that?”
He said: “The merit, may I be your ransom.”
Imam {a.s} said “Then sell your mount and consume your provisions and pray in this
mosque (Mosque of Kufa), for the obligatory prayer performed in it is (rewarded as) an
accepted Hajj, and the supererogatory prayer in it is (rewarded as) an accepted
Umrah. And the blessing from it extends for twelve miles.
Its right side is blessed, and its left side is deception. In its center is a spring of oil, and
a spring of milk, and a spring of drinking water for the believers, and a spring of
purifying water for the believers.
From it the Ark of Nuh {a.s}, peace be upon him, set sail. And in it were (the idols) Nasr,
Yaghuth, and Ya'uq. Seventy prophets and seventy successors prayed in it. I am one
of them,” And Imam Ali {a.s} placed his hand upon his chest.
(Imam {a.s} then continued) “No distressed person ever supplicated in it with a need
among his needs except that Allah {SWT} answered him and relieved him of his distress.”
AND ITS RULINGS
text_ar:
أُحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِي يُوسُفَ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ مِنْ وُلْدِ أَبِي فَاطِمَةَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ مَوْلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ
بَحْيَى الْكَاهِلِيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَحْيَى الْكَاهِلِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «جَاءَ رَجُلْ إِلَى أَمِيرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَ هُوَ فِي مَسْجِدِ الْكُوفَةِ فَقَالَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا أَمِيرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ رَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ وَ بَرَكَاتُهُ فَرَدَّ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ
جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إِنَّي أَرَذتُ الْمَسْجِدَ الْأَقْصَى فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أُسَلَّمَ عَلَيْكَ وَ أُوَدِّعَكَ فَقَالَ لَهُ «فَأَيَّ شَيْء أَرَدتَ بِدَاكَ» فَقَالَ
الْفَضْلَ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ قَالَ »فَبِعْ رَاجِلَتَكَ وَ كُلْ زَادَكَ وَ صَلِّ فِي هَذَا الْمَسْجِدِ فَإِنَّ الصَّلاَةَ الْمَكْتُوبَةَ فِيهِ حَجَةٌ مَبْرُورَةُ
وَ اَلنَافِلَةَ فِيهِ عُمْرَةْ مَبْرُورَةُ وَ الْبَرَكَةَ مِنْهُ عَلَى إِثْنَيْ عَشَرَ مِيلا يَمِينُهُ يُمْنٌ وَ يَسَارُهُ مَكْرٌ وَ فِي وَسَطِهِ عَيْنٌ مِنْ
دُهْنٍ وَ عَيْنٌ مِنْ لَبَنٍ وَ عَيْنٌ مِنْ مَاءِ شَرَابٍ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ عَيْنٌ مِنْ مَاءِ طُهْرٍ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ مِنْهُ سَارَتْ سَفِينَةُ نُوحِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ وَ كَانَ فِيهِ نَسْرٌ وَ يَفُوتُ وَ يَعُوقُ صَلَّى فِيهِ سَبْعُونَ نَبِيّاً وَ سَبْعُونَ وَصِيّاً أَنَا أَحَدُهُمْ» وَ قَالَ بِيَدِهِ عَلَى
صَدْرِهِ «مَا دَعَا فِيهِ مَكْرُوبٌ بِمَسْأَلَةٍ فِي حَاجَةٍ مِنَ ٱلْحَوَائِجِ إِلَّ أَجَابَهُ اللَّهُ وَ فَرَّجَ عَنْهُ كُرْبَتَهُ» ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Sufyan ibn al-Simt, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “When you enter from the second gate on the right side of the
mosque, count five pillars; two of them are under the shade and three of them are in
the courtyard.
At the third (pillar) is the prayer place of Ibrahim {a.s} and it is the fifth from the wall.”
He (Sufyan ibn al-Simt) said: “When it was the time of Abu al-Abbas, Abu Abdillah {a.s},
peace be upon him, entered from the ‘Gate of the Elephant’, then turned to the left as
He {a.s} entered from the gate and prayed at the fourth pillar, which is opposite the fifth.
So I asked him: “Is that the pillar of Ibrahim {a.s}, peace be upon him?”
Imam {a.s} said to me: “Yes.”
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ السِّمْطِ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «إِذَا دَخَلْتَ مِنَ
اَلْبَابِ الثَّانِي فِي مَيْمَنَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ تَعْدُّ خَمْسَ أَسَاطِينَ ثِنْتَانِ مِنْهَا فِي الظَّلَالِ وَثَلاَثُ مِنْهَا فِي الصَّحْنِ فَعِنْدَ الثَّالِئَةِ
مُصَلَّى إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ وَ هِيَ الْخَامِسَةُ مِنَ الْحَائِطِ» قَالَ فَلَمَّا كَانَ أَيَّامُ أَبِي الْعَبَّاسِ دَخَلَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ مِنْ بَابِ الْفِيلِ فَتَيَاسَرَ حِينَ دَخَلَ مِنَ اَلْبَابِ فَصَلَّى عِنْدَ الْأَسْطُوَانَةِ الرَّابِعَةِ وَ هِيَ بِجِذَاءِ الْخَامِسَةِ فَقُلْتُ
لَهُ تِلْكَ أُسْطُوَانَةُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فَقَالَ لِي «نَعَمْ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.493 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.251 • Al-Wafi, Vol.14 p.1445 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.263 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.97 p.401
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Sufyan ibn al-Simt, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s} said: “When you enter from the second gate on the right side of the
mosque, count five pillars; two of them are under the shade and three of them are in
the courtyard.
At the third (pillar) is the prayer place of Ibrahim {a.s} and it is the fifth from the wall.”
He (Sufyan ibn al-Simt) said: “When it was the time of Abu al-Abbas, Abu Abdillah {a.s},
peace be upon him, entered from the ‘Gate of the Elephant’, then turned to the left as
He {a.s} entered from the gate and prayed at the fourth pillar, which is opposite the fifth.
So I asked him: “Is that the pillar of Ibrahim {a.s}, peace be upon him?”
Imam {a.s} said to me: “Yes.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
text_en:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from Salih ibn al-Sindi from Ja’far ibn Bashir from Abu Abd al-Rahman al-Hadha’ from Abu
Usamah from Abu Ubaydah from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “The ‘Mosque of Kufah’ is a garden from gardens of Paradise.
One thousand and seventy prophets prayed in it. Its right side is mercy, and its left side
is deception.
And in it is the staff of Musa {a.s}, peace be upon him,
And the gourd tree (shajarat yaqtin),
And the ring of Sulayman {a.s}, peace be upon him.
And from it ‘the oven gushed forth’ (Surah Hud 11:40), and the Ark (of Nuh {a.s}) sailed.
And it is the ‘navel of Babylon’ and the gathering place of the prophets {a.s}.”
AND ITS RULINGS
text_ar:
عَلِي بْنُ إبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ السِّنْدِيَّ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحَذَّاءِ عَنْ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ عَنْ أَبِي
عُبَيْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: « مَسْجِدُ كُوفَانَ رَوْضَةٌ مِنْ رِيَاضِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ صَلَى فِيهِ أَلْفُ نَبِيَّ وَ سَبْعُونَ
بِيّاً وَ مَيْمَنَتُهُ رَحْمَةٌ وَ مَيْسَرَتُهُ مَكْرٌ وَ فِيهِ عَصَا مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ ٱلسِّلاَمُ وَ شَجَرَةُ يَقْطِينٍ وَ خَاتَمُ سُلَيْمَانَ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ وَ مِنْهُ «فارَ التَّنُورُ» وَ جَرَتِ السَّفِينَةُ وَ هِيَ صُرَّةُ بَابِلَ وَ مَجْمَعُ ٱلْأَنْبِيَاءِ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّلامُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.493 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.252 • Rawdat Al-Wa’izin, Vol.2 p.410 • Al- Mazar Al-Kabir, Vol.1 p.125 • Al-Wafi, Vol.14 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.251 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.97 p.389

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal from al-Husayn ibn Sayf from Uthman from Salih ibn
Abi al-Aswad, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, mentioned the ‘Mosque of al-Sahlah’ and said:
“Indeed, it is the residence of our companion (the Qa'im {ajf}), when He {ajf} rises with his
family.”
text_ar:
اَلْأَسْوَدِ قَالَ:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَيْفٍ عَنْ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ أَبِي
قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ وَ ذَكَرَ مَسْجِدَ السَّهْلَةِ فَقَالَ «أَمَا إِنَّهُ مَنْزِلُ صَاحِبِنَا إِذَا قَامَ بِأَهْلِهِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.495 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.252 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.267 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.97 p.439
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal from al-Husayn ibn Sayf from Uthman from Salih ibn

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
text_en:
From him, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Husayn ibn Bakr, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Sa'id al-Khazzaz, from Abu
Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “In Kufah, there is a mosque called the ‘Mosque of al-Sahlah’.
If my uncle Zayd had gone to it and prayed in it and sought refuge with Allah {SWT}, Allah
{SWT} would have granted him refuge for twenty years.
In it is the resting place of the ‘Rider’.”
It was asked: “And who is the ‘Rider’?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Al-Khidr {a.s}, peace be upon him, and the house of Idris {a.s} the Prophet,
peace be upon him.
And no distressed person has ever come to it and prayed in it, between the two evening
prayers, and supplicated to Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic, except that Allah {SWT}
relieved his distress.”
AND ITS RULINGS
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ بَكْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ الْخَزَّازِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ:
قَالَ » بِالْكُوفَةِ مَسْجِدٌ يُقَالُ لَهُ مَسْجِدُ السَّهَلَةِ لَوْ أَنَّ عَمَّي زَيْدا أَتَاهُ فَصَلَّى فِيهِ وَ اِسْتَجَارَ اللَّهَ لَأَجَارَ لَهُ اللَّهُ عِشِرِينَ
سَنَةً فِيهِ مُنَاخُ الرَّاكِبِ » قِيلَ وَ مَنِ الرَّاكِبُ قَالَ « الْخَصِرُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَ بَيْتُ إِدْرِيسَ النَّبِيِّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَ مَا
أَتَاهُ مَكْرُوبٌ قَطْ فَصَلَّى فِيهِ مَا بَيْنَ الْعِشَاءَيْنِ فَدَعَا اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ إِلاَّا قَرَّجَ اللَّهُ كُرْبَتَهُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.252
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from Ziyad ibn Marwan from Yunus ibn Zabian, who
said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “The best mosques for your women are
their homes.”
text_ar:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ مَرْوَانَ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ ظَبْيَانَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «خَيْرُ مَسَاجِدٍ نِسَائِكُمُ الْبُيُوتُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.238 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.252 • Rawdat Al- Wa’izin, Vol.2 p.338 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.514 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.237 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.237 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.371
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ya'qub ibn Yazid from Ziyad ibn Marwan from Yunus ibn Zabian, who

Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “The best mosques for your women are
their homes.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
text_en:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi,
who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about covered mosques, is it disliked to stand in them?
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, but prayer in them does not harm you today.
And if justice were to be established, you would see for yourselves what would be done
in that regard.”
He (al-Halabi) said: “And I asked Imam {a.s}, ‘May a man hang up his weapon in the
mosque?’”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, but not in the ‘Great Mosque’ (al-Masjid al-Akbar), for my
grandfather (Imam Ali ibn Husayn {a.s}), peace be upon him, forbade a man from
sharpening an arrowhead (mishqas) in the mosque.”
AND ITS RULINGS
text_ar:
عَنَهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ الْحَلَبِيّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلْمَسَاجِدِ الْمُظَلّلَةِ يُكْرَهُ
الْقِيَامُ فِيهَا قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ لَكِنْ لاَ تَضُرُّكُمُ الصَّلاَةُ فِيهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ وَ لَوْ قَدْ كَانَ ٱلْعَدْلُ لَرَأَيْتُمْ أَنْتُمْ كَيْفَ يُصْنَعُ فِي ذَلِكَ»
قَالَ وَسَأَلْثُهُ أَيُعَلَّقُ الرَّجُلُ السِّلاحَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ أَمَّا فِي ٱلْمَسْجِدِ الْأَكْبَرِ فَلَاَ فَإِنَّ جَدِّي عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ
نَهَى رَجْلاً يَبْرِي مِشقَصاً فِي الْمَسْجِدِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.253
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Muhammad Imam Ali ibn Husayn Zayn al-Abidin {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
text_en:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Talhah ibn Zayd, from Imam
Ja’far {a.s}, from his father {a.s}, from Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam Ali {a.s} used to break the mihrabs when He {a.s} saw them in the mosques and
would say: “It is as if they are altars of the Jews.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلاَمُ : أَنَّهُ
كَانَ يَكْسِرُ الْمَحَارِيبَ إِذَا رَاهَا فِي الْمَسَاجِدِ وَ يَقُولُ «كَأنَّهَا مَذَابِحُ الْيَهُودِ ».
cross_references: ‘Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.320 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.253 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.493 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.237
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
text_chunk:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Talhah ibn Zayd, from Imam
Ja’far {a.s}, from his father {a.s}, from Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
text_en:
From him, from Imam Ja’far {a.s}, from his father {a.s}:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, saw a mosque in Kufah that
had been elevated in height, and Imam {a.s} said: “It is as if it is a church,”
And Imam {a.s} said: “Indeed, Mosques are to be built plainly, not elevated.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ : أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ رَأَى مَسْجِداً بِالْكُوفَةِ قَدْ شُرِّفَ فَقَالَ «كَأَنَّهُ بِيعَةً» وَ قَالَ «إِنَّ
الْمَسَاجِدَ تُبْنَى جُمّا لا تُشَرَّفُ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.236 • ‘Ilal Al-Shara’i’, Vol.2 p.320 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.253 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.493 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.215 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.352
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
text_chunk:
From him, from Imam Ja’far {a.s}, from his father {a.s}:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, saw a mosque in Kufah that
had been elevated in height, and Imam {a.s} said: “It is as if it is a church,”
And Imam {a.s} said: “Indeed, Mosques are to be built plainly, not elevated.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
text_en:
AND ITS RULINGS
From him, from Muhammad ibn Hassan, from Abu Muhammad al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Imam Ja’far
{a.s}, from his father {a.s}:
Imam Ali {a.s}, said: “A prayer in ‘Bayt al-Maqdis’ is equal to one thousand prayers,
And a prayer in ‘Grand Mosque’ (al-Masjid al-A'zam) is equal to one hundred prayers,
And a prayer in ‘Mosque of the Tribe’ (Masjid al-qabila) is equal to twenty-five prayers,
And a prayer in the ‘Market Mosque’ (masjid al-suq) is equal to twelve prayers,
And the prayer of a man alone in his house is one single prayer.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ عَنْ أَبِي مُحَمَّدِ النَّوْفَلِيّ عَنِ السَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ:
«صَلَاَةٌ فِي بَيْتِ ٱلْمَقْدِسِ أَلْفُ صَلاَةٍ وَ صَلَاَةً فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْأَعْظَمِ مِائَةُ صَلَاَةٍ وَ صَلاَةً فِي مَسْجِدِ الْقَبِيلَةِ خَمْسٌ
وَ عِشرُونَ صَلاَةً وَ صَلاَةٌ فِي مَسْجِدِ السُّوقِ اِثْنَتَا عَشَرَةَ صَلاَةً وَ صَلاَةُ الرَّجُلِ فِي بَيْتِهِ وَحْدَهُ صَلاَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ».

source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
text_chunk:
AND ITS RULINGS
From him, from Muhammad ibn Hassan, from Abu Muhammad al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Imam Ja’far
{a.s}, from his father {a.s}:
Imam Ali {a.s}, said: “A prayer in ‘Bayt al-Maqdis’ is equal to one thousand prayers,
And a prayer in ‘Grand Mosque’ (al-Masjid al-A'zam) is equal to one hundred prayers,
And a prayer in ‘Mosque of the Tribe’ (Masjid al-qabila) is equal to twenty-five prayers,
And a prayer in the ‘Market Mosque’ (masjid al-suq) is equal to twelve prayers,
And the prayer of a man alone in his house is one single prayer.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
text_en:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from Salih ibn Uqbah, from Amr
ibn Abi al-Miqdam, from his father, from Habbah al-Urani, who said:
The Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, peace be upon him, went out to al-Hirah and said:
“Surely this shall be joined to this”
And Imam {a.s} gestured with his hand to Kufah and al-Hirah,
(Imam {a.s} continued) “Until land between them shall be sold by dinars, and a mosque
shall indeed be built in al-Hirah with five hundred doors, in which the Caliph of the
Riser ‘the Qa'im {ajf}’, may Allah {SWT} the Exalted hasten his relief, will pray.
This is because the ‘Mosque of Kufah’ will be too small for them. And indeed, twelve
just Imams {a.s} shall pray in it.”
I asked: “O Commander of the Faithful {a.s}, will this ‘Mosque of Kufah’ that you
describe, be able to accommodate the people on that day?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Four mosques shall be built for him (the Qa'im {ajf});
Masjid al-Kufa will be the smallest of them, and this one, and two mosques at the two
ends of Kufa, on this side and that side”
And Imam {a.s} pointed with his hand toward the Basrans (al-Basriyyin) and the people
of al-Ghari (al-Ghariyyin).
AND ITS RULINGS
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ أَبِي الْمِقْدَامِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ
حَبَّةَ الْعُرَنِيِّ قَالَ: خَرَجَ أَمِيرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ إِلَى الْحِيرَةِ فَقَالَ « لَتَصِلَنَّ هَذِهِ بِهَذِهِ» وَ أَوْمَى بِيَدِهِ إِلَى ٱلْكُوفَةِ
وَ الجِيرَة «حَتّى يُبَاعَ الذِّرَاعُ فِيمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بِدَنَانِيرَ وَ لَيُبْنَيَنَ بِالْحِيرَةِ مَسْجِدٌ لَهُ خَمْسُمِائَةِ بَابٍ يُصَلِّي فِيهِ خَلِيفَةُ
الْقَائِم عَجَّلَ اللّهُ تَعَالَى فَرَجَهُ لِأَنّ مَسْجِدَ الْكُوفَةِ لَيَضِيقُ عَنْهُمْ وَ لَيُصَلَّيَنَ فِيهِ اِثْنَا عَشَرَ إِمَاماً عَدْلاً» قُلْتُ يَا أَمِيرَ
الْمُومِنِينَ وَ يَسَعُ مَسْجِدُ الْكُوفَةِ هَذَا الَّذِي تَصِفُ النَّاسَ يَوْمَئِذٍ قَالَ «تُبْنَى لَهُ أَرْبَعُ مَسَاجِدَ - مَسْجِدُ الْكُوفَةِ أَصْفَرُهَا
وَ هَذَا وَ مَسْجِدَانٍ فِي طَرَفَي الْكُوفَةِ مِنْ هَذَا الْجَانِبِ وَ هَذَا الْجَانِبِ» وَ أَوْمَى بِيَدِهِ نَحْوَ ٱلْبَصْرِيِّينَ وَ اَلْغَرِيَّيْنِ.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.253 • Al-Wafi, Vol.14 p.1453 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.5 2 p.374

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
text_en:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn and Ali ibn Hadid, from Muhammad
ibn Sinan, from Amr ibn Khalid, from Abu Hamzah al-Thumali:
Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn {a.s}, peace be upon them both, came intentionally from Medina
to the ‘Mosque of Kufah’, and Imam {a.s} prayed in it four units of prayer.
Then Imam {a.s} returned until he mounted his riding animal and took the road.
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُصَيْنِ وَ عَلِيَّ بْنِ حَدِيدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بَنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ
أَبِي حَمْرَةَ التُمَالِيِّ : أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ أَتَى مَسْجِدَ الْكُوفَةِ عَمْداً مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ فَصَلَّى فِيهِ أَرْبَعَ
رَكَّعَاتٍ ثُمَّ عَادَ حَتَّى رَكِبَ رَاحِلَتَهُ وَ أَخَذَ الطَّرِيقَ.
