author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE VIRTUE OF MOSQUES AND PRAYER WITHIN THEM, AND THE VIRTUE OF CONGREGATIONAL PRAYER
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Mas'ud from Muhammad ibn Nusayr from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Ja’far ibn Bashir
from Hisham ibn Salim from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I heard Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} say: “When the imam (of prayer) finishes and turns away, no
one should pray in his place until he has turned away from his position.”
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ نُصَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَالِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ
اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ: «إِذَا اِنْصَرَفَ الْإِمَامُ فَلاَ يُصَلِّي فِي مَقَامِهِ حَتَّى يَنْحَرِفَ عَنْ مَقَامِهِ ذَلِكَ».
٢٦ - باب صلاة العيدين
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.321 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.2 p.382 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.284 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1267 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1267 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.186
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Mas'ud from Muhammad ibn Nusayr from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Ja’far ibn Bashir
from Hisham ibn Salim from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I heard Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} say: “When the imam (of prayer) finishes and turns away, no
one should pray in his place until he has turned away from his position.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Muhammad
ibn Muslim, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “It is necessary to wear the turban and the
cloak on the Day of al-Adha and al-Fitr. As for Friday, it is sufficient without a turban
and a cloak.”
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبِ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ قَالَ قَالَ
أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ : «لا بُدَّ مِنَ الْعِمَامَةِ وَ الْبُرْدِ يَوْمَ الْأَضْحَى وَ الْفِطْرِ فَأَمَّا الْجُمُعَةُ فَإِنَّهَا تُجْزِي بِغَيْرِ عِمَامَةٍ
وَ بُرْدٍ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.284 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1303 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.441
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Hammad ibn Isa from Hariz from Muhammad
ibn Muslim, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “It is necessary to wear the turban and the
cloak on the Day of al-Adha and al-Fitr. As for Friday, it is sufficient without a turban
and a cloak.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
From him, from al-Abbas, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Rib'i, from al-Fudayl, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be
upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “A prayer mat (khumrah) was brought to my father {a.s}, peace
be upon him, on the Day of al-Fitr, and He {a.s} ordered it to be returned.
Then He (Imam al-Baqir {a.s}) said:
“This is a day on which the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, loved to look toward the horizons of the sky and place his forehead on the
earth.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ رِبْعِيَّ عَنِ الْفُضَيْلِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «أَتِيَ أَبِي عَلَيْهِ
السّلاَمُ بِخُمْرَةٍ يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ فَأَمَرَ بِرَدِّهَا فَقَالَ «هَذَا يَوْمٌ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يُحِبُ أَنْ يَنْظُرَ فِيهِ
إِلَى آفَاقِ السَّمَاءِ وَ يَضَعَ جَبْهَتَهُ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ» ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.461 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.284 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1297 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.450 • Awalim Al-Uloom, Vol.19 p.220
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al- Baqir {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
text_chunk:
From him, from al-Abbas, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Rib'i, from al-Fudayl, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be
upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “A prayer mat (khumrah) was brought to my father {a.s}, peace
be upon him, on the Day of al-Fitr, and He {a.s} ordered it to be returned.
Then He (Imam al-Baqir {a.s}) said:
“This is a day on which the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, loved to look toward the horizons of the sky and place his forehead on the
earth.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
From him, from Yaqub ibn Yazid, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, from Abu Abdillah {a.s},
peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said regarding the prayer of the two Eids.
Imam {a.s} said: “You connect the recitation with the recitation,”
And Imam {a.s} said: “You begin with the takbir in the first (rak‘ah), then you recite, then
you bow with the seventh (takbir).”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : فِي صَلاةِ الْعِيدَيْنِ
قَالَ «تَصِلُ ٱلْقِرَاءَةَ بِالْقِرَاءَةِ» وَ قَالَ «تَبْدَأُ بِالتَّكْبِيرِ فِي الأُولَى ثُمَّ تَقْرَأْ ثُمَّ تَرْكَعُ بِالسَّابِعَةِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.284 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.450 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1320 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.438
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham ibn al-Hakam from Abu Abdillah
{a.s}, peace be upon him, and Hammad ibn Uthman from Ubaydullah al-Halabi from
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him: The same.
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ وَ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ
عُبَيْدِ اللهِ اَلْحَلَبِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : مِثلَهُ.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.284 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.450 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1320 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.438

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from al-Abbas from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah from Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar
from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, used to go out until He {saws} looked at the horizons of the sky,”
And Imam {a.s} said: “On that day, no one should pray upon a mat or a reed mat
(bariyyah).”
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ
: «أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَانَ يَخْرُجْ حَتَّى يَنظُرَ إلَى آفَاقِ السَّمَاءِ» وَ قَالَ «لا يُصَلَّيَنَ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَى
بِسَاطٍ وَ لاَ بَارِيَةٍ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.285
source_scholar: Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar
al-Sabati, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about a man who forgets to perform the
ghusl on the Day of Eid, until after he has prayed.
Imam {a.s} said: “If it is still within the time, then he must perform the ghusl and repeat
the prayer; but if the time has passed, then his prayer is valid.”

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “This report is to be understood as referring to
recommendation (mustahabb), because we have already explained that the ghusl of
the two Eids is a sunnah, not an obligation. Also, we have clarified that whoever misses
the Eid prayer is not required to make it up, but rather it is recommended for him to
pray individually, as we have explained.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةً عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَّابَاطِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا
عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَنْسَى أَنْ يَغْتَسِلَ يَوْمَ الْعِيدِ حَتَّى صَلَّى قَالَ «إِنْ كَانَ فِي وَقْتٍ فَعَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَغْتَسِلَ
وَ يُعِيدَ الصَّلاَةَ وَ إِنْ مَضَى الْوَقْتُ فَقَدْ جَازَتْ صَلاَتُهُ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : هذا الخبر محمول على الاستحباب لانا قد بينا ان غسل العيدين سنة ليس بفرض ، وأيضا قد بينا
أن من فاتته صلاة العيد فلا يجب عليه قضاؤها وانما يستحب له الصلاة على الانفراد على ما بيناه.
commentary:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “This report is to be understood as referring to
recommendation (mustahabb), because we have already explained that the ghusl of
the two Eids is a sunnah, not an obligation. Also, we have clarified that whoever misses
the Eid prayer is not required to make it up, but rather it is recommended for him to
pray individually, as we have explained.”
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.285 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.451 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.330

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Tamimi, from Sayf ibn Umayrah, from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:
Ibn Qays narrated to me from Ja’far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Indeed, the prayer on the two Eid days is only upon the one
who goes out to the open prayer ground (al-jabbana), and whoever does not go out,
there is no prayer upon him.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدِ التَّمِيمِيِّ عَنْ سَيْفِ بْنِ عَمِيرَةَ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي اِبْنُ قَيْسِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ
مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «إِنَّمَا الصَّلاَةُ يَوْمَ الْعِيدَيْنِ عَلَى مَنْ خَرَجَ إِلَى الْجَبَانَةِ وَ مَنْ لَمْ يَخْرُجْ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ صَلاَةٌ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.285 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.445 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1293 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.423
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Abdurrahman ibn Sayabah,
from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Indeed, it is upon the (just) imam to bring out those
imprisoned for debt on Fridays to the Friday prayer, and on the Day of Eid, to the Eid
prayer, and to send someone with them. Then, when they have completed the prayer
and the Eid, he should return them to the prison.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَيَابَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَاَمُ
قَالَ: «إِنَّ عَلَى الْإِمَامِ أَنْ يُخْرِجَ ٱلْمُحْبَسِينَ فِي الدَّيْنِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ وَ يَوْمَ الْعِيدِ إِلَى اَلْعِيدِ وَ يُرْسِلَ
مَعَهُمْ فَإِذَا قَضَوُا الصَّلاَةَ وَ الْعِيدَ رَدَّهُمْ إِلَى السِّجْنِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.3 p.31 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.285 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.6 p.319 • Al-Wafi, Vol.8 p.1131 • Al-Wafi, Vol.16 p.1075 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.340 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.27 p.301
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Abu Basir, from
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “If you intend to depart on the day of Eid, and dawn breaks
while you are still in the town, then do not leave until you attend that Eid.”
text_ar:
عَنهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَلَامُ
قَالَ: «إِذَا أَرَدْتَ الشُّخْوصَ فِي يَوْمِ عِيدِ فَانْفَجَرَ الصُّبْحُ وَ أَنْتَ بِالْبَلَدِ فَلاَ تَخْرُج حَتَّى تَشَهَدَ ذَلِكَ الْعِيدَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.286 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1296 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.471 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.80 p.115
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Asim ibn Humayd, from Abu Basir, from

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Yazid ibn Ishaq Sha'ir, from Harun ibn Hamzah al-Ghanawi,
from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about the takbir in al-Fitr and al-Adha.
Imam {a.s} said: “Five and four, so it does not harm you if you finish with an odd
number.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ إسحَاقَ شَعِرٍ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ حَمْرَةَ الْغَنَوِيّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ
قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ التَّكْبِيرِ فِي الْفِطْرِ وَ الْأَضْحَى فَقَالَ «خَمْسٌ وَ أَرْبَعْ فَلا يَضُرُكَ إِذَا اِنْصَرَفْتَ عَلَى وَثرِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.286 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.447 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1317 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.437
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Yazid ibn Ishaq Sha'ir, from Harun ibn Hamzah al-Ghanawi,
from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about the takbir in al-Fitr and al-Adha.
Imam {a.s} said: “Five and four, so it does not harm you if you finish with an odd

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah, from Zurarah, from Isa ibn
Abdullah, from his father, from his grandfather, from Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam Ali {a.s} said: “The Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, would not
say more than one takbir in the two Eids until the tongue of Imam al-Husayn {a.s}, peace
be upon him, was delayed in speech.
Then, on one Eid day, his mother (Sayyidah Fatima {s.a}), peace be upon her, dressed
him (Imam al-Husayn {a.s}) and sent him with his grandfather {saws}.
So the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, pronounced
the takbir, and Imam al-Husayn {a.s}, peace be upon him, also pronounced the takbir
when the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, (had said it) seven
times.
Then He {saws} stood for the second unit, and the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him
and his family, pronounced the takbir, and Imam al-Husayn {a.s}, peace be upon him,
also pronounced the takbir when He {saws} (had said it) five times.
So thus Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, made it a
sunnah, and the sunnah has remained established until today.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «مَا كَانَ يُكَبِّرُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فِي الْعِيدَيْنِ إِلاَّ تَكْبِيرَةً وَاحِدَةً حَتَى أَبْطَاً عَلَيْهِ لِسَانُ
الْحُسَيْنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ فَلَمَّا كَانَ ذَاتُ يَوْمِ عِيدِ أَلْبَسَتَهُ أُمْهُ عَلَيْهَا السَّلَاَمُ وَ أَرْسَلَتْهُ مَعَ جَدِّهِ فَكَبَّرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى
اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَكَبَّرَ الْحُسَيْنُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ جِينَ كَبَّرَ النَّبِيُ صَلّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ سَبْعاً ثُمَّ قَامَ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ فَكَبَّرَ
اَلنَّبِي صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ كَبَّرَ الْحُسَيْنُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ حِينَ كَبَّرَ خَمْساً فَجَعَلَهَا رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
سُنَّةً وَ ثَبَتَتِ السُّنَّةُ إِلَى الْيَوْمِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.286 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1317 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.437
source_scholar: Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws} & Sayyida Fatimah bint Muhammad al-Zahra {s.a} & Abu Abdillah Imam Husayn ibn Ali Sayyid al-Shuhada {a.s}
text_chunk:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah, from Zurarah, from Isa ibn
Abdullah, from his father, from his grandfather, from Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam Ali {a.s} said: “The Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, would not
say more than one takbir in the two Eids until the tongue of Imam al-Husayn {a.s}, peace
be upon him, was delayed in speech.
Then, on one Eid day, his mother (Sayyidah Fatima {s.a}), peace be upon her, dressed
him (Imam al-Husayn {a.s}) and sent him with his grandfather {saws}.
So the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, pronounced
the takbir, and Imam al-Husayn {a.s}, peace be upon him, also pronounced the takbir
when the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, (had said it) seven
times.
Then He {saws} stood for the second unit, and the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him
and his family, pronounced the takbir, and Imam al-Husayn {a.s}, peace be upon him,
also pronounced the takbir when He {saws} (had said it) five times.
So thus Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, made it a
sunnah, and the sunnah has remained established until today.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
From him, from al-Abbas, from Abdurrahman ibn Hammad, from Bashir ibn Sa'id, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “You say in the supplication of the two Eids between every two
takbirs: ‘Allah {SWT} is my Lord {AZJ} forever,
and Islam is my religion forever,
and (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} is my Prophet forever,
and the Quran is my Book forever,
and the Ka'bah is my Qiblah forever,
and Imam Ali {a.s} is my Guardian (waliyy) forever,
and the Successors (awsiya) are my Imams {a.s} forever
and you name them (the Imams {a.s}) until the last of them
and none is to be worshipped except Allah {SWT}’.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ بَشِيرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: «تَقُولُ فِي
دُعَاء الْعِيدَيْنِ بَيْنَ كُلِّ تَكْبِيرَتَيْنِ - اَللَّهُ رَبِّي أَبَداً وَ الْإِسْلاَمُ دِينِي أَبَداً وَ مُحَمَّدٌ نَبِيِّي أَبَداً وَ الْقُرْآنُ كِتَابِي أَبَداً وَ
الْكَفَبَةُ قِبْلَتِي أَبَداً وَ عَلِيْ وَلِيِّي أَبَداً وَ الْأَوْصِيَاء أَئِمَتِي أَبَداً وَتُسَمِّيهِمْ إِلَى آخِرِهِمْ وَ لا أَحَدَ إِلَّ اللَّهُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.286 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1318 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.469
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Muhammad ibn Isa from Yunus from al-Ala ibn Razin from Muhammad:
I asked Imam {a.s} about a man who missed a rak‘ah with the imam (of prayer) from the
prayer during the ‘Days of Tashriq’. (meaning 11th, 12th, and 13th of Dhul Hijjah)
Imam {a.s} said: “He completes the prayer and pronounces the takbir.”
text_ar:
عَلِي بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ
فَاتَثَهُ رَكْعَةٌ مَعَ ٱلْإِمَامِ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ أَيَامَ التَّشرِيقِ قَالَ «يُتِمُ الصَّلاَةَ وَ يُكَبَّرُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.461 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.287

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Abdullah ibn Sinan, who said:
The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, only granted
permission to the young unmarried women (al-‘awatiq), to go out on the two Eids for
the purpose of seeking provision (al-tarudd lil-rizq).
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ: إِنَّمَا رَخَصَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ لِلنَّسَاءِ
الْعَوَاتِقٍ فِي الْخُرُوجِ فِي الْعِيدَيْنِ لِلتَّعَرُّضِ لِلرِّزْقِ.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.287 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1295 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.471 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.87 p.353
source_scholar: Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
From him, from al-Hasan, from Zur’ah, from Sama’ah, who said:
I asked him about going early to the prayer ground on the Day of Fitr and Day of Adha.
He said: “After sunrise.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْغُدُوِّ إِلَى الْمُصَلَّى فِي الْفِطْرِ وَ الْأَضْحَى فَقَالَ «بَعْدَ طُلُوعِ
الشَّمْسِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.287 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1296 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.473
source_scholar: Implicit (Muzmar)

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
From him, from Safwan, from Al-Alaa, from Muhammad, from one of the two Imams {a.s}, peace be upon
them:
Imam {a.s} was asked regarding the prayer of the two Eids.
Imam {a.s} said: “The prayer is before the two sermons, and the takbir is after the
recitation; seven (takbir) in the first and five (takbir) in the last.
The first to innovate placing the sermon before (the prayer) was Uthman (third
oppressor), when he introduced his innovations.
When Uthman finished the prayer, the people would stand up to leave.
When Uthman saw that, he brought the two sermons forward and ‘detained’ the
people for the prayer.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ ٱلْعَلاءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السَلاَمُ: فِي صَلاَةِ الْعِيدَيْنِ قَالَ «الصَّلاَةُ قَبْلَ ٱلْخُطِبَتَيْنِ
وَ التَّكْبِيرُ بَعْدَ الْقِرَاءَةِ سَبْعْ فِي ٱلْأُولَى وَ خَمْسٌ فِي الْأَجِيرَةِ وَ كَانَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَحْدَثَهَا بَعْدَ ٱلْخُطْبَةِ - عُثْمَانُ لَمَّا أَحْدَثَ
أَحْدَاثَهُ كَانَ إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ قَامَ النَّاسُ لِيَرْجِعُوا فَلَمَّا رَأَى ذَلِكَ قَدَّمَ الْخُطْبَتَيْنِ وَ اِخْتَبَسَ النَّاسُ لِلصَّلاةِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.287 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1316 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.441
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
From him, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam al-Sadiq {a.s}: “When is the sacrifice to be slaughtered?”
Imam {a.s} said: “When the (just) imam has finished (the Eid prayer and turned away).”
I asked: “What if I am in a land where there is no (just) imam, and I lead them in prayer
in congregation?”
Imam {a.s} said: “(Do sacrifice) When the sun has risen fully (when it has ascended).”
And Imam {a.s} said: “There is no harm in you praying alone, but there is no (valid) prayer
except with an (just) imam.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةً عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ مَتَى يُذْبَحُ قَالَ «إِذَا اِنْصَرَفَ
اَلْإِمَامُ» قُلْتُ فَإِذَا كُنْتُ فِي أَرْضِ لَيْسَ فِيهَا إِمَامُ فَأُصَّلِّي بِهِمْ جَمَاعَةً فَقَالَ «إِذَا اِسْتَقَلَّتِ الشَّمْسُ» وَ قَالَ «لا بَأْسَ
بِأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ وَحْدَكَ وَ لاَ صَلاَةَ إِلاَّا مَعَ إِمَامٍ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.287 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1289 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.422 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.474
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
Sa’ad, from Ahmad, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Zurarah, from one of the two
Imams {a.s}, peace be upon them, who said:
Imam {a.s} said: “Indeed, the prayer of the two Eids is only upon the resident (not the
traveller), and there is no (valid) prayer except with an (just) imam.”
text_ar:
سَعْدٌ عَنْ أحمَدَ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا السِّلَامُ قَالَ: «إِنَّمَا صَلاَةُ
الْعِيدَيْنِ عَلَى الْمُقِيمِ وَ لاَ صَلاَةَ إِلاَّ بِإِمَامٍ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.287 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1290 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.422 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.431 • Al-Fusul Al-Muhimmah, Vol.2 p.107
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}

Sa’ad, from Ahmad, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Aban, from Zurarah, from one of the two

Imam {a.s} said: “Indeed, the prayer of the two Eids is only upon the resident (not the

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Ja’far ibn Bashir, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one
of the two Imams {a.s}, peace be upon them, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the speech that is said between the two takbirs, in the two Eids.
Imam {a.s} said: “Whatever good speech you wish (to say).”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا ٱلسَّلامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ
الْكَلامٍ الَّذِي يُتَكَلَّمُ بِهِ فِيمَا بَيْنَ التَّكْبِيرَتَيْنِ فِي الْعِيدَيْنِ فَقَالَ «مَا شِئْتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَلاَمِ الْحَسَنِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.288 • Awali Al-La’ali, Vol.3 p.102 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1318 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.467
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Ja’far ibn Bashir, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one
of the two Imams {a.s}, peace be upon them, who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the speech that is said between the two takbirs, in the two Eids.
Imam {a.s} said: “Whatever good speech you wish (to say).”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn, from Yazid ibn Ishaq Sha’ir, from Harun ibn Hamzah al-
Ghanawi, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Going out on the day of Fitr and Adha to the open space (al-
jabbana) is good for whoever is able to go out to it.”
So I asked: “What do you say if he is sick and not able to go out, should he pray in his
house?”
Imam {a.s} said, “No.”

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “The meaning of Imam {a.s} statement ‘No’ is that it is
not obligatory upon him (to do so).
Even though if he were to pray individually in his house, he would deserve reward for
it, as we have mentioned previously regarding it from the reports.”
And what confirms what we have said is what was narrated:
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ شَعِرٍ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ حَمْرَةَ الْغَنَوِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱَلسَّلَاَمُ
قَالَ: «الْخُرُوجُ يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ وَ الْأَضْحَى إِلَى الْجَبَّانَةِ حَسَنْ لِمَنِ اِسْتَطَاعَ الْخُرُوجَ إِلَيْهَا» فَقُلْتُ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَانَ مَرِيضاً
لاَ يَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ أيُصَلِّي فِي بَيْتِهِ قَالَ «لا)».
قال محمد بن الحسن : معنى قوله لا أي ليس بواجب عليه ذلك ، وإن كان لو صلى منفردا في بيته إستحق به الثواب على
ما قدمنا فيه من الاخبار، ويؤكد ما قلناه ما رواه :
commentary:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “The meaning of Imam {a.s} statement ‘No’ is that it is

text_en:
Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “My father (Imam al-Baqir {a.s}), peace be upon him, became ill
on the day of Adha, so He {a.s} prayed two rak‘ahs in his house, then offered the
sacrifice.”

ثم ضحى.

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Ashyam, from Yunus, who said:
I asked him about the takbir in the two Eids, should he raise his hands with each takbir,
or is it sufficient that he raises (them) with the first takbir?
He said: “He should raise (his hands) with each takbir.”
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَشيَمَ عَنْ يُونُسَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ تَكْبِيرِ الْعِيدَيْنِ أَيَرْفَعُ يَدَهُ مَعَ كُلِّ تَكْبِيرَةِ
أَمْ يُجْزِيهِ أَنْ يَرْفَعَ فِي أَوْلِ التَّكْبِيرَةِ فَقَالَ «يَرْفَعُ مَعَ كُلِّ تَكْبِيرَةِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.288 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1318 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.474

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
From him, from Sa’ad ibn Sa’ad al-Ash'ari, from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Ridha {a.s} about the traveller to Mecca or elsewhere, does he have to
perform the prayer of the two Eids; al-Fitr and al-Adha?
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes, except in Mina on the ‘Day of Sacrifice’ (Yawm al-Nahr).”

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “Its meaning is that it is upon him as a recommended
act (mustahabb), as indicated by what we have presented earlier from the reports”,
And this is confirmed by what was narrated:
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ سَعْدِ الْأَشْعَرِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ٱلْمُسَافِرِ إِلَى مَكَّةَ وَ غَيْرِهَا
هَلْ عَلَيْهِ صَلَاَةُ الْعِيدَيْنِ الْفِطْرِ وَ الْأَضْحَى فَقَالَ «نَعَمْ إِلَّ بِمِنَّى يَوْمَ اَلنَّحْرِ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : معناه أن ذلك عليه استحبابا بدلالة ما قدمناه من الاخبار، ويؤكد ذلك ما رواه:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Abu Ja’far, from his father, from Hafs ibn Ghiyath, from his father,
from Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam Ali {a.s} said: “It is upon men and women to perform the takbir during the ‘Days of
Tashriq’ after the prayers, and (this applies) to the one who prays alone and the one
who performs voluntary (nawafil) prayers.”
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاتٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ:
«عَلَى الرِّجَالِ وَ النَّسَاءِ أَنْ يُكَبِّرُوا أَيَامَ التَّشِرِيقِ فِي دُبُرِ الصَّلَوَاتِ وَ عَلَى مَنْ صَلَّى وَحْدَهُ وَ مَنْ صَلَّى تَطَوْعاً».
ام ٠٦
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.289 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1344 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.463
source_scholar: Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
From him, from Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Hanan ibn Sadir, from Abdillah ibn
Dhubyan, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “O Abdillah, there is no day of Eid for the Muslims; neither
‘Adha’ nor ‘Fitr’, except that Allah {SWT} renews for the family of (Prophet) Muhammad
{saws}, peace be upon them, sorrow on that day.”
He (Abdillah ibn Dhubyan) said: “I asked, ‘And why is that?’”
Imam {a.s} said: “Because they see their right in the hands of others.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ حَنَانٍ بْنِ سَدِيرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ذُبْيَانَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: قَالَ: «يَا عَبْدَ اللّهِ مَا مِنْ يَوْمِ عِيدِ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ أَضْحَى وَ لا فِطْرٍ إِلاَّ وَ هُوَ يُجَدِّدُ اللَّهُ لآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
ايْدِي غَيْرِهِمْ».
عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَاَمُ فِيهِ حُزْنا» قَالَ قُلْتُ وَ لِمَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ «إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَ حَقَّهُمْ فِي ا

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yusuf ibn Aqil, from Muhammad ibn Qays, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}:
Indeed, when he led the people in the prayer of ‘Fitr’ or ‘Adha’, he would lower his voice
so that those near him could hear, and he would not recite the Quran aloud. And the
sermons (al-mawa'iz) and the reminders (al-tadhkirah) on the Day of Adha and Fitr are
after the prayer.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ قَيْسِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا
صَلَّى بِالنَّاسِ صَلاةَ فِطْرٍ أَوْ أَضْحَى خَفَضَ مِنْ صَوْتِهِ يُسْمِعُ مَنْ يَليهِ لاَ يَجْهَرُ بِالْقُرْآنِ وَ ٱلْمَوَاعِظُ وَ التَّذْكِرَةُ يَوْمَ
اَلْأَضْحَى وَ الْفِطْرِ بَعْدَ الصَّلَاَةِ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar ibn
Musa al-Sabati, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam al-Sadiq {a.s}: “May a man lead his family in the prayer of the two Eids on
the rooftop or in a house?”
Imam {a.s} said: “He should not lead them, and they should not go out, and it is not
obligatory upon women to go out.”
And Imam {a.s} said: “Minimize for them the appearance (of preparation), so that they
do not ask to go out.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى السَابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ
اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ هَلْ يَوُمُّ الرَّجُلُ بِأَهْلِهِ فِي صَلاَةِ الْعِيدَيْنِ فِي السَّطْحِ أَوْ بَيْتٍ قَالَ «لا يَوُمُ بِهِنَّ وَ لا
يَخْرُجْنَ وَ لَيْسَ عَلَى النَّسَاءِ خُرُوجٌ» وَ قَالَ «أَقِلُوا لَهُنَّ مِنَ الْهَيْئَةِ حَتَّى لاَ يَسْأَلْنَ الْخُرُوجَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.289 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1295 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.471
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE TWO EIDS
text_en:
And Isma'il ibn Jabir narrated from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I said to Imam al-Sadiq {a.s}: “What do you say about the prayer of the two Eids, do they
have adhan and iqamah?”
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no adhan and no iqamah in them, but it is called out;
'The prayer, the prayer' three times.
And there is no pulpit (minbar) in them, the pulpit is not to be moved from its place.
Rather, something like a pulpit made of clay, is constructed for the (just) imam, and
he stands upon it and delivers the sermon to the people, then descends.”
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى إسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَابِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ أْرَأْيْتَ صَلاَةَ ٱلْعِيدَيْنِ هَلْ فِيهِمَا أَذَانْ وَ
إقَامَةٌ قَالَ «لَيْسَ فِيهِمَا أَذَانٌ وَ لاَ إِقَامَةٌ وَ لَكِنْ يُنَادَى الصَّلَاَةَ الصَّلاَةَ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ وَ لَيْسَ فِيهِمَا مِنْبَرُ الْمِثْبَرُ لا
يُحَوَّلُ مِنْ مَوْضِعِهِ وَ لَكِنْ يُصْنَعُ لِلْإِمَامِ شَيْءُ شِبْهُ ٱلْمِنْبَرِ مِنْ طِينٍ فَيَقُومُ عَلَيْهِ فَيَخْطُبُ ٱلنَّاسَ ثُمَّ يَنْزِلُ».
٢٧ - باب صلاة الكسوف

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE ECLIPSE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Al-Abbas ibn Ma’ruf, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id,
from Abdillah ibn Amr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Jamil, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about the earthquake (al-zalzalah).
Imam {a.s} said: “My father {a.s} informed me from his father {a.s}, from his forefathers {a.s},
peace be upon them, who said that the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, said:
‘Indeed, when Dhul-Qarnayn reached the barrier, he passed beyond it and entered
into the darkness. There he came upon an angel standing, whose height was five
hundred cubits.
The angel said to him: “O Dhul-Qarnayn, was there no path behind you?”
Dhul-Qarnayn said to him: “And who are you?”
He (the angel) replied: “I am an angel from the angels of the All-Merciful, appointed
over this mountain. There is no mountain that Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic, has
created except that it has a root connected to this mountain. So when Allah {SWT},
Mighty and Majestic, wills to shake a city, He {AZJ} reveals to me, and I shake it.”
text_ar:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ
عَمْرِو عَنْ حَمَادِ بْنِ عُثمَانَ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الزَّلزَلَةِ فَقَالَ «أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي
عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلامُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ «إِنَّ ذَا الْقَرْنَيْنِ لَمَّا اِنْتَهَى إِلَى السَّدَّ
جَاوَرَهُ فَدَخَلَ فِي الظُلْمَةِ فَإِذَا هُوَ بِمَلَكِ قَائِمِ طُولُهُ خَمْسُمَائَةِ ذِرَاعٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ ٱلْمَلَكْ يَا ذَا الْقَرْنَيْنِ أَ مَا كَانَ خَلْفَكَ
مَسْلَكْ فَقَالَ لَهُ ذُو ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ وَ مَنْ أَنْتَ قَالَ أَنَا مَلَكْ مِنْ مَلائِكَةِ الرَّحْمَنِ مُوَكَّلٌ بِهَذَا الْجَبَلِ وَ لَيْسَ مِنْ جَبَلٍ خَلَقَهُ
اللهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ إِلَّ وَ لَهُ عِرْقٌ إِلَى هَذَا الْجَبَلِ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ اللهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَنْ يُزَلْزِلَ مَدِينَةً أَوْحَى إِلَيَّ فَزَلْزَلْتُهَا» ».
cross_references: Tafsir Al-’Ayyashi, Vol.2 p.350 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.290 • Tafsir Al-Burhan, Vol.3 p.671 • Tafsir Nur Al-Thaqalayn, Vol.3 p.304 • Tafsir Kanz Al-Daqaiq, Vol.8 p.165
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Al-Abbas ibn Ma’ruf, from Ali ibn Mahziyar, from Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id,
from Abdillah ibn Amr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Jamil, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about the earthquake (al-zalzalah).
Imam {a.s} said: “My father {a.s} informed me from his father {a.s}, from his forefathers {a.s},
peace be upon them, who said that the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, said:
‘Indeed, when Dhul-Qarnayn reached the barrier, he passed beyond it and entered
into the darkness. There he came upon an angel standing, whose height was five
hundred cubits.
The angel said to him: “O Dhul-Qarnayn, was there no path behind you?”
Dhul-Qarnayn said to him: “And who are you?”
He (the angel) replied: “I am an angel from the angels of the All-Merciful, appointed
over this mountain. There is no mountain that Allah {SWT}, Mighty and Majestic, has
created except that it has a root connected to this mountain. So when Allah {SWT},
Mighty and Majestic, wills to shake a city, He {AZJ} reveals to me, and I shake it.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE ECLIPSE
text_en:
From him, from Ali ibn al-Sindi, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The prayer of ‘al-Kusuf’ (prayer of eclipse) is an obligation
(fardh).”
text_ar: عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ السِّنْدِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَ قَالَ: «صَلاَةُ الْكُسُوفِ فَرِيضَةٌ».
cross_references: Al-Muqni’ah, Vol.1 p.209 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.290 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1370 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.484 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.484 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.485 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.88 p.164

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE ECLIPSE
text_en:
From him, from Ali ibn Khalid, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from
Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “If you pray the eclipse prayer (al-kusuf) until the eclipse of the
sun or the moon passes, and you prolong your prayer, then that is better.
But if you wish to pray and finish your prayer before the eclipse ends, that is
permissible.
And if you did not know until the eclipse ended, then you came to know after that, there
is no eclipse prayer (due upon you).
And if someone informed you while you were asleep, and you became aware, then
sleep overcame you and you did not pray, then you must make it up.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدِ عَنْ مُصَدَّقٍ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارٍ
عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ قَالَ: «إِنْ صَلَّيْتَ الْكُسُوفَ إِلَى أَنْ يَذْهَبَ الْكُسُوفُ عَنِ الشَّمْسِ وَ الْقَمَرِ وَ تُطَوِّلُ
فِي صَلاَتِكَ فَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ أَفْضَلُ وَ إِنْ أَحْبَبْتَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ فَتَفْرُغَ مِنْ صَلاتِكَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَذْهَبَ الْكُسُوفُ فَهُوَ جَائِزٌ وَ إِنْ
لَمْ تَعْلَمْ حَتَّى يَذْهَبَ الْكُسُوفُ ثُمَّ عَلِمْتَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ صَلَاَةُ الْكُسُوفِ وَ إِنْ أَعْلَمَكَ أَحَدٌ وَ أَنْتَ نَائِمٌ
فَعَلِمْتَ ثُمَّ غَلَبَثكَ عَيْنُكَ فَلَمْ تُصَلِّ فَعَلَيْكَ قَضَاؤُهَا».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.291 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1370

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE ECLIPSE
text_en:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Al-Hajjaj, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Abu Abdillah
{a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
We mentioned the eclipse of the moon and what the people suffer from its intensity.
So Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “If any part of it becomes uncovered,
then it has become uncovered.”
(meaning the eclipse is considered ‘finished’ when a part of it gets ‘uncovered’)
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ الْحَجَّالِ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: ذَكَرْنَا اِنْكِسَافَ
الْقَمَرِ وَ مَا يَلْقَى النَّاسَ مِنْ شِدَّتِهِ قَالَ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «إِذَا اِنْجَلَى مِنْهُ شَيْءَ فَقَدِ اِنْجَلَى».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.291 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1371 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.488

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE ECLIPSE
text_en:
From him, from a group of our companions, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Ali ibn al-Fadl al-
Wasiti, who said:
I wrote to Imam al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him, (asking) “If the sun or the moon is
eclipsed while I am riding, and I am unable to dismount?”
So Imam {a.s} wrote back to me: “Pray on your mount which you are on.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ عِدَّةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ عَنْ عَلِيَ بْنِ الْفَضْلِ الْوَاسِطِيَ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إلَى الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَامُ إِذَا اِنْكَسَفَتِ الشَّمْسُ وَ ٱلْقَمَرُ وَ أَنَا رَاكِبٌ لا أَقْدِرُ عَلَى النُزُولِ قَالَ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيَّ «صَلَّ عَلَى مَرْكَبِكَ آلَّذِي أَنْتَ
عَلَيْهِ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE ECLIPSE
text_en:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi, from Abu al-Bakhtari, from
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Indeed, Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, prayed during the
solar eclipse; two rak‘ahs with four prostrations and four bowings.
He {a.s} stood and recited, then bowed, then raised his head and recited again, then
bowed, then stood and supplicated (like in his first rak‘ah), then prostrated twice.
Then He {a.s} stood and did the same as he did in the first rak‘ah in his recitation,
standing, bowing, and prostration all of it equally.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدِ الْبَرْقِيّ عَنْ أَبِي الْبَخْتَرِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : «أَنَّ عَلِيّا
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ صَلَّى فِي كُسُوفِ الشَّمْسِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ فِي أَرْبَعِ سَجَدَاتٍ وَ أَرْبَعِ رَكَعَاتٍ قَامَ فَقَرَأَ ثُمَّ رَكَعَ ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ
فَقَرَأ ثُمَّ رَكَعَ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَدَعَا مِثْلَ رَكْعَتِهِ ثُمَّ سَجَدَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَفَعَلَ مِثلَ مَا فَعَلَ فِي الْأُولَى فِي قِرَاءَتِهِ وَ
قِيَامِهِ وَ رُكُوعِهِ وَ سُجُودِهِ سَوَاءً».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.291 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.452 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1376 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.493

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE ECLIPSE
text_en:
From him, from Bunan ibn Muhammad, from Al-Muhassin ibn Ahmad, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “The moon was eclipsed, so my father
(Imam al-Baqir {a.s}) went out, and I went out with him to the ‘Sacred Mosque’,
And He {a.s} prayed eight rak‘ahs, like how one prays with a rak‘ah and two
prostrations.”

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “What we act upon is what we have presented earlier,
that the prayer of ‘al-Kusuf’ (prayer of eclipse) is ten rak‘ahs and four prostrations,
according to the detailed explanation we have given.
And the interpretation of these two reports is taqiyya (dissimulation), because they are
in agreement with the school of some of the general public (‘ammah, non-Shia).”
What confirms what we have presented is what was narrated:
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ بُنَانِ بْنِ مُحَمّدٍ عَنِ الْمُحَسِّنِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «اِنْكَسَفَ
اَلْقَمَرُ فَخَرَجَ أَبِي وَ خَرَجْتُ مَعَهُ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ فَصَلَّى ثَمَانَ رَكَعَاتٍ كَمَا يُصَلِّي رَكْعَةً وَ سَجْدَتَيْنِ».
قال محمد بن الحسن: الذي نعمل عليه هو ما قدمناه من أن صلاة الكسوف عشر ركعات وأربع سجدات على التفصيل الذي
بيناه، والوجه في هذين الخبرين التقية لانهما موافقان لمذهب بعض العامة ، والذي يؤكد ما قدمناه ما رواه:

in agreement with the school of some of the general public (‘ammah, non-Shia).”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE ECLIPSE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Ali ibn Ya'qub al-Hashimi, from
Marwan ibn Muslim, from Ibn Abi Ya'fur, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “If the sun or the moon is eclipsed, and the entire body is
eclipsed, then it is proper for the people to hasten to an imam (of prayer) so that he
may pray with them.
And if either of them is partially eclipsed, then it suffices for a man to pray alone.
And the prayer of ‘al-Kusuf’ (prayer of eclipse) is ten rak‘ahs and four prostrations.
The eclipse of the sun is more severe upon the people and the animals.”
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ ٱلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ الْهَاشِمِيِّ عَنْ مَرْوَانَ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنِ
اِبْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا اِنْكَسَفَتِ الشَّمْسُ وَ الْقَمَرُ فَانْكَسَفَ كُلُهَا فَإِنَّهُ يَنْبَغِي لِلنَّاسِ
أَنْ يَفْزَّعُوا إِلَى إِمَامِ لِيُصَلِّيَ بِهِمْ وَ أَيْهُمَا كَسَفَ بَعْضُهُ فَإِنَّهُ يُجْزِي الرَّجُلَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ وَحْدَهُ وَ صَلاَةُ الْكُسُوفِ عَشَرُ
رَكَعَاتٍ وَ أَرْبَعُ سَجَدَاتٍ كُسُوفُ الشَّمْسِ أَشَدُ عَلَى النَّاسِ وَ الْبَهَائِمِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.292 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1368
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Ali ibn Ya'qub al-Hashimi, from
Marwan ibn Muslim, from Ibn Abi Ya'fur, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “If the sun or the moon is eclipsed, and the entire body is
eclipsed, then it is proper for the people to hasten to an imam (of prayer) so that he
may pray with them.
And if either of them is partially eclipsed, then it suffices for a man to pray alone.
And the prayer of ‘al-Kusuf’ (prayer of eclipse) is ten rak‘ahs and four prostrations.
The eclipse of the sun is more severe upon the people and the animals.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE ECLIPSE
text_en:
From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Kufi, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal, from Ghalib ibn Uthman, from
Rawh ibn Abd al-Rahim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the eclipse prayer, whether it is
prayed in congregation.
Imam {a.s} said: “In congregation and not in congregation.”
(meaning whichever that you wish)
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ الْكُوفِيِّ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ غَالِبِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ رَوْحِ بْنِ عَبْدِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ - عَنْ صَلاَةِ الْكُسُوفِ تُصَلَّى جَمَاعَةً قَالَ «جَمَاعَةً وَ غَيْرَ جَمَاعَةٍ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.292 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1368 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.503
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE ECLIPSE
text_en:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Husayn, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, from his father, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace
be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The sun was eclipsed while I was in the bath, and I came to
know about it after I came out, so I did not make it up.”
text_ar:
عَثهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلَامُ قَالَ: «اِنْكَسَفَتِ الشَّمْسُ وَ أَنَا
فِي اَلْحَمَّامِ فَعَلِمْتُ بَعْدَ مَا خَرَجْتُ فَلَمْ أَقْضٍ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.292 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.453 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1380 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.501
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
text_chunk:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Husayn, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, from his father, from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace

Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The sun was eclipsed while I was in the bath, and I came to
know about it after I came out, so I did not make it up.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE ECLIPSE
text_en:
From him, from Ahmad, from Musa ibn al-Qasim and Abu Qatadah, from Ali ibn Ja’far, from his brother Imam
Musa ibn Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon them both, who said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} about the eclipse prayer, and whether one who misses it
must make it up.
Imam {a.s} said: “If you missed it, then there is no make-up (qadah) upon you.”

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “We have already clarified the explanation regarding
reports of this kind, and in summary; if the entire disc (of the sun or moon) is eclipsed,
then making up the eclipse prayer (qadah) is obligatory upon the one who missed it.
But if the entire disc is not eclipsed and one misses the prayer, then there is no
obligation to make it up.
There is no contradiction among the reports. Nor does this contradict what was
narrated by Ammar al-Sabati in the report we previously mentioned, in which he said
that making up the prayer becomes necessary for one who was informed (of the
eclipse) and still did not pray until the eclipse passed.
The interpretation of that narration is that it applies when part of the disc is eclipsed
and a person deliberately delayed the prayer then, in that case, he must make it up.
We have only waived the obligation of making it up for the one, who was entirely
unaware of the partial eclipse.
Based on this, the reports are consistent and not contradictory.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ وَ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا ٱلسَّلَاَمُ
قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَلَاةِ الْكُسُوفِ وَ هَلْ عَلَى مَنْ تَرَكَهَا قَضَاءُ قَالَ «إِذَا فَاتَثكَ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْكَ قَضَاءً».
قال محمد بن الحسن : قد بينا الوجه في أمثال هذين الخبرين وجملته انه إذا احترق القرص كله يجب القضاء على من
فاتته صلاة الكسوف، وان لم يحترق كله وفاتته لم يكن عليه قضاء، ولا تنافي بين الاخبار، ولا ينافي هذا ما رواه عمار
الساباطي في الخبر الذي قدمناه من قوله : انه انما يلزم القضاء على من اعلم فلم يصل حتى فاتته ، لان الوجه في هذه
الرواية أن تحملها على انه إذا احترق بعض القرص وتوانى عن الصلاة فحينئذ لزمه قضاؤها ، ونحن انما اسقطنا القضاء
عمن لم يعلم باحتراق بعض القرص أصلا وعلى هذا تلائمت الاخبار ولم تختلف.
commentary:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “We have already clarified the explanation regarding
reports of this kind, and in summary; if the entire disc (of the sun or moon) is eclipsed,
then making up the eclipse prayer (qadah) is obligatory upon the one who missed it.
But if the entire disc is not eclipsed and one misses the prayer, then there is no
obligation to make it up.
There is no contradiction among the reports. Nor does this contradict what was
narrated by Ammar al-Sabati in the report we previously mentioned, in which he said
that making up the prayer becomes necessary for one who was informed (of the
eclipse) and still did not pray until the eclipse passed.
The interpretation of that narration is that it applies when part of the disc is eclipsed
and a person deliberately delayed the prayer then, in that case, he must make it up.
We have only waived the obligation of making it up for the one, who was entirely
unaware of the partial eclipse.
Based on this, the reports are consistent and not contradictory.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE ECLIPSE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Ja’far ibn Muhammad, from Abdillah ibn
Maymun al-Qaddah, from Imam Ja’far {a.s}, from his father {a.s}, from his forefathers, peace be upon them,
who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The sun was eclipsed during the time of the Messenger of
Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family,
so He {saws} led the people in two rak‘ahs, and He {saws} prolonged (the prayer) until some
of the people behind him lost consciousness, due to the length of the standing.”
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بَنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ مَيْمُونِ ٱلْقَدَّاحِ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ
أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ السِّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «اِنْكَسَفَتِ الشَّمْسُ فِي زَمَنِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ فَصَلَّى بِالنَّاسِ
رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَطَوَّلَ حَتَّى غُشِيَ عَلَى بَعْضِ الْقَوْمِ مِمَّنْ كَانَ وَرَاءَهُ مِنْ طُولِ الْقِيَامِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.293 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1366 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.498
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Ja’far ibn Muhammad, from Abdillah ibn
Maymun al-Qaddah, from Imam Ja’far {a.s}, from his father {a.s}, from his forefathers, peace be upon them,
who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The sun was eclipsed during the time of the Messenger of
Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family,
so He {saws} led the people in two rak‘ahs, and He {saws} prolonged (the prayer) until some
of the people behind him lost consciousness, due to the length of the standing.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE ECLIPSE
text_en:
Ahmad from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The time for the eclipse prayer is at the hour when the eclipse
occurs, at sunrise and at sunset.
He (narrator) said: “And Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: ‘It is an obligation
(faridah)’.”
text_ar:
احمد بن عن ابن ابي عمير عن جميل بن دراج عن ابي عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام قال : وقت صلاة الكسوف في
الساعة التي تنكسف عند طلوع الشمس وعند غروبها قال : وقال أبو عبد اللّٰه عليه السلام : هي فريضة.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.293 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1367 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.491
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Ahmad from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The time for the eclipse prayer is at the hour when the eclipse
occurs, at sunrise and at sunset.
He (narrator) said: “And Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: ‘It is an obligation
(faridah)’.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE ECLIPSE
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Saeed from al-Nadr from Asim from Abu Basir who said:
The moon was eclipsed while I (Abu Basir) was with Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon
him, in the Month of Ramadan.
So Imam {a.s} leapt up and said: “It used to be said: ‘When the moon and the sun are
eclipsed, then hasten to your mosques’.”
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ عَنِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: اِنْكَسَفَ الْقَمَرُ وَ أَنَا عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ
فِي شَهْرٍ رَمَضَانَ قَوَثَبَ وَ قَالَ «إِنَّهُ كَانَ يُقَالُ إِذَا اِنْكَسَفَ الْقَمَرُ وَ الشَّمْسُ فَافْزَعُوا إِلَى مَسَاجِدِكُمْ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.293 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1367 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.491
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Al-Husayn ibn Saeed from al-Nadr from Asim from Abu Basir who said:
The moon was eclipsed while I (Abu Basir) was with Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon
him, in the Month of Ramadan.
So Imam {a.s} leapt up and said: “It used to be said: ‘When the moon and the sun are
eclipsed, then hasten to your mosques’.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE ECLIPSE
text_en:
Al-Husayn ibn Saeed from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Abu Ayyub Ibrahim ibn Uthman from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace
be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about the eclipse prayer before the sun sets, and we fear
missing the obligatory prayer.
So Imam {a.s} said: “Cut it off, perform the obligatory prayer, and then return to your
eclipse prayer.”
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُوبَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُثِمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنْ صَلَاةِ الْكُسُوفِ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَغِيبَ الشَّمْسُ وَ نَخْشَى فَوْتَ الْفَرِيضَةِ فَقَالَ «اقْطَعُوهَا وَ صَلُوا الْفَرِيضَةَ وَ عُودُوا
إِلَى صَلاَتِكُمْ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.293 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1368 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.490
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

So Imam {a.s} said: “Cut it off, perform the obligatory prayer, and then return to your

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE ECLIPSE
text_en:
From him, from Safwan, from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Sabati, from Imam al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him,
who said:
I asked Imam al-Ridha {a.s} about the eclipse prayer, whether it is to be performed in
congregation or individually.
Imam {a.s} said: “Whichever of the two you wish.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفَوَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى السَابَاطِيَ عَنِ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ الْكُسُوفِ تُصَلَّى
جَمَاعَةً أَوْ فُرَادَى فَقَالَ «أيَّ ذَلِكَ شِئْتَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.294 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1368 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.503
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Ridha {a.s}
text_chunk:
From him, from Safwan, from Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Sabati, from Imam al-Ridha {a.s}, peace be upon him,
who said:
I asked Imam al-Ridha {a.s} about the eclipse prayer, whether it is to be performed in
congregation or individually.
Imam {a.s} said: “Whichever of the two you wish.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE ECLIPSE
text_en:
Ahmad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Basir who said:
I asked Imam {a.s} about the eclipse prayer.
Imam {a.s} said: “Ten rak‘ahs and four prostrations.
In each rak‘ah you recite like Surah ‘Yasin’ and Surah ‘al-Nur’, and your bowing (rukuh)
should be like your recitation, and your prostration (sujud) like your bowing.”
I asked: “What about someone, who does not know Surah ‘Yasin’ and similar
(surahs)?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Then let him recite sixty verses in each rak‘ah. When he raises his head
from bowing, he should not recite Surah ‘al-Fatiha’.”
Imam {a.s} said: “If he forgets it or was asleep, then let him make it up (qadah).”
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَلاةِ الْكُسُوفِ فَقَالَ «عَشَرُ رَكَعَاتٍ
وَ أَرْبَعُ سَجَدَاتٍ تَقْرَأَ فِي كُلّ رَكْعَةِ مِثْلَ يَاسِينَ وَ النُورِ وَ يَكُونُ رُكُوعُكَ مِثْلَ قِرَاءَتِكَ وَ سُجُودُكَ مِثلَ رُكُوعِكَ»
قُلْتُ فَمَنْ لَمْ يُحْسِنْ يَاسِينَ وَ أَشبَاهَهَا قَالَ «فَلْيَقْرَأُ سِتّينَ آيَةً فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ فَإِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُكُوعِ فَلاَ يَقْرَأ
بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ » قَالَ «فَإِنْ أَغْفَلَهَا أَوْ كَانَ نَائِماً فَلْيَقْضِهَا».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.294 • Al-Wafi, Vol.9 p.1375 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.7 p.493

Imam {a.s} said: “Ten rak‘ahs and four prostrations.
In each rak‘ah you recite like Surah ‘Yasin’ and Surah ‘al-Nur’, and your bowing (rukuh)
should be like your recitation, and your prostration (sujud) like your bowing.”
I asked: “What about someone, who does not know Surah ‘Yasin’ and similar
(surahs)?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Then let him recite sixty verses in each rak‘ah. When he raises his head
from bowing, he should not recite Surah ‘al-Fatiha’.”
Imam {a.s} said: “If he forgets it or was asleep, then let him make it up (qadah).”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE ECLIPSE
text_en:
Ali ibn Mahziyar narrated:
I wrote to Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, and complained to Imam {a.s} about the
frequent earthquakes in Ahwaz, and I asked:
‘Do you see that I should relocate from it (Ahwaz)?’
So Imam {a.s}, peace be upon him, wrote:
“Do not relocate from it. Fast on Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday, and perform ghusl,
purify your clothes, go out on Friday, and supplicate to Allah {SWT}, for indeed He {AZJ} will
repel it from you.”
He (Ali ibn Mahziyar) said: “So we did (as Imam {a.s} said), and the earthquakes
subsided.”
text_ar:
وَ رَوَى عَلِيْ بْنُ مَهْزِيَارَ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ وَ شَكَوْتُ إِلَيْهِ كَثِرَةَ ٱلزَّلازِلِ فِي الْأَهْوَازِ وَ قُلْتُ
تَرَى لِيَ التَّحَوْلَ عَنْهَا فَكَتَبَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «لا تَتَحَوِّلُوا عَنْهَا وَ صُومُوا الْأَرْبِعَاءَ وَ الْخَمِيسَ وَ الْجُمُعَةَ وَ اِغْتَسِلُوا وَ
طَهُرُوا ثِيَابَكُمْ وَ أُبْرُزُوا يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَ أُدْعُوا اللَّهَ فَإِنَّهُ يَدْفَعُ عَنْكُمْ» قَالَ فَفَعَلْنَا فَسَكَنَتِ ٱلزَّلاَزِلُ.
٨٥٥٥

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OF THE ECLIPSE
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Hammad al-Kufi from Muhammad ibn Khalid from
Ubaydullah ibn al-Husayn from Ali ibn al-Husayn from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah from Ibn Yaqtin who said:
Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “Whoever is struck by an earthquake, let
him recite: ‘O’ He who holds the heavens and the earth lest they cease to be, and if
they were to cease, none could hold them after Him. Indeed, He is Forbearing,
Forgiving” (Surah Fatir 35:41).
Send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and the family of Muhammad {saws},
and withhold from us harm. Indeed, You are capable of all things (Surah Aal Imran
3:26).”
Imam {a.s} also said: “Indeed, whoever recites it at bedtime, the house will not collapse
upon him, Allah {a.s} willing.”
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَمَّادِ الْكُوفِيِّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ
بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْرَةَ عَنِ اِبْنِ يَقْطِينٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ : «مَنْ أَصَابَثَهُ زَلْزَلَةً فَلْيَقْرَأ
يَا مَن «يُمْسِكُ السّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضَ أَنْ تَزُولا وَ لَئِنْ زُالَتَا إِنْ أَمْسَكَهُمَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ حَلِيما غَفُوراً» صَلَّ
عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدِ وَ أَمْسِكْ عَنَّا السُوءَ «إِنّكَ عَلى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ» » قَالَ «إِنَّ مَنْ قَرَأَهَا عِنْدَ النَّوْمِ لَمْ يَسْقُطْ
عَلَيْهِ اَلْبَيْتُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللهُ تَعَالَى».
٢٨ - باب الصلاة في السفينة

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER IN THE SHIP
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad by al-Husayn by al-Nadr and Fadalah by Abdullah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah {a.s}:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s}: “About the obligatory prayer on a ship while he is able to
reach land, except that he fears wild beasts and thieves. And he is with people whose
opinion is not united on going out and they do not obey him.
And should he place his face (on the ground) when he prays, or gesture with signs, or
pray sitting, or standing?”
Imam {a.s} said: “If he is able to pray standing, that is better. And if he is not able, then
let him pray sitting.”
And Imam {a.s} said: “There is no blame upon him for not going out (to land), for my
father (Imam al-Baqir {a.s}) was asked about a similar matter by a man, and Imam {a.s}
said: ‘Do you turn away from the prayer of Nuh {a.s}?’”
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمِّدٍ عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ النَّضْرِ وَ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ
عَنْ صَلاَةِ الْفَرِيضَةِ فِي السَّفِينَةِ وَ هُوَ يَجِدُ ٱلْأَرْضَ يَخْرُجُ إِلَيْهَا غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ يَخَافُ السَّبْعَ وَ اللُّصُوصَ وَ يَكُونُ مَعَهُ
قَوْمٌ لا يَجْتَمِعُ رَأْيُهُمْ عَلَى الْخُرُوجِ وَ لا يُطِيعُونَهُ وَ هَلْ يَضَعُ وَجْهَهُ إِذَا صَلَّى أَوْ يُومِئُ إِيمَاءَ أَوْ قَاعِداً أَوْ قَائِماً
فَقَالَ «إِنِ اِسْتَطَاعَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ قَائِماً فَهُوَ أَفْضَلُ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ صَلَّى جَالِسا» وَ قَالَ «لا عَلَيْهِ أَنْ لا يَخْرُجَ فَإِنَّ
أَبِي سَأَلَهُ عَنْ مِثْلِ هَذِهِ الْمَسْأَلَةِ رَجُلْ فَقَالَ «أَ تَرْغَبُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ نُوحِ » ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER IN THE SHIP
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn al-Sindi from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Jamil ibn Darraj who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about prayer on a ship.
Imam {a.s} said: “A man came to my father (Imam al-Baqir {a.s}) and asked him, saying: 'I
am on a ship and the shore (al-jadd) is near to me, so I go out and pray on it.'”
Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, said to him: “Are you not content to pray with the
prayer of Nuh {a.s}, peace be upon him?”
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ السِّنْدِيِّ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ بْنِ دَرَّاجِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ
عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ الصَّلاةِ فِي السَّفِينَةِ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ رَجُلاً أَتَى أَبِي فَسَأَلَهُ فَقَالَ إِنَّي أَكُونُ فِي السَّفِينَةِ وَ ٱلْجَدَدُ مِنِّي
قَرِيباً فَأَخْرُجُ فَأُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «أَ مَا تَرْضَى أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ بِصَلاةِ نُوحِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلامُ»».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.295 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.529 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.507
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al- Baqir {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER IN THE SHIP
text_en:
Al-Husayn from Fadalah from Mu‘awiyah ibn Ammar who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about prayer on a ship.
Imam {a.s} said: “You face the qiblah with your face, then you pray however it (ship)
turns. You pray standing, and if you are not able, then pray sitting.
He may combine the prayers in it if he wishes, and he may pray on felt (al-qir) and
coarse cloth (al-qufr), and prostrate on it.”
text_ar:
الْحُسَيْنُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الصَّلاةِ فِي السِّفِينَةِ فَقَالَ
«تَسْتَقْبِلُ الْقِبْلَةَ بِوَجْهِكَ ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي كَيْفَ دَارَثْ تُصَلِّي قَائِماً فَإِنْ لَمْ تَسْتَطِعْ فَصَلَّ جَالِساً يَجْمَعُ الصَّلاَةَ فِيهَا إِنْ
أَرَادَ وَ يُصَلِّي عَلَى الْقِيرِ وَ ٱلْقُفْرِ وَ يَسْجُدُ عَلَيْهِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.295 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.529 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.506
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER IN THE SHIP
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother
al-Husayn from their father Ali ibn Yaqtin who said:
I asked Abu al-Hasan al-Madi (Imam al-Kadhim {a.s}), peace be upon him, about a man
who is on a ship. May he place mats upon luggage, or cotton, or straw, or wheat, or
barley, and the like, then pray upon it?
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no harm.”
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيَّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينِ عَنْ أَخِيهِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلِيَّ
بَنِ يَقْطِينِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا الْحَسَنِ ٱلْمَاضِيَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَلاَمُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَكُونُ فِي السّفِينَةِ هَلْ لَهُ أَنْ يَضَّعَ ٱلْحُصُرَ عَلَى
الْمَتَاعِ أَوِ الْقَتّ أَوِ التَّبْنِ أَوِ الْجِنْطَةِ أَوِ الشَّعِيرِ وَ أَشبَاهِهِ ثُمَّ يُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.296 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.530
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER IN THE SHIP
text_en:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Ja’far ibn Bashir from Salih ibn al-Hakam who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about prayer on a ship.
Imam {a.s} said: “A man asked my father (Imam al-Baqir {a.s}) about prayer on a ship, and
Imam {a.s} said to him:
‘Do you turn away from the prayer of Nuh {a.s}, peace be upon him?’”
So I asked the Imam {a.s}: “Shall I take with me a clod of earth to prostrate on?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Yes.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ
الصَّلاةِ فِي السَّفِينَةِ فَقَالَ «إِنَّ رَجُلاً سَأَلَ أَبِي عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ فِي السَّفِينَةِ فَقَالَ لَهُ «أَ تَرْغَبُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ نُوحِ عَلَيْهِ
السَلاَمُ» » فَقُلْتُ لَهُ آخْذُ مَعِي مَدَرَةً أُسْجُدُ عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَ »نَعَمْ».

source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al- Baqir {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER IN THE SHIP
text_en:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Alawi from al-Amraki al-Bufaki from Ali ibn Ja’far from his brother
Imam Musa ibn Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon them both, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The people of the ships perform the prayer in full in their
ships.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ الْعَلَوِيِّ عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيِّ الْبُوفَكِيّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَجِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا
السَّلَاَمُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ: «أَصْحَابُ السُّفُنِ يُتِمُّونَ الصَّلاَةَ فِي سُفُنِهِمْ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.296 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.167 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.486
source_scholar: Abu al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kadhim {a.s} & Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al- Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Alawi from al-Amraki al-Bufaki from Ali ibn Ja’far from his brother
Imam Musa ibn Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon them both, from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER IN THE SHIP
text_en:
From him, from al-Abbas from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira from Ya‘qub ibn Shu‘ayb from Abu Abdillah {a.s},
peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “There is no harm in praying in congregation on a ship.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لا بَأْسَ
بالصَّلاَةٍ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ فِي السَّفِينَةِ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER IN THE SHIP
text_en:
From him, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Alawi from al-‘Amraki al-Bufaki from Ali ibn Ja’far from Imam
Musa ibn Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon them both, who said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} about a group of people, who prayed in congregation on a
ship, where does the imam (of prayer) stand?
And if there are women with them, how should they proceed? Should they pray
standing or sitting?
Imam {a.s} said: “They pray standing, and if they are unable to stand, they pray sitting
(all of them).
The imam (of prayer) stands in front of them, and the women are behind them. And if
the ship is narrow, the women sit and the men pray, and there is no harm if the women
are beside them.”
And I asked Imam {a.s} about a man whose belongings were taken or drowned, and he
remained naked, and the time for prayer arrived. How should he pray?
Imam {a.s} said: “If he finds grass (or vegetation) with which he can cover his private
parts, he should then complete his prayer with bowing and prostration.
And if he does not find anything to cover his private parts, he should gesture while
standing.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ الْعَلَوِيِّ عَنِ الْعَمْرَكِيّ الْبُوفَكِيّ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السِّلَاَمُ
قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ قَوْمِ صَلَّوا جَمَاعَةً فِي سَفِينَةِ أَيْنَ يَقُومُ ٱَلْإِمَامُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مَعَهُمْ نِسَاءُ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُونَ أَقِيَاماً يُصَلُونَ
أم جُلُوساً قَالَ «يُصَلُونَ قِيَاماً فَإِنْ لَمْ يَقْدِرُوا عَلَى الْقِيَامِ صَلَّوْا جُلُوساً هُمْ وَ يَقُومُ ٱلْإِمَامُ أَمَامَهُمْ وَ النِّسَاءُ خَلْفَهُمْ
وَ إِنْ ضَاقَتِ السَّفِينَةُ قَعَدْنَ ٱلنَّسَاءُ وَ صَلَّى الرِّجَالُ وَ لا بَأْسَ أَنْ تَكُونَ ٱلنَّسَاءُ بِحِيَالِهِمْ» وَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجْلٍ قُطِعَ
عَلَيْهِ أَوْ غَرِقَ مَتَاعُهُ فَبَقِيَ عُرْيَاناً وَ حَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ كَيْفَ يُصَلِّي قَالَ «إِنْ أَصَابَ حَشِيشا يَسْتُرُ بِهِ عَوْرَتَهُ أَنَمَ
صَلاَتَهُ بِالرُّكُوعِ وَ السُّجُودِ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يُصِبُ شَيْئاً يَسْتُرُ بِهِ عَوْرَتَهُ أُوْمَى وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.296

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER IN THE SHIP
text_en:
As for what was narrated by Sahl ibn Ziyad from Abu Hashim al-Ja’fari, who said:
I was with Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, on a ship in the ‘Tigris River’, and the
time for prayer arrived.
So I asked: “May I be your ransom, shall we pray in congregation?”
Imam {a.s} said: “Do not pray in congregation in the bottom of a valley.”

Scholar's Note:
This does not contradict what we have presented earlier of reports, regarding the
permissibility of congregational prayer on a ship, because this report is to be
understood as referring to a matter of dislike (karahah), or a situation in which it is not
possible to establish the order required for congregation, while it may be possible to
do so individually.
What clarifies what we presented earlier regarding the permissibility of congregational
prayer on a ship is what has been narrated:
text_ar:
فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ سَهْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَبِي هَاشِمِ الْجَعْفَرِيّ قَالَ: كُنْتُ مَعَ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ فِي السّفِينَةِ فِي دِجْلَةَ
فَحَضَرَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَقُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ نُصَلَّي فِي جَمَاعَةٍ فَقَالَ «لا تُصَلَّ فِي بَطنٍ وَادٍ جَمَاعَةً».
فلا ينافي ما قدمناه من الاخبار في جواز الجماعة في السفينة لان هذا الخبر محمول على ضرب من الكراهية أو حال لا
يمكن فيها القيام على الاجتماع ويمكن ذلك على الانفراد، والذي يبين ما قدمناه من جواز الجماعة في السفينة ما رواه:
commentary:
This does not contradict what we have presented earlier of reports, regarding the
permissibility of congregational prayer on a ship, because this report is to be
understood as referring to a matter of dislike (karahah), or a situation in which it is not
possible to establish the order required for congregation, while it may be possible to
do so individually.
What clarifies what we presented earlier regarding the permissibility of congregational
prayer on a ship is what has been narrated:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER IN THE SHIP
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from his father from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, and Ayyub ibn Nuh from Abdullah ibn
al-Mughira, who said: Uyaynah narrated to me from Ibrahim ibn Maymun:
(Ibn Maymun) asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about prayer in
congregation, on a ship.
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no harm.”
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ وَ أَيُوبَ بْنِ نُوحِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ ٱلْمُغِيرَةِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُيَيْنَةُ عَنْ
إبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَيْمُونِ : أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلامُ عَنِ الصَّلاةِ فِي جَمَاعَةٍ فِي السَّفِينَةِ فَقَالَ «لا بَأْسَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.297 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.440 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.530 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.322 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.8 p.427

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER IN THE SHIP
text_en:
Ali from his father from Ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked about prayer on a ship.
Imam {a.s} said: “He should face the qiblah, and when it (ship) turns, if he is able to
reorient himself toward the qiblah, then let him do so; otherwise, let him pray in the
direction the ship is facing.”
Imam {a.s} said: “If he is able to stand, then let him pray standing; otherwise, let him sit
and then pray.”
text_ar:
عَلِي عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثُمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ قَالَ: إِنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ الصَّلاةِ فِي
السَّفِينَةِ فَقَالَ «يَسْتَقْبِلُ الْقِبْلَةَ فَإِذَا دَارَثْ فَاسْتَطَاعَ أَنْ يَتَوَجَّهَ إِلَى الْقِبْلَةِ فَلْيَفْعَلْ وَ إِلا فَلْيْصَلَ حَيْثُ تَوَجَّهَتْ بِهِ»
قَالَ «فَإِنْ أَمْكَنَهُ ٱلْقِيَامُ فَلْيُصَلَ قَائِما وَ إِلاَّ فَلْيَقْعُذْ ثُمَّ لْيُصَلّ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.441 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.297 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.527 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.322
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER IN THE SHIP
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Yunus ibn Ya‘qub who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about the obligatory prayer on a ship
while it is moving east and west.
Imam {a.s} said: “Face the qiblah, then say the takbir, then follow the ship and turn with
it wherever it turns with you.”
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَالٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَنِ
الصَّلَةِ الْمَكْتُوبَةِ فِي السَّفِينَةِ وَ هِيَ تَأْخُذُ شَرْقاً وَ غَرْباً فَقَالَ «اِسْتَقْبِلِ الْقِبْلَةَ ثُمَّ كَبَّرْ ثُمَّ اِثْبَعِ السَّفِينَةَ وَدُرْ مَعَهَا
حَيْثُ دَارَتْ بِكَ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.297 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.532
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER IN THE SHIP
text_en:
Ahmad from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, about prayer in the Euphrates and in
rivers weaker than it, while on a ship.
Imam {a.s} said: “If you pray (on the ship), it is good, and if you go out (to pray on land),
it is good also.”
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ الْمُفَضَّلِ بْنِ صَالِحِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ فِي
الْفُرَاتِ وَ مَا هُوَ أَضْعَفُ مِنْهُ مِنْ الْأَنْهَارِ فِي السِّفِينَةِ فَقَالَ «إِنْ صَلَّيْتَ فَحَسَنْ وَ إِنْ خَرَجْتَ فَحَسَنْ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.298 • Al-Wafi, Vol.7 p.532 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.321 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.4 p.322 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.5 p.506
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Ahmad from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from al-Mufaddal ibn Salih who said:

Imam {a.s} said: “If you pray (on the ship), it is good, and if you go out (to pray on land),

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER IN THE SHIP
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother al-Husayn from their father Ali ibn
Yaqtin from Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Kadhim {a.s} about the ship, if its rider is not able to stand, should he
pray while sitting, gesturing, or prostrating?
Imam {a.s} said: “He should stand, even if he bends his back.”

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “This report is to be understood as applying when he
is able to do so. But if he is not able, then it is permissible for him to suffice with praying
while sitting and with gesturing (ima), as we have explained.”
This is also confirmed by what was narrated:
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينِ عَنْ أَخِيهِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ يَقْطِينِ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ السَّفِينَةِ لَمْ يَقْدِرْ صَاحِبُهَا عَلَى الْقِيَامِ أَيُصَلِّي وَ هُوَ جَالِسٌ يُومِئ أَوْ يَسْجُدُ قَالَ «يَقُومُ وَ
إِنْ حَنَى ظَهْرَهُ ».
قال محمد بن الحسن: هذا الخبر محمول على انه إذا تمكن منه ، فأما إذا لم يتمكن منه جاز ان يقتصر على الصلاة جالسا
وعلى الايماء على ما بيناه ويؤكد ذلك أيضا ما رواه:
commentary:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “This report is to be understood as applying when he
is able to do so. But if he is not able, then it is permissible for him to suffice with praying
while sitting and with gesturing (ima), as we have explained.”
This is also confirmed by what was narrated:
