author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OVER THE DEAD
text_en:
From him, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Abu Hammam Isma'il ibn Hammam from
Muhammad ibn Sa'id from Ghazwan from al-Sakuni from Imam Ja’far {a.s}, from his father {a.s}, from his
forefathers, peace be upon them, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The Messenger of Allah {SWT}, peace be upon him and his
family, said: ‘Pray over the one who was stoned to death (rajm) from my nation, and
over the one who killed himself (suicide) from my nation.
Do not leave anyone from my nation without the funeral prayer.’”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ أَبِي هَمّامٍ إسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ هَمّامٍ عَنْ مُحَمّدِ بْنِ سَعِيدِ عَنْ غَزْوَانَ عَنِ
السَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ : «صَلُوا عَلَى
اَلْمَرْجُومِ مِنْ أَمَّتِي وَ عَلَى الْقَتَّالِ نَفْسَهُ مِنْ أَمَّتِي لا تَدَعُوا أَحَداً مِنْ أَمَّتِي بِلاَ صَلاةٍ».

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OVER THE DEAD
text_en:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Khalid ibn Madd al-
Qalanisi from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Baqir {a.s} about a man who is eaten by a wild beast or a bird, and only
his bones remain, without flesh. What should be done with him?
Imam {a.s} said: “He should be washed, shrouded, prayed over, and buried. And if the
deceased is in two halves, the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) should be performed over the
half that contains his heart.”
text_ar:
سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ سُوَيْدِ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَادَ ٱلْقَلاَنِسِيَّ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَأْكُلُهُ السَّبْعُ أَو الطَّيْرُ فَتَبْقَى عِظَامُهُ بِغَيْرِ لَحْمِ كَيْفَ يُصْنَعُ بِهِ قَالَ «يُغَسَّلُ وَ يُكَفَّنُ
وَ يُصَلِّى عَلَيْهِ وَ يُدْفَنُ فَإِذَا كَانَ الْمَيَّتُ نِصْفَيْنِ صُلِّيَ عَلَى النَّصْفِ الّذِي فِيهِ قَلْبُهُ».
cross_references: Masa’il Ali Ibn Ja’far, Vol.1 p.212 • Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.212 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.1 p.336 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.329 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.489 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.136
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}
text_chunk:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Nadr ibn Suwayd from Khalid ibn Madd al-
Qalanisi from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
I asked Imam al-Baqir {a.s} about a man who is eaten by a wild beast or a bird, and only
his bones remain, without flesh. What should be done with him?
Imam {a.s} said: “He should be washed, shrouded, prayed over, and buried. And if the
deceased is in two halves, the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) should be performed over the
half that contains his heart.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OVER THE DEAD
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Yahya from al-Amraki al-Bufaki from Ali ibn Ja’far from his brother
Imam Musa ibn Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon them both: the same as that.

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OVER THE DEAD
text_en:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Talhah ibn Zayd:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The funeral prayer is not performed over a limb of a man,
whether a leg, or a hand, or a head, when it is separate (from the body).
But if the body is present, then pray over it, even if it is missing the head, the hand, and
the leg.” (meaning the body containing the heart)
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السِّلاَمُ أُنَّهُ
قَالَ: «لا يُصَلَّى عَلَى عُضْوِ رَجُلٍ مِنْ رِجْلِ أَوْ يَدِ أَوْ رَأْسِ مُنْفَرِداً فَإِذَا كَانَ ٱلْبَدَنُ فَصَلَ عَلَيْهِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ نَاقِصاً مِنَ
الرَّأْسِ وَ الْيَدِ وَ الرِّجْلِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.329 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.491 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.136
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OVER THE DEAD
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Abu al-Jarrah Talhah ibn
Zayd from al-Fadl ibn Uthman al-A‘war from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} was asked regarding a man who is killed and his head is found in
one tribe (away from the body).
Imam {a.s} said: “His blood money (diyah) is upon the tribe in which his chest and his
hands are found, and the funeral prayer is performed over him.” (meaning the place
where the chest is found)
text_ar:
أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ مَعْرُوفٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْجَرّاحِ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدِ عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ عُثمَانَ
اَلْأَعْوَرِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ : فِي الرَّجُلِ يُقْتَلُ فَيُوجَدُ رَأْسُهُ فِي قَبِيلَةٍ قَالَ «دِيَتُهُ عَلَى مَنْ وُجِدَ فِي
قَبِيلَتِهِ صَدْرُهُ وَ يَدَاهُ وَ الصَّلاَةُ عَلَيْهِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.329
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OVER THE DEAD
text_en:
Sa’ad ibn Abdillah from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Sindi ibn al-Rabi' from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Nasr
from his father from Jamil ibn Darraj from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Baqir {a.s} said: “If a person is killed and only flesh, without bone, is found. Then
the funeral prayer is not performed over him. But if bone is found without flesh, the
funeral prayer is performed over him.”
text_ar:
سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ٱلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ السِّنْدِيَّ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ عَنْ عَلِيَّ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَمِيلٍ
بْنِ دَرَّاجٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا قُتِلَ قَتِيلٌ فَلَمْ يُوجَدْ إِلَّ لَحْمٌ بِلاَ عَظْمِ لَمْ
يُصَلّ عَلَيْهِ فَإِنْ وُجِدَ عَظْمٌ بِلاَ لَحْمِ صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.212 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.1 p.336 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.329 • Al- Wafi, Vol.24 p.490 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.136

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OVER THE DEAD
text_en:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khasshab from Ghiyath ibn Kallub al-
Bajali from Ishaq ibn Ammar from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Indeed, Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, found parts of a
dead body, so they were gathered, then He {a.s} performed the funeral prayer over them,
then they were buried.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُوسَى الْخَشَّابِ عَنْ غِيَاتِ بْنِ كَلُوبِ الْبَجَلِيِّ عَنْ إسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ
أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ : «أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ وَجَدَ قِطَعاً مِنْ مَيَّتِ فَجُمِعَتْ ثُمَّ صَلَّى عَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ دُفِنَتْ)).
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.167 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.1 p.337 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.329 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.492 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.135
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Amir al-Mu’minin Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib al-Murtadha {a.s}
text_chunk:
From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khasshab from Ghiyath ibn Kallub al-

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OVER THE DEAD
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Muhammad ibn Khalid from Khalaf ibn Hammad from Abdillah ibn
Sinan from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “When Adam {a.s}, peace be upon him, died and the time came
to pray over him, Hibatullah (his son) said to Jibra'il {a.s}, peace be upon him: 'Step
forward, O’ Messenger (angel) of Allah {SWT}, and perform the prayer over the Prophet of
Allah {SWT}.'
So Jibra'il {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “Indeed, Allah {SWT} commanded us to prostrate
to your father (Adam {a.s}), so we do not go ahead of the righteous among his children,
and you are among the most righteous of them.”
So Hibatullah stepped forward and said takbir over him (Adam {a.s}) five times, equal to
the number of the prayers which Allah {SWT} has made obligatory upon the nation of
(Prophet) Muhammad {saws}, and this became the ongoing sunnah among his children
(Children of Adam {a.s}) until the Day of Resurrection.”
text_ar:
أحمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ خَلَفٍ بْنِ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لَمَّا مَاتَ آدَمُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فَبَلَغَ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ هِبَةُ اللَّهِ لِجَبْرَئِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ تَقَدَّمْ يَا رَسُولَ
اللَّهِ فَصَلَّ عَلَى نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ جَبْرَئِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَمَرَنَا بِالسُّجُودِ لأَبِيكَ قَلَسْنَا نَتَقَدَّمُ عَلَى أُبْرَارِ وُلْدِهِ وَ
أَنْتَ مِنْ أَبَرِّهِمْ فَتَقَدَّمَ فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً عِدَّةَ الصَّلاَةِ الَّتِي فَرَضَهَا اللّهُ عَلَى أَمّةِ مُحَمِّدٍ وَ هِيَ السُّنَّةُ الْجَارِيَةُ فِي
وُلْدِهِ إلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ».
cross_references: Man La Yahduruhu Al-Faqih, Vol.1 p.163 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.416 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.76 • Bihar Al-Anwar, Vol.11 p.260

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OVER THE DEAD
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Amr ibn Sa’id al-Mada'ini from
Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar ibn Musa al-Sabati from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about the prayer over the deceased.
Imam {a.s} said: “You say takbir, then you say:
‘Indeed, we belong to Allah {SWT}, and indeed to Him {AZJ} we return.
Indeed, Allah {SWT} and His {AZJ} angels send blessings upon the Prophet {saws}.
O’ you who have believed, send blessings upon him and greet him with peace.
O’ Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and the family of
Muhammad {saws},
And bless Muhammad {saws} and the family of Muhammad {saws}, just as You {AZJ} sent
blessings and bestowed blessings upon Ibrahim {a.s} and the family of Ibrahim {a.s}.
Indeed, You {AZJ} are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
O’ Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon Muhammad {saws} and upon the leaders of the
Muslims (meaning Imams {a.s}).
O’ Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon Muhammad {saws} and upon the Imam {a.s} of the
Muslims.
O’ Allah {SWT}, Your servant ‘so-and-so’ (the deceased) and You {AZJ} know him best.
O’ Allah {SWT}, join him with his Prophet Muhammad {saws}, may Allah {SWT} send blessings
upon him and his family,
And make spacious for him his grave, And illuminate it for him, And raise his soul,
And prompt him with his proof, And make what is with You {AZJ} better for him.
And return him to better than what he was in.
O’ Allah {SWT}, with You {AZJ} we count him, so do not deprive us of his reward and do not
test us after him.
O’ Allah {SWT}, Your pardon, Your pardon.’
(Imam {a.s} then continued) “You say all of this in the first takbir, then you say the second
takbir and you say:
‘O’ Allah {SWT}, Your servant ‘so-and-so’ (the deceased),
O’ Allah {SWT}, join him with his Prophet Muhammad {saws}, may Allah {SWT} send blessings
upon him and his family,
And make spacious for him his grave, And illuminate it for him, And raise his soul,
And prompt him with his proof, And make what is with You {AZJ} better for him,
And return him to better than what he was in.
O’ Allah {SWT}, with You {AZJ} we count him, so do not deprive us of his reward.
And do not test us after him.
O’ Allah {SWT}, Your pardon, O’ Allah {SWT}, Your pardon.’
(Imam {a.s} then continued) “You say this in the second, third, and fourth takbir.
Then when you say the fifth takbir, say:
‘O’ Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and the family of
Muhammad {saws}.
O’ Allah {SWT}, forgive the believing men and believing women.
O’ Allah {SWT}, unite their hearts and cause me to die upon the religion of Your
Messenger {saws}.
O’ Allah {SWT}, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith, and do not place in
our hearts any resentment toward those who have believed.
Our Lord {AZJ}, indeed You {AZJ} are Kind and Merciful.
O’ Allah {SWT}, Your pardon, O’ Allah {SWT}, Your pardon.’
And you give the final salutation.”
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدِ الْمَدَائِنِيّ عَنْ مُصَدَّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ
عَمَّارِ بْنِ مُوسَى السَّابَاطِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَألْتُهُ عَنِ الصَّلاَةِ عَلَى الْمَيَّتِ فَقَالَ «تُكَبِّرُ ثُمَّ تَقُولُ
«إِنَّا لِلهِ وَ إِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ» «إِنَّ اللهَ وَ مَلائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُونَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ يَا أَيُهَا آلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا صَلُوا عَلَيْهِ وَ سَلَّمُوا تَسْلِيما»
اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ بَارِك عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ وَ بَارَكْتَ عَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدِ وَ عَلَى أَئِمَّةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَى إِمَامِ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ اللَّهُمَّ
عَبْدُكَ فُلانْ وَ أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ اللَّهُمَّ الْحِقْهُ بِنَبِيِّهِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ اِفْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ وَ نَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ وَ
صَعَّدْ رُوحَهُ وَ لَقَّنْهُ حَجَّتَهُ وَ اِجْعَلْ مَا عِنْدَكَ خَيْراً لَهُ وَ اِرْجِعْهُ إِلَى خَيْرٍ مِمَّا كَانَ فِيهِ اللَّهُمَّ عِنْدَكَ نَحْتَسِبُهُ فَلاَ
تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ وَ لا تَفْتِنَّا بَعْدَهُ اللَّهُمَّ عَفْوَكَ عَفْوَكَ تَقُولُ هَذَا كُلّهُ فِي التَّكْبِيرَةِ الْأُولَى ثُمَّ تَكَبَّرُ الثَّانِيَةَ وَ تَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ
عَبْدُكَ فُلاَنٌ اللَّهُمَّ أَلْحِقْهُ بِنَبِيِّهِ مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ اِفْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ وَ نَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ وَ صَعَدْ رُوحَهُ وَ لَقَّنْهُ
حُجَتَهُ وَ اِجْعَلْ مَا عِنْدَكَ خَيْراً لَهُ وَ اِرْجِعَهُ إِلَى خَيْرٍ مِمَّا كَانَ فِيهِ اللَّهُمَّ عِنْدَكَ نَحْتَسِبُهُ فَلا تَحْرِمْنَا أَجْرَهُ وَ لا تَفْتِنَّا
بَعْدَهُ اَللَّهُمَّ عَفْوَكَ اللَّهُمَّ عَفْوَكَ تَقُولُ هَذَا فِي الثَّانِيَةِ وَ الثَالِثَةِ وَ الرَّابِعَةِ فَإِذَا كَبَّرْتَ الْخَامِسَةَ فَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى
مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدِ اللّهُمَّ اِغْفِرْ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ الْمُؤْمِنَاتِ اَللَّهُمَّ أُلَّف بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَ تَوَفَّنِي عَلَى مِلَّةٍ رَسُولِكَ اَللَّهُمَّ «اِغْفِزْ
لَنَا وَ لِإِخْوَانِنَا الَّذِينَ سَبَقُونًا بِالْإِيمَانِ وَ لا تَجْعَلْ فِي قُلُوبِنَا غِلاَّ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا رَبَّنا إِنَّكَ رَؤُفٌ رَجِيمٌ» اللَّهُمَّ عَفْوَكَ
اللَّهُمّ عَفْوَكَ وَ تُسَلَّمُ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.330 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.455 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.65
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from Amr ibn Sa’id al-Mada'ini from
Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar ibn Musa al-Sabati from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
I asked Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} about the prayer over the deceased.
Imam {a.s} said: “You say takbir, then you say:
‘Indeed, we belong to Allah {SWT}, and indeed to Him {AZJ} we return.
Indeed, Allah {SWT} and His {AZJ} angels send blessings upon the Prophet {saws}.
O’ you who have believed, send blessings upon him and greet him with peace.
O’ Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and the family of
Muhammad {saws},
And bless Muhammad {saws} and the family of Muhammad {saws}, just as You {AZJ} sent
blessings and bestowed blessings upon Ibrahim {a.s} and the family of Ibrahim {a.s}.
Indeed, You {AZJ} are Praiseworthy, Glorious.
O’ Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon Muhammad {saws} and upon the leaders of the
Muslims (meaning Imams {a.s}).
O’ Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon Muhammad {saws} and upon the Imam {a.s} of the
Muslims.
O’ Allah {SWT}, Your servant ‘so-and-so’ (the deceased) and You {AZJ} know him best.
O’ Allah {SWT}, join him with his Prophet Muhammad {saws}, may Allah {SWT} send blessings
upon him and his family,
And make spacious for him his grave, And illuminate it for him, And raise his soul,
And prompt him with his proof, And make what is with You {AZJ} better for him.
And return him to better than what he was in.
O’ Allah {SWT}, with You {AZJ} we count him, so do not deprive us of his reward and do not
test us after him.
O’ Allah {SWT}, Your pardon, Your pardon.’
(Imam {a.s} then continued) “You say all of this in the first takbir, then you say the second
takbir and you say:
‘O’ Allah {SWT}, Your servant ‘so-and-so’ (the deceased),
O’ Allah {SWT}, join him with his Prophet Muhammad {saws}, may Allah {SWT} send blessings
upon him and his family,
And make spacious for him his grave, And illuminate it for him, And raise his soul,
And prompt him with his proof, And make what is with You {AZJ} better for him,
And return him to better than what he was in.
O’ Allah {SWT}, with You {AZJ} we count him, so do not deprive us of his reward.
And do not test us after him.
O’ Allah {SWT}, Your pardon, O’ Allah {SWT}, Your pardon.’
(Imam {a.s} then continued) “You say this in the second, third, and fourth takbir.
Then when you say the fifth takbir, say:
‘O’ Allah {SWT}, send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and the family of
Muhammad {saws}.
O’ Allah {SWT}, forgive the believing men and believing women.
O’ Allah {SWT}, unite their hearts and cause me to die upon the religion of Your
Messenger {saws}.
O’ Allah {SWT}, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith, and do not place in
our hearts any resentment toward those who have believed.
Our Lord {AZJ}, indeed You {AZJ} are Kind and Merciful.
O’ Allah {SWT}, Your pardon, O’ Allah {SWT}, Your pardon.’
And you give the final salutation.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OVER THE DEAD
text_en:
From him, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from Imam Ja’far {a.s} from his forefathers
{a.s}, peace be upon them, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “A child inherits and the funeral prayer is performed over him
if he falls from his mother's womb (birth) and cries aloud.
But if he does not cry aloud (stillborn), he is neither inherited from nor is the funeral
prayer performed over him.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمِ عَنِ النَّوْفَلِيِّ عَنِ السَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: «يُورَثُ الصِّبِيُّ وَ
يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ إِذَا سَقَطَ مِنْ بَطْنِ أُمِّهِ فَاسْتَهَلَ صَارِحاً وَ إِذَا لَمْ يَسْتَهِلَّ صَارِحًا لَمْ يُوَرَّثْ وَ لَمْ يُصَلَّ عَلَيْهِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.331 • Al-Wafi, Vol.25 p.500 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.97

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OVER THE DEAD
text_en:
From him, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from a man from Abu al-Hasan al-Madi {a.s} said:
I said to Imam {a.s}: “For how old is a child prayed over (for Salat Al Mayyit), if he has
reached a certain number of years or months?”
Imam {a.s} said: “The funeral prayer is performed over him in every case, unless he is
miscarried before completion (birth).”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الْمَاضِي عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ لِكَمْ يُصَلَّى عَلَى الصَّبِيِّ إِذَا
بَلَغَ مِنَ السَّنِينَ وَ الشُّهُورِ قَالَ «يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ عَلَى كُلِّ حَالٍ إِلَّ أَنْ يَسْقُطَ لِغَيْرِ تَمَامٍ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.331 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.480 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.481 • Al-Wafi, Vol.25 p.500 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.97 • Wasa’il Al-Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.97

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OVER THE DEAD
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin from his brother al-Husayn ibn Ali ibn Yaqtin:
I asked Abu al-Hasan {a.s}, peace be upon him: “For how old is a child prayed over (for
Salat Al Mayyit), if he has reached a certain number of years and months?”
Imam {a.s} said: “The funeral prayer is performed over him in every case, unless he is
miscarried before completion (birth).”

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “The meaning of these reports is the same as what we
have mentioned earlier in the report of Abdillah ibn Sinan.”
text_ar:
احمد بن محمد عن الحسن بن علي بن يقطين عن اخيه الحسين بن علي بن يقطين قال : سألت ابا الحسن ع
لكم يصلى على الصبي إذا بلغ من السنين والشهور؟ قال : يصلى عليه على كل حال إلا أن يسقط لغير تمام.
قال محمد بن الحسن : المعنى في هذه الاخبار ما قدمناه في خبر عبد اللّٰه ابن سنان سواء.
commentary:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “The meaning of these reports is the same as what we
have mentioned earlier in the report of Abdillah ibn Sinan.”
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.331

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OVER THE DEAD
text_en:
Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Hadid and Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran from Hurayz from Zurarah:
I said to Abu Ja’far {a.s}, peace be upon him: “May a woman lead women in prayer?”
Imam {a.s} said: “No, except over the deceased, if there is no one more appropriate than
her (to lead the prayer). She stands in the middle of them in the (same) row with them,
and says the takbir, and they say the takbir.”
text_ar:
احمد بن محمد عن علي بن حديد وعبد الرحمن بن ابي نجران عن حريز عن زرارة قال : قلت لابي جعفر
عليه السلام المرأة تؤم النساء؟ قال : لا إلا على الميت إذا لم يكن أحد أولى منها تقوم وسطهن في الصف معهن
فتكبر ويكبرن.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.331
source_scholar: Abu Ja’far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir {a.s}

Imam {a.s} said: “No, except over the deceased, if there is no one more appropriate than

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OVER THE DEAD
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ya‘qub from Ali ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Shirah from Muhammad ibn Sulayman from
Husayn al-Marjusi from Hisham, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him:
“The people speak to us and refute our statement that the funeral prayer is not
performed over the child because he did not pray, and they ask (us):
‘The funeral prayer is only for one who has prayed?.’
So we say: ‘Yes.’
Then they ask (us): ‘What do you say if a Christian or Jew embraces Islam and then dies
immediately, what is the ruling in his case?’”
Imam {a.s} said: “Say to them:
‘What do you say if someone embraces Islam just now and then slanders a person,
would the prescribed punishment (hadd) be obligatory upon him for his slander?’
They will say (to you): ‘The hadd is obligatory upon him.’
Then say to them: ‘What if this child, who did not pray, were to slander a person. Would
the hadd be obligatory upon him?’
They will say: ‘No.’
Then say to them: ‘You have (now) spoken the truth. The funeral prayer is only
obligatory for the one upon whom the prayer and the hadd are obligatory, and it is not
performed for the one upon whom neither the prayer nor the hadd are obligatory.’”
text_ar:
مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيّ بْنِ شِيرَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ حُسَيْنِ الْمَرْجُوسِ عَنْ هِشَامٍ
قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ إِنَّ النَّاسَ يُكَلَّمُونًا وَ يَرُدُّونَ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلَنَا إِنَّهُ لا يُصَلَّى عَلَى الطَّفْلِ لِأَنَّهُ لَمْ
يُصَلِّ فَيَقُولُونَ لا يُصَلَّى إِلاَّ عَلَى مَنْ صَلَّى فَتَقُولُ نَعَمْ فَيَقُولُونَ أَ رَأَيْثُمْ لَوْ أَنَ رَجْلاً نَصْرَانِيّاً أَوْ يَهُودِيَا أَسْلَمَ ثُمَّ
مَاتَ مِنْ سَاعَتِهِ فَمَا الْجَوَابُ فِيهِ فَقَالَ «قُولُوا لَهُمْ أرَأْيْتَ لَوْ أَنَّ هَذَا الَّذِي أُسْلَمَ ٱلسَاعَةَ ثُمَّ اِفْتَرَى عَلَى إِنْسَانٍ
هَلْ كَانَ يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِ فِي فِرْبَتِهِ فَإِنَّهُمْ سَيَقُولُونَ يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِ الْحَدُّ فَإِذَا قَالُوا هَذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ فَلَوْ أَنَّ هَذَا الصِّبِيَّ الَّذِي
لَمْ يُصَلِّ اِفْتَرَى عَلَى إِنْسَانٍ هَلْ كَانَ يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِ الْحَدُّ فَإِنَّهُمْ سَيَقُولُونَ لاَ فَيْقَالُ لَهُمْ صَدَقْتُمْ إِنَّمَا يَجِبُ أَنْ يُصَلَّى
عَلَى مَنْ وَجَبَتْ عَلَيْهِ الصَّلَاَةُ وَ الْحَدُ وَ لا يُصَلِّى عَلَى مَنْ لَمْ تَجِبْ عَلَيْهِ الصَّلاَةُ وَ لاَ الْحُدُودُ».
cross_references: Al-Kafi, Vol.3 p.209 • Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.332 • Al-Wafi, Vol.25 p.495 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.100

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OVER THE DEAD
text_en:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Abu Ja’far from his father from Wahb ibn Wahb from Imam Ja’far {a.s}
from his father {a.s}, peace be upon them both:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him
and his family, prayed over a funeral.
When Prophet {saws} finished, a group of people came to Him {saws} and said:
‘O’ Messenger of Allah {SWT}, we did not catch the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) over it.’
Prophet {saws} said: ‘The funeral is not prayed over twice, but you may supplicate for it
(the deceased)’.”
text_ar:
مُحَمِّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ وَهْبِ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيِهِ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلامُ : «أَنَّ
رَسُولَ اللّهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ صَلَّى عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ جَاءَهُ أُنَاسْ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللّهِ لَمْ نُدْرِكِ الصَّلاَةَ
عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَ «لا يُصَلَّى عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ مَرَّتَيْنٍ وَ لَكِنِ أُدْعُوا لَهَا» ».

source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s} & Abu al-Qasim Prophet Muhammad ibn Abdullah {saws}
text_chunk:
Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Abu Ja’far from his father from Wahb ibn Wahb from Imam Ja’far {a.s}
from his father {a.s}, peace be upon them both:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah {SWT}, may Allah {SWT} bless him
and his family, prayed over a funeral.
When Prophet {saws} finished, a group of people came to Him {saws} and said:
‘O’ Messenger of Allah {SWT}, we did not catch the prayer (Salat Al Mayyit) over it.’
Prophet {saws} said: ‘The funeral is not prayed over twice, but you may supplicate for it
(the deceased)’.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OVER THE DEAD
text_en:
From him, from Harun ibn Muslim from Mas'adah ibn Sadaqah from Imam Ja’far {a.s} from his forefathers {a.s},
peace be upon them:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “Indeed, Imam Ali {a.s}, peace be upon him, did not wash
Ammar ibn Yasir nor Hashim ibn Utbah, who was al-Mirqal. He {a.s} buried them in their
clothes with their blood,”
And did not perform the funeral prayer over them.”

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “What this narration includes that the Commander of
the Faithful {a.s}, peace be upon him, ‘did not pray over them’ is from the narrator, not
the critic. We have already clarified the obligation of the funeral prayer over martyrs.
And it is possible that the reason for this (narration) is that the general public (the non-
Shia) report this from the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, so this
(narration) came in agreement with them.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ مُسْلِمِ عَنْ مَسْعَدَةَ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ آبَائِهِ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلاَمُ : «أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ لَمْ
يُغَسِّلْ عَمَّارَ بْنَ يَاسِرٍ وَ لا هَاشِمَ بْنَ عُثْبَةَ وَ هُوَ ٱلْمِرْقَالُ دَفَنَهُمَا فِي ثِيَابِهِمَا بِدِمَائِهِمَا وَ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمَا».
قال محمد بن الحسن: ما تضمن هذا الحديث من ان أمير المؤمنين ع لم يصل عليهما وهم من الرواي لا ناقد بينا وجوب
الصلاة على الشهداء، ويجوز أن يكون الوجه فيه ان العامة يروون عن أمير المؤمنين ع ذلك فخرج هذا موافقا لهم.

And it is possible that the reason for this (narration) is that the general public (the non-
Shia) report this from the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, so this
(narration) came in agreement with them.”

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OVER THE DEAD
text_en:
Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Faddal from Muhammad ibn Ali from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim
from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, from his father {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam {a.s} said: “There is no funeral prayer over a bier, that has a woman with it.”

Scholar's Note:
Muhammad ibn al-Hasan said: “The meaning of this report is that there is no superior
or meritorious prayer, not that it is not a valid or sufficient prayer. This is because we
have already clarified the permissibility of women praying over the funeral.”
What further clarifies this is what has been narrated:
text_ar:
عَلِي بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيَّ عَنْ مُحَمِّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ غِيَاتِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ
السَّلَامُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ: قَالَ: «لا صَلاَةَ عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ مَعَهَا اِمْرَأَةٌ».
قال محمد بن الحسن : الوجه في هذا الخبر انه لا صلاة فاضلة دون أن يكون المعنى فيه لا صلاة مجزية ، لا نا قد بينا
جواز صلاة النساء على الجنازة ، ويزيد ذلك بيانا ما رواه:

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OVER THE DEAD
text_en:
Ali ibn al-Hasan from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Najran and Sindi ibn Muhammad and Muhammad ibn al-Walid,
all from Asim ibn Humayd from Yazid ibn Khalifah, who said:
I was with Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, when a man from the people of Qumm
asked Imam {a.s} and said:
“O’ Abu Abdillah, do women pray over the deceased?”
So Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, said: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah {SWT},
may Allah {SWT} bless him and his family, had declared the blood of al-Mughirah ibn Abi
al-As to be lawfully shed,” and Imam {a.s} narrated a long hadith,
“and indeed, Zaynab the daughter of the Prophet {saws}, may Allah {SWT} bless him and his
family, passed away, and (Sayyidah) Fatimah {s.a}, peace be upon her, went out with her
women and prayed over her sister.”
text_ar:
عَلِي بْنُ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرِّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ وَ سِنْدِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ جَمِيعاً عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ حُمَيْدٍ
عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ خَلِيفَةً قَالَ: كُنْتُ عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَاَمُ فَسَأْلَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقُمِّيِّينَ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ تُصَلِّي
النَّسَاءُ عَلَى الْجَنَائِزِ قَالَ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ «إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ كَانَ هَدَرَ دَمَ الْمُغِيرَةِ
بْنِ أَبِي الْعَاصِ » وَ حَدَّثَ حَدِيثاً طَوِيلاً «وَ إِنَّ زَيْنَبَ بِئْتَ النَّبِيِّ صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ تُوُفِّيَتْ وَ إِنَّ فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا
السّلاَمُ خَرَجَتْ فِي نِسَائِهَا فَصَلَّتْ عَلَى أُخْتِهَا».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.333 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.485 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.409

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OVER THE DEAD
text_en:
From him, from al-Abbas ibn Amir from Abu al-Mi'za from Sama'ah from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah {a.s},
peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “It is not appropriate for a young woman to go out to a funeral
to pray over it, unless she is a woman who has reached a older age.”
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنِ ٱلْعَبَّاسِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْمِعْزَى عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «لَيْسَ
يَنْبَغِي لِلْمَرْأَةِ الشَّابَّةِ أَنْ تَخْرُجَ إِلَى الْجِنَازَةِ تُصَلِّي عَلَيْهَا إِلَّ أَنْ تَكُونَ اِمْرَأَةَ قَدْ دَخَلَتْ فِي السِّنَّ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.333 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.486 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.409 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.139
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}
text_chunk:
From him, from al-Abbas ibn Amir from Abu al-Mi'za from Sama'ah from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah {a.s},

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OVER THE DEAD
text_en:
Ali ibn al-Hasan from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa’id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar al-
Sabati from Abu Abdillah {a.s}, peace be upon him, who said:
Imam al-Sadiq {a.s} said: “The deceased may be prayed over, as long as he has not been
covered with soil (in his grave), even if the prayer has already been performed over
him.”
text_ar:
عَلِي بْنُ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدِ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةَ عَنْ عَمَّارِ السَابَاطِيّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ
اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «الْمَيِّتُ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ مَا لَمْ يُوَارَ بِالتُّرَابِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ قَدْ صُلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ».
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.334 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.484 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.472 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.86
source_scholar: Abu Abdillah Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq {a.s}

Ali ibn al-Hasan from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa’id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar al-

author: Shaykh al-Tusi
chapter_title: THE PRAYER OVER THE DEAD
text_ar:
عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْجَنَازَةِ لَمْ أَدْرِكْهَا
حَثَّى بَلَغَتِ الْقَبْرَ أَصَلَّي عَلَيْهَا قَالَ «إنْ أَدرَكْتَهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تُدْفَنَ فَإِنْ شِئْتَ فَصَلَ عَلَيْهَا».
تمت الزيادات والحمد لله رب العالمين وصلاته على خيرته من خلقه محمد وآله الطيبين الطاهرين وصلى اللّٰه على سيدنا
محمد واله الطاهرين وسلم تسليما،
والحمد لله أعز وجل أرب العالمين
التجميع الإنجليزي للجزء الثالث - الطبعة الأولى [2025] من كتاب
'"تهذيب الأحكام" قد اكقل، من تأليف
الشيخ السعيد أبو جعفر محمد بن الحسن الطوسي،
قدس اللّٰه روحه ونور اللّٰه قبره
نقدم جهودنا في هذا التجميع في خدمة إمامنا الزمان، الإمام محمد بن الحسن
المهدي؛ القائم؛ الحجة؛ المنتظر؛ الخلف الصالح؛ الموعود؛ بقية الله؛ صاحب الزمان
وأسلافه المعصومين. والحمد لله رب العالمين،
والصلاة والسلام على سيدنا النبي محمد وعلى ذريته الطاهرة،
وخليفته أمير المؤمنين الإمام علي بن أبي طالب
هنا نختتم كلمتنا في هذا الجزء الثالث - الطبعة الأولى [2025]،
والحمد لله أعز وجل أرب العالمين
اللَّهُمَّ صَلّ عَلى فاطِمَةَ وَأَبِيهَا وَتَعْلِهَا وَبَنِيهَا وَالسّرِّ المُسْتَوْدَعِ فِيهَا بِعَدَدِ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ
يَا الله. يا اللهُ. يا الله. يا اللهُ. يا الله. يا الله. يا اللهُ
رَمَّنَا آيِنَا في الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةَ وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَاب النَّارِ - بحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآل مُحَمَّدٍ
commentary:
The additions are complete, and praise be to Allah {SWT}, the Lord {AZJ} of the worlds, and
His {AZJ} blessings upon His {AZJ} chosen ones from among His {AZJ} creation;
(Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and his pure, purified family (Ahlulbayt {a.s}).
And may Allah {SWT} send blessings upon our master (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and his
purified family (Ahlulbayt {a.s}), and grant them abundant peace.
cross_references: Tahdib Al-Ahkam, Vol.3 p.334 • Al-Istibsar, Vol.1 p.484 • Al-Wafi, Vol.24 p.472 • Wasa’il Al- Shi’ah, Vol.3 p.86

رَمَّنَا آيِنَا في الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةَ وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَاب النَّارِ - بحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآل مُحَمَّدٍ
commentary:
The additions are complete, and praise be to Allah {SWT}, the Lord {AZJ} of the worlds, and
His {AZJ} blessings upon His {AZJ} chosen ones from among His {AZJ} creation;
(Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and his pure, purified family (Ahlulbayt {a.s}).
And may Allah {SWT} send blessings upon our master (Prophet) Muhammad {saws} and his
purified family (Ahlulbayt {a.s}), and grant them abundant peace.
